articles.title: Where Does Language Originate in the Brain? New Research Challenges Our 150-Year-Old Understanding

paras.en: For roughly 150 years, scientists have thought that a brain region called Wernicke’s area, located just above the left ear, was solely responsible for understanding spoken and written language. That’s because in the 1870s, German neurologist Carl Wernicke noticed that people with damage to that area struggled to comprehend words. Speech production, on the other hand, was believed to stem from a separate place called Broca’s area, near the left temple.
paras.zh: 大约 150 年来，科学家们一直认为位于左耳上方、称为韦尼克区的大脑区域唯一负责理解口语和书面语言。这是因为在 1870 年代，德国神经学家 Carl Wernicke 注意到该区域受损的人难以理解单词。另一方面，人们认为言语的产生源于左太阳穴附近一个名为布罗卡区的独立地方。

paras.en: However, individuals with damage to Wernicke’s area sometimes also spoke in fluent-sounding gibberish, talking in what’s described as “word salad,” perplexing researchers. Now, one team may have figured out why: Wernicke’s area actually pulls double duty, helping both process speech and produce it. The findings, published in the journal Science on November 19, rewrite our understanding of how the brain constructs language and can help scientists develop technologies that restore speech.
paras.zh: 然而，韦尼克区受损的人有时也会说一些听起来很流利的胡言乱语，被称为“单词沙拉”，这让研究人员感到困惑。现在，一个团队可能已经找到了原因：韦尼克的区域实际上担负着双重职责，既帮助处理言语，又帮助产生言语。该研究结果发表在 11 月 19 日的《科学》杂志上，重写了我们对大脑如何构建语言的理解，并可以帮助科学家开发恢复言语的技术。

paras.en: To conduct the study, scientists recruited 28 people undergoing brain surgery for epilepsy. Researchers implanted grids of either 128 or 256 electrodes in their heads to record the activity of nerve cells, or neurons. Then, the participants—who remained awake during the operation—repeated and listened to words and sentences.
paras.zh: 为了进行这项研究，科学家招募了 28 名接受脑部癫痫手术的人。研究人员在他们的头部植入了 128 个或 256 个电极网格，以记录神经细胞或神经元的活动。然后，在手术过程中保持清醒的参与者重复并聆听单词和句子。

paras.en: “What we saw was not what the textbook predicted,” said study co-author Edward Chang, a neurosurgeon at the University of California, San Francisco (UCSF), at a press briefing, reports Allison Parshall for Scientific American.
paras.zh: 据《科学美国人》艾莉森·帕歇尔报道，该研究的共同作者、加州大学旧金山分校 (UCSF) 的神经外科医生爱德华·张 (Edward Chang) 在新闻发布会上表示：“我们所看到的并不是教科书所预测的。”

paras.en: Neurons in a nickel-size part of Wernicke’s area fired as the patients listened to speech, and, surprisingly, about one-fourth of a second before they spoke. Activity strength in the subzone, called the left posterior superior temporal gyrus (lpSTG), depended on the complexity and length of the word.
paras.zh: 当患者听讲话时，韦尼克区域镍币大小的部分的神经元会放电，令人惊讶的是，在他们说话前大约四分之一秒的时间里，神经元会放电。该子区域（称为左后颞上回（lpSTG））的活动强度取决于单词的复杂性和长度。

paras.en: “It’s more active when you’re about to say the word caterpillar than when you’re about to say the word cat,” said study co-author Matthew Leonard, a cognitive neuroscientist at UCSF, during the press briefing, per Laura Sanders at Science News.
paras.zh: 据《科学新闻》的劳拉·桑德斯报道，该研究的合著者、加州大学旧金山分校的认知神经科学家马修·伦纳德在新闻发布会上说：“当你要说‘毛毛虫’这个词时，它比当你要说‘猫’这个词时更活跃。”

paras.en: For a long time, scientists have wondered whether different neural mechanisms govern each language within a bilingual speaker’s brain. A study published this past summer found that people who speak both English and Spanish rely on the same “grammatical engine” for the two tongues.
paras.zh: 长期以来，科学家们一直想知道双语使用者大脑中是否有不同的神经机制控制着每种语言。去年夏天发表的一项研究发现，同时讲英语和西班牙语的人依赖两种语言的相同“语法引擎”。

paras.en: About half of the surgery participants also received electrical stimulation to their lpSTG, which rendered them unable to understand spoken queries from the researchers. They also lost the ability to start talking or spoke in “word salad,” making errors similar to those of people with Wernicke’s aphasia, a condition where someone struggles with language because of damage to Wernicke’s area. Turning off the electrical stimulation restored the participants’ ability to comprehend and produce speech.
paras.zh: 大约一半的手术参与者还接受了对其 lpSTG 的电刺激，这使得他们无法理解研究人员的口头询问。他们还失去了开始说话或用“单词沙拉”说话的能力，犯下与韦尼克失语症患者类似的错误，韦尼克失语症是一种由于韦尼克区域受损而导致语言困难的疾病。关闭电刺激可以恢复参与者理解和产生言语的能力。

paras.en: The findings suggest that biology textbooks will need to be rewritten, since Wernicke’s and Broca’s areas’ previously assigned roles are foundational. But that idea doesn’t totally surprise Leigh Hochberg, a neurologist at Mass General Brigham who wasn’t involved in the study. As scientists develop better tools to study the brain, he tells National Geographic’s Helen Thompson, “placing a circle around a part of the brain and assigning it a single function, I suspect, is going to turn out to be a substantial oversimplification.”
paras.zh: 研究结果表明，生物学教科书需要重写，因为韦尼克区和布罗卡区之前分配的角色是基础性的。但这个想法并不完全令麻省总医院的神经学家 Leigh Hochberg 感到惊讶，他没有参与这项研究。他告诉《国家地理》杂志的海伦·汤普森，随着科学家开发出更好的工具来研究大脑，“我怀疑，在大脑的一部分周围放置一个圆圈并为其指定一个单一的功能，结果将是一种严重的过于简单化。”

paras.en: The study’s findings could help researchers develop brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) that can restore speech in certain patients. Most clinical trials focus on people who have lost their ability to talk because of paralysis. But that doesn’t work for people with aphasia, per Scientific American, since the brain signals responsible for their intended speech don’t make it to the brain’s motor regions, which would have sent information to the mouth’s muscles. BCIs for aphasia patients therefore need to decode what the individuals want to communicate from the activation of undamaged parts of the lpSTG.
paras.zh: 该研究的结果可以帮助研究人员开发可以恢复某些患者言语能力的脑机接口（BCIs）。大多数临床试验都针对因瘫痪而失去说话能力的人。但据《科学美国人》报道，这对失语症患者不起作用，因为负责他们想要讲话的大脑信号不会到达大脑的运动区域，而大脑的运动区域会向口腔肌肉发送信息。因此，失语症患者的脑机接口需要通过激活 lpSTG 未受损部分来解码个体想要传达的信息。

paras.en: To start on that, the researchers made experimental brain implants for two participants with paralysis. When tested, the BCIs detected what the individuals heard and what they wanted to say.
paras.zh: 首先，研究人员为两名瘫痪参与者进行了实验性脑植入。在测试时，脑机接口检测到人们听到了什么以及他们想说什么。

paras.en: The findings also open the door for future research on Wernicke’s area. Other primates don’t have a brain region resembling it, so that could explain why these animals haven’t evolved speech.
paras.zh: 这些发现也为韦尼克领域的未来研究打开了大门。其他灵长类动物没有类似的大脑区域，因此这可以解释为什么这些动物没有进化出语言。

paras.en: “This subzone, which turns the words that we hear into words that we say, may be part of what makes us human,” Chang tells National Geographic.
paras.zh: “这个分区将我们听到的话语转化为我们所说的话语，这可能是我们人类的一部分，”张告诉国家地理。

articles.title: In the Heart of Harlem, a New Museum Tells the Overlooked Story of the Civil Rights Movement in the North

paras.en: In many American classrooms and textbooks, the history of the civil rights movement is focused on the Jim Crow-era South, including the Selma march, the Montgomery Bus Boycott, the Greensboro sit-ins, Ruby Bridges’ role in desegregating her New Orleans elementary school and Rosa Parks’ refusal to change bus seats.
paras.zh: 在许多美国课堂和教科书中，民权运动的历史都集中在吉姆·克劳时代的南方，包括塞尔玛游行、蒙哥马利巴士抵制运动、格林斯伯勒静坐、鲁比·布里奇斯在新奥尔良小学废除种族隔离中所扮演的角色以及罗莎·帕克斯拒绝更换公交车座位的行为。

paras.en: But the struggle for civil rights was nationwide, in cities as well as rural communities. The overlooked civil rights fight in the North is the focus of the Urban Civil Rights Museum, which opened to the public earlier this month in New York City’s Harlem neighborhood.
paras.zh: 但争取公民权利的斗争是全国性的，在城市和农村社区都是如此。北方被忽视的民权斗争是城市民权博物馆的焦点，该博物馆于本月早些时候在纽约市哈莱姆区向公众开放。

paras.en: Spanning 12,000 square feet inside the headquarters of the National Urban League—the civil rights organization that was founded in 1910 to economically, socially and politically empower African Americans—the museum bills itself as the first institution to prioritize the story of civil rights movements in the urban American North. It is also the first civil rights museum in New York City.
paras.zh: 该博物馆占地 12,000 平方英尺，位于全国城市联盟总部内，该民权组织成立于 1910 年，旨在在经济、社会和政治上赋予非裔美国人权力。该博物馆自称是第一个优先介绍美国北部城市民权运动故事的机构。它也是纽约市第一家民权博物馆。

paras.en: “It preserves a chapter of American history that too many people never learned, right here on 125th Street, where so much of that history was made,” Marc H. Morial, president and CEO of the National Urban League, says in a statement. “For too long, the story of civil rights in America has been told as a Southern story, but the fight for fair housing, good jobs, quality schools and equal justice was waged just as fiercely in the cities of the North, and Harlem was at the heart of it. We built this museum so that the next generation can see themselves in that legacy and carry it forward.”
paras.zh: “它保留了太多人从未了解过的美国历史篇章，就在 125 街，很多历史都是在这里创造的，”全国城市联盟主席兼首席执行官马克·H·莫里尔 (Marc H. Morial) 在一份声明中表示。 “长期以来，美国的民权故事一直被当作南方故事来讲述，但在北方城市中，争取公平住房、良好就业、优质学校和平等正义的斗争也同样激烈，而哈莱姆区正是其中的核心。我们建造这座博物馆，是为了让下一代能够看到自己的遗产并将其发扬光大。”

paras.en: This value is reflected in the museum’s primary permanent exhibition, “Moving History Forward,” in which visitors walk through centuries of Civil Rights history, beginning in the 1500s and advancing into the present day. Eight separate galleries showcase different notable benchmarks, including the arrival of the first ships carrying enslaved Africans to American, in Jamestown, Virginia, in 1619; New York’s total abolition of slavery in 1827; the end of the Civil War in 1865; the passage of the 1968 Fair Housing Act, which outlawed discriminatory housing practices; and the 1980s HIV/AIDS crisis, which disproportionately impacted Black men, primarily in urban centers likes New York City.
paras.zh: 这一价值体现在博物馆的主要永久展览“推动历史前进”中，游客可以在其中回顾几个世纪的民权历史，从 1500 年代开始一直延续到今天。八个独立的画廊展示了不同的著名基准，包括 1619 年第一批载着被奴役的非洲人到达美国的船只于 1619 年抵达弗吉尼亚州詹姆斯敦； 1827年纽约彻底废除奴隶制； 1865 年内战结束； 1968 年《公平住房法》的通过，禁止歧视性住房做法； 20 世纪 80 年代的艾滋病毒/艾滋病危机对黑人男性造成了不成比例的影响，主要是在纽约市等城市中心。

paras.en: “We want people to, as soon as they enter the gallery, start seeing and thinking about how displacement is connected with injustice over time,” Jennifer Scott, the museum’s executive director and chief curator, tells NY1’s Cheryl Wills.
paras.zh: “我们希望人们一进入画廊，就开始看到并思考随着时间的推移，流离失所与不公正是如何联系在一起的，”博物馆执行董事兼首席策展人詹妮弗·斯科特 (Jennifer Scott) 告诉 NY1 的谢丽尔·威尔斯 (Cheryl Wills)。

paras.en: At every turn, the institution’s sense of place—beginning with its Harlem roots—is brought to the fore. Other permanent exhibits are devoted to the Harlem Renaissance and the Great Migration, which saw millions of Black southerners move to northern cities.
paras.zh: 在每一个转折点，该机构的地方感——从其哈莱姆根源开始——都被凸显出来。其他永久性展览致力于哈莱姆文艺复兴和大迁徙，数百万南方黑人迁移到北方城市。

paras.en: The museum’s first special exhibition, “Thriving! Harlem as Homeplace,” is a “love letter” to the historic neighborhood, its community spaces and creative movements that that ushered meaningful change and cultivated joy throughout the 20th century, per the statement.
paras.zh: 博物馆的第一个特别展览“繁荣！哈莱姆作为家园”是一封写给历史悠久的街区、其社区空间和创意运动的“情书”，这些运动在整个 20 世纪带来了有意义的变化并培养了欢乐。

paras.en: When Fidel Castro, the revolutionary leader of Cuba, visited the 1960 United Nations General Assembly in New York City, he made a provocative point of staying in Harlem, where he hoped to draw attention to America’s racial tensions. At the storied Hotel Theresa, Castro met with Malcom X and Soviet Premier Nikita Khrushchev.
paras.zh: 1960 年，古巴革命领袖菲德尔·卡斯特罗 (Fidel Castro) 出席在纽约举行的联合国大会时，提出了留在哈莱姆区的挑衅性观点，希望在那里引起人们对美国种族紧张局势的关注。在著名的特蕾莎酒店，卡斯特罗会见了马尔科姆·X和苏联总理尼基塔·赫鲁晓夫。

paras.en: The museum hopes that its permanent and special exhibitions will dispell two incomplete civil rights narratives.
paras.zh: 博物馆希望其常设展览和特别展览能够消除两种不完整的民权叙事。

paras.en: “First being that racism and segregation were really a Southern problem,” Jeanne Theoharis, a political scientist at Brooklyn College, tells the New York Times’ Derrick Bryson Taylor. “And, two, that there wasn’t a hugely robust kind of movement in places like New York, Los Angeles, Chicago.”
paras.zh: “首先，种族主义和种族隔离确实是南方的问题，”布鲁克林学院的政治学家珍妮·西奥哈里斯 (Jeanne Theoharis) 告诉《纽约时报》的德里克·布莱森·泰勒 (Derrick Bryson Taylor)。 “第二，在纽约、洛杉矶、芝加哥等地，并没有出现非常强劲的运动。”

paras.en: The institution raised roughly $225 million to support its creation and launch, including $4 million in federal funding. A café and gift shop are also housed inside, and public programs including group tours, story readings for children and film screenings will be regularly available to the public.
paras.zh: 该机构筹集了大约 2.25 亿美元来支持其创建和启动，其中包括 400 万美元的联邦资金。里面还设有咖啡馆和礼品店，并定期向公众提供团体旅游、儿童故事朗读和电影放映等公共活动。

paras.en: “We want people to know that they are key participants,” Scott tells the Associated Press’ Fabianna Rincon. “History is living, it’s unfinished, and we can impact it.”
paras.zh: “我们希望人们知道他们是关键参与者，”斯科特告诉美联社的法比安娜·林康。 “历史是鲜活的，它尚未完成，我们可以影响它。”

paras.en: “Thriving! Harlem as Homeplace” is on view at the Urban Civil Rights Museum in Harlem, New York, through May 17, 2027.
paras.zh: “繁荣！哈莱姆区作为家园”将在纽约哈莱姆区的城市民权博物馆展出，展览期将持续到 2027 年 5 月 17 日。

articles.title: The First-Ever Children's Booker Prize Revealed Its Eight Shortlisted Finalists. Meet the Four Young Judges Deciding the Winner

paras.en: Since 1969, the Booker Prize has been one of the literary world’s most prestigious honors for fiction. This year, for the first time ever, it will have a children’s literature counterpart. The inaugural Children’s Booker Prize has revealed its shortlist and recruited a panel of young readers to help decide who takes home the £50,000 (roughly $65,500) award in February.
paras.zh: 自 1969 年以来，布克奖一直是文学界最负盛名的小说奖项之一。今年，它将有史以来第一次有儿童文学对应的内容。首届儿童布克奖公布了入围名单，并招募了一组年轻读者来帮助决定谁能在 2 月份获得 50,000 英镑（约合 65,500 美元）的奖项。

paras.en: Announced this week, the 2027 shortlist—dubbed the “Great Eight”—comprises five novels, two graphic novels and an illustrated collection of short stories for readers of ages eight to 12. Selected from 89 submissions published in the United Kingdom or Ireland, the finalists showcase authors and illustrators from five countries across three continents. The announcement arrives just two weeks after M. John Harrison won the 2026 adult Booker Prize for The End of Everything.
paras.zh: 本周公布的 2027 年入围名单（被称为“八强”）包括五本小说、两本图画小说和一本适合 8 至 12 岁读者的插图短篇小说集。入围作品是从英国或爱尔兰出版的 89 篇作品中选出的，入围作品展示了来自三大洲五个国家的作家和插画家。这一消息是在约翰·哈里森 (M. John Harrison) 凭借《一切的终结》荣获 2026 年成人布克奖两周后发布的。

paras.en: “This list, like life, is full of surprises,” Frank Cottrell-Boyce, a children's author and screenwriter who is chairing the judging panel, says in a statement. “When we set out, we were not sure what we were looking for,” he adds, noting that the panel kept one guiding rule in mind: “Every one of the ‘Great Eight’ on our shortlist had to be a book that was truly FOR CHILDREN. Our brilliant child judges will tell us whether we’ve kept our promise!”
paras.zh: “这份名单就像生活一样，充满了惊喜，”评审团主席、儿童作家兼编剧弗兰克·科特雷尔-博伊斯在一份声明中说道。 “当我们出发时，我们并不确定我们要寻找什么，”他补充道，并指出评审团牢记了一条指导原则：“入围名单上的每一本‘伟大八本’都必须是一本真正适合儿童的书。我们才华横溢的儿童评委将告诉我们是否兑现了我们的承诺！”

paras.en: The Booker Prize Foundation launched the award last year amid mounting concern over a steep slide in youth reading habits. According to the Britain’s Annual Literacy Survey from 2025, the share of children and teenagers who enjoy reading dropped to just one in three, the lowest level in the 20 years since the survey started asking the question.
paras.zh: 布克奖基金会去年设立该奖项，是因为人们越来越担心青少年阅读习惯急剧下降。根据英国 2025 年年度识字率调查，喜欢阅读的儿童和青少年比例降至三分之一，这是该调查开始提出该问题 20 年来的最低水平。

paras.en: Matching the adult Booker’s award money is a deliberate bid to elevate children’s literature. “There’s very little cultural conversation around children’s books and very little prestige,” Cottrell-Boyce tells the Guardian’s Emma Loffhagen. “Why shouldn’t a great children’s book have the same status as a great adult book?” Even in major bookstores, he argues, the entire breadth of children’s fiction is often crowded onto just a few shelves, “and half of that is going to be Roald Dahl.”
paras.zh: 与成人布克奖的奖金相匹配是为了提升儿童文学的水平。 “围绕儿童读物的文化对话很少，声望也很低，”科特雷尔-博伊斯告诉《卫报》的艾玛·洛夫哈根。 “为什么一本伟大的儿童读物不应该与一本伟大的成人读物享有同样的地位？”他认为，即使在大型书店，所有的儿童小说也常常被挤在几个书架上，“其中一半是罗尔德·达尔的作品。”

paras.en: The eight finalists span an eclectic mix of genres, from comedy and horror to science fiction and historical fantasy. The Rambler’s Curse, written and illustrated by BAFTA-winning animator Mikey Please, follows a human chef and a goblin waiter serving ogres and dragons at a woodland café. Irish author Jessica Scott-Whyte’s Séamus Almost Famous, illustrated by Becka Moor, tracks a boy determined to step out from the shadow of his notable family, including a baby sister who became an accidental internet sensation. For young readers with a taste for the eerie, Guy Bass and illustrator David Roberts offer The Worst Thing That Could Possibly Happen, a collection of unsettling short stories, while British-Pakistani former journalist Iqbal Hussain’s debut children’s novel, The Night I Borrowed Time, centers on a seventh son who discovers he can travel through time to mend his family’s lives.
paras.zh: 八名决赛入围者涵盖了各种类型，从喜剧和恐怖到科幻和历史奇幻。 《漫步者的诅咒》由英国电影和电视艺术学院奖获奖动画师 Mikey Please 创作并绘制插图，讲述了一位人类厨师和一位妖精服务员在一家林地咖啡馆为食人魔和龙提供服务的故事。爱尔兰作家杰西卡·斯科特·怀特（Jessica Scott-Whyte）的《SéamusAlmostFamous》由贝卡·摩尔（BeckaMoor）绘制，讲述了一个决心摆脱名门望族阴影的男孩的故事，其中包括一个意外成为网络红人的小妹妹。盖伊·巴斯 (Guy Bass) 和插画家大卫·罗伯茨 (David Roberts) 为喜欢怪诞事物的年轻读者提供了一本令人不安的短篇小说集《可能发生的最糟糕的事情》(The Worst Thing That Could Happen)，而英巴裔前记者伊克巴尔·侯赛因 (Iqbal Hussain) 的首部儿童小说《我借来的时间之夜》(The Night I Borrowed Time) 则以第七个儿子为中心，他发现自己可以穿越时空来修补家人的生活。

paras.en: Other contenders explore belonging, mystery and heavier emotional terrain. In The Teller of Tall Tales, by Liz Hyder and illustrator Tom de Freston, a grandmother in a remote cabin spins stories to connect her estranged grandchild with a hidden family history. Australian artist Shaun Tan’s Hometown follows a girl living on a distant planet who learns from a space-suited visitor that her true home lies far away. Graver realities anchor War, a graphic novel by Artemis Fowl-author Eoin Colfer, Andrew Donkin and illustrator Giovanni Rigano about a 14-year-old girl surviving inside a besieged European city. And in Catherine Bruton’s Tadpole Summer, a girl pitches a tent in her garden to seek solace in nature as her younger brother’s illness worsens.
paras.zh: 其他竞争者则探索归属感、神秘感和更沉重的情感领域。在莉兹·海德 (Liz Hyder) 和插画家汤姆·德·弗雷斯顿 (Tom de Freston) 合着的《荒诞故事的讲述者》中，一位住在偏僻小屋里的祖母编造故事，将她疏远的孙子与一段隐藏的家族历史联系起来。澳大利亚艺术家 Shaun Tan 的家乡讲述了一个生活在遥远星球上的女孩从一位穿着太空服的访客那里得知她真正的家在遥远的地方。 《战争》是《阿耳忒弥斯奇幻故事》的作者 Eoin Colfer、Andrew Donkin 和插画家 Giovanni Rigano 创作的图画小说，讲述了一个 14 岁女孩在被围困的欧洲城市中求生的故事，讲述了一个 14 岁女孩在一个被围困的欧洲城市中生存的故事。在凯瑟琳·布鲁顿的《蝌蚪之夏》中，当她弟弟的病情恶化时，一个女孩在她的花园里搭起了帐篷，在大自然中寻求安慰。

paras.en: Cottrell-Boyce notes that classic children’s books have never avoided dark subjects, pointing to the wartime Blitz backdrop of the Narnia series and the difficult beginnings of Anne of Green Gables.
paras.zh: 科特雷尔-博伊斯指出，经典儿童读物从不回避黑暗主题，他指出了《纳尼亚传奇》系列的战时闪电战背景和《绿山墙的安妮》的艰难开端。

paras.en: The opening lines of The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe, the first book in C.S. Lewis’ The Chronicles of Narnia series contain the only direct reference to the London Blitz, a World War II bombing campaign that battered the capital starting in September 1940.
paras.zh: 《狮子、女巫和魔衣橱》是 C.S. 刘易斯《纳尼亚传奇》系列的第一本书，它的开头几行唯一直接提到了伦敦闪电战，这是一场从 1940 年 9 月开始袭击伦敦的二战轰炸行动。

paras.en: - “Once there were four children whose names were Peter, Susan, Edmund and Lucy,” the book begins. “This story is about something that happened to them when they were sent away from London during the war because of the air raids.”
paras.zh: - “从前有四个孩子，他们的名字分别是彼得、苏珊、埃德蒙和露西，”书的开头说道。 “这个故事讲述的是战争期间他们因空袭而被送离伦敦时发生在他们身上的事情。”

paras.en: “Children’s books can be about anything, can deal with anything. But the tone has to convey hope,” Cottrell-Boyce tells the BBC’s Katie Razzall. For adults, Booker Prize Foundation chief executive Gaby Wood tells the Guardian, the books on the shortlist serve as a reminder “of the humor, empathy and resilience of young people, and offer a window on to the complexities of their worlds.”
paras.zh: “儿童读物可以讲述任何事情，可以处理任何事情。但语气必须传达希望，”科特雷尔-博伊斯告诉 BBC 的凯蒂·拉扎尔。布克奖基金会首席执行官加比·伍德告诉《卫报》，对于成年人来说，入围名单上的书籍可以提醒人们“年轻人的幽默、同理心和韧性，并为了解他们世界的复杂性提供一扇窗户。”

paras.en: To choose the winner, Cottrell-Boyce, actor Lolly Adefope and London bookseller Sanchita Basu De Sarkar will be joined by four child judges selected from more than 4,000 applicants: 12-year-olds Ibrahim and Lainey, 11-year-old Myla and 8-year-old Luna.
paras.zh: 科特雷尔-博伊斯、演员洛莉·阿德福普和伦敦书商桑奇塔·巴苏·德·萨卡将与从 4000 多名申请者中选出的四名儿童评委一起选出获胜者：12 岁的易卜拉欣和莱尼、11 岁的迈拉和 8 岁的卢娜。

paras.en: “If the children don’t love a book, it won’t win,” Cottrell-Boyce tells the BBC. Ibrahim, a young Hampshire reader who reads for an hour a day, shares that confidence, telling the BBC, “the adults are not going to control that meeting … 100 percent not!”
paras.zh: “如果孩子们不喜欢一本书，它就不会获胜，”科特雷尔-博伊斯告诉 BBC。易卜拉欣是一位每天阅读一小时的汉普郡年轻读者，他也有同样的信心，他告诉 BBC，“成年人不会控制这次会​​议……百分百不会！”

paras.en: Before the winner is announced at London’s Young V&A museum on February 2, 2027, at least 30,000 copies of the shortlisted books will be distributed to young readers through U.K. schools, libraries, hospitals, youth clubs and food banks.
paras.zh: 在 2027 年 2 月 2 日伦敦 Young V&A 博物馆宣布获奖者之前，至少 30,000 册入围书籍将通过英国学校、图书馆、医院、青年俱乐部和食品银行分发给年轻读者。

paras.en: If Ibrahim’s early reaction is any indication, the finalists are already hard at work. While reading one shortlisted book, he tells the BBC, “I had to tell my mum to confiscate it because I couldn’t stop reading it and I was getting a headache.”
paras.zh: 如果易卜拉欣的早期反应有任何迹象的话，那就是决赛入围者已经在努力工作了。在阅读一本入围的书时，他告诉英国广播公司，“我不得不告诉我妈妈把它没收，因为我无法停止阅读它，而且我感到头疼。”

articles.title: iRestore Elite Laser Hair Growth System Review: Husband-Approved
articles.author: Julia Forbes

paras.en: The Aging Process is hard. It’s jarring, for example, when the luscious, flowing locks of your youth start to disappear before your very eyes. But there's nothing to do about this natural hair loss—or is there? While still the subject of ongoing research, red-light therapy has been used to treat inflammation, pain relief, and wrinkles, and—as it turns out—it may also help with hair regrowth. It’s also a much more accessible option than flying to Istanbul for a full-on hair transplant.
paras.zh: 衰老的过程是艰难的。例如，当你年轻时那一头甜美、飘逸的头发开始在你眼前消失时，这会让人感到不舒服。但这种自然脱发与自然脱发无关——或者确实如此？虽然红光疗法仍然是正在进行的研究的主题，但它已被用于治疗炎症、缓解疼痛和皱纹，而且事实证明，它还可能有助于头发再生。这也是比飞往伊斯坦布尔进行全面植发更方便的选择。

paras.en: I learned about iRestore’s Elite Laser Growth Hair System after it came across my TikTok FYP. My algorithm likely served it to me because of my own hair woes (scalp irritation and eczema). Upon learning more about the system, I hoped it could help me with cell regeneration and kill off the bacteria causing flares on my scalp.
paras.zh: 在看到我的 TikTok 五年计划后，我了解了 iRestore 的精英激光生发系统。我的算法很可能因为我自己的头发问题（头皮刺激和湿疹）而为我服务。在了解了有关该系统的更多信息后，我希望它可以帮助我促进细胞再生并杀死导致头皮发炎的细菌。

paras.en: However, an even better test subject stood before me: my sweet husband, who is dealing with a rapidly receding hairline. So I roped him into testing this laser helmet—for science, of course. And to better understand said science, I spoke with Zakia Rahman, MD, FAAD, a clinical professor of dermatology at Stanford University School of Medicine.
paras.zh: 然而，一个更好的测试对象摆在我面前：我可爱的丈夫，他正在应对发际线迅速后退的问题。所以我说服他测试这个激光头盔——当然是为了科学。为了更好地理解上述科学，我与斯坦福大学医学院皮肤病学临床教授 Zakia Rahman（医学博士、FAAD）进行了交谈。

paras.en: Red-light therapy didn’t start as a treatment for antiaging and recovery. It actually came about as an accidental solution for hair loss in the 1960s, when Hungarian scientist Endre Mester was researching whether exposure to red light could treat cancer in hairless mice. Imagine his surprise when the mice started growing hair.
paras.zh: 红光疗法最初并不是作为抗衰老和恢复的治疗方法。它实际上是 20 世纪 60 年代偶然出现的一种治疗脱发的方法，当时匈牙利科学家 Endre Mester 正在研究暴露在红光下是否可以治疗无毛小鼠的癌症。想象一下当老鼠开始长出毛发时他的惊讶。

paras.en: Red-light therapy has come a long way since then. According to Rahman, red-light wavelengths are thought to activate the mitochondria in skin cells, which may encourage an uptick in the production of adenosine triphosphate (ATP) to promote new growth. Red-light therapy may also improve blood flow to hair follicles.
paras.zh: 从那时起，红光疗法已经取得了长足的进步。拉赫曼表示，红光波长被认为可以激活皮肤细胞中的线粒体，这可能会促进三磷酸腺苷 (ATP) 的产生增加，从而促进新的生长。红光疗法还可以改善毛囊的血液流动。

articles.title: 11 Things Jensen Huang Actually Said at His First All-Hands Back at Nvidia
articles.author: Lauren Goode, Paresh Dave

paras.en: Jensen Huang is going to therapy for 90 minutes a day, rethinking his management style, and says that violating Nvidia’s code of conduct isn’t necessarily a fireable offense. That’s just some of what the newly returned Nvidia CEO told staff during his first all-hands meeting on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 黄仁勋将每天进行 90 分钟的治疗，重新思考他的管理风格，并表示违反 Nvidia 的行为准则并不一定会被解雇。这只是新回归的英伟达首席执行官在周二的第一次全体会议上告诉员工的部分内容。

paras.en: Here are some of the most striking things Huang said during the meeting, according to remarks reviewed by WIRED. Nvidia did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
paras.zh: 根据《连线》杂志查阅的言论，以下是黄在会议期间所说的一些最引人注目的话。英伟达没有立即回应置评请求。

paras.en: On self-improvement: “I go to therapy every day for an hour and a half. And it's been helping me a lot.”
paras.zh: 关于自我提升：“我每天都会接受一个半小时的治疗。这对我帮助很大。”

paras.en: On accountability: “There are rumors on the internet that apparently I'm a tech bro, and therefore I’m back. Apparently, I'm a tech bro, and because I wear a super nice jacket, that I'm above the law, and I’m above the code of conduct. That is not true. It won't be tolerated. That is not true. It won’t be tolerated, and it wasn't tolerated here.”
paras.zh: 关于责任：“互联网上有传言说，显然我是一名技术兄弟，因此我回来了。显然，我是一名技术兄弟，因为我穿着一件超级漂亮的夹克，所以我凌驾于法律之上，我凌驾于行为准则之上。那不是真的。这是不会被容忍的。那不是真的。这是不会被容忍的，在这里也是不能容忍的。”

paras.en: “If one of you were to violate a code of conduct, what does that mean? If you were ever to violate a code of conduct, it is not appropriate. I just wanted you to know, it is not right, it's not appropriate, it won't be tolerated. But ‘it won't be tolerated’ does not mean, the moment you violate a code of conduct, we walk you out the door. Facts, circumstances, a lot of assessments. And your management team will still make the decision. That is what is in the best interest of the company and its employees, with all the facts and circumstances.”
paras.zh: “如果你们中的一个人违反了行为准则，那意味着什么？如果你曾经违反了行为准则，那是不合适的。我只是想让你知道，这是不对的，这是不合适的，这是不会被容忍的。但是‘不会容忍’并不意味着，一旦你违反了行为准则，我们就会把你赶出家门。事实、情况和大量的评估。而你的管理团队仍然会做出决定。这就是现在的情况。”考虑到所有事实和情况，公司及其员工的最大利益。”

paras.en: On his management style: “The intensity I bring elevates everybody else. But I can go too far. When I go too far, it hurts people, it belittles them, it disempowers them. And that’s not right. And so I need to go figure out how I'm going to bring the intensity, the crazy intensity, to the field.”
paras.zh: 关于他的管理风格：“我带来的强度提升了其他人。但我可以走得太远。当我走得太远时，它会伤害人们，贬低他们，剥夺他们的权力。这是不对的。所以我需要弄清楚如何将强度，疯狂的强度带到球场上。“

paras.en: On women at Nvidia: “I believe we need to create and continue to sustain a safe environment for all of our women. And if I did anything that put that in jeopardy, I cannot tell you how sad I am, and I'll do everything I can to fix it. We will not tolerate that.”
paras.zh: 关于 Nvidia 的女性：“我相信我们需要为所有女性创造并继续维持一个安全的环境。如果我做了任何让这个环境陷入危险的事情，我无法告诉你我有多悲伤，我会尽我所能来解决它​​。我们不会容忍这种情况。”

paras.en: On succession: “All day long, this company can run autonomously, and you saw it. I promise you, whether I'm here or not, this company is wired up to execute, execute, and execute, and deliver on financial results and financial results.”
paras.zh: 关于继任：“这家公司整天都可以自主运行，你也看到了。我向你保证，无论我是否在这里，这家公司都准备好执行、执行、执行，并交付财务业绩和财务业绩。”

paras.en: “I also didn't believe in succession planning. Let that sink in. I don’t believe in succession planning. I think it’s flawed. The idea of succession planning is not flawed. What people think succession planning means is flawed.”
paras.zh: “我也不相信继任计划。让这一点深入人心。我不相信继任计划。我认为它是有缺陷的。继任计划的想法没有缺陷。人们认为继任计划的含义是有缺陷的。”

paras.en: “There’s a reason why we don’t have succession planning, it’s not because we are unaware of the word. I’m the longest-running tech CEO in history.”
paras.zh: “我们没有继任计划是有原因的，并不是因为我们不知道这个词。我是历史上任职时间最长的科技公司首席执行官。”

paras.en: On politics: “There [were] also rumors that apparently I'm back because the highest levels of our government wanted me back. That is also completely untrue. Our board of directors performed their duty as they should have.”
paras.zh: 关于政治：“还有传言说我回来显然是因为我们政府的最高层希望我回来。这也是完全不真实的。我们的董事会履行了他们应有的职责。”

paras.en: “It is absolutely true that President Trump really, really loves our company,” Huang told employees. “He gloats about Nvidia. You know he does. But there’s a question about politics. Are we now political? Are we partisan? I wanna be very clear with you. President Trump is the United States president. He is my president. And I’ll do everything I can to help this president be informed about how he could make decisions that are in the best interest of our country. … We have to do it, and whoever the next president is will be my president, and I will do exactly the same.”
paras.zh: “特朗普总统确实非常热爱我们的公司，这是千真万确的，”黄告诉员工。 “他对英伟达幸灾乐祸。你知道他是这样的。但有一个关于政治的问题。我们现在是政治吗？我们有党派倾向吗？我想跟你说清楚。特朗普总统是美国总统。他是我的总统。我会尽一切努力帮助这位总统了解如何做出最符合我们国家利益的决定。......我们必须这样做，无论下一任总统是谁，都将是我的总统，我也会做同样的事情。”

paras.en: “Don't think for a second that politics ever play a role in this company, not even a little bit. We are the most apolitical company. I don't love that we talk about politics here. Take it home. I love that we talk about work here.”
paras.zh: “不要认为政治在这家公司发挥过作用，哪怕是一点点。我们是最不关心政治的公司。我不喜欢我们在这里谈论政治。把它带回家。我喜欢我们在这里谈论工作。”

articles.title: 16 Best Black Friday Headphone Deals (2026): Up to 57% Off
articles.author: Harry Rabinowitz

paras.en: It is a great time to buy a new pair of headphones. Brands have largely finished launching their latest models for the year, and I'm seeing some stellar Black Friday deals on new and older headphones alike. I've been reviewing headphones (and covering deals) for more than four years, so I have a good handle on what's worth opening your wallet for. (Spoilers: it's Sony and Bose this year).
paras.zh: 现在是购买一副新耳机的好时机。各大品牌已经基本完成了今年最新型号的推出，我看到黑色星期五的新款和旧款耳机都有一些出色的优惠。四年多以来，我一直在审查耳机（并报道优惠），因此我很清楚什么是值得掏腰包的。 （剧透：今年是索尼和 Bose）。

paras.en: All the deals below are WIRED-tested products we stand by, including wireless earbuds and over-ear headphones. For more Black Friday deals, check out our guides to the Best Black Friday TV Deals and the Best Black Friday Mattress Deals.
paras.zh: 以下所有优惠都是我们支持的经过有线测试的产品，包括无线耳塞和耳罩式耳机。有关更多黑色星期五优惠，请查看我们的最佳黑色星期五电视优惠和最佳黑色星期五床垫优惠指南。

paras.en: Updated November 24: I added new products on sale from Bose, Samsung, Sony, and Soundcore. I also updated pricing on other deals.
paras.zh: 11 月 24 日更新：我添加了 Bose、Samsung、Sony 和 Soundcore 的新促销产品。我还更新了其他交易的定价。

paras.en: Apple AirPods Pro 3 are the best wireless earbuds not only for anyone with an iPhone—but also for anyone who wants to keep things simple. They sound great and have some of the best active-noise-canceling (ANC) and transparency modes on the market. They also seamlessly sync with all of your Apple devices. At $100 off, it's the lowest price they've ever been at.
paras.zh: Apple AirPods Pro 3 是最好的无线耳机，不仅适合任何拥有 iPhone 的人，而且适合任何想要简单的人。它们听起来很棒，并且拥有市场上最好的主动降噪 (ANC) 和通透模式。它们还可以与您的所有 Apple 设备无缝同步。折扣100美元，这是他们有史以来的最低价格。

paras.en: This is the lowest price I’ve ever seen on one of my favorite pairs of wireless earbuds. The Soundcore Liberty 5 Pro have one magic trick: call quality. To put it simply, I sound better talking on calls using these earbuds than any other I’ve tested, and it’s not a close competition. Beyond that, they’re solid all-rounders, with good noise-canceling, sound quality, and versatility.
paras.zh: 这是我在我最喜欢的一对无线耳机中见过的最低价格。 Soundcore Liberty 5 Pro 有一个神奇的技巧：通话质量。简而言之，我使用这些耳机通话时的通话效果比我测试过的任何其他耳机都要好，而且这并不是一场势均力敌的竞争。除此之外，它们还是可靠的多面手，具有良好的降噪、音质和多功能性。

paras.en: Want workout earbuds that won't fall out? Get these Beats Powerbeats Pro 2. They're some of the more secure-fitting earbuds I've ever tested. Plus, they have great noise-canceling, transparency, and even built-in heart-rate sensors, so you can track your workout even if you left your fitness tracker at home.
paras.zh: 想要一款不会掉落的健身耳机吗？购买这些 Beats Powerbeats Pro 2。它们是我测试过的佩戴更牢固的耳塞之一。此外，它们还具有出色的降噪功能、透明度，甚至内置心率传感器，因此即使您将健身追踪器留在家里，您也可以跟踪您的锻炼情况。

paras.en: The Nothing Ear (3a) are one of our favorite pairs of earbuds under $100, and 30 percent off is the biggest discount I've ever seen for them so far. They have a semi-transparent design and bold colors that stand out from the crowd (particularly the yellow version). While the automated noise-canceling isn't the best, it's hard to fault them at this new low price.
paras.zh: Nothing Ear (3a) 是我们最喜欢的 100 美元以下耳机之一，30% 的折扣是迄今为止我见过的最大折扣。它们具有半透明的设计和大胆的色彩，在人群中脱颖而出（尤其是黄色版本）。虽然自动降噪功能并不是最好的，但在如此低的价格下很难挑剔它们。

paras.en: - Samsung Galaxy Buds 4 Pro for $180 ($70 off): Our go-to earbuds of choice for anyone with a Samsung Galaxy phone.
paras.zh: - 三星 Galaxy Buds 4 Pro 售价 180 美元（折扣 70 美元）：对于拥有三星 Galaxy 手机的任何人来说，我们的首选耳塞式耳机。

paras.en: - Shokz OpenFit 2+ for $100 ($100 off): Great open ear headphones at an exceptional discount.
paras.zh: - Shokz OpenFit 2+ 售价 100 美元（折扣 100 美元）：超值开放式耳机，超值折扣。

paras.en: - Sony WF-1000XM6 for $248 ($82 off): If you want excellent sound quality in your ANC earbuds, these Sony earbuds have dynamic bass and clear, detailed treble.
paras.zh: - 索尼 WF-1000XM6 售价 248 美元（折扣 82 美元）：如果您希望 ANC 耳塞具有出色的音质，这些索尼耳塞具有动态低音和清晰、细腻的高音。

paras.en: My main gripe with the Bose QuietComfort Headphones (2nd Gen) is price. At 45 percent off (their lowest price ever), that complaint vanishes, making this a top headphone deal to shop. The headphones are exceedingly comfortable and have stellar ANC—far better than basically every other set of headphones at this new low price of $200.
paras.zh: 我对 Bose QuietComfort 耳机（第二代）的主要不满是价格。由于 45% 的折扣（有史以来的最低价格），这种抱怨就消失了，使其成为耳机购物的最佳选择。这款耳机非常舒适，并且具有出色的 ANC 功能，比 200 美元的新低价中的所有其他耳机都要好得多。

paras.en: Did you hear the news? Sony made a version two of their cult-classic Sony WH-1000XM4 headphones. This is the first time they are on sale, and at $200, are one of the best deals this Black Friday. They have stellar sound, great noise-canceling, a comfortable fit, and a convenient, folding design well-suited for travel.
paras.zh: 你听到这个消息了吗？索尼制作了其经典索尼 WH-1000XM4 耳机的第二个版本。这是它们第一次打折，售价 200 美元，是这个黑色星期五最优惠的价格之一。它们具有一流的音质、出色的降噪效果、佩戴舒适以及方便的折叠设计，非常适合旅行。

paras.en: The Nothing Headphone (1) are a home run in looks and sound, and they are at their lowest price ever ahead of Black Friday. They’re solid noise cancelers with a bold, transparent design on the ear cups that's somehow techy, retro, and futuristic-looking. Among their best features are the on-ear controls, namely the clicky wheel that adjusts volume and the flat rocker paddle that you can push back and forth to move to the previous track or skip ahead, respectively.
paras.zh: Nothing 耳机 (1) 在外观和声音方面都堪称全垒打，而且在黑色星期五之前价格处于历史最低水平。它们是坚固的噪音消除器，耳罩上采用大胆、透明的设计，具有科技感、复古感和未来感。它们最好的功能之一是贴耳式控件，即调节音量的点击轮和可以前后推动以分别移动到上一曲目或向前跳过的扁平摇杆。

paras.en: The budget Nothing Headphone (a) and premium Nothing Headphone (1) Pro are also on sale, but the Headphone (1) is the most appealing deal in my view.
paras.zh: 经济型Nothing Headphone (a) 和高级Nothing Headphone (1) Pro 也在促销，但在我看来，Headphone (1) 是最具吸引力的交易。

paras.en: AirPods Max 2 are excellent over-ear headphones for Apple fans, but the $550 sticker price is frankly absurd. Thankfully, they are almost always a little bit on sale, including now. This is far from the best deal I've seen on these headphones, and I do expect the price to dip further during Black Friday sales events, so I would add them to my cart and wait to pull the trigger.
paras.zh: AirPods Max 2 对于苹果粉丝来说是一款出色的耳罩式耳机，但 550 美元的标价坦率地说是荒谬的。值得庆幸的是，它们几乎总是有一点折扣，包括现在。这远不是我在这些耳机上见过的最好的交易，我确实预计黑色星期五销售活动期间价格会进一步下跌，所以我会将它们添加到我的购物车并等待扣动扳机。

paras.en: My top over-ear headphone pick, the best-in-class Sony WH-1000XM6, is at its lowest price ever this Black Friday. These headphones are amazing across the board, with their high comfort, superior sound quality, and great noise-canceling capability.
paras.zh: 我最喜欢的头戴式耳机——同类中最好的索尼 WH-1000XM6，在这个黑色星期五的价格是有史以来的最低价。这些耳机在各方面都令人惊叹，具有高舒适度、卓越的音质和出色的降噪能力。

paras.en: - Bose QuietComfort Ultra Headphones (2nd Gen) for $369 ($80 off): These are the best ANC headphones you can buy (read our review here), but the discount could be better.
paras.zh: - Bose QuietComfort Ultra 耳机（第二代）售价 369 美元（折扣 80 美元）：这些是您可以购买的最好的 ANC 耳机（请在此处阅读我们的评论），但折扣可能会更好。

paras.en: - CMF Headphone Pro for $49 ($30 off): CMF is Nothing's sub-brand, and this is a great deal on surprisingly capable, budget headphones.
paras.zh: - CMF Headphone Pro 售价 49 美元（折扣 30 美元）：CMF 是 Nothing 的子品牌，对于性能出奇的廉价耳机而言，这是一笔超值优惠。

articles.title: Dolly Parton’s Final Recording on U2’s ‘Torn’ Marks Chart Milestones for Both Acts
articles.author: Russ Penuell

paras.en: Dolly Parton’s final recording is making its mark across multiple Billboard charts, as her collaboration with U2, “Torn,” arrives on country and rock rankings (dated Nov. 28), while standing as one of the top-selling songs in the United States.
paras.zh: 多莉·帕顿 (Dolly Parton) 的最后一张专辑在多个 Billboard 排行榜上留下了印记，她与 U2 合作的《Torn》登上了乡村和摇滚排行榜（日期为 11 月 28 日），同时成为美国最畅销的歌曲之一。

paras.en: The song becomes the legend’s first posthumous entry on Hot Country Songs as it debuts at No. 39 with 1.6 million official streams, 1.2 million in radio airplay audience and 6,000 sold Nov. 13-19, according to Luminate. It marks U2’s first appearance on the ranking.
paras.zh: 根据 Luminate 的数据，这首歌成为这位传奇人物死后在热门乡村歌曲中的第一首歌曲，首次亮相时就排名第 39 位，官方流媒体播放量达到 160 万，广播电台播放观众达到 120 万，11 月 13 日至 19 日售出 6,000 张。这标志着 U2 首次出现在排名中。

paras.en: (Parton first made Billboard’s charts in 1967; U2, in 1981.)
paras.zh: （帕顿于 1967 年首次登上 Billboard 排行榜；U2 于 1981 年登上排行榜。）

paras.en: On the Nov. 21-dated Country Airplay chart, “Torn” opened at No. 28, securing Parton her highest-ever debut and introducing U2 to the survey.
paras.zh: 在截至 11 月 21 日的乡村音乐排行榜上，《Torn》一开场就排名第 28 位，为帕顿创造了她有史以来最高的首秀成绩，并将 U2 引入了调查。

paras.en: Meanwhile, “Torn” enters Hot Rock & Alternative Songs at No. 24, becoming Parton’s second and top-charted hit on the tally, surpassing “World on Fire” (No. 26, 2023). The collaboration also launches at No. 2 on Billboard’s all-genre Digital Song Sales chart.
paras.zh: 与此同时，《Torn》进入《Hot Rock & Alternative Songs》排行榜第 24 名，成为帕顿在排行榜上的第二首热门歌曲，超过了《World on Fire》（2023 年第 26 名）。此次合作还在公告牌全流派数字歌曲销售排行榜上排名第二。

paras.en: The track closes U2’s Carnaval De Luz, which debuts at No. 4 on the Billboard 200 with 49,000 equivalent album units, becoming the band’s 14th top 10. The set also opens at No. 1 on Top Rock Albums, Vinyl Albums and Indie Store Album Sales and No. 2 on Top Album Sales, Top Rock & Alternative Albums and Top Alternative Albums.
paras.zh: 这首单曲是 U2 的《Carnaval De Luz》的收官之作，该专辑首秀便以 49,000 张同等专辑销量位列 Billboard 200 排行榜第 4 名，成为该乐队第 14 个跻身前十名的歌曲。该专辑还以最佳摇滚专辑、黑胶唱片和独立商店专辑销量排名第一，以及最佳专辑销量、最佳摇滚与另类专辑和最佳另类专辑排名第二。

paras.en: Produced by longtime U2 collaborator Jacknife Lee, the 12-track collection is the band’s first album of new material in nine years and its 16th studio LP.
paras.zh: 该专辑由 U2 长期合作伙伴 Jacknife Lee 制作，共有 12 首曲目，是该乐队九年来首张新材料专辑，也是该乐队的第 16 张录音室唱片。

paras.en: The team-up took shape when Parton offered U2 an unfinished song of her own. U2 frontman Bono and Snow Patrol’s Johnny McDaid subsequently reworked Parton’s original tale of a woman torn between two men into the story of a mother and her two estranged sons, divided by political differences.
paras.zh: 当帕顿向 U2 提供一首她自己未完成的歌曲时，这个团队就成形了。 U2 主唱博诺和 Snow Patrol 的约翰尼·麦克戴德随后将帕顿最初讲述的一个女人在两个男人之间左右为难的故事改写为一位母亲和她两个疏远儿子的故事，两个儿子因政治分歧而分裂。

paras.en: “Torn” is the last song that Parton recorded before her death Aug. 25 at age 80. She contributed her vocals in Nashville in June while battling illness.
paras.zh: 《Torn》是帕顿于 8 月 25 日去世前录制的最后一首歌，享年 80 岁。6 月，她在纳什维尔与疾病作斗争时贡献了自己的声音。

articles.title: These K-Beauty Products Loved by K-Pop Stars Are Up to 43% Off During Black Friday Sales
articles.author: Sophie Dunne

paras.en: All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.
paras.zh: 所有特色产品和服务均由编辑独立选择。然而，Billboard 可能会收到通过其零售链接下的订单的佣金，并且零售商可能会收到某些用于会计目的的可审计数据。

paras.en: These K-Beauty Products Loved By K-Pop Stars Are Up to 43% Off During Black Friday Sales
paras.zh: 这些深受韩国流行明星喜爱的韩国美容产品在黑色星期五促销期间最高可享受 43% 的折扣

paras.en: K-beauty has spent years winning over beauty enthusiasts worldwide, thanks in large part to Korean beauty influencers who introduced mainstream shoppers to innovative ingredients, thoughtful formulations and products that actually deliver results.
paras.zh: 多年来，K-beauty 赢得了全球美容爱好者的青睐，这在很大程度上要归功于韩国美容影响者，他们向主流购物者介绍了创新成分、周到配方和实际效果的产品。

paras.en: Add a little K-pop star power to the mix, with BTS’ Jin representing Laneige, V fronting TIRTIR and Tiffany Young and LE SSERAFIM’s Kazuha serving as brand ambassadors for Beauty of Joseon and ETUDE, respectively, and it’s easy to see why the obsession keeps growing. From barrier-boosting creams to glow-giving serums, Korean skincare continues to set the standard for effective, high-quality beauty. And with Black Friday discounts reaching up to 43% off on K-pop-approved products, now is the time to stock up on your favorites.
paras.zh: 再加上一点韩国流行明星的力量，BTS 的 Jin 代表 Laneige，V 代表 TIRTIR 和 Tiffany Young，LE SSERAFIM 的 Kazuha 分别担任 Beauty of Joseon 和 ETUDE 的品牌大使，不难看出为什么人们对它的痴迷程度不断增长。从增强屏障的面霜到焕发光彩的精华液，韩国护肤品不断树立有效、高品质美容的标准。黑色星期五期间，韩国流行音乐认可的产品折扣高达 43%，现在是时候囤积您最喜爱的产品了。

paras.en: Dry, flaky lips? Laneige’s cult-favorite Lip Sleeping Mask is an overnight treatment designed to replenish moisture and leave lips feeling soft by morning. Its berry fruit complex, vitamin C and nourishing butters help smooth and condition lips while delivering lasting hydration.
paras.zh: 嘴唇干燥、脱皮？兰芝备受追捧的唇部睡眠面膜是一款夜间护理产品，旨在补充水分，让双唇在早晨倍感柔软。其浆果复合物、维生素 C 和滋养黄油有助于平滑和调理双唇，同时提供持久保湿。

paras.en: BTS’ Jin gave the brand an extra dose of star power when he became Laneige’s first-ever male ambassador in 2024. Consider this your excuse to get your pout in formation.
paras.zh: 2024 年，防弹少年团 (BTS) 的 Jin 成为兰芝 (Laneige) 首位男性大使，为该品牌增添了额外的明星影响力。将此视为你撅嘴的借口。

paras.en: Mixsoon Bean Sunscreen SPF 50 Moisturizer
paras.zh: Mixsoon Bean 防晒霜 SPF 50 保湿霜

paras.en: Daily SPF is non-negotiable, and Mixsoon’s Bean Sunscreen makes the morning step feel effortless. With SPF 50 protection, a lightweight texture and a no-white-cast finish, this Korean sunscreen layers comfortably under makeup while helping keep skin hydrated.
paras.zh: 每日 SPF 值不容忽视，Mixsoon 的 Bean 防晒霜让早晨的步伐变得轻松自在。这款韩国防晒霜具有 SPF 50 保护、质地轻盈、不泛白，可在彩妆下舒适地分层，同时帮助保持肌肤水分。

paras.en: BTS’ Suga gave fans a peek at his sun-care routine in a BangtanTV vlog filmed in Busan. He applied the sunscreen before a 10-kilometer run and noted its lotion-like texture.
paras.zh: BTS 的 Suga 在釜山拍摄的 BangtanTV 视频博客中向粉丝展示了他的防晒护理程序。他在 10 公里跑步前涂抹了防晒霜，并注意到其乳液般的质地。

paras.en: Beauty of Joseon Glow Deep Serum Rice Alpha-Arbutin Niacinamide
paras.zh: Beauty of Joseon Glow 深层精华大米阿尔法熊果苷烟酰胺

paras.en: Dullness and uneven-looking skin tone are the focus of Beauty of Joseon’s Glow Deep Serum. Formulated with rice bran water, alpha-arbutin and niacinamide, this lightweight treatment helps brighten the appearance of dark spots while delivering hydration and a fresh, dewy finish.
paras.zh: Beauty of Joseon's Glow Deep Serum 的重点是解决暗沉和肤色不均的问题。这款轻盈的护理产品含有米糠水、α-熊果苷和烟酰胺，有助于提亮黑斑，同时提供保湿和清新水润的妆容。

paras.en: Girls’ Generation member Tiffany Young became a brand ambassador and muse for Beauty of Joseon in 2023. With her stamp of approval on the brand, this glow-boosting serum deserves a spot on your beauty playlist.
paras.zh: 少女时代成员蒂芙尼·杨 (Tiffany Young) 于 2023 年成为 Beauty of Joseon 的品牌大使和缪斯女神。凭借她对该品牌的认可，这款焕彩精华液值得在您的美容播放列表中占有一席之地。

paras.en: Looking for that coveted glass-skin finish? TIRTIR’s Mask Fit Red Cushion delivers buildable medium-to-full coverage with a lightweight feel and satin glow. Its standout feature is a 40-shade range, making it a particularly exciting find in the world of Korean cushion foundations.
paras.zh: 正在寻找令人垂涎的玻璃皮肤饰面吗？ TIRTIR 的 Mask Fit 红色气垫提供可叠加的中度至全覆盖效果，质感轻盈，光泽如缎。它的突出特点是有 40 种色调，使其成为韩国气垫粉底界中一个特别令人兴奋的发现。

paras.en: BTS’ V joined TIRTIR as its global ambassador, bringing even more attention to the brand and its viral complexion products. With coverage this good, TIRTIR has officially earned its place on every ARMY’s beauty radar.
paras.zh: BTS 的 V 加入 TIRTIR 担任其全球大使，让该品牌及其病毒性肤色产品获得更多关注。凭借如此良好的覆盖范围，TIRTIR 正式在每个 ARMY 的美容雷达上赢得了一席之地。

paras.en: ETUDE SoonJung pH 6.5 Whip Cleanser for Sensitive Skin
paras.zh: ETUDE SoonJung pH 6.5 洁面乳（适合敏感肌肤）

paras.en: Sensitive skin deserves a gentle cleanse, and ETUDE’s SoonJung Whip Cleanser delivers just that. Its cushiony foam helps remove everyday impurities without stripping away moisture. With a skin-friendly pH, panthenol and madecassoside, this K-beauty face cleanser is designed to leave delicate skin feeling comfortable rather than tight.
paras.zh: 敏感肌肤需要温和的清洁，ETUDE 的 SoonJung Whip Cleanser 就能满足这一需求。其柔软的泡沫有助于去除日常杂质，同时又不会带走水分。这款 K-beauty 洁面乳具有亲肤 pH 值、泛醇和羟基积雪草苷，旨在让娇嫩的肌肤感觉舒适而不紧绷。

paras.en: LE SSERAFIM’s Kazuha was named ETUDE’s brand muse in 2022, representing the beauty brand as a whole. If your skincare routine needs a softer touch, consider this your Perfect Night essential.
paras.zh: LE SSERAFIM 的 Kazuha 于 2022 年被任命为 ETUDE 的品牌缪斯，代表整个美容品牌。如果您的日常护肤需要更柔和的触感，请将此视为您完美之夜的必备品。

paras.en: AESTURA ATOBARRIER365 Cream with Ceramides
paras.zh: AESTURA ATOBARRIER365 神经酰胺霜

paras.en: Dry or sensitive skin will appreciate this barrier-loving moisturizer. AESTURA’s ATOBARRIER365 Cream combines ceramides, fatty acids and cholesterol to support the skin barrier while delivering long-lasting hydration. Its fragrance-free formula is designed to comfort easily irritated skin without feeling like an overly complicated addition to your routine.
paras.zh: 干性或敏感皮肤会喜欢这款具有屏障功能的保湿霜。 AESTURA 的 ATOBARRIER365 面霜结合了神经酰胺、脂肪酸和胆固醇，支持皮肤屏障，同时提供持久保湿。其无香料配方旨在舒缓容易受刺激的皮肤，而不会给您的日常生活带来过于复杂的感觉。

paras.en: BTS’ Jimin has been spotted using products from the ATOBARRIER line, including this cream, during Are You Sure?! travel moments. Apparently, good skincare deserves a spot in every travel itinerary.
paras.zh: BTS 的 Jimin 被发现在《Are You Sure?!》节目中使用 ATOBARRIER 系列产品，包括这款面霜。旅行的时刻。显然，良好的护肤品应该在每个旅行行程中占有一席之地。

paras.en: MEDIHEAL Madecassoside Essential Face Sheet Mask, Blemish Repair
paras.zh: MEDIHEAL 羟基积雪草苷精华面膜，淡斑修复

paras.en: MEDIHEAL’s Madecassoside Essential Face Sheet Mask is designed to calm redness-prone skin, improve the appearance of uneven tone and strengthen the skin’s moisture barrier. Made with madecassoside, ceramides and hyaluronic acid, it helps soothe irritation while delivering a boost of hydration. Its hypoallergenic, vegan-certified formula is also suitable for acne-prone skin.
paras.zh: MEDIHEAL 的羟基积雪草苷精华面膜旨在镇静易发红的皮肤，改善肤色不均，并增强皮肤的保湿屏障。它由羟基积雪草苷、神经酰胺和透明质酸制成，有助于舒缓刺激，同时增强水分。其低过敏性、经过素食认证的配方也适合易长粉刺的皮肤。

paras.en: MEDIHEAL has plenty of K-pop connections. I-dle’s Minnie is a brand ambassador, while BTS, TWS and PLAVE members have also modeled for the skincare brand. Super Junior’s Eunhyuk has also shared his daily sheet-mask habit, proving that the glow-up is a K-group effort.
paras.zh: MEDIHEAL 与韩国流行音乐有着广泛的联系。 I-dle 的 Minnie 是品牌大使，而 BTS、TWS 和 PLAVE 成员也曾为该护肤品牌做过模特。 Super Junior的银赫也分享了他每天敷面膜的习惯，证明这种焕发光彩是K组合的努力。

paras.en: Other Popular K-Beauty Products That Are On Sale for Black Friday
paras.zh: 黑色星期五促销的其他热门韩国美容产品

paras.en: COSRX Snail Mucin 96% Repairing Face Serum
paras.zh: COSRX 蜗牛粘蛋白 96% 修复面部精华液

paras.en: A K-beauty classic for a reason, COSRX Snail Mucin 96% Repairing Essence uses snail secretion filtrate to help hydrate, soothe and improve the appearance of dull or dehydrated skin. Its lightweight, fast-absorbing texture makes it easy to layer into an existing routine for a healthy-looking glow.
paras.zh: COSRX 蜗牛粘蛋白 96% 修复精华液采用蜗牛分泌物滤液帮助补水、舒缓和改善暗沉或脱水肌肤的外观，成为韩国美容经典是有原因的。其质地轻盈、吸收快，可轻松融入现有的日常护理中，打造健康光泽。

paras.en: With an impressive 60,000 units reportedly purchased on Amazon last month, this viral favorite clearly isn’t slowing down. If you’ve been curious about the snail mucin craze, Black Friday is a good opportunity to give it a try.
paras.zh: 据报道，上个月在亚马逊上的购买量高达 60,000 件，这种病毒般的流行显然并没有放缓。如果您对蜗牛粘蛋白热潮感到好奇，黑色星期五是一个尝试的好机会。

paras.en: Belif Aqua Bomb Lightweight Hydrating Daily Moisturizer
paras.zh: Belif Aqua Bomb 轻质保湿日常保湿霜

paras.en: If your skin is constantly thirsty, Belif’s Aqua Bomb is a bestselling gel moisturizer worth knowing. Its fast-absorbing, lightweight formula combines hyaluronic acid and niacinamide to deliver a refreshing hit of hydration without a greasy finish. It’s a particularly good option for anyone who wants moisture without the weight of a traditional cream.
paras.zh: 如果您的皮肤经常口渴，Belif 的 Aqua Bomb 是一款值得了解的畅销凝胶保湿霜。其快速吸收、轻盈的配方结合了透明质酸和烟酰胺，带来清爽的补水效果，但不油腻。对于那些想要滋润而又没有传统面霜重量的人来说，这是一个特别好的选择。

paras.en: This one has earned its popularity across TikTok, Reddit and retailer reviews, and it’s been a personal skincare staple for years. The hydration is real, making a Black Friday discount an especially good excuse to stock up.
paras.zh: 这款产品在 TikTok、Reddit 和零售商评论中广受欢迎，多年来一直是个人护肤品的主打产品。补水效果是真实的，因此黑色星期五折扣成为囤货的特别好借口。

paras.en: Glow Recipe Glass Skin Essential Korean Skincare Kit
paras.zh: Glow Recipe Glass Skin Essential 韩国护肤套装

paras.en: Want the glass-skin look without buying an entire new routine? Glow Recipe’s skincare duo brings together its Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops and PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner. Together, they help hydrate, boost radiance and refine the appearance of pores for a smoother, dewier complexion.
paras.zh: 想要玻璃皮肤的外观而不购买全新的日常用品吗？ Glow Recipe 的护肤组合将西瓜发光烟酰胺露滴剂和 PHA + BHA 毛孔紧致爽肤水结合在一起。它们共同帮助补水、增强光泽并缩小毛孔，使肤色更加光滑、水润。

paras.en: The kit is a convenient way to try two of the brand’s popular formulas at once. Use the exfoliating toner first, then layer on the glow-boosting serum for a fresh-faced finish that looks ready for its close-up.
paras.zh: 该套件可以方便地同时尝试该品牌的两种流行配方。先使用去角质爽肤水，然后涂上焕彩精华液，打造清新妆容，为特写做好准备。

articles.title: Disney Sued for Allegedly Using Unlicensed Music in Social Media Ads: ‘Never Paid a Dollar’
articles.author: Bill Donahue

paras.en: The latest in a flood of lawsuits over music on social media is targeting the Walt Disney Co. — and claiming that the Hollywood giant should have known better.
paras.zh: 社交媒体上有关音乐的大量诉讼中的最新一起是针对华特迪士尼公司的，并声称这家好莱坞巨头应该更清楚。

paras.en: In a case filed Tuesday (Nov. 24) in Detroit federal court, Zac Hiller and his LAA Music claim Disney illegally used three of the publishing company’s songs across seven social media videos even though the entertainment colossus “never asked for a license” and “never paid a dollar.”
paras.zh: 在周二（11 月 24 日）向底特律联邦法院提起的诉讼中，扎克·希勒 (Zac Hiller) 和他的 LAA Music 声称迪士尼在七个社交媒体视频中非法使用了该出版公司的三首歌曲，尽管这家娱乐巨头“从未申请过许可”且“从未支付过一美元”。

paras.en: “For a hundred years, The Walt Disney Company has taught the world one rule: if you want to use what someone else created, you ask permission and you pay,” Hiller’s attorneys write. “Disney enforces that rule against everyone else. This case is about Disney exempting itself from it.”
paras.zh: “一百年来，华特迪士尼公司向世界传授了一条规则：如果你想使用别人创造的东西，你需要获得许可并付费，”希勒的律师写道。 “迪士尼对其他所有人都执行了这一规则。本案是关于迪士尼将自己排除在外的。”

paras.en: The Disney posts were broadcast to “audiences in the millions,” the lawsuit says, including a promotion for Hulu that garnered 481,700 likes and 17,500 shares. The lawsuit claims the posts were removed after complaints, but that taking them down is not enough: “Taking a video down after getting caught does not undo the infringement.”
paras.zh: 诉讼称，迪士尼的帖子向“数百万观众”播出，其中包括为 Hulu 进行的宣传，获得了 481,700 次点赞和 17,500 次分享。该诉讼称，这些帖子在投诉后被删除，但删除它们还不够：“被抓后删除视频并不能消除侵权行为。”

paras.en: The new case is the latest in an ongoing crackdown against commercial social media posts that feature copyrighted songs. Dozens of lawsuits have been filed, many by the major music companies, over such allegations over the past five years, and many more claims have been settled behind closed doors.
paras.zh: 这起新案件是针对含有版权歌曲的商业社交媒体帖子持续打击的最新一起案件。过去五年来，针对此类指控，已经提起了数十起诉讼，其中许多是由大型音乐公司提起的，还有更多的索赔已经秘密解决。

paras.en: While many of the lawsuits have come from Universal Music, Sony Music or Warner Music, Tuesday’s case was filed by Hiller, an NFL agent and founder and CEO of the agency Loyalty Above All, which counts players like James Cook, J.K. Dobbins, and Shemar Stewart on its client roster.
paras.zh: 虽然许多诉讼来自环球音乐、索尼音乐或华纳音乐，但周二的案件是由希勒提起的，希勒是一名 NFL 经纪人，也是忠诚高于一切机构的创始人兼首席执行官，该机构的成员包括詹姆斯·库克、J.K.多宾斯和谢默·斯图尔特都在其客户名册上。

paras.en: The case claims that Disney used three songs owned by Hiller and LAA Music, including “Take it Off ‘Lights Off’ Beat”; “New Opp (beat)”; and “Gang Gang.” Three songs were allegedly used by ESPN, one by Hulu, one by FX and two more by Disney Parks.
paras.zh: 该案声称迪士尼使用了 Hiller 和 LAA Music 拥有的三首歌曲，包括“Take it Off ‘Lights Off’ Beat”； “新奥普（节拍）”；和“帮帮”。据称 ESPN 使用了三首歌，Hulu 使用了一首，FX 使用了一首，迪士尼乐园使用了另外两首。

paras.en: “Disney negotiates synchronization licenses every day [and] employs people whose job is to clear music,” Hiller’s attorneys write. “Its infringement here was not the oversight of a company too large to notice. It was a business decision: use the music now, take the promotional benefit, and make the rights holder chase it later.”
paras.zh: 希勒的律师写道：“迪士尼每天都在协商同步许可，并雇用负责清理音乐的人员。” “这里的侵权行为并不是一家大公司的疏忽。这是一个商业决定：现在使用音乐，获得促销利益，然后让版权所有者追赶它。”

paras.en: Neither side immediately returned requests for comment on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 周二，双方均未立即回复置评请求。

articles.title: Alfonso Ribeiro on the “Wild” Ride of ‘DWTS’ Season 35, Reuniting With Tatyana Ali and Why He Won’t Compete in an All-Winners Season
articles.author: McKinley Franklin

paras.en: Season 35 of Dancing With the Stars marks Alfonso Ribeiro’s fifth season hosting the show, and he has no idea how it will end.
paras.zh: 《与星共舞》第 35 季是阿方索·里贝罗主持该节目的第五季，他不知道节目会如何结束。

paras.en: After winning season 19 with Witney Carson, The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air joined the series as a co-host in its 31st season, a year that he believes laid the foundation for the show’s resurgence. “I think we owe a debt of gratitude to Charli D’Amelio doing the show. … Her being literally one of the most popular social media TikTok stars opened the door to an audience that previously didn’t care about this show,” he tells The Hollywood Reporter of what he pinpoints to DWTS’ spike in popularity (and ratings) in recent years.
paras.zh: 在与威特尼·卡森 (Witney Carson) 一起赢得第 19 季之后，新鲜贝莱尔王子作为联合主持人加入了该剧第 31 季，他认为这一年为该剧的复兴奠定了基础。 “我认为我们应该感谢 Charli D’Amelio 主持的这个节目。……她实际上是最受欢迎的社交媒体 TikTok 明星之一，为以前不关心这个节目的观众打开了大门，”他向《好莱坞报道》讲述了近年来 DWTS 人气（和收视率）飙升的原因。

paras.en: The TikTok star certainly brought new eyes to the series, but Ribeiro also refreshed it as host. After one year executing the job alongside Tyra Banks, Julianne Hough stepped in as his co-host, and the duo have remained at the post since. They both bring unique perspectives to DWTS: Ribeiro, as a celebrity who won the series, and Hough, as a former professional dancer and judge.
paras.zh: 这位 TikTok 明星无疑为该系列节目带来了新的视角，但里贝罗作为主持人也让该系列节目焕然一新。在与泰拉·班克斯 (Tyra Banks) 一起执行这一工作一年后，朱丽安·霍夫 (Julianne Hough) 接任他的联合主持人，此后两人一直担任该职位。他们都为 DWTS 带来了独特的视角：里贝罗（Ribeiro）作为赢得该系列赛的名人，霍夫（Hough）作为前职业舞者和评委。

paras.en: Ribeiro says there’s so many things that he loves about hosting the show, but one standout is the mentorship he’s able to offer the celebrities. This year, his Fresh Prince sister Tatyana Ali hit the ballroom floor, which he says has been “beautiful for me to experience with her.”
paras.zh: 里贝罗说，他喜欢主持这个节目的原因有很多，但最突出的一点是他能够为名人提供指导。今年，他的《新鲜王子》妹妹塔蒂亚娜·阿里 (Tatyana Ali) 登上了舞厅地板，他说“与她一起经历对我来说很美好”。

paras.en: Ali is one of five couples still competing for a chance to win the Len Goodman mirrorball trophy on Tuesday night. Ribeiro admittedly doesn’t know what factors will hold more weight when determining this year’s winner.
paras.zh: 阿里是周二晚上仍在争夺赢得伦·古德曼镜球奖杯机会的五对夫妇之一。里贝罗承认，他不知道在决定今年的获胜者时哪些因素会更重要。

paras.en: “It is quite wild to me because this is a very different season than any other season we’ve ever had,” he says. “So, all of the normal things that we would be able to gauge doesn’t really exist this year.”
paras.zh: “这对我来说非常疯狂，因为这是一个与我们经历过的任何其他季节都非常不同的季节，”他说。 “因此，我们能够衡量的所有正常事物今年都不存在。”

paras.en: One thing Ribeiro hopes is that the portion of the audience spreading hate towards contestants will fade in future seasons. “At the end of the day, this is a dance competition show. This isn’t life or death. No one’s life is changing that greatly from this. It is designed for people to let loose, have some fun and truly enjoy these incredible celebrities,” he adds.
paras.zh: 里贝罗希望的一件事是，散播对参赛者的仇恨的观众部分将在未来的几季中消失。 “归根结底，这是一场舞蹈比赛节目。这不是生与死。没有人的生活会因此而发生太大变化。它是为人们放松、享受乐趣并真正欣赏这些令人难以置信的名人而设计的，”他补充道。

paras.en: To commemorate the finale of DWTS, Ribeiro chats with THR below about the ups-and-downs of season 35; being in the ballroom and getting the chance to dance with Ali; his opinion on fans who believe celebrities with prior dance experience shouldn’t be cast on the show; and why you won’t ever see him compete on another All-Star (or all-winners) iteration of DWTS.
paras.zh: 为了纪念 DWTS 的结局，里贝罗在下面与 THR 聊了第 35 季的跌宕起伏；在舞厅里并有机会与阿里跳舞；他对那些认为有舞蹈经验的名人不应该出现在节目中的粉丝的看法；以及为什么您再也见不到他参加 DWTS 的另一场全明星（或全胜）比赛。

paras.en: How does it feel to almost be at the finish line of season 35 of Dancing With the Stars?
paras.zh: 《与星共舞》第 35 季即将结束，感觉如何？

paras.en: This is an incredibly epic season. The numbers, the fans and the interest has been through the roof. We feel really blessed to do something no other show has really ever done in history, which is come back from the brink of extinction to turn around and become the No. 1 show on television. We’ve got a great cast, and they’ve done an incredible job of opening themselves up and allowing America to get to know them. Deena Katz and Conrad Green put a great team together.
paras.zh: 这是一个令人难以置信的史诗般的赛季。人数、粉丝和兴趣都达到了顶峰。我们感到非常幸运，能够做一些历史上没有其他节目真正做过的事情，从灭绝的边缘起死回生，成为电视第一节目。我们有很棒的演员阵容，他们在开放自己并让美国人了解他们方面做了令人难以置信的工作。迪娜·卡茨 (Deena Katz) 和康拉德·格林 (Conrad Green) 组建了一支出色的团队。

paras.en: The season 35 finale is going to be airing live coast-to-coast for the first time. What do you think that says about the growth and reach of the show that this was so wanted by fans, but also so much so that the affiliates came to an agreement for this to happen?
paras.zh: 第 35 季大结局将首次在全国各地直播。您认为这说明了该剧的发展和影响力如何，粉丝们对此如此渴望，而且附属公司也同意这样做？

paras.en: That’s a major move, right? The only thing on television that does that are sporting events, and the fact that we can move side by side with the NFL and NBA, and people are willing to, on a Tuesday night on the West Coast and Mountain time, come home a little early so that they could watch the show live is quite spectacular when you really think of it. That the affiliates and the network have that much trust in doing this as a finale says that they truly believe that this will work out great for the show and for the sponsors and the companies buying ad time. It says a lot about what they believe in the show.
paras.zh: 这是一个重大举措，对吧？电视上唯一能做到这一点的是体育赛事，事实上，我们可以与 NFL 和 NBA 并肩前进，人们愿意在西海岸山区时间的周二晚上早点回家，以便可以观看现场直播，当你真正想到这一点时，这是相当壮观的。联属公司和网络对将其作为结局非常信任，这表明他们真正相信这对节目、赞助商和购买广告时间的公司来说都会有很大的帮助。它充分说明了他们对节目的信念。

paras.en: Do you think that airing the finale live could be a potential test to see how the viewership comes in to see if the show would adapt this live format for a future season?
paras.zh: 您是否认为现场直播大结局可能是一个潜在的测试，看看收视率如何，以了解该节目是否会在未来的季节中采用这种现场形式？

paras.en: I can’t really speak on it, obviously, because I don’t know anyone’s thoughts. Anything I say would be conjecture, not anything real. I actually believe that it works the way that it works so far. Of course, we’d love for everyone on the West Coast and everyone in the Mountain time zone to be able to vote for their favorites. I think the interesting way would be to do it on Disney+ and not necessarily on ABC. But the question becomes, does the audience truly support it? And if the audience supports it, then why not, right?
paras.zh: 显然，我不能真正谈论它，因为我不知道任何人的想法。我所说的任何事情都只是猜测，而不是任何真实的事情。我实际上相信它的工作方式是迄今为止的工作方式。当然，我们希望西海岸的每个人以及山区时区的每个人都能够投票选出他们最喜欢的。我认为有趣的方式是在 Disney+ 上进行，而不一定是在 ABC 上进行。但问题是，观众真的支持吗？如果观众支持，那为什么不呢，对吧？

paras.en: If the numbers end up being as good or better, then of course let’s do it. But there are things that would severely be hampered by that. Technically speaking, ABC News Tonight is the No. 1 broadcast show on Tuesday nights, so you’d be giving up on that for the success of Dancing. The smarter people will make that decision, and we’ll see where that leads us. We’re super excited that we’re getting to experience this particular case. Hopefully all of America and everybody on the West Coast watches it live and we break ratings and voting records.
paras.zh: 如果数字最终同样好或更好，那么我们当然就这么做。但有些事情会因此受到严重阻碍。从技术上讲，《ABC 今夜新闻》是周二晚上排名第一的广播节目，因此您可能会为了《舞蹈》的成功而放弃它。聪明的人会做出这样的决定，我们会看看这会引导我们走向何方。我们非常兴奋能够体验这个特殊案例。希望全美国和西海岸的每个人都能观看直播，我们打破收视率和投票记录。

paras.en: Tatyana has had such an incredible journey. What has it been like being able to be there and be a part of that journey?
paras.zh: 塔蒂亚娜经历了一段如此不可思议的旅程。能够到场并参与这段旅程是什么感觉？

paras.en: I’ve been trying to get her to do the show for many years, and the timing just wasn’t right. And so happy she did, and really, mostly, so happy for her. It isn’t about me; it’s about her and what she is getting to experience. The little girl I met in 1990, [she’s] all grown up. She’s such a special person. What this show did for me was show America who Alfonso really was, not that character [from Fresh Prince]; same situation for her: getting to experience who Tatyana Ali is and people falling in love with the beautiful human she is.
paras.zh: 多年来我一直试图让她出演这个节目，但时机不对。她很高兴，真的，最重要的是，为她感到高兴。这与我无关；这是关于她和她正在经历的事情。我1990年遇到的那个小女孩，已经长大了。她是一个很特别的人。这部剧对我来说是向美国人展示了阿方索的真实身份，而不是《新鲜王子》中的那个角色；她的情况也一样：体验塔蒂亚娜·阿里是谁，人们爱上她这个美丽的人。

paras.en: What was your reaction when she came to you with the idea for you to be a part of her Dedication Night dance in honor of James [Avery]?
paras.zh: 当她来找你并邀请你参加她纪念詹姆斯[艾弗里]的奉献之夜舞会时，你的反应是什么？

paras.en: It started obviously with the producers asking me the question first. When we finally talked about it, it was already a yes. I expressed my very small concerns of, does that make it look like I’m favoring someone over everyone else, and will that be something that we ultimately have to deal with? And everyone came to the conclusion that that wouldn’t be an issue. The thing that took it over the top for me was that the dedication was to James Avery, and it was bigger than just this show. James Avery played my dad on three different shows, so dedicating it to him felt so right. It was a great opportunity for us to spend extra time together and go through the process of doing a competitive number on the show. I dance all the time on the show, but to be part of a competitive number made it extra special.
paras.zh: 显然，这一切都是从制片人首先问我这个问题开始的。当我们最终谈到这个问题时，已经是肯定的了。我表达了我非常小的担忧，这是否会让我看起来比其他人更偏爱某人，这会是我们最终必须处理的事情吗？每个人都得出结论：这不是问题。对我来说最重要的是对詹姆斯·艾弗里的奉献，这不仅仅是这个节目。詹姆斯·艾弗里在三部不同的节目中扮演我的父亲，所以把它献给他感觉很对。这对我们来说是一个很好的机会，可以花更多的时间在一起，并完成在节目中进行有竞争力的表演的过程。我在节目中一直跳舞，但成为竞争性舞蹈的一部分让它变得格外特别。

paras.en: You have seen the growth the show has had in the past few years. What do you think it has been about these past two seasons that have really hooked a wider audience and opened the show up to more people?
paras.zh: 您已经看到了该节目在过去几年中的增长。您认为过去两季真正吸引了更多观众并使该剧向更多人开放的原因是什么？

paras.en: I actually think it goes back further than the last two seasons. I think we owe a debt of gratitude to Charli D’Amelio for doing the show. Before her season, it was always an older audience. It wasn’t what it is today, and I think that her being literally one of the most popular social media TikTok stars opened the door to an audience that previously didn’t care about this show and always looked at it as, Oh, that’s my grandmother’s show. That’s my parents’ show. It wasn’t their show, and I think Charli D’Amelio made it OK for it to be their show. As the years went along, it just grew and grew, and more people talked about it, and it became this very cool energy that moved through the younger generation. Back in the day, we used to have this term, the “water cooler” TV shows, where people would stand around the water cooler at the office and talk about the show. Well, social media has become the water cooler, and this show has gained on that.
paras.zh: 事实上，我认为这比前两季还要早。我认为我们应该感谢查理·达梅里奥主持了这个节目。在她的演出季之前，观众总是年龄较大的观众。现在的情况并非如此，我认为她作为最受欢迎的社交媒体 TikTok 明星之一，为以前不关心这个节目并总是将其视为“哦，那是我祖母的节目”的观众打开了大门。那是我父母的表演。这不是他们的节目，我认为查理·达梅里奥让它成为他们的节目是可以的。随着时间的推移，它越来越大，越来越多的人谈论它，它成为一种非常酷的能量，在年轻一代中传播。过去，我们曾经有过“饮水机”电视节目这个术语，人们会站在办公室的饮水机周围谈论该节目。嗯，社交媒体已经成为饮水机，而这个节目也从中受益。

paras.en: It’s beautiful to watch how the young audience is falling in love with the show. I certainly do hope that the younger audience can be fickle, and know as quickly as they fall in love with something, they fall out of love with it. I’m hoping that they stay in love with it for a while, and recognize that what we’re trying to do is bring love and joy to an audience. I will say that the audience out there that adds a lot of hate, negativity and bullying — I hope that goes away and it becomes more of just love and joy. At the end of the day, this is a dance competition show. This isn’t life or death. No one’s life is changing that greatly from this. It is designed for people to let loose, have some fun and truly enjoy these incredible celebrities.
paras.zh: 看到年轻观众如何爱上这个节目真是太棒了。我当然希望年轻观众能够善变，知道一旦他们爱上某样东西，他们就会很快失去它。我希望他们能暂时爱上它，并认识到我们正在努力做的是给观众带来爱和欢乐。我想说的是，观众们增加了很多仇恨、消极和欺凌——我希望这些都会消失，而更多的是爱和欢乐。归根结底，这是一场舞蹈比赛表演。这不是生或死。没有人的生活从此发生如此大的改变。它旨在让人们放松、享受乐趣并真正欣赏这些令人难以置信的名人。

paras.en: There has been a lot of chatter and conversation online this season. Has there been one specific conversation online that has specifically stood out to you?
paras.zh: 本赛季网上有很多讨论和对话。网上是否有一场特定的对话让您印象深刻？

paras.en: No, I’m not going to say anything specific. What I will say is everyone is entitled to their perspective of what they think the show is, and I would say that for me, it isn’t necessarily a show about people who have no dance experience learning to dance. You do that in Hollywood, it becomes a really short list of people. I look at this show as this is just a bunch of celebrities coming together to learn ballroom dancing. Whether they start with a lot of experience or they start with zero experience, it’s about the journey that they all go on.
paras.zh: 不，我不会说任何具体的事情。我要说的是，每个人都有权对他们认为的节目是什么有自己的看法，而且我想说，对我来说，这不一定是关于没有舞蹈经验的人学习跳舞的节目。如果你在好莱坞这样做，那么名单就会变得非常短。我看这个节目是因为这只是一群名人聚在一起学习交谊舞。无论他们是从丰富经验开始还是从零经验开始，这都是他们都要经历的旅程。

paras.en: What is your favorite part about hosting Dancing With the Stars?
paras.zh: 主持《与星共舞》时，您最喜欢的部分是什么？

paras.en: I really do love being almost a mentor to a lot of our celebrities. I go in on Monday and I’m there all day watching every one of the performances and being there as a support system; I’m there for all of it. I’ve been the host of the show, [this year] being my fifth season, and yes, I was a contestant, but I was also a fan from season one on, so I’ve watched almost every person that’s ever done this show in all 35 seasons. That’s really the part that I enjoy: I enjoy being there for them, and it’s a gift that I get to be a part of their journey in some form.
paras.zh: 我真的很喜欢成为我们许多名人的导师。我周一进去，一整天都在那里观看每一场表演，并作为支持系统在那里；我愿意承担这一切。我一直是这个节目的主持人，[今年]是我的第五季，是的，我是一名参赛者，但我从第一季开始也是一个粉丝，所以我几乎看过所有 35 季中所有看过这个节目的人。这确实是我喜欢的部分：我喜欢陪伴在他们身边，这是我能以某种形式参与他们旅程的一份礼物。

paras.en: Do you have a favorite number you performed on the show?
paras.zh: 您在节目中表演的曲目中有最喜欢的吗？

paras.en: My favorite was my Paso Doble to “Turn Down for What.” That was my all-time favorite one. It was a lot of fun to do that. I mean, the music — songs make dances, and you would never think [of doing] a Paso Doble to that song, but yet Witney choreographed a great number having Lindsay [Arnold] on it with us.
paras.zh: 我最喜欢的是我的 Paso Doble 歌曲“Turn Down for What”。那是我一直以来最喜欢的一个。这样做很有趣。我的意思是，音乐——歌曲创造了舞蹈，你永远不会想到为这首歌表演一段舞曲，但威特尼编舞了一段精彩的舞蹈，林赛·阿诺德和我们一起表演。

paras.en: Viewers always talk about how they want a potential second all-star season, but something I have always wondered about is an all-winners. If they ever did that and the idea was floated by you, is there any world where you would ever consider doing an all-winners season?
paras.zh: 观众总是谈论他们如何希望有可能进入第二个全明星赛季，但我一直想知道的是全胜者。如果他们曾经这样做过并且这个想法是你提出的，你是否会考虑打造一个全胜赛季？

paras.en: No, and that’s mostly because of the fact that I am the host of the show, and I certainly wouldn’t be giving that job to someone else while I dance again. The answer would be no. You know, we always talk about the all-star season. We always talk about how much fun that would be. The only problem with an all-star season, and especially now, think about how many of our new fans dislike the idea that they have dancers [competing on the show] that are really good dancers. So, you’d literally be making a show that all of those audience members wouldn’t ultimately want to watch. [It’d be] fun for the people doing it, right? But is it fun for that new audience that loves the idea of it being people who couldn’t dance in the beginning?
paras.zh: 不，这主要是因为我是节目的主持人，我当然不会在我再次跳舞时把这份工作交给别人。答案是否定的。你知道，我们总是谈论全明星赛季。我们总是谈论那会有多有趣。全明星赛季的唯一问题，尤其是现在，想想我们有多少新粉丝不喜欢他们的舞者（在节目中竞争）是真正优秀的舞者。所以，你实际上正在制作一个所有观众最终都不想观看的节目。 [这]对于做这件事的人来说会很有趣，对吧？但对于那些喜欢一开始不会跳舞的新观众来说，这有趣吗？

paras.en: I think the two fan favorites from this season so far are Connor [Wood] and Tatyana. Tatyana, if she was to win, will be the lowest scoring winner in the history of the show on week one.
paras.zh: 我认为本赛季迄今为止最受粉丝喜爱的两个人是康纳（伍德）和塔蒂亚娜。如果塔蒂亚娜获胜，她将成为该节目第一周历史上得分最低的获胜者。

paras.en: That’s this new audience. Tatyana doesn’t make the finale 10 years ago with that audience, because it was never about that. Now you have audience members that really want to see the Guillermos. They want to see the Tatyanas and the Connors and, going back to last season, the Andy Richters. They want to see those people go a long way because, at the end of the day, most of our audience can’t dance, so they’re excited about watching someone who reminds them of themselves achieve something that they would love to do.
paras.zh: 这就是新观众。十年前，塔蒂亚娜并没有在大结局中与观众见面，因为这根本就不是这个问题。现在观众真的很想看到吉列尔莫斯一家。他们想看到塔蒂亚娜夫妇和康纳斯夫妇，以及上个赛季的安迪·里克特夫妇。他们希望看到这些人走得更远，因为归根结底，我们的大多数观众都不会跳舞，所以他们很高兴看到那些让他们想起自己的人实现他们想做的事情。

paras.en: I don’t know if I win if I’m on a season now, even though I’m not a trained dancer. Just the idea that I have dance experience, this audience is harder on those people, and I think that’s wrong, personally. That’s my own personal [opinion], not from the show’s perspective. I think it’s wrong because I think if we had 16 people on the show in the beginning who couldn’t dance, I don’t know if that’s an enjoyable show to watch.
paras.zh: 即使我不是受过训练的舞者，我也不知道如果我现在在一个赛季，我是否会获胜。只是认为我有舞蹈经验，观众对那些人更严厉，我个人认为这是错误的。这是我个人的[观点]，而不是从节目的角度来看。我认为这是错误的，因为我认为如果我们一开始的节目中有16个人不会跳舞，我不知道这是否是一个令人愉快的节目。

paras.en: I think watching some really great dances, some dances that are mediocre and dances that are not so good, I don’t think that the show would be as successful. I question that audience because I go, man, I think you kind of want your Jenna Dewan’s and your Harry [Shum Jr.]’s and your Charli D’Amelio’s, right? You you want those people on there, and you want to see them continue to get better.
paras.zh: 我认为看一些非常出色的舞蹈，一些平庸的舞蹈和不太好的舞蹈，我认为这个节目不会那么成功。我质疑那些观众，因为我想，伙计，我想你有点想要你的珍娜·迪万（Jenna Dewan）和哈利·达梅里奥（Charli D'Amelio）的，对吧？你希望这些人在那里，你希望看到他们继续变得更好。

paras.en: Who do you think will be joining you in the Dancing With the Stars winner’s circle Tuesday night?
paras.zh: 您认为周二晚上谁会加入您的“与星共舞”获胜者圈子？

paras.en: Not a clue. I really don’t know. It is quite wild to me because this is a very different season than any other season we’ve ever had. So, all of the normal things that we would be able to gauge doesn’t really exist this year. A lot of people online say that Connor’s getting the most votes, right? OK, but he’s also the lowest-scoring celebrity. So where does that fit? How does that work? How does the scoring system work? All of those questions leave us to, you know, if you were to look at scores through the season so far, Amber [Glenn] and Pasha [Pashkov] and Ezra [Frech] and Daniella [Karagach] are your hands down two of your favorites. Well, we don’t know where they are on the list, so I have no clue. I really don’t. What I will say is, what I’m hoping for is that every one of our celebrities and partners gives the best performances of the season, and then let it fall where it falls.
paras.zh: 没有任何线索。我真的不知道。这对我来说非常疯狂，因为这是一个与我们经历过的任何其他季节都非常不同的季节。因此，我们能够衡量的所有正常事物今年都不存在。网上很多人都说康纳得票最多，对吧？好吧，但他也是得分最低的名人。那么它适合在哪里呢？这是如何运作的？评分系统如何运作？所有这些问题让我们知道，如果您查看本赛季迄今为止的得分，安布尔（格伦）和帕夏（帕什科夫）以及埃兹拉（弗雷奇）和丹妮拉（卡拉加奇）无疑是您最喜欢的两个。好吧，我们不知道它们在名单​​上的哪里，所以我不知道。我真的不知道。我要说的是，我希望我们的每一位明星和合作伙伴都能奉献出本季最好的表演，然后就让它落到该落的地方。

paras.en: The season 35 finale of DWTS airs live in every U.S. time zone, with a special three-hour finale on Tuesday at 5 p.m. PT/8 p.m. ET, simulcasting across ABC and Disney+ and streaming the next day on Hulu. Read all of THR‘s DWTS coverage here. This interview was edited and condensed for clarity.
paras.zh: DWTS 第 35 季大结局在美国每个时区播出，周二下午 5 点将特别播出三小时大结局。太平洋时间/晚上 8 点东部时间，在 ABC 和 Disney+ 联播，并于次日在 Hulu 上直播。请在此处阅读 THR 的所有 DWTS 报道。为了清晰起见，本次采访经过编辑和精简。

articles.title: IATSE Reaches Tentative Agreement for Broadway Stagehands
articles.author: Caitlin Huston

paras.en: IATSE Local One, which represents stagehands on Broadway, has reached a tentative agreement with the Broadway League, ahead of the lucrative holiday weeks.
paras.zh: 代表百老汇舞台工作人员的 IATSE Local One 在利润丰厚的假期周之前已与百老汇联盟达成了一项临时协议。

paras.en: This comes after Local One members had voted to authorize a strike in October, after working on an expired contract since late July. If called, a work stoppage from Local One would have likely put a halt to most Broadway shows. The agreement still needs to be ratified by members of the union, with details of the tentative agreement planned to be available ahead of the union’s December meeting.
paras.zh: 此前，Local One 成员自 7 月下旬以来一直在处理过期的合同，并于 10 月投票批准罢工。如果接到通知，Local One 的停工可能会导致大多数百老汇演出停止。该协议仍需得到工会成员的批准，暂定协议的细节计划在工会 12 月会议之前公布。

paras.en: However, another local chapter of the union, IATSE Local 764, which represents Broadway dressers and others who work on costumes, still remains without a contract, and voted Sunday to authorize a strike if necessary.
paras.zh: 然而，代表百老汇服装师和其他服装工作人员的工会另一个地方分会 IATSE Local 764 仍然没有签订合同，并于周日投票批准在必要时进行罢工。

paras.en: Local 764 members have been bargaining with The Broadway League, a trade association for Broadway producers and general managers, since June. The members’ previous agreement had expired July 26. The League cancelled bargaining sessions scheduled for November 18 and 19, according to IATSE, and Local 764 has been pushing for new dates.
paras.zh: 自 6 月以来，当地 764 成员一直在与百老汇联盟（百老汇制作人和总经理的行业协会）讨价还价。成员之前的协议已于 7 月 26 日到期。据 IATSE 称，联盟取消了原定于 11 月 18 日和 19 日举行的谈判会议，而 Local 764 一直在争取新的日期。

paras.en: IATSE said the issues still in contention include wages and a gender pay gap that has existed for decades for Broadway wardrobe workers. The field is predominantly female, and has been paid “significantly lower rates than stagehand classifications historically held predominantly by men” according to the union, with Local 764 department heads needing to work 45 percent longer to earn pay comparable to workers in similar department-head roles.
paras.zh: IATSE 表示，仍然存在争议的问题包括工资和百老汇服装工人几十年来一直存在的性别工资差距。根据工会的说法，这个领域主要由女性组成，而且其薪酬“比历史上主要由男性持有的舞台工作人员类别低得多”，当地 764 部门负责人需要工作 45% 的时间才能获得与类似部门负责人职位的工人相当的工资。

paras.en: Both Actors’ Equity and the American Federation of Musicians Local 802 also voted to authorize strikes last year, and came very close to doing so, before striking new contracts with the Broadway League.
paras.zh: 演员权益协会和美国音乐家联合会 Local 802 去年也投票批准罢工，并且在与百老汇联盟签订新合同之前非常接近这样做。

articles.title: Where to Stream ‘Dancing With the Stars’ Season 35 Finale Live Online
articles.author: Erin Lassner

paras.en: The season 35 finale of Dancing With the Stars marks the show’s very first time being broadcast live coast-to-coast — zero tape delay in any U.S. time zones.
paras.zh: 《与星共舞》第 35 季的结局标志着该剧首次在全美各地直播——在美国任何时区都实现零磁带延迟。

paras.en: The three-hour episode airs on Nov. 24 at 5 p.m. PT/8 p.m. ET on ABC, available to stream live via DirecTV (with a five-day free trial), Fubo (with a five-day free trial), Sling and Hulu + Live TV.
paras.zh: 该剧时长三个小时，将于 11 月 24 日下午 5 点播出。太平洋时间/晚上 8 点ABC 上的 ET，可通过 DirecTV（五天免费试用）、Fubo（五天免费试用）、Sling 和 Hulu + Live TV 进行直播。

paras.en: The finale will also stream live on Disney+, which doesn’t offer a free trial of its own, but is included in any of DirecTV’s Signature packages, which do offer the aforementioned free trial.
paras.zh: 大结局还将在 Disney+ 上直播，Disney+ 本身不提供免费试用，但包含在 DirecTV 的任何 Signature 套餐中，后者确实提供上述免费试用。

paras.en: At a Glance: How to Watch Dancing With the Stars Season 35 Finale
paras.zh: 概览：如何观看与星共舞第 35 季大结局

paras.en: - Air date/time: Tuesday, Nov. 24, 5 p.m. PT/8 p.m. ET
paras.zh: - 播出日期/时间：11 月 24 日星期二下午 5 点太平洋时间/晚上 8 点ET

paras.en: - Stream online: DirecTV, Fubo, Sling, Hulu + Live TV, Disney+ (also included in DirecTV Signature packages’ five-day free trial); available to stream next day on Hulu and on-demand via Disney+

paras.en: Where to Watch Dancing With the Stars Finale: Air Date, Time
paras.zh: 哪里可以观看《与星共舞》大结局：播出日期、时间

paras.en: The season 35 finale airs live on Tuesday, Nov. 24 at 5 p.m. PT/8 p.m. ET on ABC (carried on live TV streamers like DirecTV, Fubo, Sling and Hulu + Live TV) and will be simulcast on Disney+.
paras.zh: 第 35 季大结局将于 11 月 24 日星期二下午 5 点直播。太平洋时间/晚上 8 点ET 将在 ABC 上播出（由 DirecTV、Fubo、Sling 和 Hulu + Live TV 等直播电视流媒体直播），并将在 Disney+ 上同步播出。

paras.en: Where to Stream Dancing With the Stars Finale Online Free
paras.zh: 哪里可以免费在线观看与星共舞大结局

paras.zh: 由于比赛节目在 ABC 播出，因此还可以在任何支持该网络的流媒体服务上观看直播，包括 DirecTV（可免费试用五天）、Fubo（也可免费试用五天）、Sling 和 Hulu + Live TV。

articles.title: Dell earnings beat on AI strength, company authorizes $25 billion buyback

paras.en: Dell reported third-quarter earnings on Tuesday that topped Wall Street expectations for earnings and sales, and provided a strong guide for the fourth quarter.
paras.zh: 戴尔周二公布的第三季度收益超出了华尔街对收益和销售额的预期，并为第四季度提供了强有力的指引。

paras.en: Here's how the chipmaker did versus LSEG consensus estimates:
paras.zh: 以下是这家芯片制造商的表现与伦敦证交所共识预测的比较：

paras.en: - EPS: $9.45, adjusted, versus $6.59 expected
paras.zh: - 每股收益：调整后 9.45 美元，预期为 6.59 美元

paras.en: - Revenue: $54.94 billion, versus $49.32 billion expected
paras.zh: - 收入：549.4 亿美元，预期为 493.2 亿美元

paras.en: Dell said that it expected earnings of $8.40 per share on revenue of about $56.3 billion in the current quarter. Analysts polled by LSEG were looking for $7.50 per share on $53.61 billion in revenue.
paras.zh: 戴尔表示，预计本季度每股收益为 8.40 美元，营收约为 563 亿美元。伦敦证券交易所集团 (LSEG) 调查的分析师预计，公司营收为 536.1 亿美元，每股收益为 7.50 美元。

paras.en: The company's overall sales more than doubled on an annual basis during the third quarter, driven by AI server demand.
paras.zh: 在人工智能服务器需求的推动下，第三季度该公司的整体销售额同比增长了一倍多。

paras.en: The company's largest line is its infrastructure solutions group, or ISG, which makes AI servers and systems, often based around AI chips from companies like Nvidia and AMD.
paras.zh: 该公司最大的产品线是基础设施解决方案部门（ISG），该部门生产人工智能服务器和系统，通常基于 Nvidia 和 AMD 等公司的人工智能芯片。

paras.en: ISG sales during the quarter were $41.97 billion, topping an LSEG estimate of $35.27 billion. Of that, $22 billion was for AI-optimized servers, up 291% on an annual basis. ISG now accounts for 85% of Dell's total revenue.
paras.zh: ISG 本季度销售额为 419.7 亿美元，超过 LSEG 预期的 352.7 亿美元。其中，220 亿美元用于人工智能优化服务器，同比增长 291%。 ISG目前占戴尔总收入的85%。

paras.en: "We are now a different company, with Infrastructure Solutions Group driving the vast majority of our profit and growth," said Jeff Clarke, Dell's vice chairman and COO, in a statement. He said that Dell has 7,500 customers buying AI servers.
paras.zh: 戴尔副董事长兼首席运营官杰夫·克拉克在一份声明中表示：“我们现在是一家不同的公司，基础设施解决方案集团推动了我们绝大多数的利润和增长。”他表示，戴尔有7500家客户购买AI服务器。

paras.en: In prepared remarks, Clarke said that Dell has a competitive advantage over other computer equipment makers because it allows customers to get their computers working within hours of delivery.
