paras.en: This is far from the first time Trump has spoken warmly about Putin, joking in 2013 about becoming his “new best friend.” Once in office, Trump said in 2018 that the pair “got on very well,” and in 2022, he described Putin’s initial moves against Ukraine as “genius” and “savvy.” In 2023 and again in 2024, Trump recounted telling Putin, “We’re friends.”
paras.zh: 这远非特朗普第一次热情谈论普京，2013 年他还开玩笑说要成为他的“新最好的朋友”。特朗普在 2018 年上任后表示，两人“相处得很好”，2022 年，他将普京针对乌克兰的最初举措描述为“天才”和“精明”。特朗普在 2023 年和 2024 年两次对普京说：“我们是朋友。”

paras.en: However, this week was the first time Trump made the declaration to Putin’s face, in front of television cameras at one of the most hotly anticipated meetings of recent years.
paras.zh: 然而，本周是特朗普首次在电视摄像机前当着普京的面做出这一声明，这是近年来最受期待的会议之一。

paras.en: “It’s one thing to say in an interview, ‘We get on,’ as Trump has in the past; it’s quite another to see him crossing a room in the hotel in China with an effusive smile on his face and gushing about ‘my friend,’” said Jonathan Eyal, international director of the Royal United Services Institute, a London-based think tank. “It all felt very natural and very real.”
paras.zh: 伦敦智库皇家联合三军研究所国际主任乔纳森·埃亚尔表示：“像特朗普过去那样，在接受采访时说‘我们相处融洽’是一回事；而看到他满脸热情地微笑着穿过中国酒店的一个房间，滔滔不绝地谈论‘我的朋友’，那就完全是另一回事了。” “这一切感觉非常自然、非常真实。”

paras.en: Mara Karlin, who was assistant secretary of defense for strategy, plans and capabilities under President Joe Biden, told NBC News that while Trump’s past actions on Greenland and Ukraine have provoked outcry, “referring to Putin as a ‘friend’ seems to evoke a visceral reaction because it is both entirely believable and inconceivable for any other American president to embrace a Russian leader so literally.”
paras.zh: 乔·拜登总统领导下负责战略、计划和能力的助理国防部长玛拉·卡林告诉美国全国广播公司新闻，虽然特朗普过去在格陵兰岛和乌克兰问题上的行动引起了强烈抗议，但“将普京称为‘朋友’似乎会引起发自内心的反应，因为任何其他美国总统如此真实地拥抱俄罗斯领导人都是完全可信的，也是不可思议的。”

paras.en: The condemnation was not confined to one side of the Atlantic.
paras.zh: 谴责并不局限于大西洋的一侧。

paras.en: In the United States, Democrats were openly scathing. Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer of New York called Trump’s words “embarrassing, despicable, and quite frankly pathetic,” while Sen. Jeanne Shaheen of New Hampshire, the top Democrat on the Senate Foreign Relations Committee, described Trump’s “friend” as a “murderous war criminal.”
paras.zh: 在美国，民主党人公开严厉批评。纽约州参议院少数党领袖查克·舒默称特朗普的言论“令人尴尬、卑鄙，而且坦率地说是可悲的”，而参议院外交关系委员会民主党领袖、新罕布什尔州参议员珍妮·沙欣则将特朗普的“朋友”描述为“凶残的战犯”。

paras.en: Sen. Mark Kelly of Arizona said: “Putin is not my friend. He’s not your friend. He’s not a friend of this country, and when the president of the United States refers to him in that way, it emboldens him.”
paras.zh: 亚利桑那州参议员马克·凯利说：“普京不是我的朋友。他不是你的朋友。他不是这个国家的朋友，当美国总统这样提到他时，这让他更加大胆。”

paras.en: Republicans were more circumspect. Sen. Rick Scott of Florida called Putin a “thug” but acknowledged that Trump needed to work with him.
paras.zh: 共和党人则更加谨慎。佛罗里达州参议员里克·斯科特称普京为“暴徒”，但承认特朗普需要与他合作。

paras.en: Bill Browder, a British American financier who spearheaded the international campaign for Russian sanctions and has become one of Putin’s most prominent critics, also described his “revulsion and disgust” at hearing Trump’s words.
paras.zh: 英裔美国金融家比尔·布劳德(Bill Browder)是国际社会制裁俄罗斯运动的带头人，也是普京最著名的批评者之一，他也描述了他听到特朗普言论后的“反感和厌恶”。

paras.en: “He’s a guy who’s a geopolitical menace, and he should not get any kind of respect, let alone from the American head of state,” Browder told NBC News in a telephone interview. “To be elevated to the top table with genuine superpowers is an unbelievable symbolic position to sit in.”
paras.zh: 布劳德在接受 NBC 新闻电话采访时表示：“他是一个地缘政治威胁，他不应该得到任何形式的尊重，更不用说来自美国国家元首的尊重了。” “凭借真正的超能力登上最高席位是一个令人难以置信的象征性地位。”

paras.en: When asked about Trump’s comment at the end of the news conference following the “Coalition of the Willing” meeting in the German capital, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy only shrugged and walked offstage.
paras.zh: 在德国首都“意愿联盟”会议结束后的新闻发布会上，当被问及特朗普的评论时，乌克兰总统泽连斯基只是耸耸肩，走下台。

articles.title: Two arrested over suspected burglary at royal family’s Sandringham estate
articles.author: Alexander Smith

paras.en: LONDON — Two men have been arrested over a suspected burglary at the royal family’s Sandringham estate, British police said Tuesday, after a reported break-in at the country home of Prince William and Princess Kate.
paras.zh: 伦敦——英国警方周二表示，在威廉王子和凯特王妃的乡村住宅发生入室盗窃事件后，英国警方周二表示，两名男子因涉嫌入室盗窃而被捕。

paras.en: Police responded to reports of “suspicious activity” at the address Monday evening, dispatching searches by police dogs, drones a helicopter. That resulted in two men being arrested on suspicion of burglary and trespassing, according to a statement from the Norfolk Constabulary, the local police authority. The property was unoccupied at the time of the incident, it added.
paras.zh: 周一晚间，警方对该地址发生“可疑活动”的报告作出回应，派出警犬、无人机和直升机进行搜查。据当地警察当局诺福克警察局的一份声明称，两名男子因涉嫌入室盗窃和非法侵入而被捕。声明补充说，事发时该房产无人居住。

paras.en: The Sun newspaper first reported that police were investigating a break-in at Anmer Hall, one of the residences used by the heir to the British throne and his wife, nestled in the heart of the royals’ sprawling estate.
paras.zh: 《太阳报》首先报道称，警方正在调查安默厅 (Anmer Hall) 的一起入室盗窃案，该厅是英国王位继承人及其妻子使用的住宅之一，坐落在王室庞大庄园的中心。

paras.en: Kensington Palace, which handles communications for William and Kate, said it would not comment publicly on security matters. A royal source told NBC News that the couple and their three children, George, Charlotte and Louis, were not there at the time.
paras.zh: 负责处理威廉和凯特通讯的肯辛顿宫表示，不会就安全问题公开发表评论。一位王室消息人士告诉 NBC 新闻，这对夫妇和他们的三个孩子乔治、夏洛特和路易斯当时并不在场。

paras.en: The Waleses’ main home is Forest Lodge in Windsor, where they moved for a “fresh start” in 2025 after the death of Queen Elizabeth II and Kate’s cancer diagnosis.
paras.zh: 威尔士一家的主要住所是温莎的森林小屋，在伊丽莎白二世女王去世和凯特被诊断出癌症后，他们于 2025 年搬到了这里，开始了“新的开始”。

paras.en: Anmer Hall, a 10-bedroom country house built in the early 1800s, entered the royals’ extensive property portfolio when it was bought in 1898 by Queen Victoria’s son, who would later become King Edward VII.
paras.zh: 安默厅 (Anmer Hall) 是一座建于 1800 年代初、拥有 10 间卧室的乡间别墅，于 1898 年被维多利亚女王的儿子（后来成为国王爱德华七世）买下，进入了王室的广泛财产组合。

paras.en: It has been used by various royals over the years. And William and Kate often enjoy the residence for weekend breaks and holidays.
paras.zh: 多年来，它已被多位皇室成员使用。威廉和凯特经常在这里度过周末和假期。

paras.en: The incident will sharpen an ongoing debate about royal security.
paras.zh: 这一事件将加剧有关王室安全的持续争论。

paras.en: William, as a “working royal,” receives 24-hour armed security. But his brother, Prince Harry, does not, having moved to California in 2020 and relinquished his regal duties.
paras.zh: 威廉作为一名“工作王室成员”，受到 24 小时武装保安的保护。但他的弟弟哈里王子却没有，他于 2020 年搬到了加利福尼亚州，并放弃了王室职责。

paras.en: Harry is in a protracted battle with authorities in a bid to reinstate this arrangement, which he argues is necessary due to his high-profile position and history of serving in the armed forces in Afghanistan.
paras.zh: 哈里正在与当局进行一场旷日持久的斗争，以期恢复这一安排，他认为由于他的高调地位和在阿富汗武装部队服役的历史，这是必要的。

paras.en: This summer, Harry and his wife, Meghan, and their two children, Archie, 7, and Lilibet, 5, moved back to Britain.
paras.zh: 今年夏天，哈里和他的妻子梅根以及他们的两个孩子，7 岁的阿奇和 5 岁的莉莉贝特搬回了英国。

paras.en: In October 2024, burglars broke into the Windsor Castle estate west of London and stole a pickup truck and a quad bike from a farm building. King Charles and Queen Camilla weren’t at Windsor Castle at the time.
paras.zh: 2024 年 10 月，窃贼闯入伦敦西部温莎城堡庄园，从一座农场建筑中偷走了一辆皮卡车和一辆四轮摩托车。查尔斯国王和卡米拉王后当时并不在温莎城堡。

paras.en: Three years earlier, a man armed with a crossbow was detained on the castle grounds. Jaswant Singh Chail was later sentenced to nine years in prison after admitting he had been encouraged by a chatbot to kill Elizabeth.
paras.zh: 三年前，一名手持十字弓的男子在城堡内被拘留。贾斯万特·辛格·柴尔 (Jaswant Singh Chail) 承认自己受到聊天机器人的怂恿杀死伊丽莎白，后来被判处九年监禁。

paras.en: In 1982, intruder Michael Fagan managed to sneak into the queen’s private chambers while she was in bed. The queen spent 10 minutes chatting with the burglar before raising the alarm when he asked for a cigarette.
paras.zh: 1982 年，入侵者迈克尔·费根 (Michael Fagan) 趁女王睡觉时潜入她的私人卧室。女王花了10分钟与窃贼聊天，然后当窃贼向他要香烟时才发出警报。

paras.en: Hours after the break-in, William was meeting with British Prime Minister Andy Burnham on Tuesday on the doorstep of No. 10 Downing St., where they are expected to discuss issues such as homelessness.
paras.zh: 闯入事件发生数小时后，威廉周二在唐宁街 10 号门口会见英国首相安迪·伯纳姆，预计他们将在那里讨论无家可归等问题。

paras.en: Meanwhile Kate is set to feature in a 30-minute documentary, “Heal,” about her cancer diagnosis and remission. It will air on NBC on Nov. 30 at 8 p.m. ET/PT before streaming on Peacock from Dec. 1.
paras.zh: 与此同时，凯特将出演一部 30 分钟的纪录片《治愈》，讲述她的癌症诊断和缓解情况。该节目将于 11 月 30 日晚上 8 点在 NBC 播出。 ET/PT 将于 12 月 1 日起在 Peacock 上播出。

articles.title: Indian teen wonder breaks List A record with 200 from 52 balls

paras.en: Thu, 24 Sept, 11:00 pm, Final score, IAW 6/364, AAW 9/362
paras.zh: 9 月 24 日星期四，晚上 11:00，最终成绩，IAW 6/364，AAW 9/362

paras.en: Indian 15yo Sooryavanshi hits 200 from 52 balls in List A cricket record
paras.zh: 印度 15 岁选手 Sooryavanshi 52 个球打出 200 个球，创 A 级板球纪录

paras.en: Indian 15-year-old Vaibhav Sooryavanshi scored 200 from 52 balls to set a new List A record.
paras.zh: 印度15岁选手瓦伊巴夫·苏里亚万什(Vaibhav Sooryavanshi)52球打出200分，创造了A组新纪录。

paras.en: Sooryavanshi also set new records for the fastest century and fastest 150.
paras.zh: Sooryavanshi 还创下了最快百公里和最快 150 英里的新纪录。

paras.en: Sooryavanshi had previously broken the record as the youngest player to represent India in an ODI.
paras.zh: 此前，Sooryavanshi 打破了代表印度参加 ODI 比赛的最年轻球员的纪录。

articles.title: Victorian wildlife carer facing ban for taking sick wombat to NSW vet
articles.author: Danielle Kutchel

paras.en: A wildlife carer in East Gippsland is being investigated for illegally transporting a wombat interstate for specialised vet care without a permit.
paras.zh: 东吉普斯兰的一名野生动物护理人员因未经许可非法跨州运输袋熊进行专门兽医护理而受到调查。

paras.en: The carer is facing the loss of her wildlife carer licence, with an outcome expected by Christmas.
paras.zh: 这名看护者面临着失去野生动物看护者执照的危险，预计圣诞节前就会有结果。

paras.en: A wildlife carer in Victoria's far east could be banned from her work after she breached rules designed to stop illegal export by taking a sick wombat to New South Wales for treatment.
paras.zh: 维多利亚州远东地区的一名野生动物护理人员将一只生病的袋熊带到新南威尔士州接受治疗，违反了旨在阻止非法出口的规定，可能会被禁止从事工作。

paras.en: Carer Jade Whittingham from Wombat Wisdom Wildlife Care in East Gippsland is being investigated by the Department of Energy, Environment and Climate Action (DEECA) after she transported a wombat into NSW for vet treatment without a permit.
paras.zh: 东吉普斯兰袋熊智慧野生动物护理中心的护理员 Jade Whittingham 未经许可将一只袋熊运送到新南威尔士州接受兽医治疗，目前正在接受能源、环境和气候行动部 (DEECA) 的调查。

paras.en: Ms Whittingham said the department told her that her actions constituted illegal importing and exporting of animals.
paras.zh: 惠廷厄姆女士说，该部门告诉她，她的行为构成非法进出口动物。

paras.en: She said the wombat needed a blood transfusion but was unable to receive one in Gippsland.
paras.zh: 她说这只袋熊需要输血，但吉普斯兰无法接受输血。

paras.en: "I did what anyone would do and went and got her a blood transfusion, and she's home now," Ms Whittingham said.
paras.zh: “我做了任何人都会做的事，去给她输血，她现在回家了，”惠廷汉姆女士说。

paras.en: Ms Whittingham added the vet over the border "will only see [Victorian animals] if it's completely necessary if they can't help me over the phone".
paras.zh: 惠廷汉姆女士补充说，边境那边的兽医“只有在完全必要且无法通过电话帮助我的情况下才会看望[维多利亚动物]”。

paras.en: The Victorian Wildlife Act states that people must not import wildlife into Victoria from another state or export them to another state without a permit.
paras.zh: 《维多利亚州野生动物法》规定，未经许可，人们不得将野生动物从另一个州进口到维多利亚州或将其出口到另一个州。

paras.en: Permits may be subject to conditions that must also be adhered to.
paras.zh: 许可证可能受到必须遵守的条件的约束。

paras.en: Wildlife carers must meet permit conditions and failing to do so is an offence.
paras.zh: 野生动物护理人员必须满足许可条件，否则将构成犯罪。

paras.en: The Conservation Regulator monitors compliance and investigates alleged breaches, and punishments for breaches can include education, warnings or licence cancellation.
paras.zh: 保护监管机构负责监督合规情况并调查涉嫌违规行为，对违规行为的惩罚可能包括教育、警告或吊销许可证。

paras.en: By taking a wombat into NSW, Ms Whittingham faces the prospect of losing her wildlife licence and having to pay a fine of more than $20,000.
paras.zh: 由于将袋熊带入新南威尔士州，惠廷汉姆女士可能会被吊销野生动物许可证，并须支付超过 2 万澳元的罚款。

paras.en: Ms Whittingham said she was unaware she needed a permit to take her wombats interstate for vet treatment.
paras.zh: 惠廷厄姆女士说，她不知道自己需要获得许可才能将袋熊带到州际接受兽医治疗。

paras.en: But she said waiting for a permit in a life or death situation for an animal was unacceptable.
paras.zh: 但她表示，在动物生死攸关的情况下等待许可证是不可接受的。

paras.en: "By the time that permit is approved, the animal would have been dead," she said.
paras.zh: “当许可证获得批准时，这只动物可能已经死了，”她说。

paras.en: Ms Whittingham wants the Wildlife Act changed to allow for more leniency for wildlife carers who take wildlife interstate for treatment and rehabilitate them in Victoria.
paras.zh: 惠廷厄姆女士希望修改《野生动物法》，以便对那些将野生动物跨州接受治疗并在维多利亚州进行康复的野生动物护理人员给予更宽大的处理。

paras.en: "They should be made exempt [from the need for a permit]. We're not buying, we're not selling, we're not releasing, it's purely to get treatment," she said.
paras.zh: “他们应该被免除[不需要许可证]。我们不买，我们不卖，我们不释放，这纯粹是为了接受治疗，”她说。

paras.en: The Conservation Regulator is assessing the case.
paras.zh: 保护监管机构正在评估此案。

paras.en: DEECA and the Conservation Regulator would not comment because the investigation is ongoing.
paras.zh: DEECA 和保护监管机构不予置评，因为调查仍在进行中。

paras.en: Ms Whittingham said she was expecting to hear the outcome by Christmas.
paras.zh: 惠廷厄姆女士表示，她预计在圣诞节前听到结果。

paras.en: Wildlife Victoria chief executive Lisa Palma said prospective wildlife carers operate under the supervision of an existing licensed shelter for a year before applying for their own licence.
paras.zh: 维多利亚州野生动物协会首席执行官丽莎·帕尔马表示，未来的野生动物护理人员在现有有执照的庇护所的监督下工作一年，然后再申请自己的执照。

paras.en: "All wildlife carers are provided, and are required to comply with, the Victorian Wildlife Rehabilitator Authorisation Guide," she said.
paras.zh: “所有野生动物护理人员都必须遵守《维多利亚州野生动物康复者授权指南》，”她说。

paras.en: "They are also provided with general and species-specific guidelines, which support the guide.".
paras.zh: “还为他们提供了一般和特定物种的指南，这些指南支持该指南。”

paras.en: But she said there were gaps in the training and support that prospective and established wildlife carers receive.
paras.zh: 但她表示，潜在的和成熟的野生动物护理人员所获得的培训和支持存在差距。

paras.en: "The pathway to obtaining a carer licence is self-managed, and the onus is on the individual to find an established shelter for supervision," Ms Palma said.
paras.zh: 帕尔马女士说：“获得护理人员执照的途径是自我管理，个人有责任找到一个既定的庇护所进行监督。”

paras.en: She said there were no training courses or standardised training, which placed pressure on "supervising shelters who are already overworked and under-supported".
paras.zh: 她说，没有培训课程或标准化培训，这给“监督已经过度工作和支持不足的庇护所”带来了压力。

paras.en: Ms Palma said Wildlife Victoria would welcome changes to the system to enable more carers to enter the system.
paras.zh: 帕尔马女士表示，维多利亚州野生动物协会欢迎对该系统进行更改，以使更多的护理人员能够进入该系统。

paras.en: She said the organisation did not support relaxing the laws around transporting animals interstate, but wanted increased government funding for specialist wildlife veterinary services and support for vet clinics to build their wildlife care skills.
paras.zh: 她说，该组织不支持放宽州际运输动物的法律，但希望增加政府对专业野生动物兽医服务的资助，并支持兽医诊所培养野生动物护理技能。

articles.title: Adelaide festival-goer says lightning strike 'threw me backwards'

paras.en: Adelaide man survives lightning strike at Strawberry Fields music festival
paras.zh: 阿德莱德男子在草莓园音乐节遭雷击后幸存

paras.en: Adelaide carpenter Seb Young was struck by lightning at the Strawberry Fields music festival on the weekend.
paras.zh: 阿德莱德木匠 Seb Young 周末在草莓园音乐节上被闪电击中。

paras.en: Three other people were also hit by lightning during severe storm at the three-day festival.
paras.zh: 在为期三天的节日期间，还有另外三人在暴风雨中被闪电击中。

paras.en: Mr Young, who spent the night in hospital, said he was fortunate to only sustain "a little burn" from the incident.
paras.zh: 杨先生在医院过夜，他说他很幸运，这次事件只造成了“一点点烧伤”。

articles.title: Drops for Nvidia, Anthropic and other AI stocks drag the markets back down

paras.en: Drops for Nvidia, Anthropic and other AI stocks drag the markets back down
paras.zh: Nvidia、Anthropic 和其他人工智能股票的下跌拖累市场回落

paras.en: S&P 500 falls 0.5% to 8th loss in last 9 days
paras.zh: 标准普尔 500 指数下跌 0.5%，为过去 9 天内第 8 次下跌

paras.en: Stocks tied to the artificial intelligence industry dragged the U.S. market lower Tuesday after their surge from the day before quickly fizzled. That's even though much of the rest of Wall Street rose, along with Americans' confidence in the economy.
paras.zh: 与人工智能行业相关的股票周二拖累美国股市走低，此前一天的涨幅迅速回落。尽管华尔街其他大部分股票以及美国人对经济的信心都在上涨，但情况还是如此。

paras.en: The S&P 500 fell 0.5 per cent to its eighth loss in the last nine days. Tech stocks once again led the way and yanked the Nasdaq composite down a market-leading 1.5 per cent. Stocks outside of AI held up much better, and the Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 423 points, or 0.9 per cent.
paras.zh: 标准普尔 500 指数下跌 0.5%，为过去 9 天内第八次下跌。科技股再次领涨，导致纳斯达克综合指数下跌 1.5%，领先市场。人工智能以外的股票表现更好，道琼斯工业平均指数上涨 423 点，即 0.9%。

paras.en: In Toronto, the S&P/TSX composite index slipped 0.35 per cent.
paras.zh: 在多伦多，S&P/TSX 综合指数下跌 0.35%。

paras.en: They're the latest swings for a market that's been mostly sinking since hitting its all-time high last month. The worry is that prices for AI-related stocks shot too high into a possible bubble and need to deflate. That carries immense consequences for the broader market and workers' 401(k) accounts because AI companies have grown into Wall Street's most influential stocks.
paras.zh: 自上个月触及历史高点以来，市场一直在下跌，这是最新的波动。令人担忧的是，人工智能相关股票的价格过高，可能引发泡沫，需要通货紧缩。这对更广泛的市场和工人的 401(k) 账户产生了巨大影响，因为人工智能公司已经成长为华尔街最有影响力的股票。

paras.en: While the surprise return of Jensen Huang as Nvidia's CEO announced Monday does bring back a charismatic leader who championed the entire AI industry, it does not settle the deep concerns dogging it. For one, doubts remain about whether AI can possibly produce enough profit and productivity to make the massive investments underway in data centres worth it.
paras.zh: 虽然周一宣布黄仁勋出人意料地回归担任英伟达首席执行官，确实带来了一位拥护整个人工智能行业的魅力领袖，但这并不能解决困扰该行业的深层次担忧。一方面，人们仍然怀疑人工智能是否能够产生足够的利润和生产力，使数据中心的大规模投资物有所值。

paras.en: At the same time, high interest rates make it more difficult to borrow money to pay for the industry's growth. Sweeping victories for Democrats earlier this month in the U.S. midterm elections, meanwhile, have raised concerns about more regulation for AI, including possible halts to further construction of data centres.
paras.zh: 与此同时，高利率使得借钱来支持该行业的增长变得更加困难。与此同时，本月早些时候民主党在美国中期选举中取得的压倒性胜利引发了人们对人工智能更多监管的担忧，包括可能停止进一步建设数据中心。

paras.en: To be sure, AI stocks and the broader U.S. market have been prone to extreme reversals since the summer, not only week to week but even hour to hour.
paras.zh: 可以肯定的是，自夏季以来，人工智能股票和更广泛的美国市场一直容易出现极端逆转，不仅是每周，甚至是每小时。

paras.en: For now, at least, the momentum is back downward.
paras.zh: 至少目前来看，势头又回来了。

paras.en: Nvidia fell 5.9 per cent day after soaring 31.5 per cent to its biggest gain in more than two decades. Other stocks around the AI industry fell by similar amounts.
paras.zh: 英伟达股价飙升 31.5%，创二十多年来最大涨幅，但当天股价下跌 5.9%。人工智能行业的其他股票也出现了类似的跌幅。

paras.en: CoreWeave, which buys Nvidia chips and rents out access to them over the cloud, tumbled 11.8 per cent. GE Vernova, which helps power AI data centres, dropped 4.8 per cent.
paras.zh: CoreWeave 购买 Nvidia 芯片并通过云出租这些芯片的访问权限，该公司股价下跌 11.8%。为人工智能数据中心提供动力的 GE Vernova 股价下跌 4.8%。

paras.en: And Anthropic, the company behind the Claude AI chatbot, sank 6.5 per cent to drop below $83 US. That's how much it first sold its stock for in its initial public offering last week. The stock had briefly jumped as high as $115 US in its first day of trading amid a frenzy of hype.
paras.zh: Claude AI 聊天机器人背后的公司 Anthropic 股价下跌 6.5%，跌破 83 美元。这是该公司上周首次公开募股时首次出售股票的价格。在疯狂的炒作中，该股在首日交易中曾一度飙升至 115 美元。

paras.en: Such drops were powerful enough to drag the S&P 500 index lower, even though most of the stocks within the index climbed. They rose following the latest report to say confidence among U.S. consumers is improving by more than economists expected.
paras.zh: 尽管该指数内的大多数股票都在上涨，但这种下跌的力量足以拖累标准普尔 500 指数走低。最新报告称美国消费者信心改善程度超出经济学家预期，股价上涨。

paras.en: Confidence jumped sharply for Democrats and Independents following the midterm election results, according to the Conference Board. That narrowed the wide gap between them and Republicans, whose confidence fell slightly.
paras.zh: 根据世界大型企业联合会的数据，中期选举结果公布后，民主党人和独立人士的信心急剧上升。这缩小了他们与共和党人之间的巨大差距，共和党人的信心略有下降。

paras.en: The results echo a report from the University of Michigan released earlier in the month, which also showed a rise in overall sentiment following the midterm elections and a drop in oil prices from late October.
paras.zh: 这一结果与密歇根大学本月早些时候发布的一份报告相呼应，该报告也显示中期选举后整体情绪有所上升，且油价自 10 月底以来有所下降。

paras.en: Companies in industries across the economy, meanwhile, continue to report strong growth in profits for the summer.
paras.zh: 与此同时，整个经济行业的公司继续报告夏季利润强劲增长。

paras.en: Dollar Tree climbed 11.2 per cent after reporting bigger earnings for the latest quarter than analysts expected. The average shopper spent slightly more in its stores during the three months than they did in last year's third quarter, and more of them came in than last year.
paras.zh: Dollar Tree 公布最新季度盈利高于分析师预期后，股价上涨 11.2%。这三个月里，购物者在商店的平均消费额略高于去年第三季度，而且进店人数也比去年多。

paras.en: Kohl's rallied 19.5 per cent after reporting a profit for the latest quarter, when analysts were expecting basically zero. It also gave forecasts for revenue for the final three months of its fiscal year that were better than expected.
paras.zh: Kohl’s 公布最新季度盈利后股价上涨 19.5%，而分析师此前预期盈利基本为零。它还对本财年最后三个月的收入做出了好于预期的预测。

paras.en: Businesses in the S&P 500 are on pace to report overall growth in earnings per share of more than 25 f per cent for a third straight quarter, according to FactSet. That's a big deal because stock prices tend to follow the path of corporate profits and interest rates over the long term. But emotions of investors can also overwhelm them in the short term, as the last few weeks have demonstrated.
paras.zh: FactSet 的数据显示，标准普尔 500 指数成分股企业的每股收益总体增长将连续第三个季度超过 25%。这是一件大事，因为从长远来看，股价往往会跟随企业利润和利率的走势。但正如过去几周所证明的那样，投资者的情绪也可能在短期内压倒他们。

paras.en: All told, the S&P 500 fell 36.08 points to 7,201.09. The Dow Jones Industrial Average added 423.39 to 50,018.70, and the Nasdaq composite fell 356.02 to 23,733.54.
paras.zh: 总而言之，标准普尔 500 指数下跌 36.08 点，至 7,201.09 点。道琼斯工业平均指数上涨 423.39 点至 50,018.70 点，纳斯达克综合指数下跌 356.02 点至 23,733.54 点。

paras.en: In the bond market, U.S. Treasury yields held relatively steady. The yield on the 10-year Treasury rose to 4.93 per cent from 4.92 per cent late Monday after drifting up and down earlier in the day.
paras.zh: 债券市场方面，美国国债收益率相对稳定。 10 年期国债收益率在当天早些时候上下波动后，从周一晚间的 4.92% 升至 4.93%。

paras.en: Oil prices rose, which tend to push upward on inflation and on bond yields. The price for a barrel of Brent crude oil climbed 2.4 per cent to $88.78 US. It's been yo-yoing between $72 US and $114 US since the United States and Israel attacked Iran in February.
paras.zh: 石油价格上涨，往往会推高通胀和债券收益率。每桶布伦特原油价格上涨 2.4%，至 88.78 美元。自2月份美国和以色列袭击伊朗以来，该货币一直在72美元至114美元之间波动。

articles.title: Vanity Fair's Taylor Swift exposé sparks backlash
articles.author: Christine Pagulayan

paras.en: Vanity Fair's Taylor Swift exposé sparks backlash
paras.zh: 《名利场》泰勒·斯威夫特曝光引发强烈反对

paras.en: Critics have been taking aim at profile's claims, sources and tone
paras.zh: 批评者一直把矛头指向个人资料的主张、来源和语气

paras.en: Variety Fair's The Mastermind profile offers a less-than-flattering account of Taylor Swift's relationships and public image — though it does not name the singer directly.
paras.zh: Variety Fair 的《主谋》简介对泰勒·斯威夫特的人际关系和公众形象进行了不太讨人喜欢的描述，尽管它没有直接提及这位歌手的名字。

paras.en: The piece, which Canadian journalist May Jeong says drew from interviews with more than 100 people, rests some of its claims on anonymous accounts and memories of events from decades ago. And critics have questioned what the article establishes — and what it asks readers to infer.
paras.zh: 加拿大记者梅·郑 (May Jeong) 表示，这篇文章是根据对 100 多人的采访而摘录的，部分内容基于匿名叙述和对几十年前事件的记忆。批评者质疑这篇文章所阐述的内容以及它要求读者推断的内容。

paras.en: CBC News has contacted Jeong and Swift's representatives but did not hear back by publication time.
paras.zh: CBC新闻已联系了郑和斯威夫特的代表，但截至发稿时尚未收到回复。

paras.en: An anonymous music industry source identified as "The Exec" compares Swift to Regina George, the popular antagonist in 2004's Mean Girls. Another source known as "The Person Familiar" alleges that Swift "comes after you" if you disagree with her.
paras.zh: 一位被称为“The Exec”的匿名音乐行业消息人士将斯威夫特与 2004 年电影《贱女孩》中受欢迎的反派雷吉娜·乔治进行了比较。另一个被称为“熟悉的人”的消息来源声称，如果你不同意斯威夫特的观点，她就会“来追你”。

paras.en: Toronto culture writer Stacy Lee Kong said "an anonymous source is only anonymous to the public." The journalist, fact-checker and editors would know the source’s identity, she said, as would the lawyer. While that may reassure readers that the source was checked, Lee Kong said, it doesn't prove the account is true.
paras.zh: 多伦多文化作家史黛西·李·孔(Stacy Lee Kong)表示，“匿名消息来源只是对公众匿名。”她说，记者、事实核查人员和编辑以及律师都会知道消息来源的身份。李康说，虽然这可能会让读者放心，消息来源已经过检查，但这并不能证明该报道是真实的。

paras.en: Taylor Swift onstage during the 60th annual Country Music Association awards in November in Nashville. (Cindy Ord/Getty Images)
paras.zh: 泰勒·斯威夫特 (Taylor Swift) 于 11 月在纳什维尔举行的第 60 届乡村音乐协会年度颁奖典礼上登上舞台。 （辛迪·奥德/盖蒂图片社）

paras.en: The profile says people close to Swift "do not dare speak ill of her — dare not speak of her at all." It cites a lawyer who chose to speak through an intermediary, a manager who asked the reporter to delete their correspondence and a pastor who said they needed the family’s permission to comment.
paras.zh: 该简介称，与斯威夫特关系密切的人“不敢说她的坏话——根本不敢说她。”报道援引一名选择通过中间人发言的律师、一名要求记者删除他们的信件的经理和一名牧师表示，他们需要获得家人的许可才能发表评论。

paras.en: Lee Kong noted that people may refuse to comment or request anonymity for many reasons, including privacy or concern about professional consequences.
paras.zh: Lee Kong 指出，人们可能出于多种原因拒绝发表评论或要求匿名，包括隐私或担心职业后果。

paras.en: Swift has spoken publicly about feeling excluded and bullied as a child. In the profile, former classmates and a teacher challenge parts of her recollections. Former classmate Chanice Skinner describes Swift as part of "the popular crowd," while music teacher Sharon Luyben disputes a story about friends moving away from Swift at lunch.
paras.zh: 斯威夫特曾公开表示自己小时候感到被排斥和欺负。在简介中，以前的同学和一位老师对她的部分记忆提出了质疑。斯威夫特的前同学查尼斯·斯金纳 (Chanice Skinner) 将斯威夫特描述为“受欢迎的人群”的一部分，而音乐老师莎朗·卢本 (Sharon Luyben) 对朋友们在午餐时离开斯威夫特的故事提出了异议。

paras.en: Some readers questioned the weight given to memories from decades ago. One X user wrote, "If you're coming for a 37 year old because of a bad experience you had with her in 7th grade you gotta let it go and move on."
paras.zh: 一些读者质疑几十年前记忆的重要性。一位 X 用户写道：“如果你因为七年级时与 37 岁的女孩有过一次糟糕的经历而来找她，你就得放下它，继续前进。”

paras.en: One former classmate's recollection that Swift owned Ugg boots in three colours also became a focus of online jokes. The classmate said her single mother could not afford a pair. Critics questioned what the anecdote added to a profile making broader claims about Swift's character.
paras.zh: 一位以前的同学回忆说，斯威夫特拥有三种颜色的 Ugg 靴子，这也成为网上笑话的焦点。这位同学说她的单身母亲买不起一双。批评者质疑这段轶事在个人资料中添加了什么内容，对斯威夫特的性格做出了更广泛的评价。

paras.en: Another X user wrote, "She had three pairs of Ugg boots UGH SHES THE WORST!!! This is pathetic. 💀💀💀💀💀"
paras.zh: 另一位 X 用户写道：“她有三双 Ugg 靴子啊，她是最糟糕的！！！这太可悲了。💀💀💀💀💀”

paras.en: Lee Kong acknowledged that readers may want a story that feels "a bit more fair" and said she understood the criticism of the profile's emphasis on details such as the boots. At the same time, she argued that a profile of a powerful celebrity does not need to be a complete accounting of every positive and negative aspect of that person.
paras.zh: 李孔承认，读者可能想要一个感觉“更公平”的故事，并表示她理解因该简介强调靴子等细节而受到的批评。与此同时，她认为，一个强大的名人的形象不需要完整地描述这个人的每一个积极和消极的方面。

paras.en: Charli xcx, left, and Taylor Swift pose at an event at Madison Square Garden in December 2014 in New York City. (Dimitrios Kambouris/Getty Images for iHeartMedia)
paras.zh: 2014 年 12 月，Charli xcx（左）和泰勒·斯威夫特 (Taylor Swift) 在纽约麦迪逊广场花园举行的活动中合影。 （Dimitrios Kabouris/iHeartMedia 的盖蒂图片社）

paras.en: The profile discusses songs by pop stars Charli xcx and Olivia Rodrigo that some fans have linked to Swift. Some listeners have interpreted Charli xcx's Sympathy is a knife as reflecting insecurity around a major pop star and Swift's Actually Romantic as a response. Rodrigo has not publicly identified the subject of the grudge.
paras.zh: 该简介讨论了流行歌星 Charli xcx 和 Olivia Rodrigo 的歌曲，一些粉丝将这些歌曲与 Swift 联系起来。一些听众将 Charli xcx 的《Sympathy is a Knife》解读为反映了一位流行巨星周围的不安全感，而 Swift 的《Actually Romantic》则是对此的回应。罗德里戈尚未公开指出恩怨的对象。

paras.en: The article also complicates the simple feud narrative, including mention of Swift praising Charli xcx's songwriting and dancing during one of Rodrigo's performances.
paras.zh: 这篇文章还使简单的不和叙述复杂化，包括提到斯威夫特在罗德里戈的一场表演中赞扬了 Charli xcx 的歌曲创作和舞蹈。

paras.en: It also revisits Swift's dispute over the rights to her early recordings. After Big Machine Records sold the recordings to Scooter Braun's company, Swift said she had not been given the opportunity to buy them. She later re-recorded the albums.
paras.zh: 它还重新审视了斯威夫特关于她早期录音的权利的争议。在大机器唱片公司将这些唱片出售给斯库特·布劳恩的公司后，斯威夫特表示她没有机会购买这些唱片。她后来重新录制了这些专辑。

paras.en: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce, pictured in Cleveland in May, were married in an elaborate ceremony at Madison Square Garden on July 3. (Jason Miller/Getty Images)
paras.zh: 泰勒·斯威夫特 (Taylor Swift) 和特拉维斯·凯尔斯 (Travis Kelce) 于 5 月在克利夫兰拍摄，7 月 3 日在麦迪逊广场花园举行了一场盛大的婚礼。（Jason Miller/Getty Images）

paras.en: Wealth, wedding coverage and online reaction
paras.zh: 财富、婚礼报道和网上反应

paras.en: Vanity Fair's account of Swift and Travis Kelce's wedding at Madison Square Garden, as well as the couple's reported donations of $26 million US, drew attention to the profile's tone.
paras.zh: 《名利场》对斯威夫特和特拉维斯·凯尔斯在麦迪逊广场花园举行的婚礼的报道，以及据报道这对夫妇捐赠了 2600 万美元的报道，引起了人们对该个人资料基调的关注。

paras.en: The line "Beyond need lies want. Beyond want, greed" was especially criticized. In his column, Variety chief music critic Chris Willman called the piece a "failed exposé," while some readers said it made them more sympathetic. One X user wrote: "The Vanity Fair hit piece on Taylor Swift just made me like her even more lol."
paras.zh: “超越需要，就是想要。超越想要，就是贪婪”这句话尤其受到批评。 《综艺》首席音乐评论家克里斯·威尔曼在他的专栏中称这首曲子是“失败的揭露”，而一些读者则表示这让他们更加同情。一位 X 用户写道：“《名利场》关于泰勒·斯威夫特的热门文章让我更加喜欢她了，哈哈。”

paras.en: According to Lee Kong, the profile's format is "referential to Taylor Swift's work herself." It uses labels such as "The Exec" rather than names and includes hidden messages like bolded letters that refer to Swift's song Look What You Made Me Do. Still, she acknowledges that some readers may find the piece mean-spirited or ineffective.
paras.zh: 据 Lee Kong 称，该简介的格式“参考了泰勒·斯威夫特本人的作品”。它使用诸如“The Exec”之类的标签而不是名字，并包含隐藏的信息，例如引用斯威夫特的歌曲“Look What You Made Me Do”的粗体字母。尽管如此，她承认一些读者可能会觉得这篇文章卑鄙或无效。

paras.en: Celebrity journalism can also be shaped by reporters' dependence on access, Kong said. Outlets may hesitate to criticize public figures if they worry about losing the chance to interview them.
paras.zh: 孔说，名人新闻也可能受到记者对采访的依赖的影响。如果媒体担心失去采访公众人物的机会，他们可能会犹豫是否批评公众人物。

paras.en: At the same time, she argued, scrutiny still matters because celebrities can wield enormous cultural and economic influence and because fandom itself shapes public behaviour.
paras.zh: 与此同时，她认为，审查仍然很重要，因为名人可以发挥巨大的文化和经济影响力，而且粉丝本身也影响着公众行为。

paras.en: "I think telling the truth about people that play these really important roles actually is serious journalism."
paras.zh: “我认为讲述扮演这些真正重要角色的人的真相实际上是严肃的新闻报道。”

articles.title: Leaked FIFA documents show president Infantino's 96-year private equity plan for World Cup

paras.en: Leaked FIFA documents show president Infantino's 96-year private equity plan for World Cup
paras.zh: 泄露的国际足联文件显示主席因凡蒂诺96年世界杯私募股权计划

paras.en: Deal apparently was nearing completion in N.Y. before Men's World Cup final in July
paras.zh: 在七月份的男子世界杯决赛之前，纽约的交易显然已接近完成

paras.en: Gianni Infantino's failed private equity plan that provoked the biggest crisis of his FIFA presidency intended to sell stakes in the World Cup for 96 years.
paras.zh: 詹尼·因凡蒂诺(Gianni Infantino)的私募股权计划失败，引发了他在国际足联(FIFA)主席任期内最大的危机，该计划旨在出售96年世界杯的股份。

paras.en: Documents exchanged between FIFA and investor Joshua Kushner's firm Thrive Capital, reviewed Tuesday by The Associated Press, also show the planned $20 billion US FIFA Forward Enterprises subsidiary could have paid tens of millions of dollars in management bonuses to its executives.
paras.zh: 美联社周二查阅的国际足联和投资者约书亚·库什纳的公司 Thrive Capital 之间交换的文件还显示，计划中的价值 200 亿美元的美国 FIFA Forward Enterprises 子公司可能会向其高管支付数千万美元的管理奖金。

paras.en: The leaked documents, first reported Monday by the New York Post, show how the FFE deal was moving toward completion in New York on the weekend of July 19 final of the men's World Cup.
paras.zh: 《纽约邮报》周一首次报道了泄露的文件，文件显示了 FFE 交易正在于 7 月 19 日周末男子世界杯决赛在纽约完成。

paras.en: The secretive project was revealed nine days after the final by British daily The Times and the global backlash, including from senior FIFA executives, pushed Infantino to withdraw the proposal within days.
paras.zh: 决赛九天后，英国日报《泰晤士报》披露了这一秘密项目，全球的强烈反对，包括国际足联高级管理人员的强烈反对，迫使因凡蒂诺在几天内撤回了该提议。

paras.en: The leaked documents, including a FIFA in-house risk assessment, show its own finance officials "were not directly privy to the construction of this transaction."
paras.zh: 泄露的文件，包括国际足联内部风险评估，显示其财务官员“并不直接参与此次交易的建设”。

paras.en: "This deal provides for Fifa to create a for-profit subsidiary which would have all the commercial rights for FIFA events transferred to it for commercial exploitation for the next 96 years," the risk assessment states.
paras.zh: 风险评估指出：“这项交易规定国际足联将创建一家营利性子公司，该子公司将拥有国际足联赛事的所有商业权利，以便在未来 96 年内进行商业开发。”

paras.en: Infantino now faces a first presidential election challenge since he was elected in 2016, with two opponents campaigning ahead of a March 18 vote in Morocco: Philippe Diallo of France and Kohzo Tashima of Japan.
paras.zh: 因凡蒂诺现在面临自 2016 年当选以来的首次总统选举挑战，有两名对手在 3 月 18 日摩洛哥投票前竞选：法国的菲利普·迪亚洛和日本的田岛幸三。

paras.en: The FFE private equity plan reignited concerns in Europe and Japan about Infantino's leadership style and political ties to U.S. President Donald Trump, over creating a FIFA peace prize and waiving a mandatory one-game ban at the World Cup for United States forward Folarin Balogun.
paras.zh: FFE私募股权计划重新引发了欧洲和日本对因凡蒂诺的领导风格以及与美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的政治关系的担忧，包括设立国际足联和平奖以及免除美国前锋福拉林·巴洛贡在世界杯上的强制性一场比赛禁令。

paras.en: The leaked documents show FIFA was in talks with the Affinity Partners investment firm of Jared Kushner, Trump's son-in-law, before settling on his younger brother Joshua's firm Thrive Capital as anchor investor.
paras.zh: 泄露的文件显示，国际足联正在与特朗普女婿贾里德库什纳的 Affinity Partners 投资公司进行谈判，然后选定他弟弟约书亚的公司 Thrive Capital 作为主要投资者。

paras.en: - France's Diallo, Japan's Tashima challenging Infantino in FIFA presidential election
paras.zh: - 法国的迪亚洛和日本的田岛在国际足联主席选举中挑战因凡蒂诺

paras.en: - Diallo wants to restore 'broken' trust in soccer as he challenges FIFA presidency
paras.zh: -迪亚洛希望在挑战国际足联主席职位时恢复人们对足球“破碎”的信任

paras.en: Affinity Partners was cited in one document which explained why FIFA did not open a tender process "owing to the specific and unique nature of the proposed investment, bilateral and unilateral conversations held with interest from several potential investment sources."
paras.zh: 一份文件引用了 Affinity Partners 的说法，该文件解释了为什么国际足联没有启动招标程序，“由于拟议投资的具体性和独特性，以及多个潜在投资来源感兴趣的双边和单边对话”。

paras.en: Thrive created a "Backstop Letter and Transaction Terms" document dated July 17 about the plan with FIFA called "Project Box."
paras.zh: Thrive 于 7 月 17 日创建了一份关于与 FIFA 的计划的“保障函和交易条款”文件，称为“Project Box”。

paras.en: The document detailed a "Management Incentive Plan" with bonuses to be decided by the FFE board chaired by the sitting president, Infantino.
paras.zh: 该文件详细介绍了一项“管理层激励计划”，奖金由现任总裁因凡蒂诺担任主席的 FFE 董事会决定。

paras.en: "This is customary for proposed structures of this nature," FIFA said in a statement about the project which it had repeatedly said was a proposal needing to be approved by its 211 member federations. They effectively own FIFA as a Switzerland-based non-profit.
paras.zh: 国际足联在一份关于该项目的声明中表示：“这是此类性质的拟议结构的惯例。”国际足联曾多次表示，该提案需要得到其 211 个成员联合会的批准。他们实际上拥有国际足联作为一家总部位于瑞士的非营利组织。

paras.en: "FIFA's leadership would only have had leading roles in the board, which would not have led to any additional remuneration,” the world soccer body said.
paras.zh: 国际足联表示：“国际足联的领导层只会在董事会中发挥主导作用，这不会带来任何额外的报酬。”

articles.title: Why Iran's medicine supply chain is failing

paras.en: Ahmad,* 67, visited nearly 20 Tehran pharmacies for the antipsychotic drug chlorpromazine, but left empty-handed.
paras.zh: 67 岁的艾哈迈德 * 走遍了德黑兰近 20 家药店购买抗精神病药物氯丙嗪，但空手而归。

paras.en: "When a patient has to go to this many pharmacies just to find an essential drug, you really have to ask who is responsible for supplying medicine," he told DW.
paras.zh: 他告诉德国之声：“当一个病人必须去这么多药店才能找到一种基本药物时，你真的必须问谁负责提供药品。”

paras.en: Mitra,* a 37-year-old Tehran resident with diabetes , spent days hunting for insulin. "These are not drugs I can postpone taking or simply give up," she said. "My life depends on regular access to this insulin."
paras.zh: 米特拉 (Mitra)* 是一位 37 岁的德黑兰居民，患有糖尿病，花了几天时间寻找胰岛素。 “这些药物不是我可以推迟服用或干脆放弃的药物，”她说。 “我的生命取决于定期获得这种胰岛素。”

paras.en: Their ordeal reflects a wider crisis across Iran's health care system.
paras.zh: 他们的遭遇反映了伊朗医疗保健系统面临的更广泛的危机。

paras.en: Along with Tehran residents, DW spoke with an official at Iran's Food and Drug Administration (IFDA) and pharmacy workers in Tehran, Rasht and Mahabad. The interviews were conducted anonymously or using pseudonyms as speaking with foreign media remains dangerous in Iran.
paras.zh: 德国之声与德黑兰居民一起，采访了伊朗食品和药物管理局（IFDA）的一名官员以及德黑兰、拉什特和马哈巴德的药房工作人员。这些采访都是匿名或使用化名进行的，因为在伊朗与外国媒体交谈仍然很危险。

paras.en: The official said that Iran's falling currency, along with price controls, has drained domestic drugmaker profits, while unpaid hospital debts have delayed deliveries.
paras.zh: 这位官员表示，伊朗货币贬值以及价格管制已经耗尽了国内制药商的利润，而未偿还的医院债务也导致了交货延迟。

paras.en: "Add our own hospitals' heavy unpaid debts to distributors, and you can see why distribution has ground to a halt and companies are no longer supplying hospitals," the official said.
paras.zh: 这位官员表示：“加上我们自己的医院对分销商的巨额未偿债务，你就会明白为什么分销已经停止，公司不再向医院供货。”

paras.en: "Unless the Plan and Budget Organization makes our currency allocation realistic, banks step in with loans for drugmakers and insurers settle their debts, the Health Ministry's hands will remain tied and this disaster cannot be stopped," the official warned.
paras.zh: 这位官员警告说：“除非计划和预算组织使我们的货币分配切合实际，银行介入，为制药商提供贷款，保险公司还清他们的债务，否则卫生部将继续束手无策，这场灾难无法阻止。”

paras.en: IFDA spokesman Mohammad Hashemi told Iran's semi-official ILNA news agency on November 9 that fewer than 40 of roughly 700 essential drugs faced supply difficulties. However, pharmacists told DW about how difficult it can be to get drugs on shelves.
paras.zh: IFDA 发言人穆罕默德·哈希米 (Mohammad Hashemi) 11 月 9 日告诉伊朗半官方的 ILNA 通讯社，大约 700 种基本药物中只有不到 40 种面临供应困难。然而，药剂师告诉德国之声，将药品上架是多么困难。

paras.en: A pharmacy manager in Tehran said insurance payments are often delayed by months, while drug prices continue to climb. Another pharmacist in the northwestern Mahabad region said distributors demand cash upfront for scarce items.
paras.zh: 德黑兰的一位药房经理表示，保险付款往往会延迟数月，而药品价格却持续攀升。西北部马哈巴德地区的另一位药剂师表示，经销商要求预付现金购买稀缺物品。

paras.en: The insurance delays and shifting rules have pushed some pharmacies to drop contracts or refuse costly insured drugs.
paras.zh: 保险延误和规则变化迫使一些药店放弃合同或拒绝昂贵的承保药品。

paras.en: The pharmacist in Mahabad, who prefers to be called Leili,* said that general pharmacies can lack about 40 items, and larger specialty pharmacies stocking chemotherapy and complex treatments can lack over 100, including psychiatric and Parkinson's drugs, and insulin vials.
paras.zh: 马哈巴德的药剂师（更喜欢被称为雷利）*表示，普通药房可能缺少大约 40 种物品，而储存化疗和复杂治疗药物的大型专业药房可能缺少 100 多种物品，包括精神科和帕金森病药物以及胰岛素小瓶。

paras.en: "Many drugs can no longer be found in the official supply chain at all, such as nimodipine tablets [used to treat certain strokes] or hospital injectable antibiotics that have no substitutes," she said.
paras.zh: “许多药物在官方供应链中根本找不到，例如尼莫地平片（用于治疗某些中风）或没有替代品的医院注射抗生素，”她说。

paras.en: Turning to low-quality, black market medicine
paras.zh: 转向低质量的黑市药品

paras.en: As common items like cold medication become scarcer or more expensive, some people are turning to home remedies, she said. She added that for essential medicines like insulin, chronic patients are using smaller doses to preserve supply.
paras.zh: 她说，随着感冒药等常见物品变得越来越稀缺或越来越昂贵，一些人开始转向家庭疗法。她补充说，对于胰岛素等基本药物，慢性病患者正在使用较小的剂量来维持供应。

paras.en: Many of those unable to pay are middle-class customers whom pharmacists cannot easily refer to charities, she said, with elderly and psychiatric patients among the hardest hit.
paras.zh: 她说，许多无力支付的人是中产阶级顾客，药剂师无法轻易将他们转介给慈善机构，其中老年人和精神病患者受到的打击最严重。

paras.en: Leili warned that lower quality seen in some reverse-engineered domestic drugs presents a high risk for cancer, transplant and autoimmune patients.
paras.zh: 雷力警告说，一些逆向工程国产药物的质量较低，对癌症、移植和自身免疫患者来说存在很高的风险。

paras.en: She added that some families are forced to turn to street markets usually located outside of clinics, which lack cold-chain controls and sell counterfeit medicines or drugs with altered expiration dates.
paras.zh: 她补充说，一些家庭被迫转向通常位于诊所外的街头市场，这些市场缺乏冷链控制，出售假药或更改有效期的药物。

paras.en: Another pharmacy manager who asked to be called Khadiv* said scarce medicines can fetch up to 10 times their official price.
paras.zh: 另一位不愿透露姓名的药房经理 Khadiv* 表示，稀缺药品的售价可能高达官方价格的 10 倍。

paras.en: Amid the current conflict with the US, Khadiv said US sanctions, along with border disruptions and the US maritime blockade in the Strait of Hormuz inflate import costs.
paras.zh: 哈迪夫表示，在当前与美国的冲突中，美国的制裁、边境中断和美国对霍尔木兹海峡的海上封锁增加了进口成本。

paras.en: In a statement, the US State Department told DW its sanctions follow international law to deny Tehran funds for "destabilizing behavior," stressing the measures allow "broad authorizations and exceptions" for food, medicine and medical devices. It pointed to what it called Iran's "corrupt ruling elite" for not properly allocating resources.
paras.zh: 美国国务院在一份声明中告诉德国之声，制裁措施符合国际法，旨在拒绝德黑兰为“破坏稳定行为”提供资金，并强调这些措施允许对食品、药品和医疗设备进行“广泛的授权和例外”。它指出伊朗“腐败的统治精英”没有正确分配资源。

paras.en: Iranian officials, however, reject that claim. In late summer, Health Minister Mohammad Reza Zafarghandi called US exemption claims "a big lie," saying banking, insurance, flight and shipping sanctions block imports.
paras.zh: 然而伊朗官员否认了这一说法。夏末，卫生部长穆罕默德·礼萨·扎法甘迪 (Mohammad Reza Zafarghandi) 称美国的豁免声明是“一个弥天大谎”，称银行、保险、航班和航运制裁阻碍了进口。

paras.en: Earlier this fall, the IFDA's raw materials chief cited currency, banking, customs and shipping hurdles as the main bottleneck.
paras.zh: 今年秋天早些时候，IFDA 原材料负责人将货币、银行、海关和运输障碍视为主要瓶颈。

paras.en: DW emailed the Iranian Embassy's media office in Berlin for comment but received no reply.
paras.zh: 德国之声向伊朗驻柏林大使馆媒体办公室发送电子邮件请求置评，但没有收到回复。

paras.en: "Seeing so many people unable to afford their medicine or reach medical centers leaves me with a sense of guilt and helplessness," Khadiv said, adding that lack of access can even lead to patient deaths.
paras.zh: 哈迪夫说：“看到这么多人买不起药或无法前往医疗中心，我感到内疚和无助。”他补充说，缺乏医疗服务甚至会导致患者死亡。

paras.en: For patients like Ahmad and Mitra, the standoff offers no relief, and every day, the gap between official assurances and what is actually on pharmacy shelves grows harder to ignore.
paras.zh: 对于艾哈迈德和米特拉这样的患者来说，这种对峙并没有带来任何缓解，而且每一天，官方保证与药房货架上实际销售的药品之间的差距都变得越来越难以忽视。

articles.title: EU enlargement: Why do some EU member states use their vetoes to block the accession of certain candidate countries?

paras.en: It's been quite a while since the European Union's last enlargement, when Croatia joined the bloc back in 2013.
paras.zh: 自欧盟上一次东扩（克罗地亚于 2013 年加入欧盟）以来，已经有一段时间了。

paras.en: If everything goes according to plan, another might soon be on the cards: Montenegro, with a population of just 620,000, could complete accession negotiations in the coming months and join the EU in early 2028.
paras.zh: 如果一切按计划进行，另一个可能很快就会出现：人口仅有 62 万的黑山可能会在未来几个月内完成入盟谈判，并于 2028 年初加入欧盟。

paras.en: But no sooner had EU Enlargement Commissioner Marta Kos made this announcement in October than news emerged that Croatia might veto Montenegro's accession unless the country meets a series of Croatian demands. EU politicians and MEPs were dismayed.
paras.zh: 但欧盟扩大委员玛尔塔·科斯（Marta Kos）在十月份宣布这一消息后不久，就有消息称克罗地亚可能会否决黑山的加入，除非该国满足克罗地亚的一系列要求。欧盟政界人士和欧洲议会议员感到沮丧。

paras.en: This is not the first time something like this has happened: The veto rights that member states have on many EU matters have increasingly been used by individual countries in recent years as a means of leverage or obstruction, paralyzing the EU in the process.
paras.zh: 类似的事情已经不是第一次发生了：近年来，成员国在许多欧盟事务上拥有的否决权越来越多地被个别国家用作杠杆或阻挠的手段，从而使欧盟陷入瘫痪。

paras.en: DW takes a look at some of the most significant cases, the background to them and what are — in some instances — the serious political consequences of them.
paras.zh: 德国之声探讨了一些最重要的案例、它们的背景以及在某些情况下它们的严重政治后果。

paras.en: Montenegro is the most advanced EU candidate country, with a potential accession date of 2028. It has already provisionally closed several of the EU's 33 negotiating chapters.
paras.zh: 黑山是最先进的欧盟候选国，可能的入盟日期为 2028 年。它已经暂时结束了欧盟 33 个谈判章节中的几个。

paras.en: As of November 23, however, Croatia is blocking the closure of three chapters that have already been negotiated.
paras.zh: 然而，截至 11 月 23 日，克罗地亚正在阻止关闭已经谈判的三个章节。

paras.en: Zagreb is demanding, among other things, compensation for former prisoners held in Montenegrin camps during the Yugoslav wars of the 1990s, clarification of the fate of Croatians who have been missing since that time, and more rigorous prosecution of war crimes.
paras.zh: 除其他外，萨格勒布要求对1990年代南斯拉夫战争期间被关押在黑山难民营的前囚犯进行赔偿，澄清自那时以来失踪的克罗地亚人的命运，并对战争罪进行更严格的起诉。

paras.en: There are also disputes over the precise maritime boundary between the two countries. In addition, Croatia is demanding payment of about €2.4 billion (about $2.6 billion) for assets that belonged to the Yugoslav People's Army, the army of the former Yugoslavia to which both countries belonged before its breakup in the early 1990s.
paras.zh: 两国之间的精确海上边界也存在争议。此外，克罗地亚还要求为属于南斯拉夫人民军的资产支付约24亿欧元（约合26亿美元），南斯拉夫人民军是前南斯拉夫的军队，两国在1990年代初解体前都属于前南斯拉夫。

paras.en: Montenegro has already responded to some of Croatia's demands, including those concerning compensation for former prisoners. Others, such as the one relating to the assets of the Yugoslav People's Army, are disputed.
paras.zh: 黑山已经对克罗地亚的一些要求做出了回应，包括有关前囚犯赔偿的要求。其他问题，例如与南斯拉夫人民军资产有关的问题，也存在争议。

paras.en: It is clear that Croatia's list of demands is also driven by domestic politics. No government in Zagreb can afford to appear compliant on issues relating to the Croatian War of Independence (1991–95).
paras.zh: 显然，克罗地亚的要求清单也是由国内政治驱动的。萨格勒布的任何政府都不能在与克罗地亚独立战争（1991-95）有关的问题上表现得顺从。

paras.en: Moreover, moderate conservative Prime Minister Andrej Plenkovic, who is regularly accused in Croatia of being too pro-EU, can use the dispute to portray himself as a staunch defender of national interests.
paras.zh: 此外，克罗地亚经常被指责过于亲欧盟的温和保守派总理安德烈·普伦科维奇可以利用这场争端将自己描绘成国家利益的坚定捍卫者。

paras.en: Ukraine: Hungarian domestic politics in the name of a minority
paras.zh: 乌克兰：以少数派名义的匈牙利国内政治

paras.en: After Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine, the EU in June 2022 granted Ukraine and the Republic of Moldova EU candidate status through an accelerated procedure as a gesture of solidarity.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯全面入侵乌克兰后，欧盟于2022年6月通过加速程序授予乌克兰和摩尔多瓦共和国欧盟候选国地位，以示团结。

paras.en: Many EU member states have reservations about Ukraine joining the bloc quickly. Nevertheless, only Hungary, under former Prime Minister Viktor Orban, adopted an obstructive stance.
paras.zh: 许多欧盟成员国对乌克兰迅速加入欧盟持保留态度。然而，只有前总理欧尔班·维克托领导下的匈牙利采取了阻挠立场。

paras.en: Ostensibly, Hungary's obstruction was about getting Ukraine to improve the rights of the Hungarian minority in Transcarpathia in western Ukraine. But Orban used the matter for domestic political purposes and as an election campaign issue, portraying Ukraine as a "mafia state."
paras.zh: 表面上，匈牙利的阻挠是为了让乌克兰改善乌克兰西部外喀尔巴阡地区匈牙利少数民族的权利。但欧尔班将此事用于国内政治目的和竞选活动，将乌克兰描绘成“黑手党国家”。

paras.en: In an effort to appeal to widespread anti-Ukrainian sentiment in Hungary, the country's new prime minister, Peter Magyar, has also adopted a tough stance on Ukraine.
paras.zh: 为了唤起匈牙利广泛的反乌克兰情绪，该国新任总理彼得·马扎尔也对乌克兰采取了强硬立场。

paras.en: Nevertheless, Magyar's government lifted several temporary blocks on the opening of new negotiating chapters after the Ukrainian parliament passed a law in early October strengthening the educational rights of national minorities.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，在乌克兰议会十月初通过一项加强少数民族教育权利的法律后，马扎尔政府解除了对开启新谈判章节的几项临时障碍。

paras.en: North Macedonia: The never-ending blockade
paras.zh: 北马其顿：永无休止的封锁

paras.en: No EU candidate country has suffered as much or as long from veto politics as North Macedonia: It was granted EU candidate status in 2005 but only began accession negotiations in July 2022.
paras.zh: 没有哪个欧盟候选国像北马其顿那样遭受否决政治的影响如此之大或如此之久：该国于 2005 年获得欧盟候选国地位，但直到 2022 年 7 月才开始入盟谈判。

paras.en: Greece blocked the start of negotiations for 13 years because it objected to the name "Republic of Macedonia," as the country was previously known, and accused its neighbor of laying territorial claims to the region of Macedonia in northern Greece.
paras.zh: 希腊13年来一直阻止谈判启动，因为它反对该国以前的国名“马其顿共和国”，并指责其邻国对希腊北部马其顿地区提出领土要求。

paras.en: The dispute was settled in 2018 through a compromise that saw the country change its name to the Republic of North Macedonia the following year.
paras.zh: 这场争端于 2018 年通过妥协得到解决，次年该国更名为北马其顿共和国。

paras.en: But just as the path to accession negotiations seemed clear, Bulgaria blocked the opening of talks in November 2020.
paras.zh: 但就在入盟谈判的道路看似清晰时，保加利亚却阻止了 2020 年 11 月的谈判启动。

paras.en: Bulgaria regards the Macedonian language as a dialect of Bulgarian and disputes the existence of a distinct Macedonian nation.
paras.zh: 保加利亚将马其顿语视为保加利亚语的一种方言，并对独特的马其顿民族的存在存在争议。

paras.en: Here, too, domestic Bulgarian politics is ultimately a factor.
paras.zh: 保加利亚国内政治最终也是一个因素。

paras.en: Former Bulgarian President and current Prime Minister Rumen Radev, for example, fueled the escalation with North Macedonia to enhance his political profile.
paras.zh: 例如，保加利亚前总统兼现任总理鲁门·拉德夫（Rumen Radev）推动了与北马其顿的紧张局势升级，以提高自己的政治形象。

paras.en: Serbia: Croatia is not the only country obstructing progress
paras.zh: 塞尔维亚：克罗地亚不是唯一阻碍进展的国家

paras.en: Although Serbia has been negotiating EU accession since 2014, little progress has been made.
paras.zh: 尽管塞尔维亚自2014年以来一直在进行入盟谈判，但进展甚微。

paras.en: In July, when the country was still led by President Aleksandar Vucic, no less than eight EU member states — including Croatia — opposed opening further negotiating chapters with Serbia.
paras.zh: 7月，当该国仍由总统亚历山大·武契奇领导时，包括克罗地亚在内的至少八个欧盟成员国反对与塞尔维亚展开进一步的谈判。

paras.en: While the main reservations relate to democratic shortcomings, deficiencies in the rule of law and corruption in Serbia, Croatia also has its own disputes with its eastern neighbor.
paras.zh: 虽然主要的保留意见与塞尔维亚的民主缺陷、法治缺陷和腐败有关，但克罗地亚也与东部邻国存在争端。

paras.en: These concern the 1991–95 war, including missing persons, war crimes, minority rights and differing interpretations of history. Relations are also strained by nationalist rhetoric on both sides.
paras.zh: 这些问题涉及 1991-95 年战争，包括失踪人员、战争罪、少数群体权利和对历史的不同解释。双方的民族主义言论也使关系变得紧张。

paras.en: Whether the election victory of the Student List in Belgrade in late October , after almost two years of anti-government and anti-corruption protests, will change this situation is impossible to say.
paras.zh: 在经历了近两年的反政府和反腐败抗议之后，10月下旬贝尔格莱德学生名单选举的胜利是否会改变这种状况还很难说。

paras.en: Albania: Greece threatens to use minority rights as leverage
paras.zh: 阿尔巴尼亚：希腊威胁利用少数群体权利作为筹码

paras.en: The EU opened accession negotiations with Albania, which has been an EU candidate since 2014, in July 2022.
paras.zh: 欧盟于 2022 年 7 月与阿尔巴尼亚开启入盟谈判，阿尔巴尼亚自 2014 年以来一直是欧盟候选国。

paras.en: Albania could become the bloc's next new member after Montenegro. However, Greece has repeatedly threatened (most recently in June) to block the accession process unless the rights of its Greek minority, particularly their property rights, are adequately protected.
paras.zh: 阿尔巴尼亚可能成为继黑山之后该集团的下一个新成员。然而，希腊一再威胁（最近一次是在六月），除非希腊少数民族的权利，特别是他们的财产权得到充分保护，否则希腊将阻止入盟进程。

paras.en: In light of all this, Brussels has long been debating a reform of the accession process and the EU veto system.
paras.zh: 鉴于这一切，布鲁塞尔长期以来一直在讨论入盟程序和欧盟否决制度的改革。

paras.en: In early October, the European Commission proposed that decisions to open negotiations with candidate countries be made by qualified majority rather than unanimously. It also proposed that new EU members would be required to give up the right to veto decisions in certain policy areas altogether for a specified period.
paras.zh: 10月初，欧盟委员会提议，与候选国展开谈判的决定应以特定多数而非一致同意的方式做出。它还提议，新的欧盟成员国将被要求在特定时期内完全放弃某些政策领域的否决权。

paras.en: The problem with these proposed reforms is that they would themselves have to be adopted unanimously. In other words, any member state could veto the reform.
paras.zh: 这些拟议改革的问题在于它们本身必须获得一致通过。换句话说，任何成员国都可以否决这项改革。

articles.title: Ukraine's bid for NATO membership and more air defense remains controversial

paras.en: It took a while for the video call to connect. When Volodymyr Zelenskyy finally greeted the delegates in Berlin, applause broke out. The Ukrainian president appealed to the gathered parliamentarians from 32 NATO member states to keep supporting his country, especially against the massive aerial bombardment from Russia.
paras.zh: 视频通话花了一段时间才接通。当弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基最终在柏林向代表们致意时，爆发出热烈的掌声。乌克兰总统呼吁来自32个北约成员国的议员继续支持乌克兰，特别是针对俄罗斯的大规模空袭。

paras.en: "Dear friends, winter is now ahead of us. And of course, our number one priority is air defense," Zelenskyy told the delegates. His country urgently needs more Patriot and other comprehensive anti-air attack systems. "And your countries have them. Missiles that can stop Russian ballistic missiles should not be sitting in warehouses collecting dust. And we say this openly. Please help us with this."
paras.zh: “亲爱的朋友们，冬天即将来临。当然，我们的首要任务是防空，”泽连斯基告诉代表们。他的国家迫切需要更多的爱国者和其他综合防空系统。 “你们的国家也有它们。能够阻止俄罗斯弹道导弹的导弹不应该被放在仓库里积满灰尘。我们公开这么说。请帮助我们。”

paras.en: Zelenskyy renewed his call for his country to join the NATO military alliance. That issue is not for the NATO Parliamentary Assembly, which was gathered for its 72nd annual meeting in Berlin, to decide. But it was important to the Ukrainian president to reiterate his request.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基再次呼吁本国加入北约军事联盟。这个问题不应该由在柏林召开第 72 届年会的北约议会来决定。但对乌克兰总统来说，重申他的要求很重要。

paras.en: After the war ends, Ukraine needs strong security guarantees and NATO could ensure those. "Wouldn't it be more effective to simply bring Ukraine into NATO?" Zelenskyy asked, arguing: "Wouldn't that be better for all of us, for everyone? Cheaper to put in place? And more reliable when it comes to actually protecting security?"
paras.zh: 战争结束后，乌克兰需要强有力的安全保障，而北约可以确保这些保障。 “直接让乌克兰加入北约不是更有效吗？”泽伦斯基问道：“这对我们所有人、每个人来说不是更好吗？实施起来更便宜？而且在实际保护安全方面更可靠？”

paras.en: There is conflict among NATO members about the possibility of admitting Ukraine. The alliance has affirmed multiple times that the path to membership stands open to Ukraine — however, in the long term rather than the near future. This is primarily because of the ongoing war and the possible assistance obligations of other NATO countries for Ukraine, which was attacked by Russia.
paras.zh: 北约成员国之间对于接纳乌克兰的可能性存在冲突。该联盟多次确认，乌克兰的加入之路是开放的——不过，这是从长远来看，而不是在不久的将来。这主要是因为持续的战争以及其他北约国家可能对遭受俄罗斯袭击的乌克兰承担援助义务。

paras.en: NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte rejected the Ukrainian demands at the summit, which for the first time in 26 years was held in Berlin. Ukraine had entry prospects; however, NATO members currently lack unanimity on this issue. NATO alone decides who becomes a member. "There is total clarity on that within the alliance," Rutte said.
paras.zh: 北约秘书长马克·吕特在峰会上拒绝了乌克兰的要求，此次峰会是26年来首次在柏林举行。乌克兰有进入前景；然而，北约成员国目前在这一问题上缺乏一致意见。北约独自决定谁成为其成员。 “联盟内部对此非常清楚，”吕特说。

paras.en: Merz: Denying Ukraine NATO membership in 2008 'was a mistake'
paras.zh: 梅尔茨：2008年拒绝乌克兰加入北约“是一个错误”

paras.en: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz advocated for Ukraine to receive security guarantees similar to what NATO members have, in the instance of a possible ceasefire. In retrospect, it was clear "what a mistake it was not to follow the American suggestion back in 2008 at the NATO summit in Bucharest to admit Ukraine as a member," Merz said at a joint press conference following a meeting with Rutte.
paras.zh: 德国总理弗里德里希·梅尔茨主张，在可能停火的情况下，乌克兰应获得类似于北约成员国的安全保证。默茨在与吕特会面后举行的联合新闻发布会上表示，回想起来，“2008年北约布加勒斯特峰会上没有听从美国的建议，接纳乌克兰为成员国，这是一个多么错误的错误”。

paras.en: Whether or not a NATO entry for Ukraine could be part of negotiations with Russia is another question, according to Rutte. He approved of current US efforts to bring about peace talks, and how Europe was closely consulting with Ukraine and the US for a unified position. "But it is also to test now whether Putin is willing to play ball, and then these issues might come up again."
paras.zh: 吕特表示，乌克兰加入北约是否可以成为与俄罗斯谈判的一部分是另一个问题。他赞同美国目前为促成和平谈判所做的努力，以及欧洲如何与乌克兰和美国密切协商以达成统一立场。 “但现在也是为了测试普京是否愿意合作，然后这些问题可能会再次出现。”

paras.en: The Russian invasion of Ukraine has led to NATO arming itself on a massive scale. Members have committed to raising their countries' defense spending to 5% of their gross domestic product (GDP) by 2035.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯入侵乌克兰导致北约大规模武装自己。成员国承诺到2035年将各自国家的国防开支提高到国内生产总值(GDP)的5%。

paras.en: Rutte warned that all the allies needed a credible path to get there, "and ideally, they get there sooner than 2035." In addition, he said weapons production among member states needed to further increase because "right now, demand still far exceeds the supply."
paras.zh: 吕特警告说，所有盟友都需要一条可靠的途径才能实现这一目标，“理想情况下，他们能在 2035 年之前实现这一目标。”此外，他表示成员国之间的武器生产需要进一步增加，因为“目前需求仍然远远超过供应”。

paras.en: Germany's military budget has had a massive increase
paras.zh: 德国军事预算大幅增加

paras.en: The contribution by Germany's Bundeswehr armed forces to NATO was explained by Carsten Breuer, Germany's highest-ranking soldier. For example, the massive increase in military spending: "Our defense budget has tripled since 2021. The goal is to achieve the 5% target, which was set at the summit in The Hague, well before 2035." In the coming year, Germany's defense budget has risen to more than €139 billion ($151 billion).
paras.zh: 德国最高级别士兵卡斯滕·布洛伊尔解释了德国联邦国防军武装部队对北约的贡献。例如，军费大幅增加：“自2021年以来，我们的国防预算增加了两倍。目标是在2035年之前实现海牙峰会制定的5%的目标。”明年，德国的国防预算将增至超过 1,390 亿欧元（1,510 亿美元）。

paras.en: The Bundeswehr was further developing into a "constantly modernized, effective and innovative army, Breuer said. Also, a much larger one than before. "To reach our current capability goals we are expanding the Bundeswehr to a total of 460,000 soldiers by the mid-2030s," the German chief of defense said. Of those, 200,000 are to be reservists. "This is like walking a tightrope because we must find the right balance between growth and operational readiness."
paras.zh: 布洛尔说，德国联邦国防军正在进一步发展成为一支“不断现代化、高效和创新的军队。而且，规模比以前大得多。为了实现我们目前的能力目标，我们将在 2030 年代中期将德国联邦国防军的士兵总数扩大到 46 万人。”德国国防部长表示，其中 20 万人将成为预备役军人。“这就像走钢丝，因为我们必须找到适当的平衡。”在增长和运营准备之间。”

paras.en: Following his speech, Breuer answered questions from the delegates who showed keen interest in the developments. The discussion was a preview of Breuer's new post: He has been voted in as the new chair of the NATO Military Committee and will move to the alliance's headquarters in Brussels mid-next year. Then he will become the principal military advisor to NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte. "I take this election as a sign of recognition that Germany has now accepted its responsibility as well as its role in security policy," Breuer said.
paras.zh: 演讲结束后，布洛伊尔回答了代表们对相关进展表现出浓厚兴趣的问题。这次讨论是布洛伊尔新职位的预演：他已被选为北约军事委员会新任主席，并将于明年年中迁往位于布鲁塞尔的联盟总部。随后他将成为北约秘书长马克·吕特的首席军事顾问。布洛伊尔说：“我认为这次选举标志着德国现在已经接受了自己的责任以及在安全政策中的作用。”

paras.en: This article was originally written in German.
paras.zh: 本文最初是用德语写的。

articles.title: China’s Huawei found guilty of trade secrets conspiracy, fraud in US trial

paras.en: A United States jury has convicted Chinese tech giant Huawei Technologies of conspiracy to steal trade secrets and bank fraud as it grew into one of the world’s biggest suppliers of gear for wireless telecommunications networks.
paras.zh: 美国陪审团判定中国科技巨头华为技术有限公司犯有串谋窃取商业机密和银行欺诈罪，该公司已成长为全球最大的无线电信网络设备供应商之一。

paras.en: However, jurors on Tuesday acquitted the company of the most serious charge it faced: engaging in a criminal racketeering conspiracy. The charge is typically used in organised crime and drug cases, but prosecutors used it to accuse Huawei of operating in an illicit fashion to steal intellectual property from US companies.
paras.zh: 然而，陪审员周二宣布该公司所面临的最严重的指控无罪：参与犯罪敲诈勒索阴谋。该指控通常用于有组织犯罪和毒品案件，但检察官用它来指控华为以非法方式窃取美国公司的知识产权。

paras.en: The verdict followed a lengthy trial in which US prosecutors argued that Huawei repeatedly stole technological secrets from competitors and partners in the US and elsewhere.
paras.zh: 该判决是在经过漫长的审判之后做出的，美国检察官认为华为多次从美国和其他地方的竞争对手和合作伙伴那里窃取技术机密。

paras.en: Huawei was also accused of doing business in countries subject to US sanctions, including Iran and North Korea, and making false statements to US government officials and banks as part of an effort to hide its misdeeds.
paras.zh: 华为还被指控在伊朗和朝鲜等受美国制裁的国家开展业务，并向美国政府官员和银行做出虚假陈述，以掩盖其不当行为。

paras.en: US authorities had targeted Huawei for years, saying the company posed national security risks.
paras.zh: 美国当局多年来一直针对华为，称该公司构成国家安全风险。

paras.en: The criminal case began in 2018, and the following year the US government placed Huawei on a trade blacklist that restricted its access to US technology.
paras.zh: 这起刑事案件始于2018年，次年美国政府将华为列入贸易黑名单，限制其获取美国技术。

paras.en: Experts have said the case has not undermined Huawei’s business, as the company diversified and emerged as a key player in China’s push for artificial intelligence.
paras.zh: 专家表示，此案并未损害华为的业务，因为该公司实现了多元化，并成为中国推动人工智能发展的关键参与者。

paras.en: The trial lasted more than two months, with prosecutors calling more than 60 witnesses and the defence calling 15.
paras.zh: 审判持续了两个多月，检察官传唤了 60 多名证人，辩方传唤了 15 名证人。

paras.en: Huawei and three affiliates faced 12 charges, including racketeering conspiracy, bank fraud, wire fraud, sanctions violations, and conspiring to steal trade secrets and obstruct justice.
paras.zh: 华为及三家关联公司面临 12 项指控，包括串谋敲诈勒索、银行欺诈、电信欺诈、违反制裁规定、合谋窃取商业机密和妨碍司法公正。

paras.en: Lawyers for the company said US investigators had used isolated episodes of wrongdoing by a few of Huawei’s more than 200,000 employees to spin a false narrative about a grand conspiracy that did not actually exist.
paras.zh: 该公司的律师表示，美国调查人员利用华为20万多名员工中少数人的个别不当行为，编造了一个实际上并不存在的大阴谋的虚假叙述。

paras.en: Huawei lawyer Brian Heberlig said the company would appeal the convictions but saw the racketeering conspiracy acquittal as vindication.
paras.zh: 华为律师布赖恩·赫伯利格(Brian Heberlig)表示，该公司将对定罪提出上诉，但认为敲诈勒索阴谋无罪被宣告平反。

paras.en: “That was the only count that brought all of the allegations together,” and the jury rejected it, he said outside court, saying that the verdict “repudiated the central government narrative in the case”.
paras.zh: 他在法庭外表示，“这是将所有指控汇总在一起的唯一罪名”，陪审团驳回了这一指控，并称判决“否定了中央政府在该案中的说法”。

paras.en: It is unclear what effect the verdict might have on Huawei’s global fortunes. The company hasn’t been allowed to sell equipment to US carriers for years because of security concerns. It has also been blacklisted by other Western allies, including Canada and the United Kingdom.
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚该判决可能会对华为的全球命运产生什么影响。出于安全考虑，该公司多年来一直不允许向美国运营商出售设备。它还被包括加拿大和英国在内的其他西方盟友列入黑名单。

paras.en: The case emerged in December 2018 when Meng Wanzhou, Huawei’s chief financial officer and daughter of the company’s founder, was detained in Canada on a US warrant, prompting a diplomatic crisis involving the US, China and Canada.
paras.zh: 此案发生于2018年12月，当时华为首席财务官、该公司创始人的女儿孟晚舟根据美国的逮捕令在加拿大被拘留，引发了一场涉及美国、中国和加拿大的外交危机。

paras.en: Meng had been secretly indicted for allegedly misleading an HSBC banker about Huawei’s business in Iran, so the company could move dollars in and out of Iran in violation of US sanctions.
paras.zh: 孟晚舟因涉嫌就华为在伊朗的业务误导汇丰银行家而被秘密起诉，以便该公司可以违反美国的制裁将美元进出伊朗。

paras.en: She fought extradition to the US for nearly three years, before entering a deferred prosecution agreement and flying home to China to a hero’s welcome. The charges against her were dropped.
paras.zh: 她为引渡到美国进行了近三年的抗争，最后达成了一项暂缓起诉协议，并飞回中国，受到了英雄般的欢迎。对她的指控被撤销。

paras.en: The 2018 indictment alleged that Huawei misled HSBC, Standard Chartered and BNP Paribas about its business dealings in Iran.
paras.zh: 2018 年的起诉书称，华为在其与伊朗的业务往来中误导了汇丰银行、渣打银行和法国巴黎银行。

paras.en: Prosecutors added new charges in 2020, including that Huawei conspired to steal trade secrets from US technology companies over two decades.
paras.zh: 检察官在 2020 年增加了新指控，包括华为在二十年来合谋窃取美国科技公司的商业机密。

paras.en: During the trial, prosecutors tried to prove Huawei stole source code from Cisco Systems for its routers, stole wireless telecommunications company Quintel’s antenna technology, and hired a professor to gain access to a circuit board developed by semiconductor company CNEX.
paras.zh: 在审判期间，检察官试图证明华为窃取了思科系统公司路由器的源代码，窃取了无线电信公司 Quintel 的天线技术，并聘请了一名教授获取半导体公司 CNEX 开发的电路板。

paras.en: Jurors watched a video that, according to prosecutors, showed a Huawei employee slipping a piece of a T-Mobile testing robot into his backpack, and heard about a Huawei engineer sneaking into a Fujitsu booth at a trade show to photograph a device.
paras.zh: 据检察官称，陪审员们观看了一段视频，视频显示一名华为员工将 T-Mobile 测试机器人的一块部件塞进背包，并听说一名华为工程师在贸易展上偷偷溜进富士通展位拍摄设备。

paras.en: Prosecutors gave jurors a statement attached to Meng’s deferred prosecution agreement, in which she acknowledged that the company illegally conducted business in Iran. She did not testify at trial, though an HSBC banker she met with in 2013 did testify.
paras.zh: 检察官向陪审员提供了孟晚舟延期起诉协议所附的一份声明，其中她承认该公司在伊朗非法开展业务。她没有在审判中作证，但她在 2013 年会见的一位汇丰银行家出庭作证。

paras.en: The defence argued that HSBC and the other banks knew about Huawei’s business in Iran and were competing for Huawei’s business.
paras.zh: 辩方辩称，汇丰银行和其他银行了解华为在伊朗的业务，并正在争夺华为的业务。

paras.en: Heberlig accused prosecutors during his closing argument of having “cherry-picked” a handful of disparate incidents to support their claim of a 20-year conspiracy.
paras.zh: 赫伯利格在结案陈词中指责检察官“精心挑选”了一些不同的事件来支持他们关于 20 年阴谋的说法。

paras.en: He said Huawei succeeded through “hard work, innovation, and investment in research and development”.
paras.zh: 他表示，华为的成功是通过“努力、创新和研发投资”取得的。

paras.en: Huawei has more than 200,000 employees and operates in approximately 170 countries.
paras.zh: 华为拥有超过20万名员工，业务遍及约170个国家。

articles.title: Colombian president blames ex-FARC rebels for car bomb blast

paras.en: Car bomb strikes governor’s office in Meta, Colombia
paras.zh: 哥伦比亚梅塔州长办公室遭汽车炸弹袭击

paras.en: Bogota, Colombia – Colombian President Abelardo de la Espriella has blamed ex-FARC rebels for a car bomb attack last night targeting a state government building, which injured at least 23 people.
paras.zh: 哥伦比亚波哥大——哥伦比亚总统阿韦拉多·德拉埃斯普里埃拉指责前哥伦比亚革命武装力量叛军昨晚对州政府大楼发动汽车炸弹袭击，造成至少 23 人受伤。

paras.en: On a visit to Villavicencio on Tuesday, where the attack took place, the president accused Antonio Medina, a commander of the Central General Staff (EMC) rebel group, of plotting the bombing in retaliation for government offensives in the province.
paras.zh: 周二，在访问袭击发生地比亚维森西奥时，总统指责中央总参谋部叛乱组织指挥官安东尼奥·梅迪纳策划爆炸事件，以报复政府在该省的进攻。

paras.en: “The bandit Antonio Medina from the [FARC] dissidents is to blame, and we’re going to go after him and make him pay with blood,” de la Espriella told reporters.
paras.zh: 德拉埃斯普里埃拉告诉记者：“[哥伦比亚革命武装力量]持不同政见者的强盗安东尼奥·梅迪纳是罪魁祸首，我们将追捕他，让他付出鲜血的代价。”

paras.en: Last night’s attack rocked the seat of government in Meta, a province bordering the capital, Bogota, to the southeast. Videos show extensive damage to the building in Villavicencio, which houses the governor’s office, as well as surrounding businesses and vehicles.
paras.zh: 昨晚的袭击震动了梅塔省政府所在地，该省东南部与首都波哥大接壤。视频显示，比亚维森西奥州长办公室所在的建筑以及周围的企业和车辆遭到严重破坏。

paras.en: The Head of National Police Operations, Ricardo Alarcon, told local media that initial tests indicate the car was laden with between 80 and 100kg (176-220 pounds) of pentolite, a high explosive used in military warheads, as well as civilian mining.
paras.zh: 国家警察行动负责人里卡多·阿拉尔孔 (Ricardo Alarcon) 告诉当地媒体，初步测试表明该车载有 80 至 100 公斤（176-220 磅）的喷托石，这是一种用于军事弹头以及民用采矿的烈性炸药。

paras.en: Meta was a historical heartland for the FARC, which officially demobilised following a historic peace deal in 2016. In the years since, dissident rebels who refused to lay down their arms or returned to war have expanded their control in the province, a key access point to the coca plantations, gold mining and drug smuggling routes of the Amazon River Basin.
paras.zh: 梅塔是哥伦比亚革命武装力量历史上的中心地带，该组织在 2016 年达成历史性和平协议后正式复员。此后的几年里，拒绝放下武器或重返战场的持不同政见叛乱分子扩大了对该省的控制，该省是通往亚马逊河流域古柯种植园、金矿开采和毒品走私路线的关键入口。

paras.en: The most powerful group is the EMC, headed by alias Ivan Mordisco, one of Colombia’s most wanted men. The government earlier this year announced a bounty of 5 billion pesos (roughly $1.4m) for his capture or killing.
paras.zh: 最强大的组织是 EMC，由化名伊万·莫迪斯科 ​​(Ivan Mordisco) 领导，他是哥伦比亚的头号通缉犯之一。今年早些时候，政府宣布悬赏 50 亿比索（约合 140 万美元）逮捕或杀害他。

paras.en: In recent months, the government has increased pressure on the EMC, bombing its camps and targeting senior members. Just yesterday, the president confirmed the killing of alias El Churco, an EMC commander.
paras.zh: 近几个月来，政府加大了对 EMC 的压力，轰炸其营地并针对高级成员。就在昨天，总统证实了一名化名 El Churco 的 EMC 指挥官被杀。

paras.en: The campaign is part of the new far-right government’s security pivot, which aims to tackle criminal organisations through military force and has suspended the negotiations initiated under the previous government.
paras.zh: 这场运动是新的极右翼政府安全重点的一部分，旨在通过军事力量打击犯罪组织，并暂停了前政府发起的谈判。

paras.en: De la Espriella has suggested that last night’s bombing in Villavicencio was likely a retaliation against ramped-up state pressure on armed groups.
paras.zh: 德拉埃斯普里埃拉表示，昨晚比亚维森西奥发生的爆炸事件可能是对国家对武装团体加大压力的报复。

paras.en: “The narco-terrorists are running wild, launching desperate attacks, because they know we are defeating them and that their end is near,” the president wrote on X this morning.
paras.zh: 总统今天早上在 X 上写道：“毒品恐怖分子正在猖獗，发动绝望的袭击，因为他们知道我们正在击败他们，他们的末日即将到来。”

paras.en: The attack, which happened on the eve of the 10-year anniversary of the 2016 peace deal, highlights the growing risks to civilians under de la Espriella’s heavy-handed security strategy, say experts.
paras.zh: 专家表示，这次袭击发生在 2016 年和平协议 10 周年纪念日前夕，突显了德拉埃斯普里埃拉严厉的安全战略对平民造成的日益严重的风险。

paras.en: “As the government increases pressure, armed and criminal groups are trying to raise the cost of doing that for the government by exerting pain, instilling fear and causing direct harm against communities and against the civilian population,” said Elizabeth Dickinson, deputy director for Latin America at the International Crisis Group.
paras.zh: 国际危机组织拉丁美洲部副主任伊丽莎白·迪金森表示：“随着政府加大压力，武装和犯罪团体正试图通过施加痛苦、灌输恐惧以及对社区和平民造成直接伤害来提高政府这样做的成本。”

articles.title: Todd Blanche declines to confirm if Nvidia’s Jensen Huang was investigated

paras.en: Amid bipartisan pushback over Nvidia’s decision to reinstate CEO Jensen Huang, United States Attorney General Todd Blanche has opted not to discuss whether the tech executive was under federal investigation.
paras.zh: 在两党对英伟达恢复首席执行官黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 决定的抵制中，美国司法部长托德·布兰奇 (Todd Blanche) 选择不讨论这位科技高管是否正在接受联邦调查。

paras.en: At a press conference in Washington, DC, on Friday, Blanche was pressed by reporters over whether the Department of Justice had investigated Huang.
paras.zh: 周五在华盛顿特区举行的新闻发布会上，布兰奇被记者追问司法部是否调查了黄。

paras.en: “What does that mean, ‘Had Huang been investigated’? For what?” Blanche responded.
paras.zh: “‘黄被调查了吗’是什么意思？为什么？”布兰奇回应道。

paras.en: “I don’t understand the question. Even the reporting from the various leaks or sources or whatever that was out there didn’t suggest that Huang himself was under some sort of investigation.”
paras.zh: “我不明白这个问题。即使是各种泄密或消息来源的报道或其他任何信息，也没有表明黄本人正在接受某种调查。”

paras.en: Blanche also attempted to clarify US President Donald Trump’s comments that his administration had “exonerated” Huang of wrongdoing.
paras.zh: 布兰奇还试图澄清美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的言论，即他的政府已“免除”黄的不当行为。

paras.en: “What the president said is that he talked to a lot of people going into the decision that he made to encourage the board to reinstate him,” Blanche said. “And so, I’m not going to get into communications I had with the president about it, but what he was saying was true.”
paras.zh: 布兰奇说：“总统所说的是，他与很多人讨论了他做出的决定，以鼓励董事会恢复他的职位。” “所以，我不会就此事与总统进行沟通，但他说的是真的。”

paras.en: Huang has been under scrutiny since late October, when The New York Times broke the story that he had been romantically involved with Alice Huang, an executive for the technology firm Megaspeed.
paras.zh: 自 10 月底《纽约时报》爆料黄先生与科技公司 Megaspeed 高管爱丽丝黄 (Alice Huang) 恋爱以来，黄先生一直受到密切关注。

paras.en: Alice Huang, according to the report, had been recruited by Chinese intelligence to help influence policy about US chip sales to China.
paras.zh: 据报道，爱丽丝·黄（Alice Huang）已被中国情报部门招募，以帮助影响美国对华芯片销售的政策。

paras.en: Under Jensen Huang’s leadership, Nvidia sold large quantities to Megaspeed, which allegedly diverted the semiconductor chips to China.
paras.zh: 在黄仁勋的领导下，英伟达向 Megaspeed 出售了大量芯片，据称后者将半导体芯片转移到了中国。

paras.en: The New York Times cited anonymous US intelligence reports as its source. Beijing has denied the report as a “smear”.
paras.zh: 《纽约时报》援引美国匿名情报报告作为其来源。北京否认该报道是“诽谤”。

paras.en: Jensen Huang has since admitted to having extramarital affairs, including with a member of his staff, and on November 12, he resigned his leadership post.
paras.zh: 此后，黄仁勋承认有婚外情，包括与一名工作人员发生婚外情，并于 11 月 12 日辞去领导职务。

paras.en: But Trump, who has worked closely with Huang, petitioned for the disgraced CEO to regain control of Nvidia. Huang was reinstated on Monday.
paras.zh: 但与黄仁勋密切合作的特朗普请求这位名誉扫地的首席执行官重新获得对英伟达的控制权。黄周一复职。

paras.en: In a social media post that day, Trump said the US “government has no reason to believe that Jensen’s return to NVIDIA poses any risk to National Security”.
paras.zh: 特朗普在当天的社交媒体帖子中表示，美国“政府没有理由相信 Jensen 重返 NVIDIA 对国家安全构成任何风险”。

paras.en: “The Attorney General of the United States has confirmed that the U.S. Government does not possess evidence that he has engaged in any unlawful conduct,” he wrote.
paras.zh: “美国司法部长已确认，美国政府没有证据表明他曾从事任何非法行为，”他写道。

paras.en: During an hour-long TV interview, also on Monday, the president said his administration had conducted a “thorough” investigation into Huang’s relationship with the alleged Chinese intelligence asset.
paras.zh: 同样在周一，在长达一个小时的电视采访中，总统表示，他的政府已经对黄与所谓的中国情报人员的关系进行了“彻底”调查。

paras.en: “We believe he’s fine. He’s absolutely fine,” Trump told CNBC. He added that he personally “convinced” Nvidia’s board to reinstate Huang.
paras.zh: “我们相信他很好。他绝对很好，”特朗普告诉 CNBC。他补充说，他亲自“说服”英伟达董事会恢复黄仁勋的职位。

paras.en: That decision has sparked a political firestorm in Washington as Democrats and Republicans alike decried Trump’s involvement in Huang’s return, as well as the ongoing national security concerns.
paras.zh: 这一决定在华盛顿引发了一场政治风暴，民主党和共和党都谴责特朗普参与黄的回归，以及持续存在的国家安全担忧。

paras.en: The US and China are locked in a competition in the artificial intelligence (AI) sector, and for years, the US has restricted the sale of domestically made chips to the rival superpower, for fear that the technology could be stolen or appropriated by Beijing’s military.
paras.zh: 美国和中国在人工智能（AI）领域陷入竞争，多年来，美国一直限制向对手超级大国出售国产芯片，担心该技术可能被北京军方窃取或盗用。

paras.en: Trump himself has investments in Nvidia. Since he began his second term as president, he has also struck a deal with Huang to give the US government a 15-percent cut of sales of certain AI chips to China, as part of a loosening of restrictions.
paras.zh: 特朗普本人也对英伟达进行了投资。自从他开始担任总统的第二个任期以来，他还与黄仁勋达成协议，作为放宽限制的一部分，美国政府对中国的某些人工智能芯片的销售将减少 15%。

paras.en: During Tuesday’s news conference, Blanche appeared to become defensive when questioned about how the Justice Department ensured Huang had not violated any US laws.
paras.zh: 在周二的新闻发布会上，当被问及司法部如何确保黄没有违反任何美国法律时，布兰奇似乎采取了防御态度。

paras.en: “I’m trying to be as transparent as I can be under the laws and rules around what we do,” Blanche said. “What I said last week is that we were looking into it.”
paras.zh: 布兰奇说：“根据有关我们所做工作的法律和规则，我会尽力保持透明。” “我上周说的是我们正在调查此事。”

paras.en: He continued by explaining that there were various types of “investigations”.
paras.zh: 他继续解释说，有各种类型的“调查”。

paras.en: “The FBI, law enforcement looks into things all the time,” he said. “That doesn’t necessarily become a criminal investigation. Doesn’t necessarily become an indictment. It just literally is that. It’s looking into things”.
paras.zh: “联邦调查局和执法部门一直在调查事情，”他说。 “这不一定会成为刑事调查。不一定会成为起诉书。它只是字面上的意思。它正在调查事情”。

paras.en: The attorney general said Trump was “free to talk about whatever he wants”, and he called Nvidia “a good corporate citizen”.
paras.zh: 司法部长表示，特朗普“可以自由地谈论他想谈论的任何事情”，他称英伟达是“一个优秀的企业公民”。

paras.en: “Obviously, if Nvidia was the target, or was the subject of some criminal investigation, or they were obstructing or thwarting our investigation, then that wouldn’t be the message that the president is saying to the American people,” Blanche said.
paras.zh: 布兰奇说：“显然，如果英伟达是目标，或者是某些刑事调查的对象，或者他们阻碍或阻挠我们的调查，那么这不会是总统向美国人民传达的信息。”

articles.title: Fighting between Russia and Ukraine has expanded geographically, drawing concerns
articles.author: Charles Maynes

paras.en: Fighting between Russia and Ukraine has expanded geographically, drawing concerns
paras.zh: 俄罗斯和乌克兰之间的战斗范围扩大，引发担忧

paras.en: In recent days, Ukraine has sunk a Russian warship docked in port in Libya, and Russian missiles have landed in Poland. The Kremlin has not commented on the missiles.
paras.zh: 连日来，乌克兰击沉了一艘停靠在利比亚港口的俄罗斯军舰，俄罗斯导弹也落入波兰。克里姆林宫尚未对这些导弹发表评论。

paras.en: Depending on your point of view, Russia's war in Ukraine is either revving up or winding down.
paras.zh: 根据你的观点，俄罗斯在乌克兰的战争要么加速，要么逐渐结束。

paras.en: This month, the Trump administration claimed it was making progress toward a negotiated peace. Also this month, the fighting has expanded geographically into Eastern Europe, Northern Europe, even the Mediterranean, as if it was a world war.
paras.zh: 本月，特朗普政府声称正在朝着通过谈判达成和平的方向取得进展。同样在这个月，战斗的地域范围扩大到了东欧、北欧，甚至地中海，仿佛这是一场世界大战。

paras.en: MARTIN: Joining us to talk about both these dynamics is NPR's Charles Maynes from Moscow. Charles, good morning.
paras.zh: 马丁：来自莫斯科的美国国家公共广播电台 (NPR) 的查尔斯·梅恩斯 (Charles Maynes) 与我们一起讨论了这两个动态。查尔斯，早上好。

paras.en: CHARLES MAYNES, BYLINE: Morning, Michel.
paras.zh: 查尔斯·梅恩连线：早上好，米歇尔。

paras.en: MARTIN: So Russia and Ukraine are both striking out far beyond their borders. How concerned should we be?
paras.zh: 马丁：所以俄罗斯和乌克兰都在向远离其国境的地方发起进攻。我们应该有多担心？

paras.en: MAYNES: You know, there have been long concerns that an incident along NATO's northeastern flank near a border in Russia could serve as a tripwire for turning the war in Ukraine into a wider conflict. But recent events have brought that back to our attention. Last week we saw three Russian cruise missiles land in southeastern Poland, and on Saturday, a sanctioned Russian cargo ship was hit by what is presumed to have been a Ukrainian drone in the Baltic Sea. But now we're also seeing action further afield. Ukraine destroyed a Russian naval warship docked in Libya in the Mediterranean. Russia has its own shadow role providing intel to Iran in its war with the U.S. And just this morning, South Korea said it scrambled jets to chase away Russian sorties operating near its airspace. So the spillover is real, and the map is wide.
paras.zh: 梅恩斯：你知道，长期以来，人们一直担心俄罗斯边境附近北约东北侧发生的事件可能成为将乌克兰战争转变为更广泛冲突的绊脚石。但最近发生的事件让我们重新注意到这一点。上周，我们看到三枚俄罗斯巡航导弹降落在波兰东南部，周六，一艘受制裁的俄罗斯货船在波罗的海被一架疑似乌克兰无人机击中。但现在我们也看到了更远的地方的行动。乌克兰在地中海摧毁了一艘停靠在利比亚的俄罗斯海军军舰。俄罗斯也有自己的影子角色，在伊朗与美国的战争中向伊朗提供情报。就在今天早上，韩国表示，它紧急升空喷气式飞机，以驱赶俄罗斯在其领空附近进行的飞行活动。因此，溢出效应是真实的，而且范围很广。

paras.en: MARTIN: So what is being done to contain it?
paras.zh: 马丁：那么正在采取什么措施来遏制它呢？
