paras.en: MAYNES: Well, you know, Russian President Vladimir Putin constantly dismisses this idea that he's seeking direct confrontation with NATO. He says it's absurd. But there have been a spate of recent incidents of bomb threats, cyberattacks, sabotage that some in Europe believe are the work of Russia's security services. Russia's goal, it seems, would be to tear at the alliance's core commitment to collective security - this idea that an attack on one is an attack on all - and it's divided NATO. How do you respond to acts that fall below this threshold of outright war? So for example, President Trump has dismissed incursions by Russia into NATO airspace as basically mistakes. Now, as to other areas where we've seen Ukraine launch attacks, like Libya or apparently the Baltic Sea, it seems to show that Ukraine is intent on striking symbols of Russian power anywhere, and that also makes some supporters of Kyiv nervous.
paras.zh: 梅恩斯：嗯，你知道，俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京不断否认他正在寻求与北约直接对抗的想法。他说这很荒谬。但最近发生了一系列炸弹威胁、网络攻击和破坏事件，一些欧洲人认为这是俄罗斯安全部门所为。俄罗斯的目标似乎是撕毁联盟对集体安全的核心承诺——这种对一个人的攻击就是对所有人的攻击的观念——而且它分裂了北约。您如何应对低于全面战争门槛的行为？例如，特朗普总统将俄罗斯入侵北约领空视为根本错误。现在，至于我们看到乌克兰发动袭击的其他地区，比如利比亚或显然是波罗的海，这似乎表明乌克兰有意打击任何地方的俄罗斯权力象征，这也让基辅的一些支持者感到紧张。

paras.en: MARTIN: On the diplomatic front, President Trump is suggesting that a peace deal may be in the offing. Why does he say that?
paras.zh: 马丁：在外交方面，特朗普总统暗示和平协议可能即将达成。他为什么这么说？

paras.en: MAYNES: Well, after two years, we saw the Trump administration really make no headway. They've changed tactics by expanding the talks beyond Russia and Ukraine to focus on European security as a whole. And the conversations are now fundamentally centered on what security guarantees are on offer to Ukraine, to Russia, and to Europe. But the problem seems to be there's a bit of a disconnect between what that means to each of them.
paras.zh: 梅恩斯：嗯，两年后，我们看到特朗普政府确实没有取得任何进展。他们改变了策略，将谈判范围扩大到俄罗斯和乌克兰之外，以关注整个欧洲安全。现在的对话基本上集中在向乌克兰、俄罗斯和欧洲提供哪些安全保障上。但问题似乎是这对他们每个人的意义都有些脱节。

paras.en: For example, Trump's envoys say Russia is, quote, "comfortable" with NATO-like guarantees for Ukraine. Russian officials have pushed back against that idea hard. But President Trump - he says this is all public posturing, that everyone is being much more flexible behind the scenes. We'll just have to see if he's right.
paras.zh: 例如，特朗普的特使表示，俄罗斯对类似北约对乌克兰的保证感到“满意”。俄罗斯官员强烈反对这一想法。但特朗普总统表示，这都是公开姿态，每个人在幕后都变得更加灵活。我们只需看看他是否正确。

paras.en: MARTIN: And meanwhile, the war continues.
paras.zh: 马丁：与此同时，战争仍在继续。

paras.en: MAYNES: It does, and it was staggering losses, particularly from the Russian side, if new findings published yesterday by various independent Russian media in exile is correct. They've been sifting through data that was hacked from Russia's statistics agency and concluded that upwards of an astonishing 700,000 Russian troops have been killed in this war, and those numbers continue to grow.
paras.zh: 梅恩斯：确实如此，如果俄罗斯流亡各独立媒体昨天发表的新调查结果是正确的，那么损失是惊人的，特别是来自俄罗斯方面。他们一直在筛选从俄罗斯统计机构窃取的数据，得出的结论是，超过 70 万俄罗斯士兵在这场战争中阵亡，而且这一数字还在继续增长。

paras.en: MARTIN: That is NPR's Charles Maynes in Moscow. Charles, thank you.
paras.zh: 马丁：这是 NPR 驻莫斯科的查尔斯·梅恩斯。查尔斯，谢谢你。

paras.zh: NPR 节目文字记录的准确性和可用性可能会有所不同。转录文本也可能会被修改以纠正错误或匹配音频更新。音频可以在其原始广播或出版后进行编辑。 NPR 节目的权威记录是音频记录。

articles.title: Jensen Huang returns to Nvidia. And, Rep. Gomez resigns amid alleged sexual misconduct
articles.author: Brittney Melton

paras.en: Jensen Huang returns to Nvidia. And, Rep. Gomez resigns amid alleged sexual misconduct
paras.zh: 黄仁勋重返英伟达。而且，众议员戈麦斯因涉嫌不当性行为而辞职

paras.en: Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO yesterday, causing the company's stock to soar more than 30%. President Trump claimed credit for facilitating Huang's return. The CEO's comeback follows his resignation just two weeks earlier due to reports of extramarital affairs, including involvement with a woman U.S. intelligence agencies suspected of being a Chinese spy. Huang, a close ally of the president, had previously donated $25 million to the new White House ballroom and security complex. His return boosted Nvidia's stock and triggered a rally in the entire stock market, revealing that one man's comeback is worth about a trillion dollars. Some individuals advocating for diversity and inclusion in Silicon Valley argue that Huang's return signals that profit is the only priority.
paras.zh: 英伟达昨天恢复黄仁勋担任首席执行官，导致该公司股价飙升超过30%。特朗普总统声称为黄的回归提供了便利。两周前，这位首席执行官因婚外情报道而辞职，其中包括与一名涉嫌中国间谍的美国情报机构女性有牵连。黄是总统的亲密盟友，此前曾向新的白宫宴会厅和安全综合体捐赠了 2500 万美元。他的回归提振了英伟达的股价，并引发了整个股市的上涨，揭示了一个人的回归价值约为万亿美元。一些倡导硅谷多元化和包容性的人士认为，黄仁勋的回归表明利润是唯一的优先考虑。

paras.en: - 🎧 Trump's involvement in a private business decision is significant, NPR's Danielle Kurtzleben tells Up First — even if it's typical for this administration to intervene in the economy. In a CNBC interview, the president said he was concerned that Chinese President Xi Jinping might lure Huang to China to enhance their chip business. Despite mixed economic indicators, Trump frequently highlights stock market performance, noting that Huang reinstatement not only boosted Nvidia's stock but could also uplift the entire market after a tough week.
paras.zh: - 🎧 NPR 的 Danielle Kurtzleben 告诉 Up First，特朗普对私人商业决策的参与意义重大——即使干预经济是本届政府的典型做法。在接受 CNBC 采访时，总统表示，他担心中国国家主席习近平可能会引诱黄仁勋到中国来增强他们的芯片业务。尽管经济指标好坏参半，特朗普还是经常强调股市表现，指出黄仁勋的复职不仅提振了英伟达的股价，还可能在经历了艰难的一周后提振整个市场。

paras.en: - 🎧 Investors have put scandals aside and said that Huang represents a significant portion of Nvidia's value, says Ricky Mulvey with The Indicator from Planet Money. The stock trades at about 10 times forward earnings, indicating investors expect to pay for 10 years of future profits now. Investors are paying more for other chipmakers, implying they have more expected future growth, Mulvey says. Despite Nvidia's recent sales doubling over the past year, its investors aren't anticipating much growth ahead.
paras.zh: - 🎧 Planet Money 的 The Indicator 的 Ricky Mulvey 表示，投资者已将丑闻放在一边，并表示黄仁勋代表了 Nvidia 价值的很大一部分。该股的预期市盈率约为 10 倍，表明投资者现在期望为未来 10 年的利润付出代价。穆尔维表示，投资者为其他芯片制造商支付的费用更高，这意味着他们对未来的增长抱有更高的预期。尽管英伟达最近的销售额比过去一年翻了一番，但其投资者预计未来不会有太大增长。

paras.en: Ukraine recently sank a Russian warship in Libya, while Russian missiles struck Poland. There has been no comment from the Kremlin on the strikes. Depending on perspective, Russia's war in Ukraine appears to be either escalating or de-escalating. This month, the Trump administration said it is making progress towards a negotiated peace. However, fighting has expanded into Eastern and Northern Europe and the Mediterranean.
paras.zh: 乌克兰最近在利比亚击沉了一艘俄罗斯军舰，而俄罗斯的导弹则袭击了波兰。克里姆林宫尚未对罢工发表评论。根据不同的观点，俄罗斯在乌克兰的战争似乎要么正在升级，要么正在缓和。本月，特朗普政府表示，在通过谈判实现和平方面正在取得进展。然而，战斗已扩大到东欧、北欧以及地中海。

paras.en: - 🎧 Concerns have resurfaced that an incident along NATO's northeastern flank could serve as a way for Russia to escalate the war in Ukraine, NPR's Charles Maynes says. Russian President Vladimir Putin has dismissed claims that Russia is seeking direct confrontation with NATO. Recent bomb threats, cyber attacks and sabotage have raised suspicions among some in Europe that Russia's security services may be involved, Maynes says. He adds that it appears to be Russia's goal to undermine NATO's core principle of collective security, where an attack on one member is an attack on all.
paras.zh: - NPR 的查尔斯·梅恩斯 (Charles Maynes) 表示，人们再次担心北约东北翼发生的事件可能成为俄罗斯升级乌克兰战争的一种方式。俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京否认了俄罗斯寻求与北约直接对抗的说法。梅恩斯说，最近的炸弹威胁、网络攻击和破坏活动引起欧洲一些人的怀疑，认为俄罗斯安全部门可能参与其中。他补充说，俄罗斯的目标似乎是破坏北约集体安全的核心原则，即对一个成员国的攻击就是对所有成员国的攻击。

paras.en: Rep. Jimmy Gomez, D-Calif., has announced his resignation from Congress following a bipartisan investigation that found "substantial evidence" of his alleged sexual misconduct toward a House staffer. The House Ethics Committee determined that Gomez violated House rules by "making unwelcome sexual advances" and disregarding the power imbalance in his relationship with staff. The report says his actions could amount to criminal sexual assault. Gomez, who has represented parts of Los Angeles since 2017, lost his reelection bid this fall to Democrat Angela Gonzales-Torres. Gomez says he has strong disagreements with the report and its conclusions.
paras.zh: 加利福尼亚州民主党众议员吉米·戈麦斯宣布辞去国会职务，此前两党调查发现了他涉嫌对众议院工作人员实施不当性行为的“大量证据”。众议院道德委员会认定，戈麦斯“做出不受欢迎的性挑衅”并无视与工作人员关系中的权力不平衡，违反了众议院规则。报告称，他的行为可能构成刑事性侵犯。戈麦斯自 2017 年以来一直代表洛杉矶部分地区，今年秋天在连任竞选中输给了民主党人安吉拉·冈萨雷斯-托雷斯。戈麦斯表示，他对该报告及其结论有强烈的异议。

paras.en: Move over, violins and pianos. The Seattle Symphony is giving the timpani its moment in the spotlight with a world premiere concerto. Principal timpanist Eric Schweikert, who says he is drawn to the back-of-the-classroom vibe in the orchestra, is stepping up to showcase the versatility of the percussion instrument. The piece offers listeners a look at the timpani's range, including rumbling rolls produced with clever mallet work to imitate the effect of a long note. While Schweikert promises to deliver plenty of the wild, Muppets-style Animal energy audiences crave, he's also ready to keep his fellow musicians on their toes — and show the crowd that kettle drums can sing, too.
paras.zh: 小提琴和钢琴让开。西雅图交响乐团以全球首演的协奏曲让定音鼓成为众人瞩目的焦点。首席定音鼓手埃里克·施韦克特 (Eric Sc​​hweikert) 表示，他被管弦乐队的课堂氛围所吸引，他正在加紧展示打击乐器的多功能性。这首曲子让听众了解了定音鼓的音域，包括用巧妙的木槌制作来模仿长音符效果的隆隆声。尽管施韦克特承诺为观众带来大量狂野的布偶风格的动物能量，但他也准备好让他的音乐家同行们保持警惕，并向观众展示水壶鼓也可以唱歌。

paras.en: Traveling by air for the holidays? AAA forecasts that nearly 6 million travelers will be flying this Thanksgiving, making it essential to know how to handle flight cancellations or delays. Travel experts have shared tips with Life Kit to make the rebooking process easier and ensure you won't miss your holiday celebrations.
paras.zh: 假期乘飞机旅行？ AAA 预测今年感恩节将有近 600 万名旅客乘坐飞机，因此了解如何处理航班取消或延误至关重要。旅行专家与 Life Kit 分享了一些技巧，可以让您更轻松地重新预订，并确保您不会错过节日庆祝活动。

paras.en: - ✈️ While in line for customer service, open the airline app to rebook yourself. This speeds up the process, which can make a big difference when hundreds of other passengers may be in the same situation.
paras.zh: - ✈️ 在排队等候客户服务时，打开航空公司应用程序自行重新预订。这加快了这一过程，当数百名其他乘客可能处于同样的情况时，这可能会产生很大的影响。

paras.en: - ✈️ If your travel credit card offers lounge access, use it for personalized customer service. If you lack access, consider buying an on-site day pass.
paras.zh: - ✈️ 如果您的旅行信用卡提供休息室使用权，请使用它来获得个性化的客户服务。如果您无法进入，请考虑购买现场一日通行证。

paras.en: - ✈️ Ticket holders are entitled to a refund if the airline cancels their flight and they refuse alternative options such as later flights or travel vouchers.
paras.zh: - ✈️ 如果航空公司取消航班并且拒绝其他选择（例如稍后的航班或旅行券），持票人有权获得退款。

paras.en: - ✈️ Choose the early-morning flight when rebooking. It's your best chance to avoid delays or cancellations. First flights out have a lower risk of waiting for an incoming aircraft, since the aircraft is likely to have been at the airport overnight.
paras.zh: - ✈️改签时选择凌晨航班。这是避免延误或取消的最佳机会。首趟起飞的航班等待进港飞机的风险较低，因为飞机很可能已在机场过夜。

paras.en: - Parents of young children say they're worried about a perceived decline in kindness and they now value empathy over manners and compassion over confidence, according to a Sesame Workshop survey.
paras.zh: - 根据芝麻街工作室的一项调查，幼儿的父母表示，他们担心孩子的友善程度会下降，他们现在更看重同理心而不是礼貌，更看重同情心而不是自信。

paras.en: - A near-record number of travelers are set to hit the roads this Thanksgiving week. They'll face higher costs due to elevated fuel prices.
paras.zh: - 感恩节这一周上路的旅客数量将接近创纪录。由于燃油价格上涨，他们将面临更高的成本。

paras.en: - Has a political or social issue damaged an important relationship for you? If you're thinking about repairing it this holiday season, NPR wants to hear your story.
paras.zh: - 政治或社会问题是否损害了您的重要关系？如果您正在考虑在这个假期修复它，NPR 希望听到您的故事。

articles.title: Who really owns the Albanian land Jared Kushner wants to turn into a 5-star resort?
articles.author: Rob Schmitz

paras.en: Who really owns the Albanian land Jared Kushner wants to turn into a 5-star resort?
paras.zh: 谁真正拥有阿尔巴尼亚土地，贾里德·库什纳想将其打造成五星级度假村？

paras.en: ZVERNEC, Albania — In the summer of 2021, Jared Kushner and Ivanka Trump boarded a yacht owned by Nat Rothschild, an heir to the European banking family. On the way from Montenegro to Greece, the yacht anchored off the coast of Albania.
paras.zh: 阿尔巴尼亚兹韦尔内克——2021 年夏天，贾里德·库什纳 (Jared Kushner) 和伊万卡·特朗普 (Ivanka Trump) 登上了欧洲银行家族继承人纳特·罗斯柴尔德 (Nat Rothschild) 拥有的一艘游艇。在从黑山前往希腊的途中，这艘游艇停泊在阿尔巴尼亚海岸附近。

paras.en: And, as Kushner told an investment conference last year, that's when Albanian Prime Minister Edi Rama arrived at the boat to tell them about his plan for the country.
paras.zh: 正如库什纳去年在一次投资会议上所说，当时阿尔巴尼亚总理埃迪·拉马抵达船上，向他们讲述了他对该国的计划。

paras.en: "I was very impressed by what he wanted to do with the country," said Kushner. "I really didn't know anything about the country and I didn't understand the history, and the darkness of the history with the communism and terrible leadership led to it being fully undeveloped as a nation."
paras.zh: 库什纳说：“他想为这个国家做的事情给我留下了深刻的印象。” “我真的对这个国家一无所知，也不了解历史，共产主义的黑暗历史和可怕的领导导致它作为一个国家完全不发达。”

paras.en: A year later, Kushner was looking for development opportunities in the Balkans. He returned to the Albanian coast — to the city of Vlore, which was finishing the construction of an airport atop a wetland near an undeveloped coastline. "And obviously, a country's going to build an airport by the coast in a place they think is most beautiful," Kushner told the conference, "so we went there and we were looking for opportunities, and we found some incredible opportunities."
paras.zh: 一年后，库什纳在巴尔干地区寻找发展机会。他回到阿尔巴尼亚海岸——发罗勒市，该市正在未开发的海岸线附近的湿地上完成机场建设。库什纳在会议上表示：“显然，一个国家将在他们认为最美丽的地方建造一个沿海机场，所以我们去了那里，寻找机会，我们发现了一些令人难以置信的机会。”

paras.en: Kushner found those opportunities at Hidrovor Beach, an expanse of caramel-colored sand along the southern Albanian coast, with the gentle waves of the Adriatic lapping its perimeter and a view of an uninhabited island. A company working for Kushner purchased this land and 300 acres surrounding it for more than $130 million in April. But several people here tell NPR this is not Kushner's land.
paras.zh: 库什纳在 Hidrovor 海滩找到了这些机会，这是阿尔巴尼亚南部海岸的一片焦糖色沙滩，亚得里亚海温和的海浪拍打着它的周边，还可以看到一座无人居住的岛屿。一家为库什纳工作的公司于 4 月份以超过 1.3 亿美元的价格购买了这片土地及其周围的 300 英亩土地。但这里的一些人告诉美国国家公共广播电台，这不是库什纳的土地。

paras.en: "This land here belonged to my family for centuries," says Gentian Mocka, who claims his family has owned this strip of beach and wetland since the time of the Ottoman Empire. He provided NPR land titles that appear to prove this.
paras.zh: “这片土地几个世纪以来一直属于我的家族，”根蒂安·莫卡 (Gentian Mocka) 说道，他声称自奥斯曼帝国时代起，他的家族就拥有这片海滩和湿地。他提供的 NPR 土地所有权似乎证明了这一点。

paras.en: After World War II, Albania's Communist government seized it — along with all private land.
paras.zh: 第二次世界大战后，阿尔巴尼亚共产党政府夺取了它以及所有私人土地。

paras.en: When communism fell in 1991, families like Mocka's embarked on a years-long process to get their land back. "But then our problems started with the guys that were much more powerful than we were — had a lot of political support, were very rich and very well connected with the politics of that time," says Mocka.
paras.zh: 1991 年共产主义垮台后，像莫卡这样的家庭开始了长达数年的收回土地的过程。 “但后来我们的问题开始出现在那些比我们强大得多的人身上——他们有很多政治支持，非常富有，并且与当时的政治关系密切，”莫卡说。

paras.en: In 2005, Mocka learned that someone else was laying claim to his family's land — a fellow Albanian named Artur Shehu. It was a familiar name for those who lived here in the 1990s, when the regional capital of Vlore was outside the control of the country's government. It was instead run by mafia-style gangs. At the time, Shehu was well-known to police in Vlore for his alleged involvement in a crime syndicate that, according to Albanian prosecutors, smuggled drugs and migrants into Europe. He fled Albania in 1999, after what police say was a shootout with a rival gang.
paras.zh: 2005 年，莫卡得知有人对他家的土地提出了所有权要求，他是阿尔巴尼亚同胞阿图尔·谢胡 (Artur Shehu)。对于 20 世纪 90 年代居住在这里的人们来说，这是一个熟悉的名字，当时发罗勒地区首府不受该国政府的控制。相反，它是由黑手党风格的团伙经营的。当时，谢胡因涉嫌参与犯罪集团而为发罗勒警方所熟知，据阿尔巴尼亚检察官称，该犯罪集团向欧洲走私毒品和移民。 1999 年，警方称与敌对帮派发生枪战后，他逃离了阿尔巴尼亚。

paras.en: He ended up in the United States, where he received asylum in 2001 and, later, became a U.S. citizen. The 60-year-old Shehu now lives in a villa in Miami Beach. But he's continued to manage a growing real estate portfolio back in Albania through an associate in Vlore named Pellumb Petritaj.
paras.zh: 他最终来到了美国，并于 2001 年获得庇护，后来成为美国公民。 60岁的谢胡现在住在迈阿密海滩的一栋别墅里。但他继续通过发罗勒的一位名叫 Pellumb Petritaj 的合伙人管理阿尔巴尼亚不断增长的房地产投资组合。

paras.en: The pair has claimed plots of land — including Mocka's family plot — up and down the southern Albanian coast, and prosecutors have taken notice. In 2018, Petritaj served three years in prison for forging land titles on behalf of Shehu. And on Nov. 18, Petritaj was sentenced to another seven years in prison for falsifying documents to $17 million worth of oceanfront property in the city of Vlore on behalf of Shehu. The court ordered the land — which does not include Mocka's family plot — confiscated from Shehu last week. The pair has also claimed oceanfront farmland in the village of Zvernec, adjacent to Mocka's land.
paras.zh: 两人声称拥有阿尔巴尼亚南部海岸上下游的土地，包括莫卡的家庭土地，检察官已经注意到了这一点。 2018 年，Petritaj 因代表 Shehu 伪造土地所有权而入狱三年。 11 月 18 日，Petritaj 因代表 Shehu 伪造发罗勒市价值 1,700 万美元海滨房产的文件而被另外判处七年监禁。法院上周下令没收谢胡的土地（不包括莫卡的家庭土地）。两人还声称拥有 Zvernec 村的海滨农田，毗邻莫卡的土地。

paras.en: Albanian prosecutors say land linked to Kushner may have been "illegally acquired"
paras.zh: 阿尔巴尼亚检察官称与库什纳有关的土地可能是“非法获得的”

paras.en: The pair has also claimed oceanfront farmland in the village of Zvernec, adjacent to Mocka's land.
paras.zh: 两人还声称拥有 Zvernec 村的海滨农田，毗邻莫卡的土地。

paras.en: The quiet village has only a couple hundred residents. Most of them, like Minella Konomi and Natasha Kota, are past the age of 70. On a recent warm and sunny afternoon, the two are resting on benches in the courtyard of the village church after a day of harvesting olives. They nod their heads when asked about Artur Shehu.
paras.zh: 这个安静的村庄只有几百名居民。他们中的大多数人，比如米内拉·科诺米（Minella Konomi）和娜塔莎·科塔（Natasha Kota），都已经70多岁了。在最近一个温暖而阳光明媚的下午，两人在收获一天的橄榄后，在乡村教堂庭院的长凳上休息。当被问及阿图尔谢胡时，他们点点头。

paras.en: "He is from the village of Kanina, far from here and up in the mountains," says Konomi, motioning inland, "but his family has never lived here. He's involved in shady dealings."
paras.zh: “他来自卡尼纳村，离这里很远，在山上，”科诺米指着内陆说道，“但他的家人从来没有住在这里。他参与了不正当的交易​​。”

paras.en: Then Kota speaks up. "There wasn't a single soul of that family living here, going back to the Ottoman times," she says. "But we've heard stories about him, and we're very scared of him."
paras.zh: 然后科塔开口了。 “这个家庭没有一个灵魂住在这里，这可以追溯到奥斯曼帝国时代，”她说。 “但我们听说过有关他的故事，我们非常害怕他。”

paras.en: Twenty years ago, Kota, Konomi and dozens of others in this village learned that Artur Shehu had somehow acquired their farmland. They filed suit in Albanian court to reclaim their land, a fight that escalated this past April when Shehu sold the 300-acre parcel that includes what they say is their farmland to a company developing a luxury resort project for Kushner.
paras.zh: 二十年前，Kota、Konomi 和这个村子里的其他几十个人得知 Artur Shehu 以某种方式征用了他们的农田。他们向阿尔巴尼亚法院提起诉讼，要求收回自己的土地。今年 4 月，谢胡将这块 300 英亩的土地（其中包括他们所说的农田）卖给了一家为库什纳开发豪华度假村项目的公司，这场争斗进一步升级。

paras.en: That transaction, however, is under review.
paras.zh: 不过，该交易正在接受审查。

paras.en: In court documents obtained by NPR, Albanian prosecutors argue that the land involved in Kushner's development is "suspected of having been illegally acquired through forgery."
paras.zh: 在美国公共广播电台获得的法庭文件中，阿尔巴尼亚检察官辩称，库什纳开发项目涉及的土地“涉嫌通过伪造手段非法获得”。

paras.en: A spokesman for Kushner did not respond to NPR's request for comment by the time this article was published. Kushner had previously issued a statement on his website saying his partnership purchased the land from a private party in a private transaction. "Title was reviewed by counsel and verified," the statement says.
paras.zh: 截至本文发表时，库什纳的发言人尚未回应 NPR 的置评请求。库什纳此前曾在其网站上发表声明称，他的合伙企业通过私人交易从私人手中购买了这块土地。声明称：“产权已由律师审查并核实。”

paras.en: Shehu did not respond to NPR's request for comment. He has previously denied any wrongdoing. However, in Tirana, a former lawyer for Shehu was willing to talk.
paras.zh: Shehu 没有回应 NPR 的置评请求。他此前否认有任何不当行为。然而，在地拉那，谢胡的一位前律师愿意谈谈。

paras.en: Oceanfront properties are now claimed by several parties
paras.zh: 海滨房产现已被多方认领

paras.en: "The people that Artur [Shehu] has authorized by power of attorney to deal with his family's properties committed a forgery in which they removed the property from the brother of Artur's grandfather and passed it to Artur's grandfather," says Kujtim Cakrani. "That is the whole story of the property."
paras.zh: 库吉蒂姆·卡克拉尼 (Kujtim Cakrani) 表示：“阿图尔 [Shehu] 授权处理其家族财产的人犯下了伪造罪，他们从阿图尔祖父的兄弟手中夺走了财产，并将其传给了阿图尔的祖父。” “这就是这处房产的全部故事。”

paras.en: Cakrani says Shehu's associates forged an inheritance certificate that made it appear that Shehu's grandfather had owned the land, which was then passed to Artur Shehu himself. And then last April, Shehu sold that land to Moutaz and Ramez Al-Khayyat, Syrian-born Qatari billionaire brothers who are financial partners of Jared Kushner.
paras.zh: 卡克拉尼说，谢胡的同伙伪造了一份继承证书，使谢胡的祖父拥有这片土地，然后将土地传给了阿图尔谢胡本人。去年四月，谢胡将这块土地卖给了穆塔兹·阿尔·海亚特 (Moutaz Al-Khayyat) 和拉梅兹·阿尔·海亚特 (Ramez Al-Khayyat)，这对叙利亚出生的卡塔尔亿万富翁兄弟是贾里德·库什纳 (Jared Kushner) 的财务合作伙伴。

paras.en: Cakrani says that when he discovered that Artur Shehu was involved in this alleged forgery, he dropped him as his client. "I could no longer continue representing him because of the seriousness of the matter," he says. "It is impossible for me, with these documents that he has, to defend him."
paras.zh: 卡克拉尼说，当他发现阿图尔·谢胡参与了这起涉嫌伪造的案件时，他放弃了他的客户身份。 “由于事情的严重性，我无法再继续代表他，”他说。 “凭借他拥有的这些文件，我不可能为他辩护。”

paras.en: And this is why, Cakrani says, Albanian state prosecutors have put Shehu under investigation and froze his bank accounts. Cakrani says he is now representing a group of 30 relatives of Shehu who he claims to be the rightful owners of this land.
paras.zh: 卡克拉尼说，这就是阿尔巴尼亚国家检察官对谢胡进行调查并冻结他的银行账户的原因。卡克拉尼说，他现在代表谢胡 30 名亲属组成的团体，他声称这些人是这片土地的合法所有者。

paras.en: Gentian Mocka, as well as Minella Konomi and Natasha Kota in Zvernec, tell NPR that nobody by the name of Shehu — neither Artur nor his relatives — has any legal claim to what they say is their land, oceanfront property that has now been claimed by several parties, including the son-in-law of the president of the United States.
paras.zh: Gentian Mocka 以及 Zvernec 的 Minella Konomi 和 Natasha Kota 告诉 NPR，没有任何一个名叫 Shehu 的人——无论是 Artur 还是他的亲戚——都对他们所说的土地、海滨财产拥有任何合法权利，而这些财产现在已被包括美国总统女婿在内的多方声称拥有。

paras.en: Wealthy speculators have exploited land in Albania since the fall of communism
paras.zh: 自共产主义垮台以来，富有的投机者一直在开发阿尔巴尼亚的土地

paras.en: Albanian real estate law expert Roden Hoxha says he has seen this kind of land battle many times before. "But now that Kushner is in it," he says, "everybody is freaking out."
paras.zh: 阿尔巴尼亚房地产法专家罗登·霍查表示，他以前多次见过这种土地争夺战。 “但现在库什纳参与其中，”他说，“每个人都吓坏了。”

paras.en: He says land ownership in Albania is complicated by decades under a Stalinist regime that stole all the land from private owners and collectivized it. When communism fell in 1991, he says Albania became a land grab free-for-all.
paras.zh: 他说，阿尔巴尼亚的土地所有权在斯大林主义政权统治下几十年来变得复杂，该政权从私人所有者手中窃取了所有土地并将其集体化。他说，1991 年共产主义垮台后，阿尔巴尼亚变成了一场混战的土地争夺战。

paras.en: "It was basically chaos," he says. "People started claiming land wherever they threw a stone. It was basically the Albanian version of the U.S.' claiming of the West."
paras.zh: “这基本上是一片混乱，”他说。 “人们开始向任何扔石头的地方声称拥有土地。这基本上是阿尔巴尼亚版的美国。”对西方提出主权要求。”

paras.en: Hoxha describes wealthy speculators keen to exploit the chaos of the moment: locals whose families have farmed the land for generations and well-connected operators like Shehu, who aggressively try to claim that land. "And then on the international level," says Hoxha, most recently, "it exploded because it was Kushner and Trump and Arab money behind it."
paras.zh: 霍查描述了富有的投机者热衷于利用当前的混乱局面：当地人世代耕种土地，而像谢胡这样人脉广泛的经营者则积极地试图夺取这片土地。 “然后在国际层面上，”霍查最近说道，“它爆炸了，因为背后有库什纳、特朗普和阿拉伯资金支持。”

paras.en: And so, Hoxha says, what at first appeared to be yet another Albanian land dispute now has ties all the way to the White House. In the end, an Albanian court will likely decide who the rightful owner of this property is. But for now, it has sparked unprecedented public outrage in Albania. Protesters have taken to the streets of the capital, Tirana, every day since May 31, calling on Prime Minister Edi Rama to resign. But Rama has only vowed to crack down harder on what have become increasingly violent demonstrations against his entire government.
paras.zh: 霍查说，因此，乍一看似乎是另一场阿尔巴尼亚土地争端，现在却与白宫有着千丝万缕的联系。最终，阿尔巴尼亚法院可能会决定谁是该财产的合法所有者。但目前，它在阿尔巴尼亚引发了前所未有的公愤。自5月31日以来，抗议者每天都走上首都地拉那街头，呼吁总理埃迪·拉马辞职。但拉玛只是发誓要更加严厉地镇压针对他的整个政府的日益暴力的示威活动。

paras.en: Rama has also vowed that Kushner's resort project will go ahead as planned, but an ongoing investigation by Albania's state prosecutor into forged land titles could halt the project.
paras.zh: 拉马还誓言库什纳的度假村项目将按计划进行，但阿尔巴尼亚国家检察官正在进行的对伪造土地所有权的调查可能会阻止该项目。

paras.en: When contacted by NPR, Elona Sinaj, Rama's spokesperson, sent a statement saying, "If the seller does not have legitimate ownership of the property, the money will remain within the Republic of Albania, and certainly it will be used for anyone who proves that his claim over the property is grounded."
paras.zh: 当 NPR 联系拉玛的发言人伊洛娜·西纳 (Elona Sinaj) 时，他发表声明称，“如果卖家没有该财产的合法所有权，这笔钱将留在阿尔巴尼亚共和国境内，而且肯定会用于任何证明他对该财产的主张是有根据的人。”

paras.en: Sinaj went on to say that the ambition for Rama's government is "to create a new benchmark for sustainable Mediterranean development."
paras.zh: 西纳吉接着表示，拉玛政府的雄心是“为地中海可持续发展创造新的基准”。

paras.en: Some Albanians see advantages to having a Kushner-linked resort
paras.zh: 一些阿尔巴尼亚人看到了拥有库什纳相关度假村的优势

paras.en: That goal aligns with Kushner's vision for a luxury resort — a five-star ecotourism site, as his wife, Ivanka Trump, laid out in a podcast episode called "Ivanka Trump on Building the Authentic Life."
paras.zh: 这一目标与库什纳对豪华度假村的愿景一致——正如他的妻子伊万卡·特朗普在名为“伊万卡·特朗普建设真实生活”的播客节目中所阐述的那样，这是一个五星级生态旅游网站。

paras.en: "For me," said Trump, "this is, it feels more like a challenge than anything else, the culmination of all of my experience in real estate, all of my travel, a lot of reflection on how I want to live."
paras.zh: 特朗普说：“对我来说，这感觉更像是一个挑战，是我所有房地产经验、我所有旅行以及对我想要如何生活的大量反思的结晶。”

paras.en: In the podcast, Trump described both the Zvernec beachfront property as well as Sazan — an uninhabited island across from it — as part of a development project belonging to her and Kushner.
paras.zh: 在播客中，特朗普将兹韦尔内克海滨房产以及其对面的无人岛萨赞描述为属于她和库什纳的开发项目的一部分。

paras.en: Local tour operator Sherif Durmishaj has made a living taking tourists to Sazan by boat, guiding hikes past foxholes and signs along the trail that warn of active land mines scattered throughout the island's forests. For years, this island was a fortified military outpost.
paras.zh: 当地旅游经营者谢里夫·杜米沙伊 (Sherif Durmishaj) 靠乘船载游客前往萨赞为生，他带领游客经过散兵坑和小径沿途的警示牌，警告岛上森林中遍布着活跃的地雷。多年来，这座岛屿一直是一个戒备森严的军事前哨。

paras.en: Durmishaj says he's seen the ongoing protests against the Kushner project, but he takes a different view of it.
paras.zh: 杜米沙伊说，他看到了针对库什纳项目的持续抗议活动，但他对此有不同的看法。

paras.en: "I work in tourism, and I'm from here," he says, "and if you've seen how local developers, along with the mafia, have built this region, it's just a massacre. They've destroyed so much of what is a beautiful coastline, and I support the Kushner project because it's going to be ecologically sustainable and it will set a good benchmark for future projects."
paras.zh: “我从事旅游业，我来自这里，”他说，“如果你看到当地开发商和黑手党如何建设这个地区，那简直就是一场屠杀。他们毁掉了美丽的海岸线，我支持库什纳项目，因为它将是生态可持续的，并将为未来的项目树立良好的基准。”

paras.en: "We are a small country," Durmishaj says, "and Kushner and Trump are very big names."
paras.zh: “我们是一个小国家，”杜米沙伊说，“库什纳和特朗普都是非常有名的人。”

paras.en: At least one big name will be in the crosshairs of the incoming Democratic Congress in the U.S.
paras.zh: 至少有一位大人物将成为即将召开的美国民主党国会的焦点。

paras.en: Regarding Kushner, "This is an individual in the Trump family who has essentially been two-timing on the American people," says Maryland Democratic Rep. Jamie Raskin, who is expected to chair the House Judiciary Committee and will have the power to investigate and subpoena members of President Trump's family.
paras.zh: 关于库什纳，“这是特朗普家族中的一个人，他基本上对美国人民进行了两次攻击”，马里兰州民主党众议员杰米·拉斯金(Jamie Raskin)说，他预计将担任众议院司法委员会主席，并将有权调查和传唤特朗普总统的家族成员。

paras.en: He says he'll be focusing on Kushner, who he says has been splitting his time between foreign policy and making business deals on the side.
paras.zh: 他说他将把重点放在库什纳身上，他说库什纳一直把时间花在外交政策和商业交易上。

paras.en: "American foreign policy has never seen anything like that before," says Raskin. "And in this, of course, he is only imitating his father-in-law, who declared that he got $2.2 billion on the side in his first year in office. Uh, that's more than $1 million an hour."
paras.zh: “美国的外交政策以前从未见过这样的事情，”拉斯金说。 “当然，他只是在模仿他的岳父，岳父宣称他在上任第一年就获得了 22 亿美元的额外收入。呃，每小时超过 100 万美元。”

paras.en: Raskin says the luxury resort project in Albania is one of many Kushner-backed deals that have prompted investigative inquiries from his committee, and there could be more as the new U.S. Congress is sworn in in January.
paras.zh: 拉斯金表示，阿尔巴尼亚的豪华度假村项目是库什纳支持的众多交易之一，这些交易引发了他的委员会的调查，随着新一届美国国会在一月份宣誓就职，可能还会有更多交易。

paras.en: Fjori Sinoruka contributed to this report.
paras.zh: Fjori Sinoruka 对本报告做出了贡献。

articles.title: Thanksgiving week betting guide 2026: NFL Thanksgiving, Rivalry Week, NBA Cup, NHL and college hoops picks

paras.en: Thanksgiving is supposed to be about family, gratitude and too much food, and it always will be. But for bettors, this week also comes with plenty of side dishes and action as it's the best stretch of sports on the calendar, where you're expected to do very little aside from eat and find a spot on the couch.
paras.zh: 感恩节应该是关于家庭、感恩和丰盛的食物，而且永远都是这样。但对于投注者来说，本周也有大量的配菜和动作，因为这是日历上最好的体育赛事，除了吃饭和在沙发上找个位置之外，您几乎不需要做任何事情。

paras.en: Over four days you get three NFL games on Thursday, the NFL's Black Friday game, college football's loaded Rivalry Week, NBA Cup games on Prime Video, a 15-game NHL slate on Friday and college basketball's best early-season tournaments during Feast Week. You could bet from Wednesday afternoon until Saturday at midnight without running out of options.
paras.zh: 在四天内，您可以在周四观看三场 NFL 比赛、NFL 的黑色星期五比赛、大学橄榄球的激烈对抗周、Prime Video 上的 NBA 杯比赛、周五的 15 场 NHL 比赛以及盛宴周期间大学篮球最好的早期赛季锦标赛。您可以从周三下午到周六午夜进行投注，而不会用完所有选项。

paras.en: Here's the menu, organized by day. Some plays back the favorite, some fade the hype, and all of them come with the numbers to back them up.
paras.zh: 这是按天排列的菜单。有些播放最受喜爱的节目，有些则淡化炒作，所有这些都带有数字来支持它们。

paras.en: The holiday tournaments are in full swing by Wednesday. The headliner is the Players Era 16 in Las Vegas, which runs through Saturday and features Tennessee, Gonzaga, Michigan, Alabama, St. John's, Louisville and Texas Tech, among others. The Battle 4 Atlantis tips off in the Bahamas, with Memphis, Penn State, Wake Forest and Mississippi State in the bracket and Virginia, Xavier, Texas A&M and Marquette in signature-series matchups. On Thanksgiving Day, the Rady Children's Invitational in San Diego pairs Texas with Georgetown and UCLA with Saint Mary's.
paras.zh: 假期锦标赛将于周三如火如荼地进行。头条新闻是在拉斯维加斯举行的 Players Era 16，比赛将持续到周六，参赛队伍包括田纳西州、冈萨加州、密歇根州、阿拉巴马州、圣约翰斯、路易斯维尔和德克萨斯理工大学等。 Battle 4 Atlantis 在巴哈马拉开帷幕，孟菲斯州立大学、宾夕法尼亚州立大学、维克森林大学和密西西比州立大学参加了对阵，弗吉尼亚大学、泽维尔大学、德克萨斯农工大学和马凯特大学参加了签名系列赛。感恩节当天，圣地亚哥拉迪儿童邀请赛将德克萨斯州与乔治城大学、加州大学洛杉矶分校与圣玛丽大学配对。

paras.en: The angle to watch: Tennessee has been a fade target all season. The Vols opened the year shooting under 31% from three and rank 302nd in offensive block percentage, so opponents are swatting their shots at the rim. Against a neutral-site field full of tournament-caliber teams, that shooting problem doesn't go away.
paras.zh: 观察角度：整个赛季田纳西州一直是一个淡出的目标。沃尔斯开年三分球命中率低于 31%，进攻盖帽率排名第 302 位，因此对手都在篮下猛烈投篮。面对充满锦标赛级别球队的中立场地，投篮问题并没有消失。

paras.en: Two 8-2 teams playing at Ford Field on Thanksgiving. It doesn't get much better.
paras.zh: 感恩节两支球队在福特球场进行比赛，战绩为 8 胜 2 负。情况并没有好转。

paras.en: The early money has come in on Chicago. The Bears' moneyline moved from -135 to -142 on the strength of a five-game winning streak. But that streak hasn't been as dominant as it looks. Last week, Chicago beat New Orleans 21-13 and fell well short of covering as a 12.5-point favorite.
paras.zh: 早期的资金已经流入芝加哥。凭借五连胜，熊队的胜负盘从-135 升至-142。但这种势头并没有看起来那么占主导地位。上周，芝加哥队以 21-13 击败新奥尔良队，但距离夺冠热门球队 12.5 分还差得很远。

paras.en: Detroit is the hotter team against the number. The Lions are 6-0 straight up and 5-1 against the spread in their current run, and they've covered four straight. On Thanksgiving, at home and getting points, I'll take the Lions.
paras.zh: 底特律是进攻火热的球队。雄狮队在目前的比赛中取得了 6-0 的领先优势，并以 5-1 的比分领先，并且已经取得了四连胜。感恩节那天，在家里并获得积分，我会选择狮子队。

paras.en: Cowboys -8.5 (-111) | Eagles +8.5 (-108) | Total: 47.5 (Over -115 / Under -105)
Laying 8.5 points in a division game makes people nervous. In this case, it shouldn't.
paras.zh: 在分区赛中拿下8.5分，让人紧张不已。在这种情况下，不应该。

paras.en: Philadelphia is 3-7, 2-8 against the spread and hasn't covered a single road game this season. It will also be without Jalen Hurts. The Eagles snapped an 0-7 straight-up slide with a 19-16 win over Pittsburgh last week, but that came at home against a struggling Steelers offense.
paras.zh: 费城队目前战绩为 3 胜 7 负、2 胜 8 负，本赛季还没有参加过一场客场比赛。杰伦·赫茨也将缺席。老鹰队上周以 19-16 战胜匹兹堡队，结束了 0-7 的直线下滑，但这是在主场面对进攻陷入困境的钢人队。

paras.en: Dallas is coming off a 51-30 win over Tennessee in which it led 27-6 at halftime. The Cowboys have the better offense, the home crowd and the edge at quarterback. It's a big number, but it's the right side.
paras.zh: 达拉斯队以 51-30 战胜田纳西州队，半场以 27-6 领先。牛仔队拥有更好的进攻、主场球迷和四分卫优势。这是一个很大的数字，但它是右边的。

paras.en: Bills -3 (even) | Chiefs +3 (-120) | Total: 47.5 (Over -112 / Under -107)
This is the nightcap and the best game of the day. The Bills are 9-1 and 8-2 against the spread. The Chiefs are 8-2, with three straight wins and covers.
paras.zh: 这是睡前酒，也是当天最好的游戏。比尔队的比分是 9-1 和 8-2。酋长队战绩8胜2负，三连胜并封盖。

paras.en: The line moved from Buffalo -2.5 to -3 on early Bills money, and that's where I'll take the other side. Getting a full field goal with Patrick Mahomes in a game expected to come down to one possession is the value. Kansas City also just added Josh Downs to a receiver room that badly needed help.
paras.zh: 在比尔早期的钱上，这条线从布法罗 -2.5 移动到 -3，这就是我将采取另一边的地方。在一场预计会归结为一次控球的比赛中，与帕特里克·马霍姆斯一起打进全场进球就是价值所在。堪萨斯城还刚刚将乔什·唐斯加入了急需帮助的接收室。

paras.en: Texas Tech -14 (-112) | TCU +14 (-108) | Total: 47.5 (Over -105 / Under -115)

This is the strangest game of the week. TCU fired Sonny Dykes on Sunday, and defensive coordinator Andy Avalos takes over as interim coach. No. 9 Texas Tech clinches a spot in the Big 12 title game against unbeaten Utah with a win.
paras.zh: 这是本周最奇怪的游戏。 TCU 周日解雇了桑尼·戴克斯 (Sonny Dykes)，防守协调员安迪·阿瓦洛斯 (Andy Avalos) 接任临时教练。排名第九的德克萨斯理工大学凭借一场胜利，锁定了 Big 12 冠军赛对阵不败犹他大学的席位。

paras.en: The firing is a distraction, but it doesn't change what TCU does well. The Horned Frogs allow just 15.2 points per game, 12th in the country, and all five of their losses this season came by one score. Texas Tech's defense ranks 110th in total defense and 136th against the pass. Two touchdowns is too many points for a defense that hasn't been blown out all year, especially with a coach who built that defense now running the team and bowl eligibility on the line.
paras.zh: 解雇虽然会分散大家的注意力，但并不会改变 TCU 的出色表现。角蛙队场均失分15.2分，排在全国第12位，并且本赛季五场失利全部是一分之差。德克萨斯理工大学的防守在总防守中排名第110位，在传球防守中排名第136位。对于一整年都没有被淘汰的防守来说，两次达阵得分太多了，尤其是对于一位建立了防守的教练来说，现在他正在管理球队，碗的资格也岌岌可危。

paras.en: Friday, Nov. 27: The leftovers (somehow just as good)
paras.zh: 11 月 27 日星期五：剩菜（不知何故也一样好）

paras.en: Broncos at Steelers (3:00 pm ET, Prime Video)
paras.zh: 野马队对阵钢人队（东部时间下午 3:00，Prime 视频）

paras.en: Broncos -3 (-104) | Steelers +3 (-115) | Total: 38.5 (Over -105 / Under -115)
This is the lowest total on the NFL board, and it's still not low enough.
paras.zh: 这是 NFL 董事会中最低的总数，但仍然不够低。

paras.en: The total opened at 40 and has fallen to 38.5 on early under money. Denver is 8-2 straight up and against the spread, riding a six-game streak built on its running game and defense. Pittsburgh has lost two straight, and its offense has looked poor in both.
paras.zh: 开盘总数为 40，早盘跌至 38.5。丹佛掘金队以 8 胜 2 负的比分领先，凭借跑动和防守，连续六场比赛保持领先。匹兹堡队已经遭遇两连败，而且两场比赛的进攻看起来都很糟糕。

paras.en: Two defenses that slow the game down, one offense that can't stay on the field and a team that wants to run the ball add up to few possessions and fewer points.
paras.zh: 两种会拖慢比赛速度的防守，一种无法留在场上的进攻，以及一支想要跑球的球队，加起来就会导致控球权和得分减少。

paras.en: Florida -6 (-112) | Florida State +6 (-108) | Total: 53.5 (Over -108 / Under -112)
Moneyline: Florida -230 | Florida State +190
paras.zh: 输赢盘：佛罗里达-230 |佛罗里达州 +190

paras.en: Here's your rivalry underdog. Florida is 2-5 against the spread since early October, and it's laying nearly a touchdown on the road in Tallahassee. The line has already slipped from 6.5 to 6. In-state rivalries tend to be closer than the numbers suggest, and the Gators haven't earned this kind of trust lately.
paras.zh: 这是你的竞争失败者。自10月初以来，佛罗里达队的比分是2胜5负，并且在塔拉哈西队的客场比赛中几乎触地得分。这条线已经从 6.5 下滑到 6。州内的竞争往往比数字显示的更接近，而鳄鱼队最近并没有赢得这种信任。

paras.en: No. 5 Texas has the No. 1 defense in the country by adjusted EPA per play. Texas A&M ranks 135th in EPA per dropback and hasn't scored 10 points in a game since Oct. 24.
paras.zh: 按调整后的每场比赛 EPA 计算，排名第五的德克萨斯州拥有全国第一的防守。德克萨斯 A&M 队的每场失分得分排名第 135 位，自 10 月 24 日以来还没有在一场比赛中得到过 10 分。

paras.en: A&M is 4-7, bowl-ineligible and has lost the last two meetings. Texas needs a win to stay alive in the SEC title race. Rivalry games get weird, but an upset requires an offense, and the Aggies don't have one.
paras.zh: A&M 战绩为 4 胜 7 负，不具备保龄球资格，并且在最近两场比赛中都输了。德克萨斯州需要一场胜利才能在 SEC 冠军争夺战中保持活力。竞争比赛会变得很奇怪，但爆冷需要进攻，而阿吉队没有进攻。

paras.en: NBA Cup on Prime Video: Heat vs Knicks and Lakers vs Spurs
paras.zh: Prime Video 上的 NBA 杯：热火队对阵尼克斯队、湖人队对阵马刺队

paras.en: Black Friday gives us two NBA Cup games, both loaded with storylines.
paras.zh: 黑色星期五为我们带来了两场 NBA 杯比赛，两场比赛都充满了故事情节。

paras.en: Heat vs. Knicks is a battle on the glass between Giannis Antetokounmpo and Karl-Anthony Towns. Towns leads the NBA at 13.9 rebounds per game, and Giannis ranks third at 12.6. Miami has one of the league's highest-scoring offenses at 119.4 points per game, and Davion Mitchell leads the NBA in assists at 9.0 per game.
paras.zh: 热火队对阵尼克斯队是扬尼斯·阿德托昆博和卡尔·安东尼·唐斯之间的一场篮板球之战。唐斯以场均 13.9 个篮板领先全联盟，扬尼斯以 12.6 个篮板排名第三。迈阿密热火队是联盟进攻得分最高的球队之一，场均得分 119.4 分，而达维恩·米切尔 (Davion Mitchell) 则以场均 9.0 次助攻领跑 NBA。

paras.en: Lakers vs. Spurs is the best matchup of the night. Luka Doncic leads the league at 38.1 points per game. Victor Wembanyama is averaging 28.6 points, 11.9 rebounds and a league-leading 3.9 blocks. Both teams were 12-2 in mid-November, and San Antonio was riding a 12-game winning streak.
paras.zh: 湖人队对阵马刺队是当晚最好的对决。卢卡·东契奇以场均 38.1 分领先联盟。维克多·文班亚马场均得到 28.6 分、11.9 个篮板和联盟领先的 3.9 个盖帽。 11月中旬，两队战绩为12胜2负，马刺队取得了12连胜。

paras.en: What to target when lines post: Wembanyama's blocks and the Lakers-Spurs total. When the league's top scorer meets its best rim protector, expect a lot of shots and a lot of blocks.
paras.zh: 罚球时的目标是什么：温巴尼亚马的盖帽和湖人队与马刺队的总盖帽数。当联盟的顶级得分手遇到最好的篮筐保护者时，期待大量的投篮和大量的盖帽。

paras.en: The NHL owns Black Friday afternoon with 15 games. The standings already show some lopsided matchups:
paras.zh: NHL 拥有黑色星期五下午的 15 场比赛。积分榜已经显示出一些不平衡的对决：

paras.en: - Maple Leafs vs. Bruins (1 p.m. ET): Boston is 15-7-1 with a +22 goal differential. Toronto is 9-14-3 and -10. This is one of the biggest gaps on the board in an Original Six rivalry.
paras.zh: - 枫叶队对阵棕熊队（东部时间下午 1 点）：波士顿队战绩 15-7-1，净胜球数 +22。多伦多是 9-14-3 和 -10。这是原六队竞争中董事会上最大的差距之一。

paras.en: - Avalanche vs. Wild (4 p.m. ET): Minnesota is 17-3-5 with 39 points, tied for the most in the league, and a +34 goal differential. Colorado is 13-7-3 and +22. It's the best game on the slate.
paras.zh: - Avalanche 对阵 Wild（美国东部时间下午 4 点）：明尼苏达队战绩 17-3-5，积 39 分，并列联盟第一，净胜球+34。科罗拉多州的战绩为 13-7-3，+22。这是板上最好的游戏。

paras.en: - Rangers vs. Blackhawks (5:30 p.m. ET): New York is 13-9-1 and +6. Chicago is 8-14-2 with a -32 goal differential, among the worst in the league.
paras.zh: - 流浪者队对阵黑鹰队（东部时间下午 5:30）：纽约队的比分是 13-9-1 和 +6。芝加哥队目前战绩为 8 胜 14 负 2 负，净胜球为 -32，是联盟中最差的球队之一。

paras.en: - Penguins vs. Sabres (8 p.m. ET): Pittsburgh is 7-14-2 with 16 points. Buffalo is 10-10-4 and -10. Neither team is good, but the Penguins have been worse.
paras.zh: - 企鹅队对阵军刀队（东部时间晚上 8 点）：匹兹堡队战绩 7-14-2，积 16 分。布法罗是 10-10-4 和 -10。两支球队都不好，但企鹅队更糟糕。

paras.en: What to target when lines post: the Bruins and Rangers on the moneyline, and the Wild against Colorado. The goal differentials in those matchups are too wide to ignore.
paras.zh: 线路发布时的目标是什么：输赢盘上的棕熊队和流浪者队，以及狂野队对阵科罗拉多队。这些比赛中的净胜球差距太大，不容忽视。

paras.en: Ohio State -10.5 (-108) | Michigan +10.5 (-112) | Total: 38.5 (Over -105 / Under -115)
Moneyline: Ohio State -395 | Michigan +310
paras.zh: 输赢盘：俄亥俄州立大学-395 |密歇根州 +310

paras.en: Michigan is coming off the biggest win of its season, an 18-16 triple-overtime upset of then-No. 4 and undefeated UCLA. That's exactly why I'm worried about the Wolverines this week.
paras.zh: 密歇根队在三个加时赛中以 18-16 击败了当时排名第一的密歇根队，取得了本赛季最大的一场胜利。 4、加州大学洛杉矶分校不败。这正是我本周担心狼獾队的原因。

paras.en: After a game like that, the letdown is real and there are still a ton of reasons to question this team. Michigan's offense ranks 124th in available yards percentage and 112th in EPA per play, and now it has to go to Columbus. No. 25 Ohio State has the Heisman favorite in Jeremiah Smith. A total of 38.5 says this will be a grind, but only one team can actually move the ball. I think this number is too low.
paras.zh: 在一场这样的比赛之后，失望是真实的，而且仍然有很多理由质疑这支球队。密歇根州的进攻在可用码数百分比上排名第 124 位，在场均 EPA 排名中排名第 112 位，现在必须输给哥伦布。排名第 25 的俄亥俄州立大学拥有海斯曼最喜欢的球员杰里米亚·史密斯 (Jeremiah Smith)。共有 38.5 人表示这将是一场磨难，但只有一支球队能够真正移动球。我认为这个数字太低了。

articles.title: Broncos coach Sean Payton suspends RB JK Dobbins for conduct 'detrimental to the team'

paras.en: J.K. Dobbins barely touched the field in Sunday's blowout of Las Vegas, and now he will not even travel with the Denver Broncos for Black Friday against the Steelers.
paras.zh: J.K.多宾斯在周日击败拉斯维加斯的比赛中几乎没有上场，现在他甚至不会随丹佛野马队参加黑色星期五对阵钢人队的比赛。

paras.en: Head coach Sean Payton announced Tuesday that Dobbins has been suspended for one game for conduct detrimental to the team. Payton offered zero details besides that.
paras.zh: 主教练肖恩·佩顿周二宣布，多宾斯因有损害球队的行为而被停赛一场。除此之外，佩顿提供的细节为零。

paras.en: With the 8-2 club sitting near the top of the AFC standings, Payton will lean on his younger backs on a short week in Pittsburgh.
paras.zh: 随着这支8胜2负的球队在亚足联积分榜上名列前茅，佩顿将在匹兹堡短暂的一周内依靠他的年轻球员。

paras.en: The sudden suspension comes after Dobbins saw his role steadily vanish over the past month, despite returning to Denver this offseason on a two-year, $16 million contract. He has managed just 324 rushing yards on 3.3 yards per carry this season, opening the door for rookie Jonah Coleman to flat-out earn the starting job.
paras.zh: 尽管多宾斯在休赛期以两年价值 1600 万美元的合同回到丹佛，但在过去一个月里，他的角色逐渐消失，之后突然停赛。本赛季他的冲球码数仅为 324 码，每次冲球推进 3.3 码，这为新秀乔纳·科尔曼 (Jonah Coleman) 赢得首发位置打开了大门。

paras.en: Coleman cemented that takeover during Sunday's 38-24 win over the Raiders, piling up 111 rushing yards and three touchdowns on 24 carries. Dobbins, by contrast, logged a single play and went nowhere on his lone carry while even backup Cody Schrader saw more work.
paras.zh: 科尔曼在周日 38-24 战胜突袭者队的比赛中巩固了这一统治地位，他冲球 111 码，并在 24 次冲球中取得 3 次达阵。相比之下，多宾斯只打了一场比赛，并且在他的单独进攻中毫无进展，而即使是替补科迪·施拉德也看到了更多的工作。

paras.en: On Monday, Payton brushed aside any concern when he told reporters the 27-year-old was completely healthy and insisted Dobbins would be "super important for what we're doing in this stretch."
paras.zh: 周一，佩顿对记者表示这位 27 岁的球员完全健康，并坚称多宾斯“对于我们在这段时间所做的事情非常重要”，他没有理会任何担忧。

paras.en: Whether Dobbins pushed back on his shrinking workload or crossed a line inside the building, his role in Denver has cratered. Coleman has given Bo Nix the ground game this offense needed, making Dobbins an expensive afterthought in a playoff race.
paras.zh: 无论多宾斯是推迟减少的工作量还是越界，他在丹佛的角色都受到了影响。科尔曼为博尼克斯提供了进攻所需的地面比赛，使多宾斯在季后赛中成为代价高昂的事后想法。

paras.en: Send us your thoughts: alejandro.avila@outkick.com / Follow along on X: @alejandroaveela
paras.zh: 将您的想法发送给我们：alejandro.avila@outkick.com / 关注 X：@alejandroaveela

articles.title: Americans don’t have to choose between our AI future and ripping off copyright owners

paras.en: One of the biggest court battles over artificial intelligence (AI) is putting an age-old legal principle to the test — and raising important questions about the Trump administration's AI policy.
paras.zh: 关于人工智能 (AI) 的最大法庭斗争之一是对一项古老的法律原则进行检验，并对特朗普政府的人工智能政策提出重要问题。

paras.en: Several news organizations, including The New York Times, are suing OpenAI and Microsoft for using millions of newspaper articles to train AI systems. The newspapers argue that the tech firms violated basic copyright protections. The tech firms contend that training their models on those articles qualifies as "fair use," a longstanding principle that allows copyrighted material to be used in certain ways without permission from or compensation to the copyright owner.
paras.zh: 包括《纽约时报》在内的多家新闻机构正在起诉 OpenAI 和微软使用数百万篇报纸文章来训练人工智能系统。报纸认为科技公司违反了基本的版权保护。科技公司认为，根据这些文章训练他们的模型符合“合理使用”，这是一项长期存在的原则，允许在未经版权所有者许可或不向版权所有者提供补偿的情况下以某些方式使用受版权保护的材料。

paras.en: The Department of Justice (DOJ) has sided squarely with OpenAI's position — breaking with the administration's previously more balanced stance on the issue. The DOJ filed a statement of interest embracing an extreme vision of fair use that would grant AI companies virtually unfettered access to copyrighted material for commercial training, without obtaining permission from or compensating the creators whose works fuel these systems.
paras.zh: 美国司法部 (DOJ) 完全支持 OpenAI 的立场——打破了政府此前在该问题上较为平衡的立场。美国司法部提交了一份利益声明，拥护合理使用的极端愿景，该声明将允许人工智能公司几乎不受限制地获取受版权保护的材料以进行商业培训，而无需获得其作品为这些系统提供动力的创作者的许可或对其进行补偿。

paras.en: This expansive interpretation threatens to turn a narrow copyright exception into a blanket exemption for the world's most powerful and profitable industries.
paras.zh: 这种宽泛的解释有可能将狭隘的版权例外变成对世界上最强大、最赚钱的行业的全面豁免。

paras.en: The DOJ's reasoning is that requiring a copyright license for material used in AI training would impose high costs on AI developers. It claims those costs could make it harder for small companies to compete and hamper U.S. AI leadership and national security.
paras.zh: 美国司法部的理由是，要求人工智能培训中使用的材料获得版权许可会给人工智能开发人员带来高昂的成本。它声称这些成本可能会使小公司更难竞争并阻碍美国人工智能的领导地位和国家安全。

paras.en: Those concerns deserve consideration. But the DOJ's aggressive arguments in the brief depart from more measured guidance elsewhere in the administration. The White House's official AI framework acknowledges valid arguments on both sides of the copyright debate.
paras.zh: 这些担忧值得考虑。但司法部在简报中的激进论点与政府其他部门更加谨慎的指导背道而驰。白宫的官方人工智能框架承认版权争论双方的有效论点。

paras.en: Likewise, the Carolina Principles for Emerging Technologies, adopted by G20 ministers at the Commerce Department's recent Innovation Ministerial, recognize that the intersection of AI and copyright poses "complex legal and policy questions." The principles note the "essential role" of copyright protections in supporting creators and call for respecting IP as a pillar of G20 AI policy.
paras.zh: 同样，二十国集团部长们在商务部最近举行的创新部长级会议上通过的《卡罗莱纳新兴技术原则》承认人工智能和版权的交叉带来了“复杂的法律和政策问题”。这些原则指出了版权保护在支持创作者方面的“重要作用”，并呼吁将尊重知识产权作为 G20 人工智能政策的支柱。

paras.en: The DOJ statement also overlooks how its stance could favor larger AI companies over smaller firms and startups. Several AI startups have argued that paying for the material they use provides more reliable access to training material, reduces legal uncertainty and improves models. Other companies have emerged to aggregate copyrights and make licensing easier.
paras.zh: 美国司法部的声明还忽视了其立场如何有利于大型人工智能公司，而不是小型公司和初创公司。几家人工智能初创公司认为，为他们使用的材料付费可以更可靠地获取培训材料，减少法律不确定性并改进模型。其他公司已经出现，以聚合版权并使许可变得更容易。

paras.en: It's particularly problematic for large AI companies to complain about paying for access to copyrighted materials. They are among the best positioned to pay for those materials, and doing so would help develop the kind of licensing markets they claim are lacking.
paras.zh: 对于大型人工智能公司来说，抱怨付费访问受版权保护的材料尤其成问题。他们是支付这些材料费用的最佳人选，这样做将有助于开发他们声称缺乏的许可市场。

paras.en: And even if national security were a legitimate justification, the government could not simply disregard property rights. The Constitution and other laws require just compensation when private property is taken for public use, and intellectual property rights are still property rights. Letting AI firms appropriate creators' IP without permission or compensation would be akin to letting data center builders seize private land without paying fair value.
paras.zh: 即使国家安全是一个合法的理由，政府也不能简单地忽视财产权。宪法和其他法律要求私有财产被公共使用时必须得到公正的补偿，而知识产权仍然是财产权。让人工智能公司在未经许可或不予补偿的情况下侵占创作者的知识产权，就像让数据中心建设者在不支付公平价值的情况下夺取私人土地一样。

paras.en: If courts adopt the DOJ's position that fair use protects AI developers in virtually all circumstances, it would reduce incentives to create new works. Copyrights encourage creative work by assuring writers, artists and other creators that their work can't be easily stolen or copied. Licensing those rights allows creators to earn a living and underpins over $1 trillion in U.S. economic activity.
paras.zh: 如果法院采纳司法部的立场，即合理使用几乎在所有情况下都能保护人工智能开发者，这将减少创作新作品的动力。版权通过向作家、艺术家和其他创作者保证他们的作品不会被轻易窃取或复制来鼓励创造性工作。获得这些权利的许可可以让创作者谋生并支撑超过 1 万亿美元的美国经济活动。

paras.en: Weaker copyrights could result in fewer human-created books, articles, research papers, films and songs. Ironically, that could eventually leave AI systems with fewer and lower-quality materials to train on – a scenario that serves no one's interests.
paras.zh: 版权较弱可能会导致人类创作的书籍、文章、研究论文、电影和歌曲减少。具有讽刺意味的是，这最终可能会让人工智能系统使用更少、质量更低的材料进行训练——这种情况不符合任何人的利益。

paras.en: All of this is why the Trump administration would be wise to follow its own AI framework and let the court system evaluate AI copyright disputes case by case, rather than arguing for unfettered fair use exceptions.
paras.zh: 所有这些就是为什么特朗普政府明智地遵循自己的人工智能框架，让法院系统逐案评估人工智能版权纠纷，而不是主张不受约束的合理使用例外。

paras.en: The DOJ's reasoning is that requiring a copyright license for material used in AI training would impose high costs on AI developers. It claims those costs could make it harder for small companies to compete and hamper U.S. AI leadership and national security.
paras.zh: 美国司法部的理由是，要求人工智能培训中使用的材料获得版权许可会给人工智能开发人员带来高昂的成本。它声称这些成本可能会使小公司更难竞争并阻碍美国人工智能的领导地位和国家安全。

paras.en: Policymakers also have a role to play. One promising bill is the bipartisan CLEAR Act. Introduced in February by California Democrat Sen. Adam Schiff and Utah Republican Sen. John Curtis, the CLEAR Act would require AI developers to publicly disclose the copyrighted works used in each new generative-AI model's training dataset.
paras.zh: 政策制定者也可以发挥作用。一项有希望的法案是两党共同通过的 CLEAR 法案。加州民主党参议员亚当·希夫 (Adam Schiff) 和犹他州共和党参议员约翰·柯蒂斯 (John Curtis) 在 2 月提出的 CLEAR 法案将要求人工智能开发人员公开披露每个新的生成人工智能模型的训练数据集中使用的受版权保护的作品。

paras.en: The proposal would not settle whether any particular training practice qualifies as fair use. But it would give creators more information about whether their work helped train an AI system, enabling them to pursue appropriate compensation or other remedies when they believe their rights have been violated.
paras.zh: 该提案不会解决任何特定培训实践是否符合合理使用的问题。但这将为创作者提供更多关于他们的工作是否有助于训练人工智能系统的信息，使他们能够在认为自己的权利受到侵犯时寻求适当的赔偿或其他补救措施。

paras.en: That kind of targeted reform offers a useful model for copyright enforcement in the age of AI. Rather than treating licensing as an obstacle to innovation, policymakers should foster a market where AI developers can efficiently license copyrighted material while respecting creators' rights.
paras.zh: 这种有针对性的改革为人工智能时代的版权执法提供了有用的模式。政策制定者不应将许可视为创新的障碍，而应培育一个市场，让人工智能开发者能够有效地许可受版权保护的材料，同时尊重创作者的权利。

paras.en: AI innovation is vital to America's future. But America's creative industries still depend on strong copyright protections. Policymakers need to promote both.
paras.zh: 人工智能创新对美国的未来至关重要。但美国的创意产业仍然依赖于强有力的版权保护。政策制定者需要促进两者。

articles.title: Nigerian monarch, 92, suspended after sexual assault claims

paras.en: One of Nigeria's best-known monarchs, the Emir of Daura, has been suspended from all official engagements and travel following allegations of sexual assault by a Polish tourist.
paras.zh: 尼日利亚最著名的君主之一、达乌拉埃米尔因被一名波兰游客指控性侵犯而被暂停所有官方活动和旅行。

paras.en: The visitor said Umar Farouk Umar, 92, had grabbed her chest during a tourism encounter and that she felt disgusted by the experience.
paras.zh: 这位游客说，92 岁的奥马尔·法鲁克·奥马尔 (Umar Farouk Umar) 在一次旅游遭遇中抓住了她的胸部，她对这次经历感到恶心。

paras.en: The allegation sparked widespread discussion across social media platforms, with many calling for the suspension of the emir and an investigation - calls the Katsina state government has now heeded.
paras.zh: 这一指控引发了社交媒体平台上的广泛讨论，许多人呼吁埃米尔停职并进行调查——卡齐纳州政府现已注意到这一呼吁。

paras.en: Umar has not commented on the allegations or his suspension.
paras.zh: 奥马尔尚未对这些指控或他的停职发表评论。

paras.en: He is one of several emirs - a traditional role dating back to pre-colonial times - who still wield great cultural and religious influence in northern Nigeria, although they have lost their political power.
paras.zh: 他是几位埃米尔之一——这是一个可以追溯到前殖民时代的传统角色——尽管他们已经失去了政治权力，但他们仍然在尼日利亚北部发挥着巨大的文化和宗教影响力。

paras.en: Daura, where Umar serves as emir, holds an extremely important position for the Hausa people who dominate northern Nigeria. It is widely regarded as their spiritual homeland and the origin of the Hausa royal lineage, serving as the core of Hausa origin mythology and the legitimate foundation of traditional authority.
paras.zh: 奥马尔担任埃米尔的达乌拉对于统治尼日利亚北部的豪萨人来说占有极其重要的地位。它被广泛视为他们的精神家园和豪萨王族血统的起源，是豪萨起源神话的核心和传统权威的合法基础。

paras.en: Politicians routinely visit his palace for royal prayers and to gain his support.
paras.zh: 政客们经常前往他的宫殿进行皇家祈祷并获得他的支持。

paras.en: On her Instagram page, the tourist said she had spent 30 days travelling around Nigeria before visiting the Emir's palace on 14 November.
paras.zh: 这位游客在她的 Instagram 页面上表示，在 11 月 14 日参观埃米尔宫殿之前，她花了 30 天环游尼日利亚。

paras.en: She posted a video, which has since been deleted, in which a man who appears to be the emir is holding her hands in his lap.
paras.zh: 她发布了一段视频，视频中一名疑似埃米尔的男子将她的双手放在腿上，但该视频已被删除。

paras.en: After some moments she was heard saying: "Stop, stop" as the hands reached for her chest.
paras.zh: 过了一会儿，有人听到她说：“停下来，停下来”，双手伸向她的胸部。

paras.en: According to a statement, Katsina Governor Dikko Umaru Radda directed the immediate constitution of a committee to investigate the allegations.
paras.zh: 根据一份声明，卡齐纳州州长 Dikko Umaru Radda 指示立即成立一个委员会来调查这些指控。

paras.en: The statement said the state government was taking the allegations seriously and would rely on the committee's findings to determine the appropriate course of action.
paras.zh: 声明称，州政府正在认真对待这些指控，并将根据委员会的调查结果来确定适当的行动方案。

paras.en: It said the committee's findings and recommendations would be fully implemented, stressing that justice would be served.
paras.zh: 声明称，委员会的调查结果和建议将得到全面落实，并强调正义将得到伸张。

paras.en: However, it did not disclose the membership of the investigative committee, its terms of reference or the timeline for submitting its report.
paras.zh: 不过，它没有透露调查委员会的成员、职权范围或提交报告的时间表。

paras.en: The emir has been on the throne since 2007, succeeding his brother Bashar dan Umaru, who reigned for 41 years.
paras.zh: 埃米尔自 2007 年起继承王位，接替其兄巴沙尔·丹·奥马鲁 (Bashar dan Umaru)，后者在位 41 年。

articles.title: US attorney general dodges questions about Nvidia investigation

paras.en: US Attorney General Todd Blanche has backed Nvidia as a "good corporate citizen" while refusing to comment on whether the AI chipmaker was under federal investigation.
paras.zh: 美国司法部长托德·布兰奇支持英伟达是“优秀的企业公民”，但拒绝评论这家人工智能芯片制造商是否正在接受联邦调查。

paras.en: Blanche said he had no information about newly reinstated CEO Jensen Huang's security clearance status, as lawmakers demand answers about President Donald Trump's involvement in Huang's comeback.
paras.zh: 布兰奇表示，他不知道新恢复的首席执行官黄仁勋的安全许可状态，因为立法者要求回答有关唐纳德·特朗普总统参与黄仁勋复出的问题。

paras.en: Huang was given his job back less than two weeks after being forced to resign over revelations of extramarital affairs, including one with an alleged Chinese spy.
paras.zh: 黄因婚外情（包括与一名涉嫌中国间谍的婚外情）被曝光而被迫辞职，不到两周后，黄就被恢复了工作。

paras.en: Asked several times on Tuesday if the justice department or FBI had investigated Huang, Blanche responded: "I don't know what you're talking about."
paras.zh: 周二，当多次被问及司法部或联邦调查局是否调查过黄时，布兰奇回答说：“我不知道你在说什么。”

paras.en: Huang is still set to appear before Congress next week, where he will be questioned about national security concerns over his relationship with an alleged China spy who led Megaspeed, a Singapore-based corporate customer of Nvidia.
paras.zh: 黄仁勋仍将于下周出席国会听证会，他将因与一名涉嫌中国间谍的关系而受到国家安全方面的质询，该间谍领导着英伟达新加坡公司客户 Megaspeed。

paras.en: The US commerce department has also announced it was preparing to blacklist the tech company Megaspeed, which has been suspected of helping to divert advanced chips to China.
paras.zh: 美国商务部还宣布准备将科技公司Megaspeed列入黑名单，该公司涉嫌帮助将先进芯片转移到中国。

paras.en: In a joint statement last week, the commerce and justice departments said they began investigating Megaspeed in 2024 "for potential export control violations".
paras.zh: 在上周的一份联合声明中，商务和司法部门表示，他们将于 2024 年开始调查 Megaspeed“是否存在潜在的出口管制违规行为”。

paras.en: But speaking to reporters on Tuesday, Blanche said the latter department has "hundreds, if not more" export investigations occurring at any one time.
paras.zh: 但布兰奇周二对记者表示，该部门随时都会发生“数百起甚至更多”的出口调查。

paras.en: "So when you say the export investigation is still ongoing, I don't know what you're talking about," he said.
paras.zh: “所以当你说出口调查仍在进行时，我不知道你在说什么，”他说。

paras.en: Asked if he was satisfied Nvidia had been co-operative with any efforts to get to the bottom of whether the company or Huang potentially knew about any chips being diverted to China, Blanche said: "I have no reason to stand up here and say Nvidia is anything but a good corporate citizen.
paras.zh: 当被问及英伟达是否愿意配合调查该公司或黄仁勋是否可能知道任何芯片被转移到中国的真相时，布兰奇表示：“我没有理由站在这里说英伟达不是一个好的企业公民。

paras.en: "Obviously, if Nvidia was the target or was subject to some criminal investigation or they were obstructing or thwarting our investigation, then that wouldn't be the message that the president is saying to the American people.
paras.zh: “显然，如果英伟达是目标或受到某些刑事调查，或者他们阻碍或阻挠我们的调查，那么这不会是总统向美国人民传达的信息。

paras.en: "It shouldn't be what my message would be either."
paras.zh: “这也不应该是我的信息。”

paras.en: While Nvidia's stock market value surged on the announcement of Huang's reappointment, some of the gains were reversed in volatile Tuesday trading.
paras.zh: 尽管黄仁勋再次任命的消息公布后，英伟达的股价飙升，但在周二波动的交易中，部分涨幅被逆转。

paras.en: The company's share price closed down nearly 6% - still well above where it ended last week. On Monday, Nvidia stock rocketed more than 31% following news of Huang's return.
paras.zh: 该公司股价收盘下跌近 6%，仍远高于上周收盘价。周一，黄仁勋回归的消息传出后，英伟达股价飙升超过 31%。

paras.en: The company's board reinstated Huang on Monday in a shock U-turn. Harvey Jones, chairman of Nvidia's board, said Huang's return was in the "best interests of our stockholders, employees, partners and customers".
paras.zh: 该公司董事会周一突然大转变，恢复了黄先生的职务。英伟达董事会主席哈维·琼斯表示，黄仁勋的回归符合“我们股东、员工、合作伙伴和客户的最佳利益”。

paras.en: The board said it had received input from senior levels of the US government and was confident that Huang's reinstatement posed no national security risk.
paras.zh: 该委员会表示，已收到美国政府高层的意见，并相信黄的复职不会构成国家安全风险。

paras.en: On Monday, Trump said he spoke to the company's directors and convinced them to bring back Huang.
paras.zh: 周一，特朗​​普表示，他与公司董事进行了交谈，并说服他们带回黄。

paras.en: Huang's reinstatement provoked bipartisan anger.
paras.zh: 黄的复职激起了两党的愤怒。

paras.en: Republican congressman Don Bacon said Nvidia should have "ignored the Administration's inexplicable desire to save Huang".
paras.zh: 共和党国会议员唐·培根表示，英伟达应该“忽视政府拯救黄仁勋的莫名其妙的愿望”。

paras.en: Republican Senator Pete Ricketts said Huang's behaviour "doesn't absolve Nvidia of answering for national security concerns and unaccounted-for chips".
paras.zh: 共和党参议员皮特·里基茨 (Pete Ricketts) 表示，黄仁勋的行为“并不能免除英伟达对国家安全担忧和下落不明芯片的责任”。

paras.en: Democratic congressman Robert Garcia, the incoming chairman of the House oversight committee, said Trump's "direct involvement" with Nvidia's decision "raises serious national security and corruption questions".
paras.zh: 即将上任的众议院监督委员会主席、民主党众议员罗伯特·加西亚表示，特朗普“直接参与”英伟达的决定“引发了严重的国家安全和腐败问题”。

paras.en: Democratic Senator Ruben Gallego said Congress needed to "investigate what stock positions took place before the announcement".
paras.zh: 民主党参议员鲁本·加列戈表示，国会需要“调查公告发布前的股票头寸”。

articles.title: Huawei found guilty of stealing trade secrets but acquitted of racketeering

paras.en: Huawei has been found guilty of conspiracy to steal trade secrets and bank fraud, but not guilty of the more serious overarching racketeering charge in a landmark trial in the US.
paras.zh: 在美国一项具有里程碑意义的审判中，华为被判犯有串谋窃取商业机密和银行欺诈罪，但没有犯下更严重的总体敲诈勒索罪。

paras.en: In a two-month trial, prosecutors accused the Chinese technology and telecommunications giant of lying, cheating and stealing to gain any competitive advantage.
paras.zh: 在为期两个月的审判中，检察官指控这家中国科技和电信巨头撒谎、欺骗和盗窃，以获取任何竞争优势。

paras.en: Huawei's defence team argued that prosecutors had decided Huawei was a criminal organisation and built its case from there, but the firm's success was due to its own innovation.
paras.zh: 华为的辩护团队辩称，检察官已经认定华为是一个犯罪组织，并以此为基础立案，但该公司的成功归功于其自身的创新。

paras.en: In a statement, Huawei said the racketeering acquittal "confirms that these allegations lack factual basis and vindicates our consistent position over the past eight years".
paras.zh: 华为在一份声明中表示，敲诈勒索罪的无罪释放“证实了这些指控缺乏事实依据，并证明了我们过去八年来的一贯立场”。

paras.en: Jurors in a Brooklyn court found Huawei guilty of 10 out of 12 counts, which also included conspiracy to violate US sanctions.
paras.zh: 布鲁克林一家法院的陪审员裁定华为犯有 12 项罪名中的 10 项，其中还包括串谋违反美国制裁。

paras.en: However the jury declined to convict Huawei of the racketeering conspiracy charge, which required members to find the firm acted like a criminal enterprise.
paras.zh: 然而，陪审团拒绝判定华为犯有敲诈勒索共谋罪，该罪名要求陪审团成员发现该公司的行为像犯罪​​企业。

paras.en: Federal prosecutors first announced the charges against Huawei in 2019, after the dramatic arrest in late 2018 of senior executive Meng Wanzhou in Canada.
paras.zh: 继 2018 年底华为高管孟晚舟在加拿大戏剧性被捕后，联邦检察官于 2019 年首次宣布对华为的指控。

paras.en: Meng, also known as Cathy Meng, was held for three years in Canada before she was released to return to China through a deal with US prosecutors.
paras.zh: 孟晚舟又名孟晚舟，她在加拿大被关押了三年，之后通过与美国检察官的协议获释返回中国。

paras.en: During closing arguments last week, assistant US attorney Meredith Arfa told jurors Huawei spent 20 years doing whatever it took to expand its business, including lying to banks about its business dealings in Iran and stealing technology secrets from rival firms to ensure it had a competitive edge.
paras.zh: 在上周的结案陈词中，美国助理检察官梅雷迪思·阿尔法 (Meredith Arfa) 告诉陪审员，华为花了 20 年时间不择手段地扩大业务，包括就其在伊朗的业务交易向银行撒谎，以及窃取竞争对手公司的技术机密，以确保其拥有竞争优势。

paras.en: The BBC contacted the US Department of Justice for comment.
paras.zh: BBC联系了美国司法部寻求评论。

paras.en: However, defence attorney Brian Heberlig said Huawei had grown into business with operations in 170 countries and more than 200,000 staff through hard work.
paras.zh: 然而，辩护律师布赖恩·赫伯利格表示，通过努力，华为已经发展成为业务遍及170个国家、拥有超过20万名员工的企业。

paras.en: Following the verdict, Heberlig told the BBC that Huawei was gratified the jury had rejected the racketeering charge.
paras.zh: 判决后，赫伯利格告诉英国广播公司，华为对陪审团驳回敲诈勒索指控感到高兴。

paras.en: "The RICO count that alleged that Huawei was a corrupt organisation, with a corporate culture and policy of committing crime. That was, in our view, a significant overreach, and the jury soundly rejected it," he said.
paras.zh: 他表示：“RICO 指控华为是一个腐败组织，其企业文化和政策都存在犯罪行为。我们认为，这是严重的越权行为，陪审团断然拒绝了这一指控。”

paras.en: "Of course, we have mixed emotions about the rest of the verdict ... [we] thought that Huawei was deserving of acquittals across the board."
paras.zh: “当然，我们对判决的其余部分心情复杂……[我们]认为华为应该被全面无罪释放。”

paras.en: Sentencing is planned for September 2027. Heberlig said there will be "significant advocacy" to achieve the lowest sentence possible. Following that, he said he fully expects Huawei to appeal.
paras.zh: 量刑计划于 2027 年 9 月进行。Heberlig 表示，将进行“大力宣传”，以实现尽可能最低的量刑。随后，他表示完全期待华为上诉。

paras.en: "If I know Huawei, that fight will continue, and the company's not going to rest until it's pursued every last argument it can through appeal, and hopefully, ultimately toward vindication," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“如果我了解华为，这场斗争将会继续下去，该公司不会停下来，直到通过上诉追寻所有可能的论点，并希望最终得到平反。”

articles.title: How Paper-Based Friction Materials Power Modern Machinery

paras.en: How Paper-Based Friction Materials Power Modern Machinery
paras.zh: 纸基摩擦材料如何为现代机械提供动力

paras.en: Have you ever wondered what enables everything from roaring construction machinery to agricultural machinery plowing the fields to industrial equipment shuttling through factories—the precise starting, smooth operation, and reliable braking they achieve?
paras.zh: 您有没有想过，从轰鸣的工程机械到耕地的农业机械，再到穿梭于工厂的工业设备，是什么让它们能够实现精确的启动、平稳的运行和可靠的制动？

paras.en: The answer lies in a seemingly insignificant yet crucial core component: friction material. It acts as the "safety guard" and "power link" of machinery, ensuring every brake is safe and effective, and every power transmission is smooth and flawless.
paras.zh: 答案就在于一个看似微不足道却至关重要的核心部件：摩擦材料。它充当机械的“安全卫士”和“动力纽带”，保证每一次制动都安全有效，每一次动力传递平稳无瑕。

paras.en: Among the vast family of friction materials, wet friction materials are becoming the new favorite in modern machinery due to their exceptional reliability, safety, and exceptionally long lifespan. Among wet materials, paper-based friction materials stand out as a leading force thanks to their excellent overall performance, cost-effectiveness, and broad application prospects.
paras.zh: 在众多的摩擦材料家族中，湿式摩擦材料因其卓越的可靠性、安全性和超长的使用寿命而成为现代机械的新宠。在湿式材料中，纸基摩擦材料以其优异的综合性能、成本效益和广阔的应用前景脱颖而出，成为主导力量。

paras.en: Today, let's delve deeper into the fascinating world of this "unsung hero"—paper-based friction materials.
paras.zh: 今天，让我们深入探究这个“无名英雄”——纸基摩擦材料的迷人世界。

paras.en: What is Paper-Based Friction Material? — A Sponge-Like Power Core
paras.zh: 什么是纸基摩擦材料？ — 海绵状动力核心

paras.en: Imagine a "sponge" with countless tiny pores—that's the most intuitive image of paper-based friction material.
paras.zh: 想象一下有无数微小孔隙的“海绵”——这就是纸基摩擦材料最直观的形象。

paras.en: It is a material with a reticular porous structure composed of three core components: reinforcing fibers, functional fillers, and a binder resin. This unique structure gives it extraordinary capabilities:
paras.zh: 它是一种具有网状多孔结构的材料，由增强纤维、功能填料和粘结剂树脂三种核心成分组成。这种独特的结构赋予了它非凡的功能：

paras.en: - Oil Storage Capacity: The porous structure acts like a miniature "oil depot," capable of storing large quantities of lubricant.
paras.zh: - 储油能力：多孔结构就像一个微型“油库”，能够储存大量润滑剂。

paras.en: - Dynamic Lubrication: When the friction plate and mating plate engage and are subjected to pressure, the lubricant within the material is instantly squeezed onto the friction surface, forming a tough lubricant film, enabling smooth, gentle "wet" friction.
paras.zh: - 动态润滑：当摩擦片和配合片接合并受到压力时，材料内的润滑剂立即被挤压到摩擦表面上，形成坚韧的润滑膜，从而实现平滑、温和的“湿”摩擦。

paras.en: - Self-Recovery: When the friction plates separate, the material rebounds like memory foam, "absorbing" the lubricant back into the pores, ready for the next operation.
paras.zh: - 自我恢复：当摩擦片分离时，材料会像记忆海绵一样反弹，将润滑剂“吸收”回毛孔中，为下一次操作做好准备。

paras.en: It is this dynamic cycle of "oil storage-oil squeezing-oil return" that allows paper-based friction materials to perform well in an oil bath environment, achieving a perfect combination of high durability and stable friction performance.
paras.zh: 正是这种“储油-挤油-回油”的动态循环，让纸基摩擦材料在油浴环境下表现良好，实现了高耐用性和稳定摩擦性能的完美结合。

paras.en: Exploring Core Performance: How Do Three Key Factors Affect It?
paras.zh: 探索核心绩效：三个关键因素如何影响它？

paras.en: The performance of paper-based friction materials is not static. Like a top athlete, its performance is influenced by the "field," "equipment," and "condition." Let's examine how these three key factors shape its performance.
paras.zh: 纸基摩擦材料的性能并不是静态的。就像顶级运动员一样，其表现受到“场地”、“装备”和“条件”的影响。让我们来看看这三个关键因素如何影响其性能。

paras.en: Factor 1: The "Stage Effect" of Lubricants
paras.zh: 因素一：润滑油的“阶段效应”

paras.en: Paper-based friction materials are highly sensitive to lubricants, and different lubricants create distinct "stages" for their performance. Even the same friction material can exhibit significantly different friction characteristics (especially the kinetic friction coefficient) when exposed to different lubricants.
paras.zh: 纸基摩擦材料对润滑剂高度敏感，不同的润滑剂为其性能创造了不同的“阶段”。即使是相同的摩擦材料，当接触不同的润滑剂时也会表现出明显不同的摩擦特性（尤其是动摩擦系数）。

paras.en: Figure 1: Kinetic friction coefficient curve for a paper-based friction material in gear oil
paras.zh: 图 1：纸基摩擦材料在齿轮油中的动摩擦系数曲线

paras.en: Figure 2: Dynamic friction coefficient curve of the same material in hydraulic oil
paras.zh: 图2：同材质在液压油中的动摩擦系数曲线

paras.en: Interpretation: The above chart clearly shows that the same material behaves very differently in gear oil and hydraulic fluid. Furthermore, various additives added to lubricating oils (such as dispersants and anti-wear agents) can interact complexly with the material surface, further affecting its friction properties. Therefore, choosing the right oil for paper-based friction materials is the first step in achieving optimal performance.
paras.zh: 解读：上图清楚地表明，相同的材料在齿轮油和液压油中的表现截然不同。此外，润滑油中添加的各种添加剂（如分散剂和抗磨剂）会与材料表面发生复杂的相互作用，进一步影响其摩擦性能。因此，为纸基摩擦材料选择合适的油是实现最佳性能的第一步。

paras.en: Density is a trump card for paper-based friction materials. It is directly related to the material's porosity, leading to a delicate balancing act in terms of performance.
paras.zh: 密度是纸基摩擦材料的王牌。它与材料的孔隙率直接相关，从而导致性能方面的微妙平衡。

paras.en: High density (low porosity) means a denser material, resulting in better strength and thermal conductivity, lower wear rate, and longer life. However, the downside is reduced oil storage capacity, which can lead to a lower coefficient of friction and compromise power transmission.
paras.zh: 高密度（低孔隙率）意味着材料更致密，从而具有更好的强度和导热性、更低的磨损率和更长的使用寿命。然而，其缺点是储油能力降低，这可能导致摩擦系数降低并损害动力传输。

paras.en: Low density (high porosity) means the material is more porous, resulting in greater oil storage capacity and a higher coefficient of friction, which can provide greater braking force or transmit torque. However, the downside is reduced mechanical strength and wear resistance, shortening service life.
paras.zh: 低密度（高孔隙率）意味着材料孔隙较多，从而产生更大的储油能力和更高的摩擦系数，从而可以提供更大的制动力或传递扭矩。但其缺点是机械强度和耐磨性降低，使用寿命缩短。

paras.en: Figure 3: Comparison of the dynamic coefficient of friction for materials of varying densities (Type 2 to Type 6, increasing density)
paras.zh: 图 3：不同密度材料的动摩擦系数比较（类型 2 至类型 6，密度增加）

paras.en: Figure 4: Comparison of wear rates of materials with different densities
paras.zh: 图4：不同密度材料的磨损率比较

paras.en: Interpretation: Figures 3 and 4 vividly illustrate this balancing act. There's no such thing as absolute good or bad, only suitability. When selecting a paper-based friction material, the optimal trade-off between friction coefficient and durability must be determined based on specific application requirements (e.g., high torque versus long life).
paras.zh: 解读：图3和图4生动地说明了这种平衡行为。没有绝对的好或坏，只有合适。选择纸基摩擦材料时，必须根据具体应用要求（例如高扭矩与长寿命）确定摩擦系数和耐用性之间的最佳权衡。

paras.en: Factor 3: Extreme Challenges of Operating Conditions
paras.zh: 因素三：运行条件的极端挑战

paras.en: In addition to oil type and density, actual operating conditions, such as surface pressure, sliding speed, and oil temperature, pose extreme challenges to paper-based friction materials. These factors directly affect the temperature of the friction interface, the thickness and stability of the oil film, and thus dynamically alter the coefficient of friction.
paras.zh: 除了油的类型和密度之外，实际操作条件，例如表面压力、滑动速度和油温，对纸基摩擦材料提出了极大的挑战。这些因素直接影响摩擦界面的温度、油膜的厚度和稳定性，从而动态地改变摩擦系数。

paras.en: Therefore, please remember: the coefficient of friction of a particular paper-based friction material is not a fixed value, but rather a performance range determined through extensive and repeated testing under specific operating conditions.
paras.zh: 因此，请记住：特定纸基摩擦材料的摩擦系数不是一个固定值，而是在特定操作条件下通过广泛和反复测试确定的性能范围。

paras.en: Broad Applications: Injecting a Powerful "Heart" into Machinery
paras.zh: 广泛应用：为机械注入强大的“心脏”

paras.en: Thanks to its excellent overall performance and customizability, Carlisle Brake & Friction's paper-based friction materials have been successfully applied to the core components of various heavy-duty machinery, becoming their powerful and reliable "heart."
paras.zh: 凭借其优异的综合性能和可定制性，卡莱制动摩擦材料纸基摩擦材料已成功应用于各类重型机械的核心部件，成为其强大而可靠的“心脏”。

paras.en: We understand that different machines and applications require significantly different friction materials. For example:
paras.zh: 我们了解不同的机器和应用需要截然不同的摩擦材料。例如：

paras.en: - Service brakes for construction machinery (such as excavators and loaders) require materials that provide a stable, powerful braking force under high loads to ensure safety.
paras.zh: - 工程机械（如挖掘机和装载机）的行车制动器需要能够在高负载下提供稳定、强大制动力的材料，以确保安全。

paras.en: - Powershift transmissions for agricultural machinery (such as tractors) require materials that provide smooth engagement and excellent heat resistance to handle frequent shifting.
paras.zh: - 农业机械（如拖拉机）的动力换档变速箱需要能够提供平稳接合和出色耐热性的材料，以应对频繁换档。

paras.en: - Clutches for industrial machinery require materials that respond quickly and have a long lifespan to ensure continuous and efficient operation of production lines.
paras.zh: - 工业机械离合器需要响应快且使用寿命长的材料，以确保生产线连续高效运行。

paras.en: To this end, Carlisle Brake & Friction has developed a series of special paper-based friction materials for different application scenarios, providing each customer with the most suitable and reliable solution.
paras.zh: 为此，卡莱制动摩擦开发了一系列针对不同应用场景的特种纸基摩擦材料，为每位客户提供最合适、最可靠的解决方案。

paras.en: Continuous Innovation, Driving the Future
paras.zh: 持续创新，驱动未来

paras.en: Technological advancement is endless. To meet increasingly demanding application requirements and broaden market prospects, Carlisle Brake & Friction remains at the forefront of innovation.
paras.zh: 技术进步永无止境。为了满足日益苛刻的应用要求并拓宽市场前景，Carlisle Brake & Friction 始终走在创新的前沿。

paras.en: We are not only continuously optimizing the formulation and processing of paper-based friction materials to push their performance limits, but are also actively exploring next-generation wet friction materials with even higher performance. These R&D efforts have made significant progress, aiming to provide global customers with more diverse and advanced options, driving the infinite possibilities of future machinery.
paras.zh: 我们不仅不断优化纸基摩擦材料的配方和加工工艺以突破其性能极限，而且还积极探索具有更高性能的下一代湿式摩擦材料。这些研发工作取得了重大进展，旨在为全球客户提供更多样化、更先进的选择，驱动未来机械的无限可能。

articles.title: Celebrating 100-Years with Medina Mayor and Employees

paras.en: Celebrating 100-Years with Medina Mayor and Employees
paras.zh: 与麦地那市长和员工一起庆祝 100 周年

paras.en: MEDINA, OHIO — September 24, 2025 — Carlisle Brake & Friction (CBF), a global leader in the development and manufacture of high-performance brake and friction solutions, today welcomed Medina Mayor Dennis Hanwell, Economic Development Director Kimberly Marshall, and Executive Director of the Medina Chamber of Commerce Jaclyn Ringstmeier, for a special photo op at the company’s headquarters, located at 920 Lake Road. The event was a commemorative celebration of CarlisleCBF’s 100-year anniversary and its enduring presence in the Medina community.
paras.zh: 俄亥俄州梅迪纳 — 2025 年 9 月 24 日 — 高性能制动和摩擦解决方案开发和制造领域的全球领导者 Carlisle Brake & Friction (CBF) 今天欢迎梅迪纳市长 Dennis Hanwell、经济发展总监 Kimberly Marshall 和梅迪纳商会执行董事 Jaclyn Ringstmeier 在位于湖路 920 号的公司总部进行了特别合影。该活动是为了纪念 CarlisleCBF 成立 100 周年及其在麦地那社区的持久存在。

paras.en: The photo op featured Mayor Hanwell alongside Carlisle’s Operations Leader, David Smith, and a number of employees who have been with the company for decades. The occasion honored CarlisleCBF’s century of innovation and its deep roots in the Medina area, where it has been a significant employer and community partner.
paras.zh: 这张照片的主角是汉威尔市长、卡莱尔的运营负责人大卫·史密斯以及一些在公司工作了几十年的员工。此次活动旨在表彰 CarlisleCBF 的百年创新历程及其在麦地那地区的深厚根基，该公司一直是该地区重要的雇主和社区合作伙伴。

paras.en: "We are incredibly proud of our history and our strong connection to the city of Medina," said David Smith. "This milestone is a testament to the hard work and dedication of our employees, many of whom have been with us for decades. We are grateful for the continued support of Mayor Hanwell and the entire Medina community."
paras.zh: “我们对我们的历史以及我们与麦地那市的紧密联系感到无比自豪，”大卫·史密斯说。 “这一里程碑证明了我们员工的辛勤工作和奉献精神，其中许多人已经在我们身边工作了数十年。我们感谢汉威尔市长和整个麦地那社区的持续支持。”

paras.en: The photo op followed a recent employee and family event at the Medina plant that celebrated the 100-year milestone. The celebration was filled with games, face painting, food, and fun for all ages, reinforcing the company's commitment to its employees and their families.
paras.zh: 这张照片是在麦地那工厂最近举行的庆祝 100 周年里程碑的员工和家庭活动之后​​拍摄的。庆祝活动充满了适合各个年龄段的游戏、面部彩绘、美食和乐趣，强化了公司对员工及其家人的承诺。

paras.en: Mayor Hanwell expressed his gratitude for CarlisleCBF’s presence in the city. “Carlisle has been a part of the Medina community for nearly 65 years, providing good jobs and a strong economic foundation,” said Mayor Hanwell. "We are proud to celebrate their 100-year anniversary and recognize the significant role they have played in our city’s growth and prosperity."
