articles.title: Automakers in Japan to standardize parts for cost savings
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: Toyota, Nissan, and Honda are lowering production costs by standardizing some parts, according to Car and Driver.
paras.zh: 据 Car and Driver 报道，丰田、日产和本田正在通过标准化某些零部件来降低生产成本。

paras.en: The decision was announced by Japan Automobile Manufacturers Association chairman Koji Sato last week, Automotive News first reported. It says this will include a universal color-coding scheme for wire harnesses, harmonized quality criteria for steel, and a unified recycling protocol for plastics.
paras.zh: 据《汽车新闻》首先报道，日本汽车制造商协会主席佐藤浩司上周宣布了这一决定。该公司表示，这将包括线束的通用颜色编码方案、钢材的统一质量标准以及塑料的统一回收协议。

paras.en: Car and Driver says there are plans to standardize more vehicle parts in the future.
paras.zh: Car and Driver 表示，未来计划对更多车辆零部件进行标准化。

paras.en: “The three areas were chosen as the first to be standardized because they are parts that are generally not noticed by consumers, and they shouldn’t have an impact on any brand’s individual identity,” Car and Driver states. “All three are also areas that account for significant production costs for the automakers, meaning they can have an immediate impact.”
paras.zh: “这三个领域被选为第一个标准化领域，因为它们是消费者通常不会注意到的部分，并且它们不应该对任何品牌的个人身份产生影响，”Car and Driver 表示。 “这三个领域也是汽车制造商生产成本的重要组成部分，这意味着它们可以产生立竿见影的影响。”

paras.en: The first steps are set to start next year and include domestic automotive parts suppliers. International suppliers are expected to be included over time.
paras.zh: 第一步将于明年开始，其中包括国内汽车零部件供应商。随着时间的推移，国际供应商预计将被纳入其中。

paras.en: Automakers in Japan are looking for ways to save money as they continue to compete with Chinese automakers, Car and Driver states.
paras.zh: 日本汽车制造商在继续与中国汽车制造商、汽车和驾驶员国家竞争时正在寻找省钱的方法。

paras.en: CNBC also reported earlier this month that Nissan plans to expand exports of vehicles developed in China to help globally compete with Chinese rivals.
paras.zh: CNBC 本月早些时候还报道称，日产计划扩大在中国开发的汽车的出口，以帮助在全球范围内与中国竞争对手竞争。

paras.en: The decision came as the automaker cut its global sales outlook for the fiscal year ending March 2027 to between 2.97 million and 3 million vehicles, CNBC says. It is the second time the outlook has been cut from its originally planned 3.3 million vehicles.
paras.zh: 据 CNBC 报道，该汽车制造商做出这一决定之际，将截至 2027 年 3 月的财年全球销量预期下调至 297 万至 300 万辆。这是其原计划 330 万辆汽车的产量预期第二次被下调。

paras.en: German automakers and suppliers have faced profit cuts as they compete with cheaper Asian vehicles entering the European market and U.S. tariffs.
paras.zh: 德国汽车制造商和供应商在与进入欧洲市场的廉价亚洲汽车和美国关税竞争时面临利润削减。

articles.title: Hyundai no longer approves use of non-OEM and other parts in collision repair
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: Hyundai has revised its position statement to strengthen language regarding non-OEM parts.
paras.zh: 现代汽车修改了其立场声明，以加强有关非 OEM 零件的语言。

paras.en: The current statement, found on OEM1Stop, says: “Hyundai does not approve of the use of counterfeit, gray market, aftermarket, imitation, recycled, alternate, or other non-original equipment parts for collision repairs.”
paras.zh: OEM1Stop 上发现的当前声明称：“现代汽车不赞成使用假冒、灰色市场、售后、仿制、回收、替代或其他非原装设备零件进行碰撞维修。”

paras.en: The previous version stated: “Hyundai does not recommend the use of counterfeit, gray market, aftermarket, imitation, recycled, alternate, or other non-original equipment parts for collision repairs.”
paras.zh: 之前的版本指出：“现代汽车不建议使用假冒、灰色市场、售后、仿制、回收、替代或其他非原装设备零件进行碰撞修复。”

paras.en: Both statements list the above in all capital letters, bold, and underlined.
paras.zh: 两个声明都以全部大写字母、粗体和下划线列出了上述内容。

paras.en: The statements say that Hyundai Genuine Parts help to ensure occupant protection and vehicle integrity.
paras.zh: 声明称，现代原厂配件有助于确保乘员保护和车辆完整性。

paras.en: “Use of counterfeit, gray market, aftermarket, imitation, recycled collision parts or any alternative or other non-original equipment parts for the repair of any collision-damaged vehicle may negatively affect vehicle crashworthiness and occupant safety during a collision and is not recommended by Hyundai.”
paras.zh: “使用假冒、灰色市场、售后、仿制、回收的碰撞零件或任何替代品或其他非原装设备零件来修理任何碰撞损坏的车辆可能会对车辆的耐撞性和碰撞期间乘员的安全产生负面影响，现代汽车不建议这样做。”

paras.en: Hyundai told Repairer Driven News it updated the position statement to more clearly communicate its position on the use of non-OEM parts in collision repair.
paras.zh: 现代汽车告诉 Repairer Driven News，它更新了立场声明，以更清楚地传达其在碰撞修复中使用非 OEM 零件的立场。

paras.en: “Because Hyundai cannot verify that non-OEM parts meet the same engineering, quality, and safety specifications as Hyundai Genuine Parts, we believe ‘does not approve’ more accurately reflects our position,” Hyundai said.
paras.zh: 现代汽车表示：“由于现代汽车无法验证非 OEM 零部件是否符合现代原厂零部件的工程、质量和安全规范，因此我们认为‘不批准’更准确地反映了我们的立场。”

paras.en: In the past year, General Motors has made multiple revisions to its position statements regarding non-OEM parts; the most recent added the words “strictly prohibits” in red throughout the statements. Several of the automaker’s statements now specifically prohibit salvage, recycled, used, non-Genuine parts, and non-GM reconditioned parts in collision repair.
paras.zh: 去年，通用汽车对其有关非 OEM 零部件的立场声明进行了多次修订；最近的声明在整个声明中添加了红色“严格禁止”字样。该汽车制造商的几份声明现在明确禁止在碰撞修复中使用报废、回收、使用过的非正品零件和非通用汽车翻新零件。

paras.en: Ford and Lincoln also released an updated ADAS position statement in May that uses stronger language to say all standards in the document are mandated.
paras.zh: 福特和林肯还在 5 月份发布了更新的 ADAS 立场声明，使用更强硬的语言表示文件中的所有标准都是强制性的。

articles.title: BMW begins first U.S. production battery production, iX5 production underway
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: BMW has opened a new facility in South Carolina to produce sixth-generation high-voltage batteries for the new iX5. The first iX5s rolled off assembly lines last week.
paras.zh: 宝马在南卡罗来纳州开设了一家新工厂，为新款 iX5 生产第六代高压电池。第一批 iX5 上周下线。

paras.en: The iX5 is BMW’s first fully electric model assembled in the U.S. Plant Woodruff opened Nov. 13 to supply iX5 batteries to Plant Spartanburg 15 miles away, according to a BMW Group press release.
paras.zh: 据宝马集团新闻稿称，iX5 是宝马首款在美国伍德拉夫工厂组装的全电动车型，该工厂于 11 月 13 日开业，为 15 英里外的斯帕坦堡工厂供应 iX5 电池。

paras.en: The release states that the new Woodruff plant is setting industry standards for high-voltage vehicle assembly through AI-supported production processes, digital twins, and virtual reality applications.
paras.zh: 新闻稿称，伍德拉夫新工厂正在通过人工智能支持的生产流程、数字孪生和虚拟现实应用程序，为高压汽车装配制定行业标准。

paras.en: “Electromobility is our most important growth area,” said Raymond Wittmann, BMW AG Board of Management member responsible for production, in the release. “That is why we are systematically electrifying our portfolio, with the U.S. playing a key role.”
paras.zh: “电动汽车是我们最重要的增长领域，”宝马公司负责生产的管理委员会成员雷蒙德·威特曼(Raymond Wittmann)在新闻稿中表示。 “这就是为什么我们系统地使我们的投资组合电气化，其中美国发挥着关键作用。”

paras.en: Wittmann added that by 2030, BMW will assemble at least six fully electric models at Plant Spartanburg.
paras.zh: 魏特曼补充说，到 2030 年，宝马将在斯巴达堡工厂组装至少六款全电动车型。

paras.en: Automotive News reports that Plant Spartanburg is assembling about 70 iX5s daily, following a recent 1 million-square-foot expansion to allow EV production.
paras.zh: 据《汽车新闻》报道，斯帕坦堡工厂最近扩建了 100 万平方英尺以生产电动汽车，目前每天组装约 70 辆 iX5。

paras.en: “The automaker would not provide production volume estimates for the iX5, but suppliers were told to expect 60,000 EVs in 2027, down from a prior forecast of 100,000,” the article states. “Suppliers were also given a target of 175,000 in 2028 and 2029, but that could change significantly.”
paras.zh: 文章称：“汽车制造商不会提供 iX5 的产量预估，但供应商被告知预计 2027 年电动汽车的产量将达到 60,000 辆，低于之前预测的 100,000 辆。” “供应商还设定了 2028 年和 2029 年 175,000 家的目标，但这可能会发生重大变化。”

paras.en: It adds that Kavit Antani, general manager of vehicle assembly, said the market is currently “looking like 20-25 percent EVs for the immediate three months.”
paras.zh: 该公司补充说，汽车装配总经理卡维特·安塔尼 (Kavit Antani) 表示，目前市场“未来三个月内电动汽车的占比将达到 20-25%”。

paras.en: A BMW spokesperson reportedly told Automotive News that the automaker will import battery cells for the iX5 from China until it switches to sourcing from an LG Energy Solution plant in Arizona at the end of the decade.
paras.zh: 据报道，宝马发言人告诉《汽车新闻》，该汽车制造商将从中国进口 iX5 的电池，直到本世纪末转而从位于亚利桑那州的 LG Energy Solution 工厂采购。

paras.en: Autoblog reports that the iX5 is expected at U.S. dealerships in Q1 2027.
paras.zh: Autoblog 报道称，iX5 预计将于 2027 年第一季度在美国经销店上市。

paras.en: Secondary image: High-voltage battery assembly at BMW Group Plant Woodruff is shown.
paras.zh: 次图：宝马集团伍德拉夫工厂的高压电池组装。

articles.title: Porsche TPMS: The First Carmaker To The Game
articles.author: Andrew Markel

paras.en: Porsche was the first manufacturer to use a tire pressure monitoring system (TPMS) on a vehicle in 1986 for the 959 supercar. The 959 was another first because it was equipped with world’s first self-supporting run-flat tires made by Bridgestone. This TPMS setup was again used on the 928 for model years 1990 to 1994.
paras.zh: 保时捷于 1986 年在 959 超级跑车上成为第一家在车辆上使用轮胎压力监测系统 (TPMS) 的制造商。 959 是另一个第一，因为它配备了世界上第一款由普利司通制造的自支撑防爆轮胎。该 TPMS 设置再次在 1990 至 1994 年的 928 车型上使用。

paras.en: The 959 did not have a spare tire as standard equipment. Instead, the dealership would dispatch a technician with a spare if a customer had a flat or loss of inflation. The run-flat tires could be driven for a limited distance at 50mph. The wheels used a system that locked a compatible tire into a channel that locked the bead to the wheel. This was called the Denloc system and prevented the tire from coming off the rim and suddenly deflating in the event of a puncture. The rims also used an innovative hollow-spoke system.
paras.zh: 959 没有标配备胎。相反，如果客户出现故障或通货膨胀损失，经销商会派遣一名技术人员携带备件。缺气保用轮胎可以以 50 英里/小时的速度行驶有限的距离。车轮使用了一个系统，将兼容的轮胎锁定到一个通道中，将胎圈锁定到车轮上。这被称为 Denloc 系统，可防止轮胎在发生刺穿时脱离轮辋并突然泄气。轮圈还采用了创新的空心辐条系统。

paras.en: The early system used tire pressure sensors mounted in special holes in the valley of the wheel. This early tire pressure monitoring system was known as RDK, or Reifen Druck Kontrolle, which roughly translates to Tire Pressure Control.
paras.zh: 早期的系统使用安装在车轮谷底的特殊孔中的轮胎压力传感器。这种早期的轮胎压力监测系统被称为 RDK，或 Reifen Druck Kontrolle，大致翻译为“轮胎压力控制”。

paras.en: The sensors looked like a stack of poker chips. A diaphragm inside the sensors connected to switches that were set to a reference pressure. The receiver was mounted on the knuckle and was an inductive coil that would pass current through the sensors wirelessly. Depending on the position of the diaphragm and which switches were open or closed, the amount of current flowing through the receiver’s coils, would change the voltage.
paras.zh: 传感器看起来就像一堆扑克筹码。传感器内部的隔膜连接到设置为参考压力的开关。接收器安装在指关节上，是一个感应线圈，可以无线方式通过传感器传递电流。根据隔膜的位置以及打开或关闭的开关，流经接收器线圈的电流量会改变电压。

paras.en: In 2004, Porsche started to use a conventional TPMS system for the Cayenne and select Boxster and 911 models. These systems were a lot like those found on BMW, Mercedes-Benz and Audi vehicles.
paras.zh: 2004 年，保时捷开始在 Cayenne 以及部分 Boxster 和 911 车型上使用传统的 TPMS 系统。这些系统与宝马、梅赛德斯-奔驰和奥迪汽车上的系统非常相似。

paras.en: Porsche TPMS systems use four antennas mounted in the wheel wells and a designated module for the tire pressure. The sensors use a 433mHz frequency. On most models, the menu will have the option for two sets of tires and sensor IDs for summer and winter tires.
paras.zh: 保时捷 TPMS 系统使用安装在轮舱中的四个天线和一个指定的轮胎压力模块。传感器使用 433mHz 频率。在大多数车型上，菜单将提供两组轮胎以及夏季和冬季轮胎的传感器 ID 的选项。

paras.en: The system has a telltale malfunction indicator light and a low-pressure light. When the system detects a malfunction, the telltale light will flash for approximately one minute, and then will remain continuously illuminated. This sequence will continue upon subsequent vehicle startups, as long as the malfunction exists.
paras.zh: 该系统有一个指示故障的指示灯和一个低压灯。当系统检测到故障时，警示灯将闪烁大约一分钟，然后持续亮起。只要故障存在，后续车辆启动时就会继续执行此序列。

paras.en: If a sensor is not transmitting, the warning light in the speedometer flashes for one minute, and then remains continuously illuminated. Codes and data from the TPMS control module can be accessed with a scan tool. If there is a problem, it is typically communication errors with the four receivers in the wheel wells.
paras.zh: 如果传感器未进行传输，车速表中的警告灯会闪烁一分钟，然后持续亮起。可以使用扫描工具访问 TPMS 控制模块的代码和数据。如果出现问题，通常是轮舱中四个接收器的通信错误。

paras.en: It is also important to remember that the TPMS module starts hunting for sensor signals the second the ignition is turned on. Leaving the ignition in the “on” position when a wheel is removed may cause the information display to say, “Wheel change? Input new TPM settings.” Also, if the second set of wheels is in the vicinity of the vehicle, the same warning could be set.
paras.zh: 同样重要的是要记住，TPMS 模块在点火开关打开的那一刻就开始寻找传感器信号。拆下车轮后，将点火装置保持在“打开”位置可能会导致信息显示屏显示“更换车轮？输入新的 TPM 设置”。此外，如果第二组车轮位于车辆附近，则可以设置相同的警告。

paras.en: Before starting any relearn process, set the tire to the pressure specified in the doorjamb for the cold temperature. The relearn process starts with turning the ignition on, accessing the vehicle’s computer and entering into the tire pressure control menu. On most models, you will need to select the winter or summer set of tires. The system will then start to learn the sensor IDs and positions.
paras.zh: 在开始任何重新学习过程之前，将轮胎设置为门框上指定的低温压力。重新学习过程从打开点火开关、访问车辆计算机并进入轮胎压力控制菜单开始。在大多数车型上，您需要选择冬季或夏季轮胎。然后系统将开始学习传感器 ID 和位置。

paras.en: The onboard computer displays the message “TPM is learning.” The process may take 2 to 10 minutes, and the vehicle speed needs to be above 15-16 mph. During this time, the current tire pressures are not available on the display. The tire pressure warning light will remain lit until all wheels have been learned.
paras.zh: 车载计算机显示消息“TPM 正在学习”。该过程可能需要 2 到 10 分钟，车速需要高于 15-16 英里/小时。在此期间，显示屏上不会显示当前轮胎压力。轮胎压力警告灯将一直亮起，直到所有车轮都被学习为止。

paras.en: Position and pressure information will be displayed as soon as the TPMS system has assigned the wheels identified as belonging to the vehicle and to the correct wheel positions.
paras.zh: 一旦 TPMS 系统将识别为属于车辆的车轮分配到正确的车轮位置，就会显示位置和压力​​信息。

articles.title: MANN+HUMMEL Leaders Anticipate What’s Next
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: This episode of DriveTime features Hasmeet Kaur, president, Transportation Division, MANN+HUMMEL, and Cedric Dackam, president & GM, Automotive Aftermarket, MANN+HUMMEL.
paras.zh: 本期《DriveTime》由曼胡默尔运输部门总裁 Hasmeet Kaur 和曼胡默尔汽车售后市场总裁兼总经理 Cedric Dackam 担任嘉宾。

paras.en: As the automotive industry undergoes significant transformation, MANN+HUMMEL is leveraging its presence in both the original equipment and aftermarket sectors to deliver solutions throughout a vehicle’s lifecycle. Kaur explained how the company’s integrated business model enables it to anticipate customer needs, beginning with vehicle design and continuing through aftermarket service and repair. Rather than treating OE and aftermarket operations as separate businesses, Kaur emphasized how the two segments complement each other, allowing MANN+HUMMEL to address evolving customer requirements while positioning both for long-term growth.
paras.zh: 随着汽车行业经历重大转型，曼胡默尔正在利用其在原始设备和售后市场领域的影响力，在车辆的整个生命周期中提供解决方案。考尔解释了该公司的综合业务模式如何使其能够预测客户需求，从车辆设计开始，一直到售后服务和维修。考尔没有将原配设备和售后市场业务视为独立的业务，而是强调这两个部门如何相互补充，使曼胡默尔能够满足不断变化的客户需求，同时为两者的长期增长做好准备。

paras.en: Dackam highlighted the growing complexity facing aftermarket suppliers and customers. An aging vehicle fleet, electrification, advanced vehicle technologies and increasing parts proliferation are reshaping the industry’s challenges and opportunities. He said customers increasingly expect more than quality products, placing greater importance on predictive analytics, accurate coverage and access to vehicle data. He also emphasized how MANN+HUMMEL’s OE engineering expertise helps the company prepare aftermarket solutions for emerging technologies, including filtration applications in battery safety, thermal management and battery venting. Its established WIX, Purolator and MANN-FILTER brands further support the company’s ability to serve different market segments and distribution channels.
paras.zh: 达卡姆强调了售后市场供应商和客户面临的日益复杂的情况。车队老化、电气化、先进的车辆技术和零部件的激增正在重塑该行业的挑战和机遇。他表示，客户对优质产品的期望越来越高，他们更加重视预测分析、准确的覆盖范围和车辆数据的访问。他还强调了曼胡默尔的原厂工程专业知识如何帮助公司为新兴技术准备售后解决方案，包括电池安全、热管理和电池通风方面的过滤应用。其成熟的 WIX、Purolator 和 MANN-FILTER 品牌进一步支持了公司服务不同细分市场和分销渠道的能力。

paras.en: Looking ahead, Kaur emphasized MANN+HUMMEL’s commitment to innovation, sustainability and its core mission of separating the useful from the harmful. She pointed to investments in filtration media development and vertical integration that enable the company to accelerate innovation and tailor solutions to customer needs. Kaur also discussed her leadership philosophy, emphasizing trust, empowerment and creating an environment where teams can perform at their best. Dackam reinforced the importance of anticipating industry change and translating emerging technologies into aftermarket opportunities, noting that the company’s engineering capabilities, established brands and customer relationships provide a foundation for navigating the industry’s evolving landscape.
paras.zh: 展望未来，考尔强调了曼胡默尔对创新、可持续发展的承诺以及将有用与有害分开的核心使命。她指出，在过滤介质开发和垂直整合方面的投资使公司能够加速创新并根据客户需求定制解决方案。考尔还讨论了她的领导理念，强调信任、授权以及创造一个让团队能够发挥最佳水平的环境。达卡姆强调了预测行业变化并将新兴技术转化为售后市场机会的重要性，并指出公司的工程能力、知名品牌和客户关系为驾驭行业不断发展的格局奠定了基础。

articles.title: Inspection and Replacement of Active Motor Mounts
articles.author: Jerry Renshaw

paras.en: Motor mounts aren’t glamorous or impressive or a high-performance item, but they’re a critical part of any vehicle’s drivetrain and its entire noise/vibration/harshness package. Motor mounts (and transmission mounts) help keep several hundred pounds of engine and drivetrain aligned at a precise angle, attaching the engine and transmission to the chassis or subframe. These rubberized mounts help isolate the vibrations from the engine and dampen the tendency for the engine to twist to one side due to torque on acceleration. They’re part of a system that keeps the drivetrain situated properly and ensures a quiet and smooth experience for the driver.
paras.zh: 电机支架并不迷人或令人印象深刻，也不是高性能产品，但它们是任何车辆传动系统及其整个噪声/振动/粗糙度包的关键部分。电机支架（和变速箱支架）有助于使数百磅的发动机和传动系统以精确的角度对齐，将发动机和变速箱连接到底盘或副车架上。这些橡胶支架有助于隔离发动机的振动，并抑制发动机由于加速扭矩而向一侧扭转的趋势。它们是保持动力传动系统正确定位并确保驾驶员安静平稳体验的系统的一部分。

paras.en: For decades, motor mounts were just a sandwich of vulcanized rubber inside inner and outer metal sleeves; while this is a simple and dependable design, rubberized motor mounts tend to dry out and shrink after time and many heat/cool cycles, meaning they’ll transmit more vibration or may fail completely and need to be replaced. Some European models use a hydraulic mount, a gel-filled donut with sealed chambers and passages. This more advanced design is tuned to respond to certain vibration frequencies and amplitudes that go along with RPM and load.
paras.zh: 几十年来，电机支架只是内部和外部金属套筒内的硫化橡胶的三明治；虽然这是一种简单可靠的设计，但经过一段时间和多次热/冷循环后，橡胶电机支架往往会变干和收缩，这意味着它们会传递更多振动，或者可能完全失效并需要更换。一些欧洲型号使用液压安装座，这是一个带有密封室和通道的凝胶填充甜甜圈。这种更先进的设计经过调整，可以响应与转速和负载相关的某些振动频率和振幅。

paras.en: Active motor mounts, on the other hand, are designed with electronic or vacuum controls that can alter stiffness on demand and are featured on a number of performance brands. In design and function, they’re not too dissimilar from the solenoids and controls for active suspensions, including the magnetorheological fluid used in active shock absorbers.
paras.zh: 另一方面，主动电机安装座采用电子或真空控制装置设计，可以根据需要改变刚度，并且是许多高性能品牌的特色。在设计和功能上，它们与主动悬架的螺线管和控制器没有太大不同，包括主动减震器中使用的磁流变液。

paras.en: On some Jaguar models, the active mounts are part of the driving mode package and can be adjusted to provide more feedback for the driver in Sport mode. They’re designed to be dynamic and can even change stiffness slightly during gear changes or while cornering. The problems with active mounts usually stem from the vacuum or electronic side, not the mount itself.
paras.zh: 在某些捷豹车型上，主动支架是驾驶模式包的一部分，可以进行调整，以便在运动模式下为驾驶员提供更多反馈。它们被设计为动态的，甚至可以在换档或转弯时轻微改变刚度。有源安装座的问题通常源于真空或电子侧，而不是安装座本身。

paras.en: Earlier designs of active motor mounts relied on engine vacuum to regulate their damping behavior. An engine pulls more vacuum at idle, and the mounts would be softer and more compliant to easily soak up NVH. Acceleration and load means less vacuum, and mounts were designed to limit excessive engine movement as they firmed up. That, of course, means a vacuum line and port that could be prone to wear and failure.
paras.zh: 主动电机支架的早期设计依靠发动机真空来调节其阻尼行为。发动机在怠速时会产生更多的真空，并且支架会更柔软、更柔顺，可以轻松吸收 NVH。加速和负载意味着真空度降低，支架的设计旨在限制发动机在固定时的过度运动。当然，这意味着真空管线和端口可能容易磨损和失效。

paras.en: Later designs worked much the same way, but rely on an electronic actuator that’s controlled by the vehicle’s ECU, based on input from sensors and programming. This design is more precise and doesn’t have the lag time that goes along with vacuum actuation, adjusting the firmness of the mounts on the fly. Some active mounts can even generate a counter-vibration that’s tuned to neutralize the vibration frequencies from the engine’s rotating assembly, not unlike a balance shaft design. These mounts are common on models from Audi, BMW, Jaguar, Lexus, Toyota, Honda and other makes. Active motor mounts are commonplace on any vehicle that has a cylinder deactivation system, helping to soak up vibrations as the engine’s cylinders shut down.
paras.zh: 后来的设计工作原理大致相同，但依赖于由车辆 ECU 根据传感器输入和编程控制的电子执行器。这种设计更加精确，并且没有真空驱动带来的滞后时间，可以动态调整安装座的牢固度。一些主动安装座甚至可以产生反振动，该反振动经过调整以中和发动机旋转组件的振动频率，这与平衡轴设计没有什么不同。这些安装座常见于奥迪、宝马、捷豹、雷克萨斯、丰田、本田和其他品牌的车型。主动电机支架在任何配备停缸系统的车辆上都很常见，有助于吸收发动机气缸关闭时的振动。

paras.en: There are usually some pretty clear signs of failing motor mounts. These include:
paras.zh: 通常有一些非常明显的迹象表明电机安装座出现故障。这些包括：

paras.en: - Excessive vibration that can be felt through the steering wheel or floorboards, during certain RPM or load ranges, while idling in gear or using the AC.
paras.zh: - 在某些转速或负载范围内，在挂档或使用空调时，可以通过方向盘或地板感觉到过度振动。

paras.en: - Noticeable clunk or bang when putting the vehicle in gear, accelerating or decelerating (this can easily be mistaken for bad U-joints or CV joints).
paras.zh: - 当车辆挂档、加速或减速时，会发出明显的沉闷声或撞击声（这很容易被误认为是损坏的 U 形万向节或等速万向节）。

paras.en: - Noticeable torque steer on a FWD vehicle.
paras.zh: - 前轮驱动车辆上的明显扭矩转向。

paras.en: - The engine moves in its motor mount cradle when an assistant revs the engine, in gear and foot on the brake.
paras.zh: - 当助手挂档并踩下制动器转动发动机时，发动机会在电机安装支架中移动。

paras.en: One failed mount puts extra stress on the other mounts and will usually lead to their failure as well. When the engine is wobbling and torquing around underhood, it stretches wiring and puts strain on vacuum lines, radiator hoses, belts, throttle and shift linkages. In extreme cases, a misaligned engine and transmission can change driveline geometry and wear out CV joints, or the engine can even come in contact with the radiator fan and shroud.
paras.zh: 一个失败的安装座会给其他安装座带来额外的压力，并且通常也会导致它们的失败。当发动机在引擎盖下晃动和扭转时，它会拉伸接线并对真空管路、散热器软管、皮带、油门和换档连杆施加压力。在极端情况下，未对准的发动机和变速箱可能会改变传动系统的几何形状并磨损等速万向节，或者发动机甚至可能与散热器风扇和护罩接触。

paras.en: It’s also worth noting here that oil or transmission fluid leaks can degrade the rubber of a motor mount, softening it and hastening its failure. In instances like this, the leak will need to be addressed as well. Also, an active misfire code like P0300 or P0304 can cause vibrations that are harsh enough to destroy engine mounts within weeks.
paras.zh: 这里还值得注意的是，油或变速箱油泄漏会降低电机支架的橡胶性能，使其软化并加速其故障。在这种情况下，也需要解决泄漏问题。此外，像 P0300 或 P0304 这样的主动失火代码可能会导致剧烈的振动，足以在几周内损坏发动机支架。

paras.en: The ECU might store codes as well, but these can be misleading: for instance, P0171 or P0400 codes indicate a failed EGR or clogged PCV that will produce an idle so rough that it can mimic a failed motor mount. Codes like P1586 can confirm a failed solenoid and internal electronics.
paras.zh: ECU 也可能存储代码，但这些代码可能会产生误导：例如，P0171 或 P0400 代码表示 EGR 故障或 PCV 堵塞，会产生非常粗糙的怠速，以至于可以模仿故障的电机安装。 P1586 等代码可以确认电磁阀和内部电子设备出现故障。

paras.en: Your best bet, though, is still a visual inspection: does the engine torque to one side when an assistant “power-brakes” it with the transmission in gear? Can you see a sooty appearance to the body of the engine mount? Does the rubber look dry-rotted, degraded or is it starting to separate from the metal body?
paras.zh: 不过，最好的选择仍然是目视检查：当助手在变速箱挂档的情况下“动力制动”发动机时，发动机是否会向一侧扭转？您能看到发动机支架主体有黑黑的外观吗？橡胶是否看起来干腐、退化或者开始与金属体分离？

paras.en: Inspect other components like wiring harnesses, throttle linkage, transmission linkage, heat shields, hoses, vacuum lines, intake ducts, drive axles, etc., to ensure that they haven’t been damaged by excessive engine movement. When servicing, make sure the oil pan, transmission and other parts are properly supported to avoid damage and be aware that other components might need to be removed in order to access the motor mounts.
paras.zh: 检查其他部件，如线束、油门连杆、传动连杆、隔热罩、软管、真空管路、进气管、驱动轴等，以确保它们没有因发动机过度运动而损坏。维修时，确保油底壳、变速箱和其他部件得到适当支撑，以避免损坏，并注意可能需要拆下其他部件才能接触电机安装座。

paras.en: Mounts should be replaced in pairs or sets, not one at a time; a single mushed-out motor mount can put undue stress on the other mounts. After installing the mounts, check and verify the clearance around exhaust and cooling components to make sure the engine’s position is correct. Active systems might require calibration or functional testing; be sure of the right process for your year/make/model.
paras.zh: 安装座应成对或成套更换，而不是一次更换一个；单个松散的电机安装座可能会给其他安装座带来过度的压力。安装支架后，检查并验证排气和冷却部件周围的间隙，以确保发动机的位置正确。主动系统可能需要校准或功能测试；确保您的年份/品牌/型号采用正确的流程。

paras.en: After installation, always road test the vehicle at different speeds to be sure the vibration problem’s been eliminated. Inspection of the motor mounts should go along with other routine maintenance, such as changing a timing belt, and motor and transmission mount inspection should be part of any collision repair work.
paras.zh: 安装后，始终以不同的速度对车辆进行道路测试，以确保振动问题已消除。电机安装座的检查应与其他日常维护一起进行，例如更换正时皮带，并且电机和变速箱安装座的检查应成为任何碰撞维修工作的一部分。

paras.en: Depending on the design of active engine mounts, a technician should look for DTCs, module commands, wiring (power and ground) and the mount’s response to any commands or switching of modes. Be mindful that the details of repair and replacement can vary a lot from one year/make/model to another.
paras.zh: 根据主动发动机支架的设计，技术人员应查找 DTC、模块命令、接线（电源和接地）以及支架对任何命令或模式切换的响应。请注意，维修和更换的细节可能因年份/品牌/型号而异。

articles.title: Brake Job: 2020–2026 Buick Encore GX
articles.author: Andrew Markel

paras.en: I was recently working on an ASE A5 test-prep article, and we reached the section on parking brakes. Most parking brakes act on the rear wheels, so the test is structured around that arrangement. But some vehicles have parking brakes on the front wheels. I knew that some older Saabs and Datsuns used front-wheel parking brakes. One modern example is the Buick Encore GX.
paras.zh: 我最近正在撰写 ASE A5 测试准备文章，我们到达了有关驻车制动器的部分。大多数驻车制动器作用于后轮，因此测试是围绕这种安排进行的。但有些车辆的前轮装有驻车制动器。我知道一些较旧的萨博和达特桑使用前轮驻车制动器。别克 Encore GX 就是现代的一个例子。

paras.en: On these models, pulling the park-brake switch sends a signal to the Electronic Brake Control Module. The module supplies 12 volts to the apply-control circuits and ground to the release-control circuits, activating the left and right park-brake actuators and applying the brakes.
paras.zh: 在这些型号上，拉动驻车制动开关会向电子制动控制模块发送信号。该模块向应用控制电路提供 12 伏电压，并向释放控制电路提供接地电压，从而激活左右驻车制动执行器并应用制动器。

paras.en: Pressing the switch sends a signal to the module to release the brakes. The module supplies 12 volts to the release-control circuits and ground to the apply-control circuits, activating the actuators and releasing the brakes. Depending on the vehicle, the switch may be a push-button style. Pressing it commands the parking brakes to apply or release based on their current position.
paras.zh: 按下开关会向模块发送信号以释放制动器。该模块向释放控制电路提供 12 伏电压，并向应用控制电路提供接地电压，从而激活执行器并释放制动器。根据车辆的不同，开关可能是按钮式的。按下它可以命令驻车制动器根据当前位置应用或释放。

paras.en: The parking brake will release automatically if the engine is running, the vehicle is shifted into gear, and the driver attempts to move off. Avoid rapid acceleration while the parking brake is applied to help preserve the parking-brake lining.
paras.zh: 如果发动机正在运转、车辆挂档且驾驶员试图起步，驻车制动器将自动释放。使用驻车制动器时避免快速加速，以帮助保护驻车制动器衬片。

paras.en: The Electronic Brake Control Module, also called the Brake System Control Module, controls the park-brake motor circuits and runs diagnostics to verify that they are operating properly.
paras.zh: 电子制动控制模块，也称为制动系统控制模块，控制驻车制动电机电路并运行诊断以验证它们是否正常运行。

paras.en: To replace the brake pads, the park-brake caliper pistons must be fully retracted. There are two ways to put the parking brake into service mode. The preferred method is to use a scan tool with a service-mode function. If you do not have a compatible scan tool, use this procedure:
paras.zh: 要更换刹车片，驻车制动卡钳活塞必须完全缩回。有两种方法可以将驻车制动器置于维修模式。首选方法是使用具有服务模式功能的扫描工具。如果您没有兼容的扫描工具，请使用以下过程：

paras.en: - Turn the ignition on with the engine off.
paras.zh: - 在发动机关闭的情况下打开点火装置。

paras.en: - Press the accelerator pedal halfway down.
paras.zh: - 将油门踏板踩到一半。

paras.en: - Move the park-brake switch to the release position and hold it for 10 seconds. Release the switch.
paras.zh: - 将驻车制动开关移至释放位置并保持 10 秒钟。松开开关。

paras.en: - Within five seconds, move the switch to the release position again.
paras.zh: - 在五秒钟内，再次将开关移至释放位置。

paras.en: The actuator bolts to the back of the caliper and is not included with a replacement caliper. If you remove the actuator, GM recommends replacing the caliper’s O-ring. Front-wheel parking brakes may be a novelty, but they make an interesting piece of trivia to test your technician friends on.
paras.zh: 执行器用螺栓固定在卡钳的背面，并且不包含在替换卡钳中。如果拆下执行器，GM 建议更换卡钳的 O 形圈。前轮驻车制动器可能是一个新奇事物，但它们是一个有趣的琐事，可以测试您的技术人员朋友。

articles.title: TCA Opens Nominations for Elevate Young Leadership Program
articles.author: Kevin Linger

paras.en: The Truckload Carriers Association (TCA) announced that nominations opened for the 2027 Elevate Young Leadership Program. Truckload carriers can nominate employees who show leadership potential, a commitment to professional growth, and an interest in building a career in the industry.
paras.zh: 卡车运输协会 (TCA) 宣布 2027 年提升青年领导力计划开放提名。卡车承运商可以提名具有领导潜力、致力于职业发展以及有兴趣在该行业发展职业的员工。

paras.en: The 2027 class will be the program’s fourth. Participants will meet in person at TCA events, attend virtual sessions, and work on group projects throughout the year. The program combines mentorship and leadership development with opportunities to learn from industry executives and peers.
paras.zh: 2027 年课程将是该项目的第四期。参与者将在全年的 TCA 活动中亲自会面、参加虚拟会议并开展小组项目。该计划将指导和领导力发展与向行业高管和同行学习的机会结合起来。

paras.en: “Drivers Legal Plan is proud to continue supporting the Elevate Young Leadership Program,” said Brad Klepper, president of Drivers Legal Plan. “The success of this program demonstrates the importance of investing in rising professionals and creating opportunities for them to learn, connect, and grow. We are excited to help develop the leaders who will guide our industry forward in the years ahead.”

The future of trucking depends on strong leadership, and we’re proud to be part of that journey.”

articles.title: Investing in the Vehicles the Aftermarket Will Be Repairing
articles.author: Jason Morgan

paras.en: Preparing for the next generation of vehicles takes money and so does keeping up with the ones already in the shop. When you consider investments for 2027, both of those aspects deserve attention. The challenge is deciding how much to commit to each as repair needs develop at different speeds.
paras.zh: 为下一代车辆做准备需要资金，跟上商店里已有的车辆也需要资金。当您考虑 2027 年的投资时，这两方面都值得关注。挑战在于，随着维修需求以不同的速度发展，决定对每个项目投入多少。

paras.en: The headlines that flooded AftermarketNews website in the past month offer a useful view of that balancing act. Suppliers are developing products for electric drive units while expanding conventional transmission coverage. They are advancing familiar battery technology and redesigning components around problems that emerge after years of use. The opportunities span vehicles of different ages and technologies, all competing for a place in the business plan.
paras.zh: 过去一个月充斥 AftermarketNews 网站的头条新闻为这种平衡行为提供了有用的观点。供应商正在开发电力驱动装置产品，同时扩大传统传输覆盖范围。他们正在推进熟悉的电池技术，并围绕使用多年后出现的问题重新设计组件。这些机会涵盖了不同年代和技术的车辆，所有这些都在商业计划中争夺一席之地。

paras.en: The latest powertrain forecast from the Auto Care Association and MEMA Aftermarket Suppliers helps explain why such planning requires patience. Developed with Strategy&, PwC’s strategy division, the report projects hybrids will account for 32% of U.S. new-vehicle sales in 2035, up from 17% in 2026. It also expects the number of hybrid models to triple between 2025 and 2035.
paras.zh: 汽车护理协会和 MEMA 售后市场供应商的最新动力总成预测有助于解释为什么此类规划需要耐心。该报告由普华永道战略部门思略特共同制定，预计到 2035 年，混合动力汽车将占美国新车销量的 32%，高于 2026 年的 17%。报告还预计，2025 年至 2035 年间，混合动力车型的数量将增加两倍。

paras.en: “Hybrids are becoming a bigger part of the picture, and suppliers need to plan for that reality,” said Philip Atkins, director of strategic research and planning at MEMA Aftermarket Suppliers. “The mix of vehicles on the road will keep changing, and understanding where that demand is headed will help companies make better decisions about products and investment.”
paras.zh: MEMA 售后市场供应商战略研究和规划总监 Philip Atkins 表示：“混合动力汽车正在成为整个市场的重要组成部分，供应商需要针对这一现实进行规划。” “道路上的车辆组合将不断变化，了解需求的走向将有助于公司在产品和投资方面做出更好的决策。”

paras.en: Those are new-vehicle sales projections. Their implications for independent repair develop over time, as vehicles age and their service requirements become clearer. Some of that change is happening within categories the aftermarket already knows well.
paras.zh: 这些是新车销售预测。随着车辆老化及其服务要求变得更加清晰，它们对独立维修的影响随着时间的推移而发展。其中一些变化发生在售后市场已经熟知的类别内。

paras.en: Clarios’ expansion of its hAGM battery technology, for example, addresses growing demands on low-voltage electrical systems across powertrain types. More electronics, connectivity and energy-management functions place additional demands on the 12-volt battery, including when the vehicle is parked. The company is applying the technology to future original-equipment programs and, through its OPTIMA REDTOP with hAGM+ technology, the premium replacement market.
paras.zh: 例如，Clarios 对其 hAGM 电池技术的扩展满足了对各种动力系统类型的低压电气系统日益增长的需求。更多的电子、连接和能源管理功能对 12 伏电池提出了额外的要求，包括在车辆停车时。该公司正在将该技术应用于未来的原始设备项目，并通过其采用 hAGM+ 技术的 OPTIMA REDTOP 进入高端替代市场。

paras.en: “The technology trends shaping future vehicles will also shape the replacement market,” said Marc Andraca, president of U.S. and Canada region at Clarios.
paras.zh: Clarios 美国和加拿大地区总裁 Marc Andraca 表示：“塑造未来汽车的技术趋势也将塑造替换市场。”

paras.en: So even a well-established replacement category can require continued development as the systems around it change. Familiarity with the product does not settle the question of what customers will need from its next generation.
paras.zh: 因此，即使是一个完善的替代品类，随着周围系统的变化，也需要持续发展。对产品的熟悉并不能解决客户需要下一代产品的问题。

paras.en: Schaeffler’s recent portfolio announcements show how several investment horizons can sit alongside one another. The company is expanding electronics capabilities through its integration of Vitesco Technologies and adding conventional transmission coverage, including an 8L90 torque converter. Its E-Axle RepSystem 2 in1 bearing repair kit enables targeted repairs within electric drive units as an alternative to replacing larger assemblies.
paras.zh: 舍弗勒最近发布的投资组合公告表明，多种投资视野可以相互并存。该公司正在通过整合Vitesco Technologies来扩展电子能力，并增加传统变速箱覆盖范围，包括8L90变矩器。其 E-Axle RepSystem 2 合 1 轴承维修套件可在电力驱动单元内进行有针对性的维修，作为更换较大组件的替代方案。

paras.en: Each addresses a particular repair need, but taken together, they illustrate the breadth of development work that a more varied vehicle population can require. The investment extends into what information and technical support do customers need to use those products?
paras.zh: 每一个都解决了特定的维修需求，但综合起来，它们说明了更多样化的车辆群体可能需要的开发工作的广度。投资延伸到客户使用这些产品需要哪些信息和技术支持？

paras.en: Dorman’s new aluminum oil filter housing brings the discussion back to an existing application. Designed for select Genesis, Hyundai and Kia vehicles, it addresses an original equipment plastic housing that the company said can degrade, warp or crack after prolonged exposure to heat and chemicals. Dorman’s replacement uses high-pressure die-cast aluminum to address that weakness.
paras.zh: 多尔曼的新型铝制机油滤清器外壳将讨论带回现有的应用。它专为精选的Genesis、现代和起亚汽车而设计，解决了原始设备塑料外壳的问题，该公司表示，这种外壳在长时间暴露于高温和化学物质后可能会降解、变形或破裂。多尔曼的替代品使用高压压铸铝来解决这个弱点。

paras.en: For leaders weighing next year’s commitments, these stories suggest that the timing of investment deserves as much scrutiny as its direction. Vehicle populations, emerging failure points and customer experience can help test whether an opportunity is becoming ready for the business to serve.
paras.zh: 对于权衡明年承诺的领导人来说，这些故事表明投资时机与其方向一样值得仔细审查。车辆数量、新出现的故障点和客户体验可以帮助测试业务是否准备好提供服务。

paras.en: The vehicles that will shape the aftermarket’s next decade are entering service alongside those that still have years of repairs ahead. Preparing for that future means staying close enough to customers to recognize what is arriving in their bays, then putting the right resources behind it.
paras.zh: 那些将塑造售后市场未来十年的车辆正在与那些仍需要多年维修的车辆一起投入使用。为未来做好准备意味着与客户保持足够的距离，以了解即将到达他们的海湾的货物，然后投入适当的资源。

articles.title: Advance Auto Parts Opens New Store in Bradenton
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: Advance Auto Parts opened its newest store in Bradenton, expanding access to parts, tools and expertise for local drivers and automotive professionals. The company marked the opening of the store at 10010 State Road 64 alongside local officials and representatives from Manatee Technical College who were on site to accept a donation for the school’s automotive technology program.
paras.zh: Advance Auto Parts 在布雷登顿开设了最新的商店，为当地驾驶员和汽车专业人士提供更多零件、工具和专业知识。该公司在 64 号国道 10010 号庆祝这家商店开业，当地官员和海牛技术学院的代表也在现场接受了对该学校汽车技术项目的捐款。

paras.en: The donation will help students gain hands-on experience, training, and career opportunities through the school’s automotive technology programs. Skilled automotive technicians continue to be in high demand, with approximately 70,000 openings projected annually through 2034, according to U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics.
paras.zh: 此次捐赠将帮助学生通过学校的汽车技术项目获得实践经验、培训和职业机会。根据美国劳工统计局的数据，熟练的汽车技术人员的需求量仍然很高，预计到 2034 年，每年大约有 70,000 个职位空缺。

paras.en: “Opening our seventh store in Bradenton is an exciting milestone that allows us to better serve customers across the community,” said Mark Ortiz, regional vice president, Advance Auto Parts. “Whether helping drivers maintain their vehicles or supporting professional shops and technicians, our team is focused on providing the service and products customers depend on. We’re also proud to support Manatee Technical College as they prepare future technicians for careers in the automotive industry.”
paras.zh: Advance Auto Parts 区域副总裁 Mark Ortiz 表示：“在布雷登顿开设第七家商店是一个令人兴奋的里程碑，它使我们能够更好地为整个社区的客户提供服务。” “无论是帮助驾驶员维护车辆，还是为专业商店和技术人员提供支持，我们的团队都专注于提供客户所依赖的服务和产品。我们也很自豪能够支持海牛技术学院，因为他们为未来的技术人员在汽车行业的职业生涯做好准备。”

paras.en: Customers can access a variety of free services at Advance, including battery testing, battery and wiper blade installation with purchase, and check engine light scanning through ReliaScan, which enables a team member to quickly scan the vehicle and identify what may be causing the issue, with no appointment needed.
paras.zh: 客户可以在 Advance 获得各种免费服务，包括电池测试、购买时安装电池和雨刷片，以及通过 ReliaScan 检查发动机灯扫描，这使团队成员能够快速扫描车辆并确定可能导致问题的原因，而无需预约。

articles.title: YANG Launches 2027 Mentorship Program
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: The Young Auto Care Network Group (YANG), a community of the Auto Care Association, recently launched its 2027 YANG Mentorship Program. Now in its fifth year, the program averages 125 mentees and 24 volunteer mentors annually. Anyone under age 40 who joins the YANG community can participate for free.
paras.zh: 汽车护理协会旗下社区青年汽车护理网络集团 (YANG) 最近启动了 2027 年 YANG 指导计划。该计划现已进入第五个年头，平均每年有 125 名学员和 24 名志愿者导师。任何 40 岁以下加入 YANG 社区的人都可以免费参与。

paras.en: “One of the most valuable aspects of my involvement with YANG has been the relationships I’ve built with individuals who genuinely challenge me to grow, both personally and professionally,” said Brandon Crenshaw, chair, YANG. “The Mentorship Program creates an opportunity to go beyond networking, by building meaningful connections, challenging your own perspectives, and developing the confidence and perspective to lead in new ways. It’s an experience I encourage every young professional in our industry to embrace.”
paras.zh: YANG 主席布兰登·克伦肖 (Brandon Crenshaw) 表示：“我参与 YANG 的最有价值的方面之一是我与那些真正挑战我成长的人建立了关系，无论是个人还是职业。” “导师计划通过建立有意义的联系、挑战自己的观点以及培养以新方式领导的信心和视角，创造了一个超越网络的机会。我鼓励我们行业的每一位年轻专业人士接受这种经历。”

paras.en: Each YANG mentee will rank industry-specific topics by preference to form mentorship circles. Examples of topics include:
paras.zh: 每个 YANG 学员都会根据偏好对特定行业主题进行排序，形成导师圈。主题示例包括：

paras.en: - Navigating change, building influence and earning your seat at the table
paras.zh: - 驾驭变革、建立影响力并赢得席位

paras.en: - Standing out and the importance of networking
paras.zh: - 脱颖而出和网络的重要性

paras.en: Each mentorship circle consists of approximately five mentees and one mentor focused on a unique topic.
paras.zh: 每个导师圈由大约五名学员和一名专注于某个独特主题的导师组成。

paras.en: Organizers will assign groups after registration closes Nov. 30. Participants will then join the YANG Mentorship Program kickoff meeting in January 2027. Each mentorship circle will meet once per quarter throughout 2027. The program runs from January through December 2027.
paras.zh: 组织者将在 11 月 30 日报名截止后分配小组。参与者随后将参加 2027 年 1 月举行的 YANG 导师计划启动会议。每个导师圈将在 2027 年每季度举行一次会议。该计划从 2027 年 1 月持续到 2027 年 12 月。

paras.en: The YANG Mentorship Program aims to help mentees experience all three YANG pillars: networking, professional development and giving back. Through this small-group mentorship program, mentees will benefit from the experience of automotive aftermarket veterans.
paras.zh: YANG 导师计划旨在帮助受训者体验 YANG 的所有三个支柱：网络、专业发展和回馈。通过这个小组辅导计划，学员将受益于汽车售后市场资深人士的经验。

paras.en: The program targets young automotive aftermarket professionals who want to advance their careers. It provides opportunities for members to focus on individual professional goals while developing the skills to become future leaders.
paras.zh: 该计划针对希望提升职业生涯的年轻汽车售后专业人士。它为会员提供了专注于个人职业目标的机会，同时培养成为未来领导者的技能。

articles.title: Up, Up and Awayyyy! Upselling and Cross-Selling at the Counter
articles.author: Thomas Dayton

paras.en: One of the ugliest stereotypes in our industry is that those of us behind the counter are simply a bunch of order-takers. There is a world of difference between a salesperson and an order-taker, and if you’re taking the time to read Counterman, I’m willing to bet that you aren’t just another order-taker. If you care enough to consider this a career, you’re already familiar with the value of upselling and the importance of add-on sales at the checkout counter.
paras.zh: 我们行业中最丑陋的刻板印象之一是，我们这些柜台后面的人只是一群接订单的人。销售人员和订单接受者之间存在天壤之别，如果您花时间阅读《Counterman》，我敢打赌您不仅仅是另一个订单接受者。如果您足够重视将其视为职业，那么您已经熟悉追加销售的价值以及收银台附加销售的重要性。

paras.en: For some retailers, those “add-on” sales take the form of impulse items at the counter or small items related to the repair, while others take a more holistic approach to the concept of increasing revenue per transaction. Make no mistake, revenue is the driving force behind the quotas and spiffs attached to these additional sales, but when applied correctly (and with a little finesse), upselling and/or cross-selling becomes both an effective sales tool and a time-saver for the customer.
paras.zh: 对于一些零售商来说，这些“附加”销售采取柜台冲动商品或与维修相关的小商品的形式，而其他零售商则采取更全面的方法来实现增加每笔交易收入的概念。毫无疑问，收入是这些额外销售所附带的配额和利润背后的驱动力，但如果应用得当（并且有一点技巧），追加销售和/或交叉销售既可以成为有效的销售工具，又可以为客户节省时间。

paras.en: It starts with understanding the complex association between the various systems of today’s automobile. I’ve often been guilty of thinking about parts as individual components rather than part of a larger ecosystem. I’m old, and “back in my day,” a lot of the parts we sold were a lot easier to get to without the need to disassemble half of the vehicle just to access them. Today’s crowded underhood environment means that replacing an alternator might require the technician to drain coolant or remove a CV axle just to access a few bolts. Increasingly, it also requires a special tool or three to extract the parts in need of replacement. Scenarios like that not only add unexpected labor to an otherwise straightforward repair, but may also lead to additional sales. The best time to suggest those supplemental parts and supplies is during the initial quote and sale, not after their vehicle is already scattered across the driveway outside of business hours. This version of a customer is in a considerably better mood, and more receptive to your suggestions than the one who just spent the afternoon struggling through a repair that still isn’t complete and is about to cost them more money than they anticipated!
paras.zh: 首先要了解当今汽车各个系统之间的复杂关联。我经常错误地将各个部分视为单独的组件，而不是更大生态系统的一部分。我老了，“回到我那个时代”，我们出售的许多零件都更容易获得，而不需要拆卸一半的车辆来获取它们。当今拥挤的引擎盖下环境意味着更换交流发电机可能需要技术人员排出冷却液或拆下CV轴才能检修几个螺栓。越来越多地，它还需要一个或三个特殊工具来提取需要更换的零件。类似的情况不仅给原本简单的维修增加了意想不到的劳动力，而且还可能带来额外的销售。建议这些补充零件和用品的最佳时间是在最初的报价和销售期间，而不是在工作时间之外他们的车辆已经散落在车道上之后。这个版本的客户心情要好得多，也比刚刚花了一个下午努力完成尚未完成的维修并且将花费比他们预期更多的钱的客户更容易接受您的建议！

paras.en: Labor-intensive repairs are an excellent time to upsell to a premium product. If a product saves time, has a longer service life, or includes associated components that might otherwise be overlooked, then those benefits help overcome many objections to price. Critical components, especially safety-related items, are another prime category for upselling. If the failure of a part is likely to cause catastrophic damage or compromise someone’s safety, it just isn’t worth skimping on quality. We don’t need to resort to scare tactics in order to sell our premium lines, but safety and security are important considerations for many buyers, so they become effective talking points when guiding a customer toward a particular product.
paras.zh: 劳动密集型维修是追加销售优质产品的绝佳时机。如果产品可以节省时间，具有更长的使用寿命，或者包含可能被忽视的相关组件，那么这些好处有助于克服对价格的许多反对意见。关键部件，尤其是与安全相关的部件，是追加销售的另一个主要类别。如果某个零件的故障可能会造成灾难性的损害或危及某人的安全，那么就不值得在质量上马虎。我们不需要采取恐吓策略来销售我们的优质产品，但安全和保障对于许多买家来说是重要的考虑因素，因此它们在引导客户购买特定产品时成为有效的话题。

paras.en: It is important to remember that potential up-sales and cross-sales should always benefit the customer first. Our customers’ continued confidence and trust will produce much more long-term profitability for our store than a series of one-off sales to customers who are put off by a pushy salesperson. You may be able to talk them into the current purchase, but they might think twice about making their next purchase with you, especially if their inflated expectations aren’t realized after the sale. Recommend only those items that will enhance the owner’s repair and ownership experience. Focus on adding value to the current purchase, not just adding zeroes to the invoice!
paras.zh: 重要的是要记住，潜在的追加销售和交叉销售应始终首先使客户受益。与那些被咄咄逼人的销售人员推迟的一系列一次性销售相比，客户持续的信心和信任将为我们的商店带来更多的长期盈利能力。您也许可以说服他们进行当前的购买，但他们可能会在下次与您一起购买时三思而后行，特别是如果他们夸大的期望在销售后没有实现的话。仅推荐那些能够增强车主的维修和拥有体验的物品。专注于为当前购买增值，而不仅仅是在发票上添加零！

articles.title: ‘Tis the Season: Forecasting for Demand
articles.author: Thomas Dayton

paras.en: Seasonal items present a unique challenge for purchasing and inventory specialists. While many of the products on our store shelves move at a steady and predictable rate throughout the year, seasonal items are confined to a narrower “window of opportunity” and are characterized by frequent or increased sales numbers within that window. An item with a steady demand throughout the year is a prime candidate for continuous restocking to maintain a ready supply on a daily basis. Seasonal items, on the other hand, will require an increased on-hand inventory level for only a brief period of time in order to maximize sales and profitability. Responding effectively to this temporary spike in demand requires a bit of planning and more than a bit of gambling.
paras.zh: 季节性商品对采购和库存专家提出了独特的挑战。虽然我们商店货架上的许多产品全年都以稳定且可预测的速度移动，但季节性商品仅限于较窄的“机会之窗”，其特点是该窗口内的销售数量频繁或增加。全年需求稳定的商品是持续补充库存以维持日常供应的主要候选商品。另一方面，季节性商品只需要在短时间内增加现有库存水平，即可最大限度地提高销售额和盈利能力。有效应对这种暂时的需求激增需要一些计划和一些赌博。

paras.en: Calculating demand for an individual SKU seems relatively simple, identifying the number of sales of that item within a set time period. Past performance helps us establish a base level for our immediate future needs. Extended out over time, that demand reveals sales patterns that indicate if sales of that SKU are growing, remaining steady, or falling off. We can use these patterns to adjust inventory levels, filling those needs as necessary to prevent out-of-stock situations as well as keeping overstock from chipping away at our profitability.
paras.zh: 计算单个 SKU 的需求似乎相对简单，只需确定该商品在设定时间段内的销售数量即可。过去的表现帮助我们为未来的需求奠定基础。随着时间的推移，这种需求揭示了销售模式，表明该 SKU 的销售额是增长、保持稳定还是下降。我们可以使用这些模式来调整库存水平，根据需要满足这些需求，以防止缺货情况，并防止库存过多削弱我们的盈利能力。

paras.en: Seasonal sales patterns will also reveal themselves, indicating the need for increased inventory volume for various products at certain times of the year. Forecasting the need for a particular item involves a number of factors. Lead time, availability, pricing and even weather predictions can have an effect on when to place these seasonal orders and how many of any particular SKU you expect to sell during that season. Unfortunately, political and economic factors can also influence the pricing and availability of our products. Many of us have seen the debilitating effects of the First Brands bankruptcy firsthand, as well as the widespread supply constraints throughout the petroleum industry. This has created shortages of product at the store level, and higher prices for most consumer goods through increased fuel costs. It not only affects our ability as vendors to plan ahead, but also the willingness of consumers to make purchases.
paras.zh: 季节性销售模式也会显现出来，表明在一年中的某些时间需要增加各种产品的库存量。预测特定物品的需求涉及许多因素。交货时间、供货情况、定价甚至天气预报都会影响何时下这些季节性订单以及您预计在该季节销售的任何特定 SKU 的数量。不幸的是，政治和经济因素也会影响我们产品的定价和可用性。我们中的许多人都亲眼目睹了第一品牌破产的破坏性影响，以及整个石油行业普遍存在的供应限制。这导致商店一级的产品短缺，并且由于燃料成本增加，大多数消费品的价格上涨。它不仅影响我们作为供应商提前计划的能力，也影响消费者的购买意愿。

paras.en: Forecasting remains our best defense against empty shelves when demand is at its peak, or a back room filled with overstock at the tail end of the rush. Recognizing seasonality on individual SKUs, even those we don’t normally consider “seasonal goods” allows us to anticipate increased demand before an item is needed, and to stock those additional items only when that demand justifies the extra expense. It should be proactive, rather than reactive. We’ve all seen the news reports of “panic buying” in the days leading up to a blizzard, hurricane, or other crisis, and we’re unlikely to forget the misery of trying to find N95 masks, toilet paper, and hand sanitizer during a pandemic. The time to build an ark is before the flood.
paras.zh: 预测仍然是我们应对需求高峰时货架空空，或高峰期末期库存积压的最佳防御手段。认识到单个 SKU 的季节性，即使是那些我们通常不认为是“季节性商品”的商品，也能让我们在需要某件商品之前预测需求的增加，并仅在该需求足以证明额外费用合理时才储存这些额外商品。它应该是主动的，而不是被动的。我们都看过暴风雪、飓风或其他危机前几天“抢购”的新闻报道，我们不太可能忘记在大流行期间试图找到 N95 口罩、卫生纸和洗手液的痛苦。建造方舟的时间是在洪水之前。

paras.en: Many tend to think of seasonal items in terms of winter, spring, summer, or fall goods, but there are a wide range of other “seasons” that can boost sales across product lines or even individual SKUs. The local racing season, planting and harvest times in rural markets, snowmobiling, boating, and RV travel seasons all represent opportunities to present those niche products others have overlooked. Those obvious categories like snowplow parts, lawn and garden or air conditioning parts have well-established seasonality, but determining the timing and duration of those seasons is becoming more of a moving target. Retailers can count on fixed “selling seasons” leading up to holidays like Halloween and Christmas, or the triple-threat of Black Friday, Small Business Saturday, and Cyber Monday. We can’t plan sales around “the first major snowfall” or “hottest week of the year” in quite the same way, but keeping tabs on recurring sales trends certainly allows us to maximize the effectiveness of our inventories throughout the year.
paras.zh: 许多人倾向于将季节性商品视为冬季、春季、夏季或秋季商品，但还有许多其他“季节”可以促进整个产品线甚至单个 SKU 的销售。当地的赛车季节、农村市场的种植和收获时间、雪地摩托、划船和房车旅行季节都代表了展示其他人忽视的利基产品的机会。那些明显的类别，如扫雪机零件、草坪和花园或空调零件，具有明确的季节性，但确定这些季节的时间和持续时间正变得越来越成为一个不断变化的目标。零售商可以依靠万圣节和圣诞节等假期之前的固定“销售季节”，或黑色星期五、小型企业星期六和网络星期一的三重威胁。我们无法以完全相同的方式围绕“第一场大雪”或“一年中最热的一周”计划销售，但密切关注经常性的销售趋势无疑使我们能够最大限度地提高全年库存的效率。

articles.title: Gold, weapons or a 'Rosetta stone': Which archaeological treasure would you most like to discover?
articles.author: Kenna Hughes-Castleberry

paras.en: Archaeological discoveries can offer remarkable insights into the lives, cultures and beliefs of ancient peoples. From richly furnished royal tombs to caches of silver coins, some of the most significant finds have revealed how people lived, traded, fought, governed and died thousands of years ago.
paras.zh: 考古发现可以为了解古代人民的生活、文化和信仰提供非凡的见解。从装饰华丽的皇家陵墓到藏匿的银币，一些最重要的发现揭示了数千年前人们的生活、贸易、战争、统治和死亡方式。

paras.en: - 'Links with the British royal family would eventually prove crucial': How DNA solved the 70-year mystery of what happened to the executed members of the last Russian imperial family
paras.zh: -“与英国王室的联系最终将被证明至关重要”：DNA 如何解开 70 年来最后一位俄罗斯皇室被处决成员遭遇的谜团

paras.en: - Ghostly 'sand body' double burial unearthed at Sutton Hoo
paras.zh: - 萨顿胡出土的幽灵“沙体”双层墓葬

paras.en: - 2,600-year-old inscription in Turkey finally deciphered — and it mentions goddess known 'simply as the Mother'
paras.zh: - 土耳其 2600 年前的铭文终于被破译，其中提到了“简称为母亲”的女神

paras.en: Other discoveries stand out for their extraordinary preservation or historical significance. For example, the most expensive shipwreck on record — the 300-year-old Spanish galleon San José that's worth an estimated $17 billion — was found off the coast of Colombia in 2015 and continues to inform archaeologists and challenge governments that can't agree about its modern ownership. Meanwhile, ancient texts can provide invaluable clues about long-lost languages and civilizations. The Rosetta stone opened up the world of ancient Egypt to scholars, but researchers are still trying to decipher the mysterious Indus Valley script, one of the world's earliest urban civilizations.
paras.zh: 其他发现因其非凡的保存或历史意义而脱颖而出。例如，有记录以来最昂贵的沉船——拥有 300 年历史的西班牙大帆船圣何塞号，估计价值 170 亿美元——于 2015 年在哥伦比亚海岸被发现，并继续为考古学家提供信息，并挑战那些无法就其现代所有权达成一致的政府。与此同时，古代文献可以提供有关失落已久的语言和文明的宝贵线索。罗塞塔石碑为学者们打开了古埃及的世界，但研究人员仍在试图破译神秘的印度河流域文字，这是世界上最早的城市文明之一。

paras.en: Each type of discovery offers a new window to the ancient world. But which of these archaeological treasures would you most want to uncover? Vote in the poll below and let us know your thoughts in the comments.
paras.zh: 每种类型的发现都为了解古代世界提供了新的窗口。但您最想揭开这些考古宝藏中的哪一个呢？在下面的投票中投票，并在评论中让我们知道您的想法。

paras.en: Kenna Hughes-Castleberry is the Content Manager at Live Science. Formerly, she was the Content Manager at Space.com and before that the Science Communicator at JILA, a physics research institute. Kenna is also a book author, with her upcoming book 'Octopus X' scheduled for release in spring of 2027. Her beats include physics, health, environmental science, technology, AI, animal intelligence, corvids, and cephalopods.
paras.zh: Kenna Hughes-Castleberry 是 Live Science 的内容经理。此前，她曾担任 Space.com 的内容经理，此前曾担任物理研究所 JILA 的科学传播员。肯纳还是一名书籍作者，她即将出版的新书《章鱼 X》计划于 2027 年春季发行。她的研究领域包括物理、健康、环境科学、技术、人工智能、动物智能、鸦科动物和头足类动物。

articles.title: BepiColombo spacecraft becomes 2nd-ever mission to orbit Mercury — and it will soon split in two
articles.author: Brandon Specktor

paras.en: After eight years slingshotting around the inner solar system, the joint European-Japanese spacecraft BepiColombo has finally entered into orbit around Mercury — becoming only the second mission ever to orbit the closest planet to the sun.
paras.zh: 经过八年在内太阳系的弹射后，欧洲和日本联合航天器 BepiColombo 终于进入绕水星的轨道——成为有史以来第二个绕离太阳最近的行星运行的任务。

paras.en: Mission scientists confirmed on Saturday (Nov. 21) that the spacecraft reached Mercury's orbit and is transmitting data back to the ground team.
paras.zh: 任务科学家于周六（11 月 21 日）证实，航天器已到达水星轨道，并将数据传回地面团队。

paras.en: However, the orbital insertion didn't go entirely as planned, European Space Agency (ESA) representatives said in a statement on Monday. Due to a software glitch, the spacecraft didn't fire its thrusters for the full 37 minutes required to slow its approach to Mercury.
paras.zh: 然而，欧洲航天局（ESA）代表周一在一份声明中表示，轨道插入并未完全按计划进行。由于软件故障，航天器在减缓接近水星速度所需的整整 37 分钟内都没有启动推进器。

paras.en: While ESA investigates the issue and what it means for the spacecraft's trajectory, BepiColombo remains "safe," the statement noted. The spacecraft will hopefully be ready to begin a year of intensive science observations of Mercury starting a few months from now.
paras.zh: 声明指出，虽然欧空局正在调查这个问题及其对航天器轨道的影响，但贝皮科伦坡仍然“安全”。该航天器有望在几个月后开始对水星进行为期一年的密集科学观测。

paras.en: Built jointly by ESA and the Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency (JAXA), BepiColombo is actually two separate probes, which are currently stacked one atop the other in orbit. The ESA-built orbiter, named the Mercury Planetary Orbiter (MPO), and the JAXA-built orbiter, the Mercury Magnetospheric Orbiter (Mio), carry separate science instruments, and they will soon diverge into separate orbital paths around the mysterious inner planet, operating as two probes gathering different streams of data.
paras.zh: BepiColombo 由欧空局和日本宇宙航空研究开发机构 (JAXA) 联合建造，实际上是两个独立的探测器，目前在轨道上一个叠放在另一个探测器上。欧洲航天局建造的轨道飞行器，名为水星行星轨道飞行器（MPO），和日本宇宙航空研究开发机构建造的轨道飞行器，水星磁层轨道飞行器（Mio），携带着独立的科学仪器，它们很快将分成围绕神秘内行星的不同轨道路径，作为两个收集不同数据流的探测器运行。

paras.en: The pair of probes launched together aboard an Ariane 5 rocket in October 2018, and spent the following eight years on an interplanetary journey that took them past Earth, the moon and Venus. It even passed by Mercury itself six times. (During one of these flybys, in January 2025, Bepi snapped an incredible closeup photo of Mercury's north pole.)
paras.zh: 这对探测器于 2018 年 10 月一起搭载阿丽亚娜 5 号火箭发射升空，并在接下来的八年里进行了星际旅行，飞越了地球、月球和金星。它甚至六次掠过水星本身。 （在 2025 年 1 月的一次飞越过程中，贝皮拍摄了一张令人难以置信的水星北极特写照片。）

paras.en: This complicated cosmic choreography was necessary to prevent BepiColombo from picking up too much speed and overshooting Mercury's orbit, according to ESA. Mercury sits about 36 million miles (58 million kilometers) from our star, or roughly one third of the distance between Earth and the sun. That makes it very difficult for a spacecraft to reach Mercury without being captured by the sun's considerable gravitational pull and dragged off course.
paras.zh: 据欧空局称，这种复杂的宇宙编排对于防止贝皮科伦坡速度过快并超出水星轨道是必要的。水星距我们的恒星约 3600 万英里（5800 万公里），大约是地球与太阳之间距离的三分之一。这使得航天器很难在不被太阳巨大引力捕获并偏离轨道的情况下到达水星。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: Only one other spacecraft — NASA's MESSENGER probe — has succeeded in entering Mercury orbit before, circling the planet from 2011 to 2015 after its own seven-year journey through space.
paras.zh: 只有另外一艘航天器——美国宇航局的信使号探测器——此前曾成功进入水星轨道，在经历了七年的太空之旅后，它于 2011 年至 2015 年环绕水星运行。

paras.en: Assuming ESA determines that BepiColombo is fit to continue its mission as planned, then it will spend the next few months getting both probes in position to start mapping Mercury in the greatest detail ever.
paras.zh: 假设欧空局确定贝皮科伦坡号适合按计划继续其任务，那么它将在接下来的几个月内让两个探测器就位，开始绘制有史以来最详细的水星地图。

paras.en: MPO and Mio are expected to separate in early December, with Mio entering a highly elliptical orbit around Mercury's poles. MPO will then take a few more months to fine-tune its trajectory, reaching a lower and more circular polar orbit in March 2027, according to ESA. Its science operations are expected to begin in April.
paras.zh: MPO 和 Mio 预计将于 12 月初分离，Mio 进入围绕水星两极的高椭圆轨道。据 ESA 称，MPO 将再花几个月的时间来微调其轨道，并于 2027 年 3 月达到更低、更圆的极地轨道。其科学运作预计将于四月开始。

paras.en: The sibling probes will each orbit Mercury several times a day, with MPO completing an orbit every 2 hours or so. Observing the mysterious inner planet from several different vantage points, the probes will make the most comprehensive map of Mercury ever. The mission's suite of science instruments will study the planet across the electromagnetic spectrum, taking observations in X-rays, gamma-rays and ultraviolet light, as well as collecting detailed measurements of the planet's magnetic field.
paras.zh: 兄弟探测器每天将绕水星运行数次，MPO 每 2 小时左右绕行一周。探测器从几个不同的有利位置观察这颗神秘的内行星，将绘制出迄今为止最全面的水星地图。该任务的科学仪器套件将通过电磁波谱研究行星，进行 X 射线、伽马射线和紫外线观测，并收集行星磁场的详细测量结果。

paras.en: With this information, scientists hope to unravel many mysteries of the least-explored planet in the solar system. The new data should enable scientists to tackle myriad long-standing questions: What is Mercury's interior made of, and where does its magnetic field come from? How was the planet formed, and to what extent is it still tectonically active today? By making precise measurements of the spacecraft's orbit and position, a radio experiment will also provide a new test of Einstein's theory of general relativity.
paras.zh: 借助这些信息，科学家们希望能够解开太阳系中探索最少的行星的许多谜团。新数据应该能够帮助科学家解决无数长期存在的问题：水星的内部是由什么构成的，它的磁场从何而来？这颗行星是如何形成的？今天它的构造活动在多大程度上仍然活跃？通过对航天器的轨道和位置进行精确测量，无线电实验还将为爱因斯坦的广义相对论提供新的检验。

paras.en: Stay tuned for more updates from ESA about humanity's first visit to Mercury in more than a decade.
paras.zh: 请继续关注欧空局关于人类十多年来首次访问水星的更多更新。

paras.en: Brandon is the space / physics editor at Live Science. With more than 20 years of editorial experience, his writing has appeared in The Washington Post, Reader's Digest, CBS.com, the Richard Dawkins Foundation website and other outlets. He holds a bachelor's degree in creative writing from the University of Arizona, with minors in journalism and media arts. His interests include black holes, asteroids and comets, and the search for extraterrestrial life.
paras.zh: 布兰登是《Live Science》的空间/物理编辑。凭借 20 多年的编辑经验，他的文章曾发表在《华盛顿邮报》、《读者文摘》、CBS.com、理查德·道金斯基金会网站和其他媒体上。他拥有亚利桑那大学创意写作学士学位，辅修新闻学和媒体艺术。他的兴趣包括黑洞、小行星和彗星，以及寻找外星生命。

articles.title: What Can 300 Years of European Portraits Reveal About Evolving Beauty Standards?

paras.en: Long before the invention of photography, wealthy Europeans commissioned portraits to preserve their likenesses for posterity. But portraits aren’t necessarily faithful reproductions of reality. Like photos, they can be manipulated to accentuate flattering features, portraying subjects as they wish to be seen.
paras.zh: 早在摄影术发明之前，富有的欧洲人就委托拍摄肖像来为子孙后代保存自己的肖像。但肖像不一定是现实的忠实再现。就像照片一样，它们可以被操纵来突出迷人的特征，以他们希望被看到的方式描绘主题。

paras.en: As it happens, those choices can tell us a great deal about how ideal beauty standards have evolved over time. According to a study published last week in the journal Proceedings of the Royal Society B, historic portraits serve as “cognitive fossils” that shed new light on “historical shifts in psychological preferences and reproductive strategies.”
paras.zh: 事实上，这些选择可以告诉我们很多关于理想的美容标准如何随着时间的推移而演变的信息。根据上周发表在《英国皇家学会学报 B》杂志上的一项研究，历史肖像作为“认知化石”，为“心理偏好和生殖策略的历史转变”提供了新的线索。

paras.en: “They cover a much longer timespan than photographs, which allows us to observe changes across several centuries,” lead author Jeanne Bovet, a behavioral scientist at England’s Northumbria University, tells El País’ Miguel Ángel Criado. “They were created to be seen by others—suitors, relatives, society—and therefore reflect the messages people wanted to convey.”
paras.zh: “它们涵盖的时间跨度比照片长得多，这使我们能够观察几个世纪以来的变化，”主要作者、英国诺森比亚大学的行为科学家珍妮·博韦特 (Jeanne Bovet) 告诉国家报的米格尔·安赫尔·克里亚多 (Miguel Ángel Criado)。 “它们的创建是为了让其他人——追求者、亲戚、社会——看到，因此反映了人们想要传达的信息。”

paras.en: The researchers analyzed 606 women in 486 European portraits created between 1650 and 1950. They then recruited roughly 1,500 participants to assess various aspects of the subjects’ appearances. One group received cropped images of subjects’ faces and guessed their ages, while another group rated their attractiveness. A third group estimated each woman’s waist-to-hip ratio by examining full portraits with blurred-out faces.
paras.zh: 研究人员分析了 1650 年至 1950 年间创作的 486 幅欧洲肖像画中的 606 名女性。然后，他们招募了大约 1,500 名参与者来评估受试者外貌的各个方面。一组收到受试者脸部的裁剪图像并猜测他们的年龄，而另一组则评估他们的吸引力。第三组通过检查脸部模糊的完整肖像来估计每个女性的腰臀比。

paras.en: Waist-to-hip ratio is calculated by dividing someone’s waist circumference by their hip circumference. Women with lower ratios have more of an hourglass shape, with larger hips and smaller waists, while those with higher ratios have a straighter silhouette.
paras.zh: 腰臀比是通过将某人的腰围除以臀围来计算的。比例较低的女性更倾向于沙漏型身材，臀部较大，腰部较小，而比例较高的女性则有更直的轮廓。

paras.en: - In 2019, a study published in the journal Archives of Sexual Behavior found that the contrapposto pose—standing with weight shifted onto one leg—can lower perceived waist-to-hip ratio.
paras.zh: - 2019 年，发表在《性行为档案》杂志上的一项研究发现，反向姿势（站立并将重量转移到一条腿上）可以降低腰臀比。

paras.en: - This pose appears in many famous artworks, from Sandro Botticelli’s Birth of Venus (circa 1485) to Michelangelo’s David (1504).
paras.zh: - 这个姿势出现在许多著名的艺术作品中，从桑德罗·波提切利的《维纳斯的诞生》（约 1485 年）到米开朗基罗的《大卫》（1504 年）。

paras.en: The researchers found that subjects’ perceived waist-to-hip ratios have increased over time. “We confirmed an upward trend across those three centuries, although there were fluctuations,” Bovet tells El País. Ratios bottomed out in the mid-18th century, which produced works like The Souvenir (circa 1776-78) by Jean-Honoré Fragonard, a French Rococo painter. The painting depicts a woman in a light pink dress, cinched tightly around the waist. Her perceived waist-to-hip ratio was 0.51.
paras.zh: 研究人员发现，随着时间的推移，受试者感知到的腰臀比有所增加。 “我们证实了这三个世纪的上升趋势，尽管存在波动，”播维告诉《国家报》。比率在 18 世纪中叶触底，出现了法国洛可可画家让-奥诺雷·弗拉戈纳尔 (Jean-Honoré Fragonard) 的《纪念品》（约 1776-78 年）等作品。这幅画描绘了一个穿着浅粉色连衣裙的女人，腰间紧紧地系着。她的感知腰臀比为 0.51。

paras.en: A century later, the French artist Pierre-Paul-Léon Glaize created Before the Mirror (1873), which depicts a woman in a looser gown that isn’t fitted to accentuate her curves. Raters estimated this subject’s waist-to-hip ratio at 0.72.
paras.zh: 一个世纪后，法国艺术家皮埃尔-保罗-莱昂·格莱兹 (Pierre-Paul-Léon Glaize) 创作了《镜前》(Before the Mirror)（1873 年），画中描绘了一位穿着宽松礼服的女性，礼服不合身，无法凸显她的曲线。评估者估计该受试者的腰臀比为 0.72。

paras.en: What drove this evolution? The study’s authors explain that lower waist-to-hip ratios are traditionally linked to youth and fertility. “Evolutionary psychologists have proposed that a preference for a low [waist-to-hip ratio], or a more hourglass-shaped silhouette, might reflect a preference for more fertile partners,” Bovet tells Science magazine’s Jack Tamisiea.
paras.zh: 是什么推动了这种演变？该研究的作者解释说，较低的腰臀比传统上与年轻和生育能力有关。 “进化心理学家提出，对低腰臀比或沙漏形轮廓的偏好可能反映出对生育能力更强的伴侣的偏好，”播维告诉《科学》杂志的杰克·塔米西亚。

paras.en: The researchers think that the upward trend may be connected to other societal shifts during this 300-year period. Women began having children at older ages—and having fewer children overall. Infant mortality declined, and women spent more time pursuing education.
paras.zh: 研究人员认为，这种上升趋势可能与这 300 年间的其他社会转变有关。女性开始生孩子的年龄较大，而且总体上生孩子的数量较少。婴儿死亡率下降，女性花更多时间接受教育。

paras.en: According to the raters, subjects in later portraits also appeared to be older. While women’s waist-to-hip ratios do increase with age, the upward trend in ratios persisted even when researchers controlled for perceived facial age. Perceived body weight, meanwhile, remained relatively stable.
paras.zh: 据评估者称，后来的肖像画中的拍摄对象似乎也更老了。虽然女性的腰臀比确实随着年龄的增长而增加，但即使研究人员控制了感知的面部年龄，比例的上升趋势仍然持续。与此同时，感知体重保持相对稳定。

paras.en: “Women’s education kept rising during that time, but models’ proportions barely changed,” he tells Science. “To me, that suggests the fashion industry itself shapes its body ideals at least as much as social change does.”
paras.zh: “在那段时间里，女性的教育程度不断提高，但模特的比例几乎没有变化，”他告诉《科学》杂志。 “对我来说，这表明时尚业本身对身体理想的塑造至少与社会变革一样多。”

articles.title: Look Up This Week to See November's Full Beaver Moon—the First of Four Back-to-Back Supermoons Over the Coming Months

paras.en: We’re in for a dazzling treat over the next few months. Four consecutive supermoons will grace our skies from November through February. The second in the series—and the last of 2026—will fall on Christmas Eve and represents the closest full moon to Earth since 2018, according to Live Science’s Jamie Carter.
paras.zh: 在接下来的几个月里，我们将迎来一场令人眼花缭乱的盛宴。从十一月到二月，连续四次超级月亮将为我们的天空增光添彩。据 Live Science 的杰米·卡特 (Jamie Carter) 称，该系列中的第二颗满月，也是 2026 年的最后一颗满月，将于圣诞节前夕发生，这是自 2018 年以来距离地球最近的满月。

paras.en: The supermoon sequence starts with this month’s full moon on the 24th, which will reach peak illumination at 9:53 a.m. Eastern time. The orb won’t be visible from North America then, so the best time to see it is after sunset on the day before or day of. The next supermoons in the spectacular series will take place on December 24, January 22 and February 20, according to AstroPixels.com, a website by the late astrophysicist Fred Espenak.
paras.zh: 超级月亮序列从本月 24 日的满月开始，将于东部时间上午 9:53 达到峰值亮度。届时从北美将看不到该球体，因此观看它的最佳时间是前一天或当天的日落之后。据已故天体物理学家 Fred Espenak 的网站 AstroPixels.com 称，这一壮观系列的下一次超级月亮将于 12 月 24 日、1 月 22 日和 2 月 20 日发生。

paras.en: The moon’s 27-day orbit around our planet is shaped like an oval, which means it drifts closer and farther from us as it transitions through its phases. The closest point along its orbital path, or perigee, is around 226,000 miles from Earth, while its farthest point, or apogee, is around 251,000 miles away.
paras.zh: 月球绕地球运行 27 天的轨道形状像一个椭圆形，这意味着它随着相位的转变，离我们越来越近。其轨道路径上的最近点（或近地点）距地球约 226,000 英里，而最远点（或远地点）距地球约 251,000 英里。

paras.en: When perigee roughly “coincides with a full moon, it is called a supermoon,” Devon Salasin, head astronomer and site manager at Stargazing Moab, tells National Geographic’s Stefanie Waldek. In other words, a supermoon is a full moon that occurs when the moon is near its closest point to Earth.
paras.zh: 当近地点大致“与满月重合时，它被称为超级月亮”，观星摩押的首席天文学家兼现场经理德文·萨拉辛（Devon Salasin）告诉国家地理杂志的斯蒂芬妮·瓦尔德克（Stefanie Waldek）。换句话说，超级月亮是当月球接近地球最近点时发生的满月。

paras.en: While the term suggests an impressive celestial display, a supermoon is actually only 7 percent bigger than an average full moon, according to Josh Morley at the Farmer’s Almanac. It can look up to 14 percent brighter and 30 percent bigger than the faintest moon of the year, which happens at apogee. However, skywatchers probably won’t notice a difference if viewing our celestial companion with the naked eye.
paras.zh: 根据《农民年鉴》的乔什·莫利 (Josh Morley) 的说法，虽然这个词暗示着令人印象深刻的天象，但超级月亮实际上只比普通满月大 7%。它看起来比一年中最暗的月亮（发生在远地点）亮 14%，大 30%。然而，如果用肉眼观察我们的天体同伴，天文观察者可能不会注意到任何差异。

paras.en: Additionally, supermoon is not an official astronomical term, so which moons count as one depends on who you ask. According to NASA and the Royal Observatory Greenwich in London, a supermoon is a full moon that occurs within 10 percent of perigee. Some astronomers have stricter guidelines, however, saying that supermoons only occur when the moon is within about 223,694 miles of Earth, says Carys Herbert, an astronomer at the Royal Observatory Greenwich, to BBC Newsround.
paras.zh: 此外，超级月亮并不是一个官方的天文学术语，因此哪些卫星算作超级月亮取决于你问的是谁。根据美国国家航空航天局 (NASA) 和伦敦格林威治皇家天文台的说法，超级月亮是指发生在近地点 10% 范围内的满月。然而，格林威治皇家天文台的天文学家卡里斯·赫伯特 (Carys Herbert) 向 BBC Newsround 表示，一些天文学家制定了更严格的指导方针，称只有当月球距离地球约 223,694 英里时，才会出现超级月亮。

paras.en: November’s full moon will be 224,171 miles away from Earth; December’s will be 221,668 miles away; January’s will be 222,230 miles away; and February’s will be 225,748 miles away. Some astronomers using the more rigid definition don’t consider the last one to be a supermoon.
paras.zh: 11 月的满月将距离地球 224,171 英里； 12 月的距离为 221,668 英里；一月的距离为 222,230 英里； 2 月的距离为 225,748 英里。一些使用更严格定义的天文学家不认为最后一个是超级月亮。

paras.en: Which guidance you follow also determines just how rare the December 24 supermoon is.
paras.zh: 您遵循的指南也决定了 12 月 24 日超级月亮的罕见程度。

paras.en: “Taking the stricter definition, the most recent Christmas Eve full moon perigee was 1787, but with the more generous definition which appears to increasingly be the standard, then this also occurred in 2007 and 1912,” Herbert tells BBC Newsround.
paras.zh: “按照更严格的定义，最近的圣诞夜满月近地点是 1787 年，但随着更宽松的定义似乎越来越成为标准，那么这也发生在 2007 年和 1912 年，”赫伯特告诉 BBC Newsround。

paras.en: Whether or not it’s a supermoon, November’s full moon is always dubbed the “beaver” moon. During this month, the furry animals reinforce their lodges and dams for winter, which is a popular Algonquin and colonial explanation for the name, according to Daniel Higgins at the Farmer’s Almanac. Another possible reason is that November kicks off trapping season: It’s cold enough for the large rodents to have grown their thick winter coats, but there’s little snow on the ground to get in trappers’ way.
paras.zh: 无论是否是超级月亮，十一月的满月总是被称为“海狸”月亮。根据《农民年鉴》中的丹尼尔·希金斯的说法，在这个月里，毛茸茸的动物会加固它们的小屋和水坝过冬，这是阿尔冈昆和殖民时期对这个名字的流行解释。另一个可能的原因是十一月开始了诱捕季节：天气足够冷，大型啮齿类动物已经长出了厚厚的冬毛，但地面上的积雪很少，无法妨碍诱捕者。

paras.en: Tomorrow’s celestial event might get in the way of Thanksgiving travel, unfortunately. The alignment of the sun, Earth and moon produces full moons that cause a greater difference between high and low tides than usual, meteorologist Brian Lada writes for AccuWeather. The effect can be stronger when full moons are closer to Earth, so the beaver moon might contribute to coastal flooding just before the holiday.
paras.zh: 不幸的是，明天的天体活动可能会妨碍感恩节旅行。气象学家布赖恩·拉达 (Brian Lada) 为 AccuWeather 撰文，太阳、地球和月球的排列产生了满月，导致涨潮和低潮之间的差异比平常更大。当满月距离地球较近时，这种影响可能会更强，因此海狸月可能会在假期前导致沿海洪水。

articles.title: Peggy Guggenheim's First Art Gallery Lasted Just 18 Months. But Its 21 Exhibitions Showed a Multitude of Modern Art Masterpieces

paras.en: Long before Peggy Guggenheim became synonymous with her palazzo art museum on Venice’s Grand Canal, she launched her art collecting career in a modest storefront on London’s Cork Street. Between January 1938 and June 1939, her short-lived gallery, Guggenheim Jeune, introduced skeptical British audiences to radical European modernism and laid the groundwork for one of the 20th century’s most influential art collections.
paras.zh: 早在佩吉·古根海姆成为威尼斯大运河上的宫殿艺术博物馆的代名词之前，她就在伦敦科克街的一家不起眼的店面开始了自己的艺术收藏生涯。 1938 年 1 月至 1939 年 6 月期间，她的短命画廊古根海姆·杰恩 (Guggenheim Jeune) 向持怀疑态度的英国观众介绍了激进的欧洲现代主义，并为 20 世纪最有影响力的艺术收藏之一奠定了基础。

paras.en: Now, a new exhibition at London’s Royal Academy of Arts, “Peggy Guggenheim in London: The Making of a Collector,” brings together more than 80 artworks and archival artifacts to re-examine that pivotal 18-month chapter. Running through March 14, 2027, after an earlier stint in Venice, the show argues that Guggenheim’s prewar London venture has been unfairly overshadowed by her later fame and sensationalized personal life.
paras.zh: 现在，伦敦皇家艺术学院举办的新展览“佩吉·古​​根海姆在伦敦：收藏家的成长”汇集了 80 多件艺术品和档案文物，重新审视这长达 18 个月的关键篇章。该剧在威尼斯短暂停留后，一直持续到 2027 年 3 月 14 日，该剧认为，古根海姆战前在伦敦的事业不公平地被她后来的名声和耸人听闻的个人生活所掩盖。

paras.en: “I think she’s been underrated,” Gražina Subelytė, a curator at the Peggy Guggenheim Collection in Venice and a co-curator of the London exhibition tells the BBC’s Cath Pound. “People talk so much about her relationships, all the advisors who helped her make decisions, but Peggy was really groundbreaking herself.”
paras.zh: “我认为她被低估了，”威尼斯佩吉·古根海姆美术馆馆长、伦敦展览的联合策展人格拉齐娜·苏贝利特 (Gražina Subelytė) 告诉英国广播公司 (BBC) 的凯思·庞德 (Cath Pound)。 “人们谈论了很多她的人际关系，以及所有帮助她做出决定的顾问，但佩吉本人确实具有开创性。”

paras.en: Born in New York in 1898, Guggenheim grew up on the fringes of immense family wealth; her father, Benjamin Guggenheim, squandered much of his fortune before dying aboard the Titanic in 1912. Eager to escape upper-crust convention, she volunteered in her youth at New York’s woman-owned, avant-garde Sunwise Turn Bookshop, an experience that showed her how “a woman could do something extremely creative and independent,” Simon Grant, co-curator of the exhibition, tells the BBC.
paras.zh: 古根海姆 1898 年出生于纽约，在巨大的家庭财富的边缘长大。她的父亲本杰明·古根海姆 (Benjamin Guggenheim) 于 1912 年在泰坦尼克号上去世前挥霍了自己的大部分财产。为了摆脱上流社会的传统，她年轻时曾在纽约女性拥有的前卫 Sunwise Turn 书店做志愿者，这次经历向她展示了如何“一个女人可以做一些极具创意和独立的事情”，展览联合策展人西蒙·格兰特 (Simon Grant) 告诉 BBC。

paras.en: Guggenheim consorted with major figures in the creative world, who helped shape her views on abstraction and modern art. During a trip to Paris, Irish playwright Samuel Beckett urged her to devote herself to contemporary art as “a living thing,” per the BBC. Marcel Duchamp tutored her on the nuances of abstraction and surrealism, the Guardian’s Olivia McEwan reports. In 1937, a $450,000 inheritance (around $5 million today) following her mother’s death gave the 39-year-old Guggenheim the means to act.
paras.zh: 古根海姆与创意界的主要人物交往，他们帮助塑造了她对抽象和现代艺术的看法。据英国广播公司报道，在巴黎之行期间，爱尔兰剧作家塞缪尔·贝克特敦促她将当代艺术视为“有生命的事物”投身其中。据《卫报》的奥利维亚·麦克尤恩报道，马塞尔·杜尚指导她了解抽象和超现实主义的细微差别。 1937 年，39 岁的古根海姆在母亲去世后得到了 45 万美元的遗产（如今约为 500 万美元），这为她提供了采取行动的手段。

paras.en: Peggy Guggenheim’s uncle, Solomon R. Guggenheim, commissioned architect Frank Lloyd Wright to design a museum in New York City for his vast art collection. Sixteen years later, the Solomon R. Guggenheim Museum opened its doors.
paras.zh: 佩吉·古根海姆的叔叔所罗门·R·古根海姆委托建筑师弗兰克·劳埃德·赖特在纽约市为其庞大的艺术收藏品设计一座博物馆。十六年后，所罗门·R·古根海姆博物馆开门迎客。

paras.en: - Peggy was unwilling to have the works she collected be shown at what she called “my uncle’s garage, that Frank Lloyd Wright thing on Fifth Avenue.”
paras.zh: - 佩吉不愿意让她收集的作品在她所说的“我叔叔的车库，第五大道上弗兰克·劳埃德·赖特的车库”展出。

paras.en: Back in London, influential British art historian and critic Herbert Read served as Guggenheim’s “general galvanizer” in shaking up the Mayfair gallery scene, the London Times’ Laura Freeman writes. Gallery manager Winifred “Wyn” Henderson secured the 30 Cork Street premises and tapped her professional network ahead of the January 1938 opening.
paras.zh: 《伦敦时报》的劳拉·弗里曼 (Laura Freeman) 写道，回到伦敦后，颇具影响力的英国艺术史学家和评论家赫伯特·里德 (Herbert Read) 成为古根海姆的“总动员”，撼动了梅​​菲尔区的画廊界。画廊经理 Winifred “Wyn” Henderson 在 1938 年 1 月开业之前锁定了科克街 30 号的场地，并利用了她的专业网络。

paras.en: Over the next year and a half, the gallery staged 21 exhibitions. It hosted the United Kingdom’s first solo shows for Jean Cocteau, Wassily Kandinsky and Yves Tanguy, who also painted a pair of tiny shell-and-pearl earrings for Guggenheim with miniature surrealist works, according to a statement. Other shows spotlighted women artists and children’s art—including a painting by a teenage Lucian Freud.
paras.zh: 在接下来的一年半里，画廊举办了 21 场展览。据一份声明称，这里举办了让·谷克托 (Jean Cocteau)、瓦西里·康定斯基 (Wassily Kandinsky) 和伊夫·唐吉 (Yves Tanguy) 在英国的首次个展，他们还为古根海姆 (Guggenheim) 创作了一对带有超现实主义微型作品的小型贝壳珍珠耳环。其他展览则重点关注女性艺术家和儿童艺术，其中包括青少年卢西恩·弗洛伊德的画作。

paras.en: “Guggenheim Jeune is where Peggy Guggenheim defined herself through action: exhibiting, taking risks, and forming friendships with artists,” Subelytė and Grant tell Wallpaper’s Hannah Silver.
paras.zh: “古根海姆青年号是佩吉·古根海姆通过行动定义自己的地方：展览、冒险以及与艺术家建立友谊，”苏贝利特和格兰特告诉《壁纸》的汉娜·西尔弗。

paras.en: Those risks frequently collided with British institutional conservatism. When Guggenheim imported sculptures by Constantin Brâncuși, Jean Arp and Henry Moore for a group show, British customs officials refused to recognize the abstract works as art and moved to tax them as raw stone. Tate director J.B. Manson backed the officials, declaring the pieces were not art, a ruling that sparked a debate in the House of Commons before Guggenheim ultimately prevailed. “Mr. Manson not only lost his case, but pretty soon his job as well,” Guggenheim later wrote. “I thus rendered a great service to foreign artists and to England.”
paras.zh: 这些风险经常与英国机构保守主义发生冲突。当古根海姆进口康斯坦丁·布朗库西、让·阿尔普和亨利·摩尔的雕塑进行群展时，英国海关官员拒绝承认这些抽象作品是艺术品，并开始将它们作为原石征税。泰特美术馆馆长 J.B. 曼森 (J.B. Manson) 支持官员的决定，宣称这些作品不是艺术品，这一裁决在古根海姆最终获胜之前在下议院引发了一场辩论。 “曼森先生不仅输掉了官司，而且很快也失去了工作，”古根海姆后来写道。 “因此，我为外国艺术家和英国提供了巨大的服务。”

paras.en: According to the exhibition catalogue, at least 60 percent of the works currently on view at the Royal Academy were originally displayed at Guggenheim Jeune, reflecting the difficulty of fully reassembling a long-lost gallery, per the Guardian. Original highlights include a Salvador Dalí painting, Kandinsky’s Dominant Curve and Wolfgang Paalen’s sponge-covered umbrella.
paras.zh: 据《卫报》报道，根据展览目录，目前在皇家艺术学院展出的作品中，至少有 60% 最初是在新古根海姆展出的，这反映出完全重新组建一个失落已久的画廊的难度。原创亮点包括萨尔瓦多·达利的画作、康定斯基的主曲线和沃尔夫冈·帕伦的海绵雨伞。

paras.en: Concluding, as she confided to a friend, that “the London public [was] apathetic to modern art,” Guggenheim closed the gallery in June 1939, according to the Telegraph’s Alastair Sooke.
paras.zh: 据《每日电讯报》的阿拉斯泰尔·苏克 (Alastair Sooke) 报道，古根海姆向一位朋友透露，她得出的结论是“伦敦公众对现代艺术漠不关心”，并于 1939 年 6 月关闭了画廊。

paras.en: Months later, as World War II erupted, she traveled to France, snapping up works by Pablo Picasso, Piet Mondrian and Paul Klee even after the Louvre declined to safeguard her collection from the Nazis because it was deemed too modern.
