Smuggling the art out of Europe before fleeing to New York and later settling in Venice, she cemented a legacy that began in London.
paras.zh: 几个月后，第二次世界大战爆发，她前往法国，抢购巴勃罗·毕加索、皮特·蒙德里安和保罗·克利的作品，尽管卢浮宫拒绝保护她的藏品免受纳粹分子的侵害，因为她认为这些藏品过于现代。她将艺术品偷运出欧洲，然后逃往纽约，后来定居威尼斯，巩固了始于伦敦的遗产。

paras.en: “She undeniably left her mark,” Guggenheim’s granddaughter Karole Vail tells the London Times’ Etan Smallman. “And, thanks to this exhibition, people—at least I hope—will understand how critical she really was to the development of modern and contemporary art in England.”
paras.zh: “无可否认，她留下了自己的印记，”古根海姆的孙女卡罗尔·韦尔告诉伦敦时报的伊坦·斯莫曼。 “而且，通过这次展览，人们——至少我希望——能够理解她对英国现当代艺术的发展到底有多么重要。”

paras.en: “Peggy Guggenheim in London: The Making of a Collector” is on view at the Royal Academy of Arts in London through March 14, 2027.
paras.zh: “佩吉·古​​根海姆在伦敦：收藏家的成长”将于 2027 年 3 月 14 日在伦敦皇家艺术学院展出。

articles.title: Jensen Huang Is Back, and So Is Nvidia’s Stock
articles.author: Kate Taylor

paras.en: Jensen Huang is back, baby, and Wall Street is thrilled.
paras.zh: 宝贝，黄仁勋回来了，华尔街兴奋不已。

paras.en: The chipmaker’s shares have surged more than 30 percent following the board’s announcement that it was reinstating Huang as president, CEO, and board member. The company’s valuation has soared by more than $1 trillion, which puts it on track to break Microsoft’s record for the greatest single-day gain in market value by hundreds of billions of dollars.
paras.zh: 在董事会宣布恢复黄仁勋担任总裁、首席执行官和董事会成员后，这家芯片制造商的股价飙升了 30% 以上。该公司估值飙升逾1万亿美元，有望打破微软创下的市值单日最大涨幅数千亿美元的记录。

paras.en: Huang departed the company he helped found on November 12 amid suspected asset-kissing and allegations of extramarital affairs with employees. Each report chipped away at the company’s value until nearly $2.2 trillion was erased over the past month.
paras.zh: 11 月 12 日，黄离开了他帮助创办的公司，原因是涉嫌亲吻资产以及与员工发生婚外情的指控。每份报告都削弱了该公司的价值，直到过去一个月近 2.2 万亿美元被抹去。

paras.en: Last week, board chair Harvey Jones said during the company’s earnings call that the board did “not intend to reinstate Jensen as CEO.” WIRED also reported that Nvidia’s board had been alarmed by Huang’s “lack of candor” and “lying.”
paras.zh: 上周，董事会主席哈维·琼斯在公司财报电话会议上表示，董事会“不打算恢复詹森担任首席执行官”。 《连线》还报道称，英伟达董事会对黄仁勋的“缺乏坦诚”和“撒谎”感到震惊。

paras.en: And yet, despite all this, the board announced on Monday that it had brought Huang back—with some help from the US government. Semafor reported that, hours before Huang was reinstated, President Donald Trump dialed into the publicly traded company’s board meeting to argue for the ousted CEO’s return.
paras.zh: 然而，尽管如此，董事会周一宣布在美国政府的帮助下，已将黄带回。 Semafor 报道称，在黄仁勋复职前几个小时，唐纳德·特朗普总统拨通了这家上市公司的董事会会议，要求被罢黜的首席执行官回归。

paras.en: Many questions remain unanswered. What happens at the conclusion of the board-led investigation into Huang’s behavior? Multiple government agencies and lawmakers are reportedly investigating Huang; given the Trump administration’s aggressive support of the executive, what sort of accountability can anyone reasonably expect?
paras.zh: 许多问题仍未得到解答。董事会领导的对黄的行为的调查结束后会发生什么？据报道，多个政府机构和立法者正在调查黄；鉴于特朗普政府对行政部门的积极支持，人们可以合理地期望什么样的责任？

paras.en: The turmoil has also raised red flags about what happens when so much of the market revolves around one person at one company. Nvidia has massive sway over the wider artificial intelligence ecosystem, due to its deals with and investments in other companies. Last week, the Nasdaq Composite dropped 10 percent, in part due to Nvidia’s struggles—the index’s biggest decline since March 2020.
paras.zh: 这场动荡也引发了人们的警惕，当市场的大部分都围绕着一家公司的一个人时，会发生什么。由于与其他公司的交易和投资，英伟达对更广泛的人工智能生态系统拥有巨大的影响力。上周，纳斯达克综合指数下跌 10%，部分原因是英伟达的困境——该指数创 2020 年 3 月以来最大跌幅。

paras.en: On Monday morning, CNBC asked Trump if Nvidia’s influence on the stock market influenced his decision to push for Huang’s return. “Probably so, but the bigger impact was the long term,” Trump responded.
paras.zh: 周一早上，CNBC 询问特朗普，英伟达对股市的影响是否影响了他推动黄仁勋回归的决定。 “可能是这样，但更大的影响是长期的，”特朗普回应道。

paras.en: Trump, who has worked closely with Huang during his second administration, established himself as a vocal supporter of the CEO amid the recent chaos. Trump told The New York Times that he believed the board responded positively to his argument for Huang’s return because of the stock market dip, with the president suggesting that investors didn’t have much confidence in interim CEO Colette Kress.
paras.zh: 特朗普在第二届政府期间与黄的密切合作，在最近的混乱中确立了自己作为首席执行官的坚定支持者的地位。特朗普告诉《纽约时报》，他相信董事会对他关于黄仁勋回归的论点做出了积极回应，因为股市下跌，总统暗示投资者对临时首席执行官科莱特·克雷斯(Colette Kress)没有太大信心。

paras.en: “I just thought he should be running the company, and I didn’t know it was going to have this kind of an impact,” Trump told The New York Times. “I’ve never seen anything quite like it, actually. The stock is up.”
paras.zh: 特朗普告诉《纽约时报》：“我只是认为他应该经营这家公司，但我不知道这会产生这样的影响。” “事实上，我从来没有见过这样的事情。股票上涨了。”

paras.en: According to Trump, however, his decision wasn’t guided solely by the market.
paras.zh: 然而，特朗普表示，他的决定并不仅仅取决于市场。

paras.en: “The bigger impact was, you know, he’s got other chips in his brain that nobody else knows about,” the president told CNBC. Sure!
paras.zh: “更大的影响是，你知道，他的大脑里还有其他人不知道的芯片，”总统告诉 CNBC。当然！

articles.title: The Feds Left Iowans in the Dark About Plans to Blow Up Tons of Lead
articles.author: Molly Taft

paras.en: On October 26, Charles Massner, the mayor of Mediapolis, Iowa, got an email from the US Army. It described “an intentional, controlled detonation” of “a quantity of degraded lead azide … in the near future” at the Iowa Army Ammunition Plant, some 20 miles south of Mediapolis.
paras.zh: 10月26日，爱荷华州米迪亚波利斯市市长查尔斯·马斯纳收到一封来自美国陆军的电子邮件。报告描述了“在不久的将来”在位于米迪亚波利斯以南约 20 英里的爱荷华州陆军弹药厂“故意、受控爆炸”了“一定数量的降解叠氮化铅”。

paras.en: The email, which was reviewed by WIRED, provided no details about when this explosion would happen, how much material the explosion would destroy, or what steps officials should take to protect the public from a possible toxic fallout. But it did request that public officials allow for environmental testing on public lands before and after the event, which the town granted in a November 2 meeting.
paras.zh: 《连线》杂志审阅了这封电子邮件，其中没有详细说明爆炸何时发生、爆炸会毁坏多少物质，或者官员应采取哪些措施来保护公众免受可能的有毒物质影响。但它确实要求政府官员允许在活动前后对公共土地进行环境测试，该镇在 11 月 2 日的会议上批准了这一要求。

paras.en: Massner says the next time he heard anything was early last week, when the Army published a press release on its website saying it would explode the lead azide in just a few days. That press release included a map of potential exposure from the blast. Mediapolis was directly in the path of exposure, covered in a reddish-yellow cloud with a hot pink border.
paras.zh: 马斯纳说，他下次听到任何消息是在上周早些时候，当时陆军在其网站上发布了一份新闻稿，称将在几天内引爆叠氮化铅。该新闻稿包括一张爆炸可能暴露的地图。媒体城直接位于曝光路径上，被红黄色的云层覆盖，边缘呈粉红色。

paras.en: “There was really no communication, so to speak, other than what was on their website,” he says.
paras.zh: “可以说，除了他们网站上的内容之外，实际上没有任何交流，”他说。

paras.en: Massner wasn’t alone in being caught off guard. The sudden announcement that the Army would be exploding 9,500 pounds of lead azide with seemingly little to no notice caught nearly all of Iowa by surprise. Governor Kim Reynolds’ office said last week that they’d learned about the explosion the same way Massner did: via the press release sent out by the Army on November 15.
paras.zh: 马斯纳并不是唯一一个措手不及的人。陆军将在几乎没有人注意到的情况下爆炸 9,500 磅叠氮化铅，这一突然消息让爱荷华州几乎所有人都感到惊讶。州长金·雷诺兹 (Kim Reynolds) 办公室上周表示，他们与马斯纳 (Massner) 一样了解了爆炸事件：通过陆军 11 月 15 日发布的新闻稿。

paras.en: Now, despite a court order blocking the detonation, the Army announced late Sunday night that it plans to blow up the lead azide on Wednesday, a day before the Thanksgiving holiday. (On Monday, President Donald Trump posted that he was ordering the Army not to detonate anything without court approval.) Many Iowans are left with more questions than answers. Iowa’s unofficial state subreddit is filled with posts from people trying to plan holiday travel and safety around the event, which has switched dates twice in the past week. One local official in the path of a potential fallout told WIRED on Friday that she was leaving the area and staying at a hotel with her immunocompromised child.
paras.zh: 现在，尽管法院下令阻止爆炸，陆军仍于周日深夜宣布，计划在周三（感恩节假期前一天）炸毁叠氮化铅。 （周一，唐纳德·特朗普总统发帖称，他命令军队在未经法院批准的情况下不得引爆任何东西。）许多爱荷华州人面临的问题多于答案。爱荷华州的非官方州 Reddit 子版块上充斥着人们试图围绕活动计划假期旅行和安全的帖子，该活动在过去一周已两次更改日期。周五，一名面临潜在后果的当地官员告诉《连线》杂志，她将离开该地区，带着免疫功能低下的孩子住在一家酒店。

paras.en: Peter Thorne, a professor of environmental health at the University of Iowa who has studied exposure to lead in his laboratory, says his lab has been “deluged with concerns,” with everyone from pediatricians to parents to people who run cleaning facilities and are worried about their staff exposure reaching out. Like most Iowans, Thorne also heard about the explosion from the Army’s press release.
paras.zh: 爱荷华大学环境健康教授彼得·索恩（Peter Thorne）在他的实验室里研究了铅的暴露情况，他说他的实验室“充满了担忧”，从儿科医生到家长，再到经营清洁设施的人，每个人都担心他们的工作人员接触到铅。和大多数爱荷华州人一样，索恩也是从陆军新闻稿中得知爆炸事件的。

paras.en: “My first reaction was, They’re going to do what?” he says.
paras.zh: “我的第一反应是，他们要做什么？”他说。

paras.en: The 68 barrels of degraded lead azide at the Middletown site have been there for more than 20 years. In March, according to a document released by the Army on November 18, the material was officially labeled hazardous waste, and officials began looking into how to dispose of it. In a court filing published Saturday, the Army says that there is an “immediate risk” of the material exploding by itself after temperatures drop below 30 degrees Fahrenheit. It is now invoking emergency powers to detonate the barrels by November 24.
paras.zh: 米德尔敦工厂的 68 桶降解叠氮化铅已存放了 20 多年。今年3月，根据陆军11月18日发布的一份文件，该材料被正式标记为危险废物，官员们开始研究如何处置它。在周六发布的一份法庭文件中，陆军表示，当温度降至 30 华氏度以下时，该材料存在自行爆炸的“直接风险”。目前，它正在援引紧急权力，在 11 月 24 日之前引爆这些桶。

paras.en: “In short, a controlled detonation is by far safer than an uncontrolled explosion,” the filing states.
paras.zh: 文件称：“简而言之，受控爆炸比不受控制的爆炸安全得多。”

paras.en: The Army did not immediately respond to a list of questions sent by WIRED.
paras.zh: 陆军没有立即回复《连线》杂志发送的问题清单。

paras.en: The Army does seem to have looked into other options besides blowing up the azide. The New York Times reported Friday that the Army awarded a contract in late March to a private company to handle cleaning up the chemicals onsite. However, that contract was pulled two months later; the company told the Times that the Army did not give a reason for changing its mind on the cleanup. A contracting officer in the Army told the company that the Army’s decision to pursue detonation “was not based on deficiencies” with the company’s science.
paras.zh: 除了炸毁叠氮化物之外，陆军似乎确实考虑了其他选择。 《纽约时报》周五报道称，陆军于三月下旬将一份合同授予一家私营公司，负责现场清理化学品。然而，两个月后该合同被撤销；该公司告诉《泰晤士报》，陆军没有给出改变清理决定的理由。陆军的一名合同官员告诉该公司，陆军寻求爆炸的决定“并非基于公司科学的缺陷”。

paras.en: In a letter sent to Governor Reynolds on Friday, the EPA Region 7 administrator said that the agency only learned that the material had degraded to a dangerous state in March. The letter also listed a number of strategies the EPA had considered besides detonation, including chemical cleanup, which also risked causing an explosion.
paras.zh: EPA 第 7 区管理员在周五致雷诺兹州长的一封信中表示，该机构在 3 月份才得知该材料已退化到危险状态。这封信还列出了美国环保局考虑的除爆炸之外的一些策略，包括化学清理，这也有引起爆炸的风险。

paras.en: The Army has blown up expired munitions before, although not at the scale of what it plans to do in Iowa. Thorne says that any exposure to lead from the explosion is expected to be “quite a bit lower” than lead exposures in communities exposed to legacy pollution sources. But “there is no safe level for lead, especially for young children,” he says.
paras.zh: 陆军以前曾炸毁过过期弹药，尽管规模没有其计划在爱荷华州所做的那样。索恩表示，爆炸造成的铅暴露量预计将比暴露于遗留污染源的社区中的铅暴露量“低得多”。但“铅的含量没有安全水平，尤其是对于幼儿来说，”他说。

paras.en: The Army did have some public meetings and communications in late October with officials in Middletown, where the explosion will take place and where it has recommended temporary evacuation measures for some neighborhoods. But it’s not clear why its initial direct outreach around public health didn’t extend to towns in potential fallout ranges for a blast, including Mediapolis, beyond asking for permission to test soil samples. (The Army did include recommended public health measures in its November 15 press release.)
paras.zh: 十月下旬，陆军确实与爆炸发生地米德尔敦的官员举行了一些公开会议和沟通，并建议对一些社区采取临时疏散措施。但目前尚不清楚，除了请求测试土壤样本的许可之外，为什么最初围绕公共卫生的直接接触没有扩展到包括 Mediapolis 在内的潜在辐射范围内的城镇。 （陆军确实在 11 月 15 日的新闻稿中纳入了建议的公共卫生措施。）

paras.en: Thorne, a former chair of the EPA’s Science Advisory Board, says that a successful public health outreach program has lots of opportunity for public engagement for all affected areas.
paras.zh: 美国环保局科学顾问委员会前主席索恩表示，成功的公共卫生外展计划将为所有受影响地区的公众参与提供大量机会。

paras.en: “You have public meetings. You answer questions. You have extensive Q&A and FAQs, and you have people speaking to why this is the only choice, what are the burdens, and some kind of a cost-benefit comparison between the options, and then you roll it out through the media, through social media, through many ways,” he says. “Best practice is not what they’ve done—I think this is closer to worst practice, from a public health perspective.”
paras.zh: “你召开公开会议。你回答问题。你有广泛的问答和常见问题解答，你让人们谈论为什么这是唯一的选择，负担是什么，以及选项之间的某种成本效益比较，然后你通过媒体、社交媒体，通过多种方式推出它，”他说。 “最佳做法并不是他们所做的——我认为从公共卫生的角度来看，这更接近最差做法。”

paras.en: For his part, Massner, Mediapolis’s mayor, said on Friday that he planned to take “standard precautions” and follow the Army’s public health recommendations. (The Army has not released fallout modeling for a Wednesday explosion, but if winds carry the material south, it would be possible for Mediapolis to no longer be in the affected zone.) But Massner says he understands why people in his town were freaked out.
paras.zh: 米迪亚波利斯市市长马斯纳周五表示，他计划采取“标准预防措施”并遵循陆军的公共卫生建议。 （陆军尚未发布周三爆炸的尘埃模型，但如果风将物质吹向南方，米迪亚波利斯可能不再位于受影响区域。）但马斯纳说，他理解为什么镇上的人们感到害怕。

paras.en: “What people saw was the map they drew, which showed a [red] cloud going over everybody’s head. I don’t think that was the intent of the map,” he laughs. “When you see a map covered in red, you’re supposed to run for shelter immediately—your life is in danger.”
paras.zh: “人们看到的是他们绘制的地图，其中显示每个人的头顶上都有一片[红色]云。我不认为这就是地图的意图，”他笑着说。 “当你看到地图被红色覆盖时，你应该立即逃向避难所——你的生命有危险。”

paras.en: Update: 11/23/2026, 2:01 PM EDT: WIRED has updated the piece to clarify that President Donald Trump said he will defer to an appeals court on whether the material will be detonated.
paras.zh: 更新：2026 年 11 月 23 日，美国东部时间下午 2:01：《连线》杂志更新了该文章，以澄清唐纳德·特朗普总统表示，他将推迟上诉法院决定该材料是否会被引爆。

articles.title: How to Win Big Betting on Jensen Huang? Listen to Trump
articles.author: Kate Knibbs

paras.en: Just days ago, Jensen Huang’s chances of returning as Nvidia CEO looked increasingly slim, at least according to prediction markets. Earlier this month, Huang resigned from the AI hardware giant following reports of multiple extramarital affairs, including one with a woman alleged to have ties to Chinese intelligence services. As more reports emerged about Huang’s alleged bad behavior, Nvidia’s board insisted it had no plans to reinstate him. By early Sunday morning on the East Coast, traders on Polymarket’s US platform put his chances of returning at just 10 percent. But by Monday, Huang was back in charge.
paras.zh: 就在几天前，至少根据市场预测，黄仁勋重新担任英伟达首席执行官的机会看起来越来越渺茫。本月早些时候，黄在被报道多起婚外情后从这家人工智能硬件巨头辞职，其中包括与一名据称与中国情报部门有联系的女性的婚外情。随着越来越多有关黄涉嫌不良行为的报道出现，英伟达董事会坚称没有计划让他复职。截至东海岸周日凌晨，Polymarket 美国平台上的交易员预计他回归的可能性仅为 10%。但到周一，黄又重新掌权。

paras.en: The swings in Huang’s odds on prediction markets offer a window into how his unlikely comeback unfolded and who saw it coming. The New York Times reported that President Trump played a crucial role in convincing the board to bring Huang back. Traders who paid attention to what Trump and his allies wanted appear to have fared much better than those who did not.
paras.zh: 黄在预测市场上的赔率波动为我们提供了一个窗口，让我们了解他不太可能的复出是如何展开的，以及谁预见到了他的到来。 《纽约时报》报道称，特朗普总统在说服董事会让黄回归的过程中发挥了至关重要的作用。关注特朗普及其盟友想要什么的交易员似乎比那些不关注的交易员表现要好得多。

paras.en: On Sunday evening in Washington, Huang’s odds on Polymarket US jumped six percentage points in just 40 minutes after Trump published a Truth Social missive calling for Huang’s reinstatement. The president said he wanted to help revive the stock market, which had plunged following Huang’s scandal, a sign of Nvidia’s enormous influence over the AI industry and broader US economy.
paras.zh: 周日晚上在华盛顿，特朗普发表了一封呼吁黄复职的《真相社会》信函后，黄在 Polymarket US 的胜算在短短 40 分钟内上升了 6 个百分点。总统表示，他希望帮助重振黄蜂丑闻后暴跌的股市，这表明英伟达对人工智能行业和更广泛的美国经济具有巨大影响力。

paras.en: According to the prediction market intelligence firm Betting Intelligence, odds on both Kalshi and Polymarket’s markets largely tracked with public signals about the likelihood of Huang’s return. They rose when Huang said he was open to returning, fell when the board dismissed the possibility, and climbed again when President Trump threw his support behind the former CEO. But there were several large trades that could not be tied to public developments.
paras.zh: 根据预测市场情报公司 Betting Intelligence 的数据，Kalshi 和 Polymarket 市场的赔率很大程度上取决于黄回归可能性的公开信号。当黄仁勋表示愿意回归时，股价上涨；当董事会驳回这种可能性时，股价下跌；当特朗普总统支持这位前首席执行官时，股价再次攀升。但有几项大型交易无法与公共发展挂钩。

paras.en: Betting Intelligence and the prediction market forensics firm MSR Decode identified clusters of trades on Huang’s return that did not appear to be driven by news or public commentary. Kalshi and Polymarket declined to comment on whether they are currently investigating potential insider trading in markets related to Huang’s return.
paras.zh: Betting Intelligence 和预测市场取证公司 MSR Decode 发现了黄回归时的一系列交易，这些交易似乎并非由新闻或公众评论驱动。 Kalshi 和 Polymarket 拒绝评论他们目前是否正在调查与黄回归相关的市场中潜在的内幕交易。

paras.en: Despite these anomalies, Betting Intelligence CEO Dan Zimmermann says the Huang-related markets showed fewer signs of potentially suspicious activity than usual. “The group that could have known the board’s decision in advance was small. So the market was mostly headline chasers and longshot buyers,” he says.
paras.zh: 尽管存在这些异常现象，Betting Intelligence 首席执行官丹·齐默尔曼 (Dan Zimmermann) 表示，与黄相关的市场显示出的潜在可疑活动迹象比平时要少。 “能够提前知道董事会决定的群体很小。因此市场主要是头条新闻追逐者和前景渺茫的买家，”他说。

paras.en: For traders who profited from Huang’s comeback, the lesson is clear: Don’t discount Trump.
paras.zh: 对于从黄的复出中获利的交易者来说，教训很明显：不要低估特朗普。

paras.en: Isaac Rose-Berman, a research and policy fellow at the American Institute for Boys & Men and professional sports bettor, says he made approximately $10,000 wagering on Huang’s return on Kalshi. He placed his trade after the Nvidia chief said on X that he was open to reclaiming his old job. Rose-Berman says that he figured that the board would consider Huang’s return if it looked likely to improve the company’s stock performance. (Never mind the concerns about national security or Huang allegedly threatening employees that he would “pee in your brain.”) “It’s 2026 and Trump is president, scandal schmandal,” Rose-Berman says. “Should’ve bet more.”
paras.zh: 艾萨克·罗斯-伯曼 (Isaac Rose-Berman) 是美国男孩与男子研究所 (American Institute for Boys & Men) 的研究和政策研究员、职业体育博彩玩家，他表示，他通过黄在卡尔希 (Kalshi) 的回报上的赌注赚了大约 10,000 美元。在这位 Nvidia 首席执行官在 X 上表示他愿意重新担任原来的工作后，他进行了交易。罗斯-伯曼表示，他认为如果黄的回归可能会改善公司的股票表现，董事会就会考虑黄的回归。 （别介意对国家安全的担忧，或者黄据称威胁员工说他会“在你的大脑里撒尿”。）“现在是 2026 年，特朗普是总统，丑闻施曼达尔，”罗斯-伯曼说。 “应该赌更多。”

paras.en: A pseudonymous prediction market trader known as Domer tells WIRED he cleared approximately $600,000 by placing an early wager last week on Huang’s return. He wasn’t focused explicitly on Trump’s desires, but he says his understanding of power dynamics ultimately guided his approach. “Boards can be very malleable,” he tells WIRED.
paras.zh: 一位名叫多默（Domer）的匿名预测市场交易员告诉《连线》杂志，他上周对黄的回归下注，赚了大约 60 万美元。他并没有明确关注特朗普的愿望，但他表示，他对权力动态的理解最终指导了他的做法。 “董事会的可塑性非常强，”他告诉《连线》杂志。

paras.en: Other prediction market “sharps” say that commentary from Trumpworld was the strongest signal available about Huang’s return. As some bettors noted, there was a notable opportunity for profit after Trump suggested to a PBS NewsHour reporter that Huang would be back in power soon, but before Nvidia officially announced his reinstatement. “The key was looking at Trump’s support and the recent performance of the stock market,” says Kalshi trader Caleb Davies.
paras.zh: 其他预测市场的“尖锐人士”表示，特朗普世界的评论是黄仁勋回归的最强烈信号。正如一些投注者指出的那样，在特朗普向 PBS NewsHour 记者暗示黄仁勋将很快重新掌权之后，但在英伟达正式宣布复职之前，这是一个显着的获利机会。卡尔什交易员凯莱布·戴维斯 (Caleb Davies) 表示：“关键是关注特朗普的支持率和近期股市表现。”

paras.en: Aaron Courtney, a data analyst and cofounder of a prediction market analytics firm, says he took a loss on his Huang position. Looking back, he says his mistake was not paying attention to what Trump and other administration officials said over the weekend. “Trump saying he hoped Nvidia would bring Jensen back would be the clearest signal,” he says.
paras.zh: 数据分析师兼预测市场分析公司联合创始人亚伦·考特尼 (Aaron Courtney) 表示，他在黄的立场上蒙受了损失。回顾过去，他说他的错误在于没有关注特朗普和其他政府官员周末的言论。 “特朗普表示他希望英伟达将詹森带回来将是最明确的信号，”他说。

articles.title: Stevie Wonder Addresses Conspiracy Theories About His Blindness: ‘Get in the Car With Me & We’ll See’
articles.author: Angel Diaz

paras.en: Stevie Wonder has seen and heard all the jokes, rumors and conspiracy theories about him actually not being blind, and he has a message for everybody.
paras.zh: 史蒂夫·旺德（Stevie Wonder）看到和听到了所有关于他的笑话、谣言和阴谋论，实际上他并不是盲目的，他有一个信息要告诉大家。

paras.en: During a performance in Chicago at the United Center over the weekend (Nov. 21), he took a break in between playing his plethora of hits to address the conspiracy theories as he sat behind his piano and had a good laugh. “If you believe I can really drive or really see,” he quipped, “Get in the car with me and we’ll see what happens to us at the end of the day.”
paras.zh: 周末（11 月 21 日）在芝加哥联合中心举行的一场演出中，他在演奏大量热门歌曲的间隙休息一下，坐在钢琴后面开怀大笑，以回应阴谋论。 “如果你相信我真的能开车或真的能看东西，”他打趣道，“跟我一起上车，看看一天结束时我们会发生什么。”

paras.en: Speaking of the “Stevie Wonder can drive” theories, Lionel Richie told Kelly Clarkson back in 2019 that he spent most of his life thinking that Stevie could see and told a funny anecdote about them being in a car once.
paras.zh: 谈到“史蒂夫·旺德可以开车”的理论，莱昂内尔·里奇在 2019 年告诉凯莉·克拉克森，他一生中的大部分时间都认为史蒂夫可以看到并讲述他们曾经在车里的有趣轶事。

paras.en: “I went to his house, he says, ‘Wanna hear a new song? I’ve got it in the car, come on, come with me.’ We got out to the car, he says, ‘You sit on the passenger side, I’ll sit on the driver’s side.’ He goes in, he cranks the car up, he puts the tape in, and then he does this [motions that Stevie turns around as if he’s backing the car up] and starts driving back down the driveway. And I scream, I say, ‘Stevie! What are you doing?’ And he says. ‘Got ya, didn’t I?'”
paras.zh: “我去了他家，他说，‘想听一首新歌吗？我已经在车里了，来吧，跟我来吧。’我们下了车，他说，‘你坐在乘客侧，我坐在驾驶员侧。’他进去，发动汽车，放上磁带，然后他做了这个动作（史蒂夫转身，好像他正在倒车一样），然后开始沿着车道开回去。然后我尖叫起来，我说，‘史蒂维！你在做什么？’他说，‘明白了，不是吗？’”

paras.en: 2019 must’ve been the height of the theories because Shaquille O’Neal also told a hilarious story about the time he and Stevie lived in the same building when Shaq played for the Los Angeles Lakers. According to him, the legendary musician walked into their building’s elevator by himself, said “What’s up, Shaq,” pressed the button to his floor and walked to his apartment.
paras.zh: 2019 年一定是各种理论的高潮，因为沙奎尔·奥尼尔还讲述了一个搞笑的故事，讲述了沙克为洛杉矶湖人队效力时，他和史蒂夫住在同一栋楼里的故事。据他说，这位传奇音乐家独自走进他们大楼的电梯，说“怎么了，沙克”，按下了他所在楼层的按钮，然后走到了他的公寓。

paras.en: Then there’s the time in 2017 when he told TMZ that he would reveal the truth after they asked about the rumors, which then led to this classic video in “Stevie Wonder Might Not Be Blind” internet lore. Be sure to heck out the comments for a funny tidbit about a story Charlie Murphy told in his memoir The Makings of a Stand Up Guy published in 2011.
paras.zh: 2017 年，他告诉 TMZ，在他们询问谣言后，他将揭露真相，这导致了网络传说中“史蒂维·旺德可能不是瞎子”的经典视频。请务必查看评论，了解有关查理·墨菲 (Charlie Murphy) 在其 2011 年出版的回忆录《站起来的人的成长》中讲述的一个故事的有趣花絮。

paras.en: Stevie is currently on the back leg of his 18-date Songs in the Key of Life 50th anniversay tour.
paras.zh: Stevie 目前正在完成他的 Key of Life 50 周年纪念巡演中的 18 首歌曲。

articles.title: Jay-Z’s 2027 Super Bowl Halftime Show Coming to IMAX Theaters
articles.author: Michael Saponara

paras.en: “This ain’t a movie, dog,” Jay-Z says on “Public Service Announcement (Interlude)” — but this time around, it is.
paras.zh: “这不是电影，狗，”Jay-Z 在“公共服务公告（插曲）”中说道，但这一次，它是。

paras.en: The NFL, Disney and ESPN collectively announced on Monday (Nov. 23) that Hov’s Super Bowl LXI Halftime Show will be getting the IMAX treatment.
paras.zh: NFL、迪士尼和 ESPN 于周一（11 月 23 日）共同宣布，霍夫的第 61 届超级碗中场秀将获得 IMAX 待遇。

paras.en: With the Super Bowl broadcasting on ESPN for the first time in its history, the big game is set to air in IMAX theaters across the U.S. and select international markets.
paras.zh: 随着超级碗历史上首次在 ESPN 上转播，这场盛大的比赛将在美国各地的 IMAX 影院和部分国际市场播出。

paras.en: According to Variety, tickets will go on sale in January, with Super Bowl LXI slated for Feb. 14 at SoFi Stadium in Los Angeles.
paras.zh: 据《Variety》报道，门票将于 1 月开始发售，第 61 届超级碗定于 2 月 14 日在洛杉矶 SoFi 体育场举行。

paras.en: Theaters hosting the Super Bowl in IMAX will also be announced in the coming weeks. There will be a four-hour presentation of the game’s entirety, including Hov’s halftime show, as well as a pre and post-game show.
paras.zh: 举办 IMAX 超级碗比赛的影院也将在未来几周内公布。整个比赛将有四个小时的演示，包括霍夫的半场表演，以及赛前和赛后表演。

paras.en: “Watching the Super Bowl with your fellow fans is one of the great shared experiences in sports, and this first-of-its-kind collaboration with the NFL and IMAX takes it to a historic new scale,” said Ken Potrock, who serves as the Walt Disney Company’s president of major event integration, per Variety. “With ESPN’s first Super Bowl, we’re reaching fans across an unprecedented range of platforms and meeting them wherever they want to be, with unique moments that only Disney and ESPN can deliver.”
paras.zh: 据 Variety 报道，华特迪士尼公司重大赛事整合总裁肯·波特洛克 (Ken Potrock) 表示：“与其他球迷一起观看超级碗比赛是体育界最伟大的共同体验之一，而与 NFL 和 IMAX 的首次合作将其提升到历史性的新规模。” “通过 ESPN 的首届超级碗，我们将通过前所未有的广泛平台接触粉丝，并在他们想去的任何地方与他们见面，为他们带来只有迪士尼和 ESPN 才能提供的独特时刻。”

paras.en: Jay-Z was announced as the 2027 Super Bowl headliner during a Monday Night Football broadcast on Oct. 26, just days after he performed a pair of concerts at SoFi Stadium.
paras.zh: Jay-Z 在 10 月 26 日的周一橄榄球之夜广播中被宣布为 2027 年超级碗的头条新闻，就在几天前，他在 SoFi 体育场举办了两场音乐会。

paras.en: The Brooklyn rap deity has been back outside this year. He returned to the stage in May at Roots Picnic and hosted a blockbuster three-night stay at Yankee Stadium in July, before heading across the pond for dates in London and Paris.
paras.zh: 这位布鲁克林说唱之神今年又回来了。 5 月，他在 Roots Picnic 上重返舞台，并于 7 月在洋基体育场举办了一场轰动一时的三晚演出，然后跨越大西洋前往伦敦和巴黎约会。

paras.en: Jay and Roc Nation partnered with the NFL in 2019 and have served as the league’s live music entertainment strategist since 2019.
paras.zh: Jay 和 Roc Nation 于 2019 年与 NFL 合作，并自 2019 年起担任该联盟的现场音乐娱乐策略师。

paras.en: Hov’s upcoming Super Bowl debut has come with fan-driven rumors of an album in tow. Jay’s last solo effort, 4:44, arrived in June 2017 and debuted atop the Billboard 200 with 262,000 total album-equivalent units earned.
paras.zh: 霍夫即将在超级碗首秀，粉丝们纷纷传言他将推出一张专辑。周杰伦的最后一首个人作品《4:44》于 2017 年 6 月推出，首次亮相便登上 Billboard 200 排行榜榜首，共获得 262,000 张专辑当量单位。

articles.title: Jagged Edge Member Brandon Casey Sued by Woman Claiming Child Rape
articles.author: Rachel Scharf

paras.en: Brandon Casey of the R&B group Jagged Edge is facing a lawsuit that claims he sexually assaulted a young girl over the course of several years in the early 2000s.
paras.zh: R&B 乐队 Jagged Edge 的布兰登·凯西 (Brandon Casey) 正面临一项诉讼，指控他在 2000 年代初的几年时间里对一名年轻女孩进行了性侵犯。

paras.en: Casey was sued in September by a 29-year-old woman named Tyliyah Lee, who alleges she was repeatedly raped by the singer after meeting him at a Philadelphia “community event” in 2003. Casey’s lawyer, Leron Rogers of the firm Fox Rothschild, said in a Monday (Nov. 23) statement to Billboard that the singer “flatly rejects the untrue allegations of battery and sexual assault set forth in the civil complaint.”
paras.zh: 凯西于 9 月被一位名叫 Tyliyah Lee 的 29 岁女子起诉，她声称自己在 2003 年费城的一次“社区活动”中见到凯西后，多次被凯西强奸。凯西的律师、福克斯·罗斯柴尔德公司的莱伦·罗杰斯 (Leron Rogers) 在周一（11 月 23 日）向公告牌发表的声明中表示，凯西“断然否认民事诉讼中提出的关于殴打和性侵犯的不真实指控”。

paras.en: “The claims stem from events alleged to have occurred some twenty years ago, are baseless and unsupported by any corroboration we are aware of and have already been met with a firm denial in court,” added Rogers.
paras.zh: 罗杰斯补充道：“这些说法源于据称发生在大约二十年前的事件，毫无根据，也没有我们所知的任何佐证支持，并且已经在法庭上遭到坚决否认。”

paras.en: The lawsuit, obtained by Billboard, alleges that Casey had nonconsensual sexual intercourse with Lee on five separate occasions when she was between six and 10 years old. Lee is now suing Casey for battery and seeking at least $50,000 in damages for “severe emotional distress and substantial depression and anxiety.”
paras.zh: Billboard 获得的诉讼称，凯西在李 6 岁至 10 岁时曾五次在不同场合与她发生非自愿性行为。李现在以殴打罪起诉凯西，并寻求至少 5 万美元的赔偿，理由是“严重的情绪困扰以及严重的抑郁和焦虑”。

paras.en: Lee, who is a singer-songwriter, also claims in the lawsuit that she wrote the 2003 Jagged Edge hit “Walked Outta Heaven” when she was just six years old. She says Casey stole the song from her after she played it for him and never compensated her. “Walked Outta Heaven” hit No. 6 on the Billboard Hot 100 and No. 2 on Billboard‘s Hot R&B/Hip Hop Songs chart.
paras.zh: Lee 是一位创作型歌手，她还在诉讼中声称，她在 6 岁时就创作了 2003 年 Jagged Edge 热门歌曲“Walked Outta Heaven”。她说凯西在她为他演奏这首歌后就从她那里偷走了这首歌，并且从未补偿过她。 《Walked Outta Heaven》在 Billboard 百强单曲榜上排名第六，在 Billboard 热门 R&B/Hip Hop 歌曲排行榜上排名第二。

paras.en: The lawsuit does not level any copyright infringement claims against Casey or Jagged Edge over “Walked Outta Heaven.” Casey is credited as an arranger and lyricist on the track alongside Brian Casey, his twin brother and fellow Jagged Edge member, though he does not have composition credit. Bryan-Michael Cox is the song’s composer.
paras.zh: 该诉讼并未就《走出天堂》对凯西或锯齿边缘提出任何版权侵权索赔。凯西被认为是这首歌的编曲家和作词家，与他的双胞胎兄弟、Jagged Edge 成员布莱恩·凯西 (Brian Casey) 一起担任歌曲的编曲家和作词家，尽管他没有作曲功劳。布莱恩-迈克尔·考克斯是这首歌的作曲家。

paras.en: Lee initially brought the lawsuit in a Philadelphia county court in September. On Thursday (Nov. 19), Casey’s attorneys moved the case to federal court. That court filing says Casey “denies each and every allegation of wrongdoing in the complaint” and notes that before she sued, Lee demanded a $15 million settlement from the singer.
paras.zh: 李最初于九月向费城县法院提起诉讼。周四（11 月 19 日），凯西的律师将此案移交给联邦法院。该法庭文件称，凯西“否认投诉中的每一项不当行为指控”，并指出在她提起诉讼之前，李要求这位歌手支付 1500 万美元的和解金。

paras.en: “Mr. Casey will not be pressured by headlines, and he will not stand by while his name and reputation are attacked,” Rogers said in his Monday statement to Billboard. “We intend to pursue sanctions and every other available remedy against the Plaintiff and her counsel for bringing claims we believe have no basis in fact. Mr. Casey believes genuine survivors of abuse deserve a voice and our full respect, and baseless claims only diminish their cause.”
paras.zh: “凯西先生不会受到头条新闻的压力，当他的名字和声誉受到攻击时，他不会袖手旁观，”罗杰斯在周一向公告牌发表的声明中表示。 “我们打算对原告及其律师提出制裁和一切其他可用的补救措施，因为他们提出了我们认为没有事实依据的指控。凯西先生认为，真正的虐待幸存者应该有发言权并得到我们的充分尊重，毫无根据的指控只会削弱他们的事业。”

articles.title: The Center of the News Universe Has Shifted to CNBC
articles.author: Alex Weprin

paras.en: On Monday morning, CNBC senior Washington correspondent Eamon Javers was driving in his car when the President of the United States called.
paras.zh: 周一早上，当美国总统打来电话时，CNBC 驻华盛顿高级记者埃蒙·贾弗斯 (Eamon Javers) 正在开车。

paras.en: Javers pulled over to the side of the road, and within minutes he and President Trump were live on Squawk on the Street to talk about Nvidia‘s shock decision to bring back CEO Jensen Huang. Trump was on the show for nearly an hour, revealing his central role in securing Huang’s return.
paras.zh: 贾弗斯把车停在路边，几分钟后，他和特朗普总统就在街头 Squawk 上进行了直播，谈论英伟达召回首席执行官黄仁勋的令人震惊的决定。特朗普在节目中待了近一个小时，揭示了他在确保黄的回归中所扮演的核心角色。

paras.en: In an interview with The Hollywood Reporter Monday afternoon, KC Sullivan, the president of CNBC, called this morning’s coverage of Huang and Nvidia a “really special moment.”
paras.zh: 周一下午接受《好莱坞报道》采访时，CNBC 总裁 KC Sullivan 称今天上午对黄仁勋和 Nvidia 的报道是一个“非常特别的时刻”。

paras.en: “The President was so generous with his time, but it was fun to see Eamon bring that in, and then to have [Jim] Cramer jump in, Sarah Eisen jump in, Carl Quintanilla jump in, David Faber jump in, and to be able to get all those different perspectives, I just think it made such a rich discussion,” Sullivan said. “I was really just so proud of the team and how they delivered.”
paras.zh: 沙利文说：“总统非常慷慨地投入了时间，但很高兴看到埃蒙提出这一点，然后让[吉姆]克莱默加入，莎拉艾森加入，卡尔昆塔尼拉加入，大卫法贝尔加入，并且能够获得所有这些不同的观点，我认为这引起了如此丰富的讨论。” “我真的为这个团队以及他们的表现感到自豪。”

paras.en: For months, the news business has been focused on the 2026 midterm elections, and for good reason. But the midterms are over, and suddenly it seems the most consequential stories of this moment in time are happening on CNBC.
paras.zh: 几个月来，新闻界一直关注 2026 年中期选举，这是有充分理由的。但中期选举已经结束，突然之间，这一时刻最重要的故事似乎正在 CNBC 上发生。

paras.en: Nvidia stock soared 31.8 percent on Monday after the news, and the entire stock market rallied. Huang and Nvidia are not only a business story, they are an economic story, a political story, a national security story. It’s a story of our time. For CNBC, it was also the second highest hour of web traffic this year, behind only SpaceX’s IPO in June.
paras.zh: 消息传出后，英伟达股价周一飙升 31.8%，整个股市上涨。黄仁勋和英伟达不仅仅是一个商业故事，他们还是一个经济故事、一个政治故事、一个国家安全故事。这是我们这个时代的故事。对于 CNBC 来说，这也是今年网络流量第二高的时段，仅次于 SpaceX 6 月份的 IPO。

paras.en: “In the world of media now, it’s those who are essential to their audience and really understand their brand promise and deliver on that are the ones that are going to going to thrive,” Sullivan says. “I do think that there’s a lot of attention on the business world right now, and I don’t think there’s anybody who can compete with us in that arena.”
paras.zh: 沙利文说：“在当今的媒体世界中，那些对受众至关重要、真正了解其品牌承诺并兑现这一承诺的人才能蓬勃发展。” “我确实认为现在商业界受到了很多关注，但我认为没有人可以在这个领域与我们竞争。”

paras.en: For CNBC, that audience includes Trump, as well as seemingly every CEO of note in America. “I want to congratulate you guys. You covered it really well,” Trump told the Squawk on the Street hosts during his marathon interview.
paras.zh: 对于 CNBC 来说，这些观众包括特朗普，以及似乎美国每一位知名首席执行官。 “我想祝贺你们。你们报道得非常好，”特朗普在马拉松式采访中对《Squawk on the Street》主持人说道。

paras.en: Huang, of course, is just the latest news. Last week, it was Cramer’s exclusive interview with Nvidia’s interim Colette Kress as the company reported its first (and only?) earnings report without Huang at the helm. Two days later Andrew Ross Sorkin had an exclusive interview with Anthropic co-founders Dario and Daniela Amodei as the AI company IPOd.
paras.zh: 当然，黄只是最新消息。上周，克莱默对英伟达临时员工科莱特·克雷斯 (Colette Kress) 进行了独家采访，当时该公司公布了第一份（也是唯一一份？）没有黄仁勋掌舵的收益报告。两天后，Andrew Ross Sorkin 在人工智能公司 IPO 期间接受了 Anthropic 联合创始人 Dario 和 Daniela Amodei 的独家采访。

paras.en: “It’s not like those things just happen. Those are long-term, trusted relationships,” Sullivan explains. Eamon has been working that relationship to the President for many months, which put him in a position to do that; Cramer’s relationship and trust with Nvidia is what allowed him to get that first interview with Colette; [Joe] Kernen’s got a really important, longstanding relationship with the Treasury Secretary so when he was playing a major role over the last two weeks, to be able to have him come on our air; Sorkin has the relationship into Anthropic. Those aren’t gimmes. Those aren’t just things that happen.”
paras.zh: “这些事情并不是突然发生的。这些是长期的、值得信赖的关系，”沙利文解释道。埃蒙几个月来一直致力于与总统建立这种关系，这使他能够做到这一点； Cramer 与 Nvidia 的关系和信任使他能够接受 Colette 的第一次采访； [乔]克南与财政部长有着非常重要的长期关系，所以当他在过去两周发挥重要作用时，能够让他出现在我们的节目中；索金与人类有关系。这些都不是礼物。这些不仅仅是发生的事情。”

paras.en: Those moments all delivered double-digit ratings increases for CNBC on linear TV, and secured millions of social views and engagements, where they were shared, analyzed and moved the markets.
paras.zh: 这些时刻都为 CNBC 的线性电视收视率带来了两位数的增长，并获得了数以百万计的社交观点和参与度，这些时刻被分享、分析并推动了市场。

paras.en: “At CNBC we pride ourselves on this, but we’re the place that the most influential people go to at the most important times and most important moments,” Sullivan says. “I think what it comes down to is that our audience wants to understand what is changing, what does it mean, and what do they do with that information? And that’s everything from the midterms to the AI trade. When they’re trying to to figure out what’s going on, they turn to us. And I think our guests know that as well.”
paras.zh: “在 CNBC，我们对此感到自豪，但我们是最有影响力的人在最重要的时刻和最重要的时刻去的地方，”沙利文说。 “我认为归根结底，我们的观众想要了解正在发生的变化，这意味着什么，以及他们如何处理这些信息？这包括从中期选举到人工智能交易的一切。当他们试图弄清楚发生了什么时，他们会向我们求助。我认为我们的客人也知道这一点。”

paras.en: The TV news business can be fickle. General interest brands like CNN and NBC News can benefit immensely when major global news is happening, but tend to be consistent on a day-to-day basis. More partisan-leaning cable news channels like MS NOW and Fox News can rise and fall with the outcome of elections, or how people on the right or left side of the spectrum are feeling.
paras.zh: 电视新闻业务可能变化无常。当全球重大新闻发生时，像 CNN 和 NBC News 这样的大众品牌可以从中受益匪浅，但在日常工作中往往保持一致。更多有党派倾向的有线新闻频道，如 MS NOW 和福克斯新闻，可能会随着选举结果或右派或左派人士的感受而兴衰。

paras.en: In the case of CNBC, the news cycle today is simply in their wheelhouse, and it is poised to continue over time as OpenAI weighs its own IPO, and with investigations into Nvidia assuredly coming from Congress (MS NOW may benefit from those too).
paras.zh: 就 CNBC 而言，今天的新闻周期完全在他们的掌控之中，而且随着 OpenAI 权衡自己的 IPO，并且国会肯定会对 Nvidia 进行调查（MS NOW 也可能从中受益），随着时间的推移，这种情况将继续下去。

paras.en: The CNBC boom also comes at a good time for the news brand, which is set to launch a new direct-to-consumer offering in the coming months. Sullivan is coy on what that specific offering will entail, but he notes that it will lean into its brand attributes of trust, and the live exclusives that the channel has become known for, be it an exclusive interview with the Amodei siblings, or having the President on the phone for nearly an hour.
paras.zh: CNBC 的热潮对该新闻品牌来说也恰逢其时，该品牌计划在未来几个月内推出新的直接面向消费者的产品。沙利文对于具体内容的内容含糊其辞，但他指出，它将依赖于其信任的品牌属性，以及该频道闻名的现场独家报道，无论是对阿莫代兄弟姐妹的独家采访，还是让总统接听近一个小时的电话。

paras.en: “I think that what you’ll see when we roll out our direct-to-consumer product early next year is that we’re doubling down on that to deliver for the audience where and how they want it, making CNBC more useful and making CNBC easier to interact with and more rich for the consumer where and how they want it, but all built off of the same tenets that you saw today or over the last few weeks.”
paras.zh: “我认为，当我们明年初推出直接面向消费者的产品时，你会看到，我们将加倍努力，在观众想要的地方以他们想要的方式为他们提供服务，让 CNBC 变得更有用，让 CNBC 更容易与消费者互动，让消费者在他们想要的地方和方式变得更加丰富，但所有这些都建立在你今天或过去几周看到的相同原则之上。”

articles.title: ‘GTA 6’ Boss Strauss Zelnick Among First Raft of SXSW London 2027 Speakers
articles.author: Lily Ford

paras.en: Take-Two Interactive CEO Strauss Zelnick, the man behind Grand Theft Auto VI, is among the first raft of speakers confirmed for next year’s SXSW London.
paras.zh: Take-Two Interactive 首席执行官 Strauss Zelnick 是《侠盗猎车手 VI》的幕后黑手，也是首批确认参加明年伦敦 SXSW 大会的演讲者之一。

paras.en: The conference is set to return to Shoreditch, east London, for its third year from May 24-29, where Zelnick will take to the stage to talk about building one of the world’s biggest entertainment franchises (sales for the latest release have already out-grossed Christopher Nolan’s box office behemoth The Odyssey).
paras.zh: 该会议将于 5 月 24 日至 29 日重返伦敦东部肖尔迪奇，这是第三年，泽尔尼克将登台谈论打造世界上最大的娱乐特许经营权之一（最新发行的票房收入已超过克里斯托弗·诺兰的票房巨兽《奥德赛》）。

paras.en: The upcoming installment is built around the theme “The Power of Human Potential,” described by organizers as a deliberate focus on people in a year dominated by what machines can do. Among the speakers making that case is Jon Steinback, the former DeepMind creative lead whose start-up Marker is building an AI writing tool designed to develop, rather than delete, writers.
paras.zh: 即将推出的展览围绕“人类潜力的力量”主题，组织者将其描述为在机器能力主导的一年中刻意关注人。提出这一观点的演讲者包括前 DeepMind 创意主管 Jon Steinback，他的初创公司 Marker 正在开发一款人工智能写作工具，旨在培养而不是删除作家。

paras.en: Elsewhere, David Thornton, president of Genomics Limited, will explore how rapid analysis of large-scale genetic and genomic information will empower us to predict disease risks and improve medicine.
paras.zh: 在其他地方，Genomics Limited 总裁 David Thornton 将探讨如何快速分析大规模遗传和基因组信息使我们能够预测疾病风险并改进医学。

paras.en: Ilyas Khan, who founded Cambridge Quantum and was the founding CEO of Quantinuum, is also on board to discuss the convergence of AI and quantum computing. His appearance follows Quantinuum’s $1.68bn Nasdaq listing in June 2026, the largest traditional IPO yet for a pure-play quantum computing company.
paras.zh: Cambridge Quantum 创始人兼 Quantinuum 创始首席执行官 Ilyas Khan 也参与讨论人工智能和量子计算的融合。 Quantinuum 于 2026 年 6 月在纳斯达克上市，融资 16.8 亿美元，这是迄今为止纯量子计算公司规模最大的传统 IPO。

paras.en: Two of Britain’s best-known voices in advertising, Martin Sorrell and Rory Sutherland, and media personality GK Barry, will join the festival to explore the future of advertising and the creator economy, while Refik Anadol, founder of the newly opened LA museum, Dataland, will share his artistic vision for AI and data-driven installations.
paras.zh: 英国广告界两位最知名的声音马丁·索雷尔 (Martin Sorrell) 和罗里·萨瑟兰 (Rory Sutherland) 以及媒体名人 GK 巴里 (GK Barry) 将参加本次节日，探索广告和创作者经济的未来，而新开张的洛杉矶博物馆 Dataland 的创始人 Refik Anadol 将分享他对人工智能和数据驱动装置的艺术愿景。

paras.en: “SXSW London is a place of firsts — where you see it first, hear it first, and meet the people behind it first,” began Katy Arnander, SXSW London’s chief programming officer. “It’s also where industries converge: where gaming meets advertising, art meets AI, and quantum computing shares a stage with the creator economy. Our first wave of speakers reflects exactly that, and shows what happens when human potential is central to the conversation.”
paras.zh: “SXSW 伦敦是一个创造第一的地方——你首先看到它，首先听到它，并首先见到它背后的人，”SXSW 伦敦的首席节目官凯蒂·阿南德 (Katy Arnander) 说道。 “这也是行业融合的地方：游戏与广告、艺术与人工智能相遇，量子计算与创造者经济共享一个舞台。我们的第一波演讲者恰恰反映了这一点，并展示了当人类潜力成为对话的核心时会发生什么。”

paras.en: The event will welcome around 20,000 festival-goers on its walkable Shoreditch campus, engaging in networking, music showcases, international premieres and parties. The 2026 festival drew attendees from 97 countries, 863 speakers (including Michelle Obama, Serena Williams and Brian Eno), 256 music artists across 18 venues and 100 film screenings, 13 of them world premieres.
paras.zh: 该活动将在适合步行的肖尔迪奇园区迎来约 20,000 名音乐节观众，参加社交活动、音乐展示、国际首演和派对。 2026 年的音乐节吸引了来自 97 个国家的参加者、863 位演讲者（包括米歇尔·奥巴马、塞雷娜·威廉姆斯和布莱恩·伊诺）、256 名音乐艺术家，分布在 18 个场馆，放映了 100 部电影，其中 13 部为全球首映。

articles.title: Bela Bajaria Calls Time at Netflix a “Fun Chapter” as She Teases Rest and “Conversations” in First Remarks on Exit
articles.author: Hilary Lewis

paras.en: Former Netflix chief content officer Bela Bajaria addressed her exit from the streamer in her first public comments about her abrupt departure last month.
paras.zh: Netflix 前首席内容官贝拉·巴贾里亚 (Bela Bajaria) 上个月在首次公开评论中谈到了自己退出流媒体的问题。

paras.en: Speaking to The Hollywood Reporter ahead of the 2026 International Emmys, where she’s set to be honored with the Founders Award, Bajaria called her decade at Netflix “such an amazing, fun chapter” and shared she was “proud of so many of the things” that she and her team had accomplished.
paras.zh: 在 2026 年国际艾美奖颁奖典礼之前，巴贾里亚在接受《好莱坞报道》采访时表示，她将在 2026 年国际艾美奖颁奖典礼上荣获创始人奖，她称自己在 Netflix 的十年是“令人惊叹、有趣的篇章”，并表示她为自己和团队所取得的“许多成就感到自豪”。

paras.en: Since her exit, Bajaria said she’s been indulging in “a little rest” and having some “really fun conversations.”
paras.zh: 巴贾里亚表示，自从退出以来，她一直在“休息一下”并进行一些“非常有趣的对话”。

paras.en: “I’m excited about what’s next, and I think this time is good for a little rest after a lot of global travel,” she told THR on the red carpet ahead of the awards show, adding that she’s “really open” to whatever the future holds.
paras.zh: “我对接下来的事情感到很兴奋，我认为在经历了多次全球旅行之后，这一次适合休息一下，”她在颁奖典礼前的红地毯上告诉《THR》，并补充说她对未来的发展“非常开放”。

paras.en: Bajaria was ousted from her role at Netflix on Oct. 15, with former Fox and Disney exec Peter Rice taking her place as chief content officer.
paras.zh: 10 月 15 日，巴贾里亚被 Netflix 解雇，前福克斯和迪士尼高管彼得·赖斯 (Peter Rice) 接替她担任首席内容官。

paras.en: The former chief content officer previously spoke with THR at the Saban Community Clinic Gala at the end of October but wasn’t yet ready to speak about her time at Netflix. Still she offered, “the outpouring that I’ve received in the last couple of weeks has been so beautiful and amazing. I’ve been in television for 30 years, and at this point I have worked with what feels like nearly every single person from agents and producers to writers and actors. I love it. I’m so grateful for the career I have had to date, with lots more to come.”
paras.zh: 这位前首席内容官此前曾在 10 月底的萨班社区诊所晚会上接受过 THR 采访，但尚未准备好谈论她在 Netflix 的时光。她仍然表示，“过去几周我收到的热情洋溢是如此美丽和令人惊叹。我在电视行业工作了 30 年，在这一点上，我几乎与每一个人一起工作，从经纪人、制片人到编剧和演员。我喜欢它。我非常感谢我迄今为止的职业生涯，还有更多的未来。”

paras.en: Bajaria, who joined Netflix after serving as president of Universal Television at NBCUniversal, left the streamer as it shed 1,000 employees, roughly six percent of its workforce, including execs Doug Belgrad and, days after news broke of Bajaria leaving, film boss Dan Lin. The layoffs came as the company seeks a reset amid slowing viewership growth.
paras.zh: 巴贾里亚在担任 NBCUniversal 环球电视总裁后加入 Netflix，随着 Netflix 裁员 1,000 名员工（约占员工总数的 6%），他离开了 Netflix，其中包括高管道格·贝尔格莱德 (Doug Belgrad)，以及在巴贾里亚离职消息传出几天后，电影老板丹·林 (Dan Lin)。此次裁员是由于该公司在收视率增长放缓的情况下寻求重组。

paras.en: When she left Netflix, co-CEO Ted Sarandos said of Bajaria, “Bela has built and shaped a truly global Content organization, hiring brilliant people and empowering them to make good decisions. I am incredibly grateful to her for everything she’s done.”
paras.zh: 当她离开 Netflix 时，联合首席执行官泰德·萨兰多斯 (Ted Sarandos) 谈到巴贾里亚 (Bajaria) 时表示，“贝拉建立并塑造了一个真正的全球内容组织，聘请了优秀的人才，并帮助他们做出正确的决策。我非常感谢她所做的一切。”

paras.en: He added in a staff memo, “I know this is a big change in a year that has already had its share. But I also see an opportunity to take our slate to the next level, especially in [the U.S. and Canada] where we have an outsize impact in creating big, buzzy hits that our members love and drive conversation around the world.”
paras.zh: 他在一份员工备忘录中补充道，“我知道这是一年中的一个重大变化，已经发生了一些变化。但我也看到了将我们的名单提升到一个新水平的机会，特别是在[美国和加拿大]，我们在创造我们的会员喜爱的热门歌曲并在世界各地推动对话方面产生了巨大的影响。”

articles.title: Trump sealed deal for Nvidia to rehire Jensen Huang as CEO

paras.en: The stunning decision by Nvidia's board to bring back Jensen Huang as CEO was sealed by a personal promise from President Donald Trump on Sunday that Huang had not broken national security laws, three people familiar with the board's thinking told CNBC.
paras.zh: 三名熟悉董事会想法的人士告诉 CNBC，英伟达董事会做出了令人震惊的决定，让黄仁勋重新担任首席执行官，唐纳德·特朗普总统周日亲自承诺，黄仁勋没有违反国家安全法。

paras.en: Several other factors also set the stage for Huang's return and accelerated discussions with him over the weekend, said the people, who spoke on condition of anonymity to discuss internal deliberations close to Nvidia's board.
paras.zh: 这些不愿透露姓名的人士表示，其他几个因素也为黄仁勋的回归奠定了基础，并加速了周末与他的讨论。这些人士要求匿名，讨论与英伟达董事会关系密切的内部审议情况。

paras.en: A sharp stock price drop after his resignation and questions about the leadership of interim CEO Colette Kress also spurred the board's decision, the people said.
paras.zh: 知情人士称，他辞职后股价大幅下跌以及对临时首席执行官科莱特·克雷斯(Colette Kress)领导力的质疑也促使董事会做出了这一决定。

paras.en: "I convinced them," Trump told CNBC's Eamon Javers in a phone interview Monday morning, shortly after Nvidia announced Huang's return.
paras.zh: “我说服了他们，”周一上午，在英伟达宣布黄仁勋回归后不久，特朗普在电话采访中对 CNBC 的埃蒙·贾弗斯 (Eamon Javers) 说道。

paras.en: "I made the deal," the president said. "It was a lot easier to convince them yesterday than it was a week and a half ago.
paras.zh: “我达成了协议，”总统说。 “昨天比一周半前更容易说服他们。

paras.en: Trump said Nvidia's board asked for guarantees that Huang, who resigned less than two weeks ago, was not a threat to national security.
paras.zh: 特朗普表示，英伟达董事会要求保证不到两周前辞职的黄仁勋不会对国家安全构成威胁。

paras.en: "And we gave them assurances, at least with everything we know," the president said. "We believe he's fine. He's absolutely fine."
paras.zh: “我们向他们做出了保证，至少是根据我们所知道的一切，”总统说。 “我们相信他很好。他绝对很好。”

paras.en: Senior Trump administration officials reached out to the board overnight Friday to inform them that Huang had not violated U.S. national security laws, people familiar with the board's actions said.
paras.zh: 熟悉该委员会行动的人士称，特朗普政府高级官员周五连夜联系该委员会，告知他们黄没有违反美国国家安全法。

paras.en: After the White House outreach, the board contacted Huang, who joined meetings on Saturday and Sunday to discuss his potential return, the people said.
paras.zh: 知情人士称，在白宫进行外展活动后，董事会联系了黄，黄参加了周六和周日的会议，讨论他可能回归的问题。

paras.en: Huang's spokesman did not respond to a request for comment when asked about his contact with the board and other events leading up to his return.
paras.zh: 当被问及他与董事会的联系以及导致他回归的其他事件时，黄的发言人没有回应置评请求。

paras.en: The Nvidia founder resigned on Nov. 12 after reports that he had an affair with an Nvidia employee and with Alice Huang, a former executive at the Singapore-based company Megaspeed who is suspected of being a spy for China. A report of an affair with a second Nvidia employee broke right after he quit.
paras.zh: 这位 Nvidia 创始人于 11 月 12 日辞职，此前有报道称，他与 Nvidia 一名员工以及新加坡公司 Megaspeed 前高管 Alice Huang 有染，后者被怀疑是中国间谍。另一名英伟达员工辞职后，有关他与另一名员工发生婚外情的报道立即曝光。

paras.en: Nvidia's board named Kress, the company's chief financial officer, as the interim CEO while it searched for a permanent successor.
paras.zh: 英伟达董事会任命公司首席财务官克雷斯为临时首席执行官，同时寻找永久继任者。

paras.en: But within days of Kress taking over, some employees and investors who spoke to CNBC questioned her stewardship, as many of them clamored for Huang's return.
paras.zh: 但克雷斯接任后几天，接受 CNBC 采访的一些员工和投资者对她的管理能力提出了质疑，因为他们中的许多人强烈要求黄回归。

paras.en: Kress' performances at an all-hands company meeting on Wednesday and on Nvidia's earnings call with analysts a day earlier were seen by some investors as uninspiring and underwhelming.
paras.zh: 一些投资者认为，克雷斯在周三的公司全体会议上以及一天前在英伟达与分析师举行的财报电话会议上的表现并不鼓舞人心且平淡无奇。

paras.en: As the board faced those concerns amid a stock drop of more than 25% over the past week, Huang was aggressively working the phones with major tech CEOs who wanted to see him return to Nvidia, according to sources close to Huang.
paras.zh: 据接近黄的消息人士透露，由于董事会在过去一周股价下跌超过 25% 的情况下面临这些担忧，黄正在积极与希望看到他重返 Nvidia 的主要科技公司首席执行官通电话。

paras.en: In the days after he resigned, Huang spoke with OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, OpenAI President Greg Brockman, and Elon Musk, CEO of SpaceX and Tesla, one of the sources said.
paras.zh: 其中一位消息人士称，在他辞职后的几天里，黄与 OpenAI 首席执行官萨姆·奥尔特曼 (Sam Altman)、OpenAI 总裁格雷格·布罗克曼 (Greg Brockman) 以及 SpaceX 和特斯拉首席执行官埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 进行了交谈。

paras.en: Huang wanted his job back, but he was not sure what the return path looked like, the sources said.
paras.zh: 消息人士称，黄希望恢复工作，但他不确定返回路径是什么样的。

paras.en: On Nov. 17, less than a week after quitting, Huang issued a public statement saying he was open to returning as CEO.
paras.zh: 11 月 17 日，也就是辞职后不到一周，黄发布了一份公开声明，表示他对重新担任首席执行官持开放态度。

paras.en: "I've seen an outpouring of calls from NVIDIA's employees, investors, business partners, and customers for me to return as CEO," he said.
paras.zh: 他表示：“我看到 NVIDIA 的员工、投资者、业务合作伙伴和客户纷纷呼吁我重新担任首席执行官。”

paras.en: "NVIDIA is a once-in-a-generation company," he added. "If the Board of Directors decides that my return is in the best interest of our shareholders, our employees, the company, and America, I would be honored to answer these calls and return as CEO."
paras.zh: “NVIDIA 是一家百年一遇的公司，”他补充道。 “如果董事会认为我的回归符合我们的股东、员工、公司和美国的最佳利益，我将很荣幸回应这些呼吁并重新担任首席执行官。”

paras.en: On the same day, Nvidia's newly appointed board chair, Harvey Jones, told analysts on the company's earnings call that the board did "not intend to reinstate Jensen as CEO."
paras.zh: 同一天，英伟达新任命的董事会主席哈维·琼斯在公司财报电话会议上对分析师表示，董事会“不打算恢复詹森担任首席执行官”。

paras.en: Kress, the following day, told company employees at the all-hands meeting, "Let's move forward."
paras.zh: 第二天，克雷斯在全体员工会议上对公司员工说：“让我们继续前进。”

paras.en: Nvidia's public stance against Huang returning came as members of Congress moved ahead with plans to interview him at hearings and as criticism grew over the company's business in Asia.
paras.zh: 英伟达公开反对黄仁勋回归之际，国会议员正在推进在听证会上采访黄仁勋的计划，而且该公司在亚洲的业务受到越来越多的批评。

paras.en: The Department of Justice and the Commerce Department, in an unusual joint public statement on Nov. 17, said they were investigating Megaspeed for possible diversion of advanced Nvidia semiconductor chips to China in violation of U.S. export control law.
paras.zh: 美国司法部和商务部在 11 月 17 日发表的一份不同寻常的联合公开声明中表示，他们正在调查 Megaspeed 可能将先进的 Nvidia 半导体芯片转移到中国，违反了美国出口管制法。

paras.en: "Sensitive technologies like semiconductors are among the most valuable and strategic assets of the U.S. economy," the departments said.
paras.zh: 这些部门表示：“半导体等敏感技术是美国经济中最有价值和战略性的资产之一。”

paras.en: But days later, senior Trump administration officials contacted Nvidia's board to tell them that Jensen Huang himself was not a risk, according to the sources.
paras.zh: 但据消息人士透露，几天后，特朗普政府高级官员联系了英伟达董事会，告诉他们黄仁勋本人不存在风险。

paras.en: The Department of Commerce added Megaspeed to a trade blacklist later Monday.
paras.zh: 周一晚些时候，商务部将 Megaspeed 添加到贸易黑名单中。

paras.en: Trump, during his interview Monday with CNBC, was asked what Attorney General Todd Blanche had told him about potential criminal liability for Huang and the question of whether Nvidia chips had ended up in China in violation of U.S. export laws.
paras.zh: 特朗普在周一接受 CNBC 采访时被问及司法部长托德·布兰奇 (Todd Blanche) 告诉他关于黄的潜在刑事责任以及英伟达芯片最终是否违反美国出口法的问题。

paras.en: "They did a pretty good investigation, and they felt that he, himself, was exonerated," Trump said.
paras.zh: 特朗普说：“他们做了很好的调查，他们认为他本人是无罪的。”

paras.en: Both Trump and Vice President JD Vance became convinced that Huang was a singular figure who is preventing closed-source model AI companies, such as Anthropic, from getting too powerful, according to a person familiar with the matter, who spoke on condition of anonymity to disclose private discussions.
paras.zh: 据一位不愿透露姓名的知情人士透露，特朗普和副总统 JD Vance 都确信，黄仁勋是一个独特的人物，他正在阻止 Anthropic 等闭源模型人工智能公司变得过于强大。

paras.en: The person said Trump and Vance were briefed on the national security elements of the situation and saw no evidence that Huang did anything illegal or untoward in that regard.
paras.zh: 该人士表示，特朗普和万斯听取了有关情况的国家安全因素的简报，没有看到黄在这方面有任何非法或不当行为的证据。

paras.en: Trump believes his administration's close working relationship with Huang gives the U.S. its best opportunity to protect national security and prevent cutting-edge AI chips from reaching banned customers, according to the person.
paras.zh: 这位人士表示，特朗普认为，他的政府与黄仁勋的密切工作关系为美国提供了保护国家安全并防止尖端人工智能芯片到达被禁客户手中的最佳机会。

paras.en: Trump said he spoke with Huang on Sunday, after Nvidia had voted unanimously to reinstate him.
paras.zh: 特朗普表示，在英伟达一致投票决定恢复黄仁勋的职位后，他于周日与黄仁勋进行了交谈。

paras.en: "I called him up, and I said: 'I ask you to do one thing, Jensen. Work hard,'" Trump said.
paras.zh: “我给他打电话，我说：‘我要求你做一件事，詹森。努力工作，’”特朗普说。

paras.en: "He knows what to do and what not to do," Trump said. "But I just said work hard because if you work hard, there's nobody that can capture what you've done. Nobody, nobody close."
paras.zh: 特朗普说：“他知道什么该做，什么不该做。” “但我只是说努力工作，因为如果你努力工作，就没有人能捕捉到你所做的一切。没有人，没有人接近。”

paras.en: — CNBC's Kevin Breuninger and Kif Leswing contributed to this article.
paras.zh: — CNBC 的 Kevin Breuninger 和 Kif Leswing 对本文做出了贡献。

articles.title: AI adoption grows in Asia, but measuring the gains remains tricky

paras.en: Businesses across Asia-Pacific say their investments in artificial intelligence are paying off, with the technology helping boost productivity and revenue. But putting a number on those gains is proving far less straightforward.
paras.zh: 亚太地区的企业表示，他们对人工智能的投资正在获得回报，该技术有助于提高生产力和收入。但事实证明，用数字来衡量这些收益远没有那么简单。

paras.en: Some 58% of businesses using AI said their investments had already surpassed their initial costs, yet just 12% were very confident in their ability to accurately measure their return on investment, according to research conducted by Strand Partners for Amazon Web Services.
paras.zh: Strand Partners 为 Amazon Web Services 进行的研究显示，约 58% 使用人工智能的企业表示，他们的投资已经超过了初始成本，但只有 12% 的企业对自己准确衡量投资回报的能力非常有信心。

paras.en: The survey included 9,750 business leaders across 10 Asia-Pacific markets: Australia, Indonesia, Japan, Malaysia, New Zealand, the Philippines, Singapore, South Korea, Thailand and Vietnam.
paras.zh: 该调查涵盖了 10 个亚太市场的 9,750 名商界领袖：澳大利亚、印度尼西亚、日本、马来西亚、新西兰、菲律宾、新加坡、韩国、泰国和越南。

paras.en: The biggest shift over the past year has been the growing number of companies moving AI projects into production, Jaime Vallés, AWS vice president for Asia Pacific, Japan and China, told CNBC in an exclusive interview.
paras.zh: AWS 亚太、日本和中国副总裁 Jaime Vallés 在接受 CNBC 独家采访时表示，过去一年最大的变化是越来越多的公司将人工智能项目投入生产。

paras.en: "From year over year, probably the biggest difference is you're seeing a lot of ideas put into production," Vallés said.
paras.zh: “年复一年，最大的区别可能是你看到很多想法被投入生产，”瓦莱斯说。

paras.en: Despite the reported financial benefits, many businesses remain in the early stages of AI adoption.
paras.zh: 尽管报告了经济效益，但许多企业仍处于人工智能采用的早期阶段。

paras.en: The survey found that 64% of businesses using AI across Asia-Pacific and Japan still rely on general-purpose AI tools or ready-made solutions for specific tasks, while only 19% of businesses have a formal and comprehensive AI strategy.
paras.zh: 调查发现，亚太地区和日本使用人工智能的企业中有 64% 仍然依赖通用人工智能工具或现成的解决方案来完成特定任务，而只有 19% 的企业拥有正式且全面的人工智能战略。

paras.en: Among those with such an AI strategy, 35% had reached the most advanced stage of adoption, compared with just 8% of businesses without one, according to the research.
paras.zh: 研究显示，在采用此类人工智能战略的企业中，35% 的企业已达到采用的最高级阶段，而没有这种战略的企业中这一比例仅为 8%。

paras.en: Technology alone is not enough to turn AI investments into meaningful business outcomes, Vallés said. He pointed to what he called the "four Rs of readiness": technological, cultural, skills and personal readiness.
paras.zh: 瓦莱斯表示，仅靠技术不足以将人工智能投资转化为有意义的业务成果。他指出了他所说的“4R准备度”：技术、文化、技能和个人准备度。

paras.en: "Where we see more meaningful impact is when you see the leadership using AI, building a culture of using AI and using AI to transform and not automate," Vallés said.
paras.zh: 瓦莱斯说：“当你看到领导层使用人工智能、建立使用人工智能的文化以及使用人工智能进行转型而不是自动化时，我们会看到更有意义的影响。”

paras.en: Financial services is among the sectors seeing stronger AI adoption. Vallés pointed to Vietnam's Techcombank as an example, saying the bank is using AI to assess loan applications and expand access to credit for small businesses.
paras.zh: 金融服务是人工智能应用更为广泛的行业之一。 Vallés 以越南 Techcombank 为例，称该银行正在使用人工智能来评估贷款申请并扩大小企业获得信贷的机会。

paras.en: The technology has helped the bank to analyze more data and approve some loan applications that might otherwise have been rejected, he said.
paras.zh: 他说，这项技术帮助银行分析更多数据并批准一些可能被拒绝的贷款申请。

paras.en: Techcombank, one of Vietnam's largest commercial banks, serves more than 16.5 million retail and corporate customers. According to an AWS case study, its modernization of digital banking infrastructure using AWS improved application response times by up to 35% and cut the time needed to launch new product features by 30%.
paras.zh: Techcombank 是越南最大的商业银行之一，为超过 1,650 万零售和企业客户提供服务。根据 AWS 案例研究，其使用 AWS 实现的数字银行基础设施现代化将应用程序响应时间缩短了高达 35%，并将推出新产品功能所需的时间缩短了 30%。

paras.en: AI adoption continued to expand across Asia-Pacific, with all 10 markets surveyed recording increases from the previous year.
paras.zh: 亚太地区人工智能的采用继续扩大，接受调查的所有 10 个市场均较上年有所增长。

paras.en: Australia led the group with an adoption rate of 61%, followed by Singapore at 59% and South Korea at 58%.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚以 61% 的采用率领先，其次是新加坡（59%）和韩国（58%）。

paras.en: Still, businesses face significant obstacles to scaling AI investments. A shortage of AI and digital skills remains a key barrier, cited by 48% of respondents as an obstacle to adoption or expansion.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，企业在扩大人工智能投资方面仍面临重大障碍。人工智能和数字技能的短缺仍然是一个主要障碍，48% 的受访者认为这是采用或扩展的障碍。

paras.en: Despite those challenges, Vallés expressed optimism about Asia-Pacific's role in AI innovation, pointing to the region's cultural diversity and range of perspectives.
paras.zh: 尽管面临这些挑战，瓦莱斯对亚太地区在人工智能创新中的作用表示乐观，并指出该地区的文化多样性和视角广泛。

paras.en: "I am convinced that most of the innovation in the fullness of time will come from our region," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“我相信，随着时间的推移，大部分创新将来自我们地区。”

paras.en: Vallés added that Asia-Pacific has the ingredients to become a global center for innovation, citing its diversity, talent, startup ecosystem and technology.
paras.zh: 瓦莱斯补充说，亚太地区拥有成为全球创新中心的要素，因为其多样性、人才、创业生态系统和技术。

paras.en: "APAC, to make it simpler, has all the ingredients to be in my view the core or the center of worldwide innovation," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“简单来说，亚太地区具备成为全球创新核心或中心的所有要素。”

articles.title: CrowdStrike CEO defends Zscaler acquisition, calls it a 'winning combination'

paras.en: CrowdStrike CEO George Kurtz on Monday defended the cybersecurity company's planned acquisition of Zscaler, arguing the deal will strengthen its security capabilities and create significant growth opportunities despite a sharp sell-off in its shares.
paras.zh: CrowdStrike 首席执行官 George Kurtz 周一为该网络安全公司计划收购 Zscaler 进行了辩护，称该交易将增强其安全能力，并创造重大增长机会，尽管其股价大幅下跌。

paras.en: "When you look at the tailwinds from these agentic attacks and you listen to customers, they're looking for a complete solution and a platform that delivers not only all of the capabilities we have, but also has network visibility, protection, and control, and zero trust from a network perspective," Kurtz told CNBC's Jim Cramer on "Mad Money." "This is why we acquired Zscaler today. The technology, the team, and we think it's a winning combination putting it together with the CrowdStrike platform."
paras.zh: Kurtz 在“Mad Money”节目中对 CNBC 的 Jim Cramer 表示：“当你观察这些代理攻击带来的影响并倾听客户的意见时，他们正在寻找一个完整的解决方案和一个平台，不仅提供我们拥有的所有功能，而且还具有网络可见性、保护和控制，以及从网络角度来看的零信任。” “这就是我们今天收购 Zscaler 的原因。技术、团队，我们认为将其与 CrowdStrike 平台结合在一起是一个成功的组合。”

paras.en: Shares of CrowdStrike fell roughly 9% Monday after the company announced it would acquire Zscaler in an all-stock deal valued at roughly $44 billion, raising investor concerns about dilution. The deal is expected to close in the second half of CrowdStrike's fiscal year 2028. Zscaler shares rose more than 17%.
paras.zh: CrowdStrike 宣布将以价值约 440 亿美元的全股票交易收购 Zscaler，周一该公司股价下跌约 9%，引发投资者对股权稀释的担忧。该交易预计将在 CrowdStrike 2028 财年下半年完成。Zscaler 股价上涨超过 17%。

paras.en: The acquisition overshadowed CrowdStrike's better-than-expected quarterly results released Monday morning. The company had been scheduled to report earnings on Dec. 1, but moved up the release date to coincide with the Zscaler announcement.
paras.zh: 此次收购盖过了 CrowdStrike 周一上午发布的好于预期的季度业绩。该公司原定于 12 月 1 日公布收益报告，但推迟了发布日期以与 Zscaler 公告一致。

paras.en: The acquisition fills a key gap in CrowdStrike's cybersecurity platform. While its Falcon platform protects devices and cloud systems, Zscaler adds security across the networks connecting them. Kurtz said the deal expands CrowdStrike's addressable market by roughly $185 billion.
paras.zh: 此次收购填补了 CrowdStrike 网络安全平台的一个关键空白。虽然其 Falcon 平台可以保护设备和云系统，但 Zscaler 还增加了连接它们的网络的安全性。 Kurtz 表示，这笔交易将 CrowdStrike 的潜在市场扩大了约 1850 亿美元。

paras.en: CrowdStrike's largest acquisition to date comes amid a wave of consolidation in the cybersecurity industry as companies ramp up defenses against increasingly sophisticated AI-powered attacks. Recent high-profile hacks and technology outages have heightened concerns about vulnerabilities in corporate systems. CrowdStrike has been a major beneficiary of skyrocketing demand for AI security, with shares having soared about 96% this year entering Monday's session. For its part, Zscaler's stock ended last week down 13% year to date. As of Friday's close, the companies had a combined market value of more than $265 billion, trailing industry leader Palo Alto Networks at $282 billion.
paras.zh: CrowdStrike 迄今为止最大的一笔收购发生在网络安全行业的整合浪潮中，因为各公司加强了对日益复杂的人工智能攻击的防御。最近备受瞩目的黑客攻击和技术中断加剧了人们对企业系统漏洞的担忧。 CrowdStrike 是人工智能安全需求飙升的主要受益者，今年进入周一交易时段，其股价已飙升约 96%。就 Zscaler 而言，其股价上周收盘，今年迄今已下跌 13%。截至周五收盘，这些公司的总市值超过 2,650 亿美元，落后于行业领先者 Palo Alto Networks 的 2,820 亿美元。

paras.en: Kurtz also highlighted the potential to sell more products across the combined customer base. He said the companies share only about 2,000 accounts, leaving roughly 8,000 Zscaler customers that do not currently use CrowdStrike.
paras.zh: 库尔茨还强调了在合并后的客户群中销售更多产品的潜力。他表示，两家公司仅共享约 2,000 个账户，大约有 8,000 名 Zscaler 客户目前不使用 CrowdStrike。

paras.en: The companies are "very complementary overall," Kurtz said. "There's very little overlap."
paras.zh: 库尔茨说，这些公司“总体上非常互补”。 “几乎没有重叠。”

paras.en: He emphasized that the announcement generated an overwhelmingly positive response from customers.
paras.zh: 他强调，这一消息得到了客户的热烈响应。

paras.en: "Most important, customers demanded it. They loved it, and I can tell you, my phone blew up after the acquisition," Kurtz said. "There's so many customers that love both us and Zscaler, and they're excited to see the acquisition news today."
paras.zh: “最重要的是，客户要求它。他们喜欢它，我可以告诉你，我的手机在收购后就爆炸了，”库尔茨说。 “有很多客户都喜欢我们和 Zscaler，他们很高兴看到今天的收购消息。”

paras.en: To be sure, the all-stock deal has raised concerns about dilution, since CrowdStrike will issue new shares to pay for the acquisition, reducing existing shareholders' ownership stakes.
paras.zh: 可以肯定的是，全股票交易引发了对稀释的担忧，因为 CrowdStrike 将发行新股来支付收购费用，从而减少现有股东的所有权股份。

paras.en: Kurtz pushed back on those concerns, arguing that the combination will deliver immediate financial benefits. "On a free cash flow per share basis, it's immediately accretive right after close," he said. "With just modest synergies, you're going to have revenue, operating margin, and free cash flow margin accretion."
paras.zh: 库尔茨反驳了这些担忧，认为合并将带来立竿见影的经济效益。他表示：“以每股自由现金流计算，交易结束后，它会立即增值。” “只要适度的协同效应，你就会获得收入、营业利润和自由现金流利润的增长。”

paras.en: He also downplayed integration risks, pointing to the companies' longstanding technology partnership. That relationship dates back to at least 2019, and the firms announced an expanded partnership in August 2025. "Zscaler is our No. 1 technology partner," Kurtz said.
paras.zh: 他还淡化了整合风险，指出了两家公司长期的技术合作伙伴关系。这种关系至少可以追溯到 2019 年，两家公司于 2025 年 8 月宣布扩大合作伙伴关系。“Zscaler 是我们的第一大技术合作伙伴，”Kurtz 说。

paras.en: In a separate "Mad Money" interview, Zscaler CEO and Founder Jay Chaudhry emphasized that combining the companies' platforms will better position them to combat a new generation of AI-powered cyberattacks.
paras.zh: 在另一次“Mad Money”采访中，Zscaler 首席执行官兼创始人 Jay Chaudhry 强调，合并两家公司的平台将使他们能够更好地应对新一代人工智能网络攻击。

paras.en: "I think there's some areas where, by bringing the platforms together, we can become the best protection against AI attacks. That's why the timing became important, and we're coming from strength, both of us," Chaudhry said.
paras.zh: “我认为，在某些领域，通过将平台整合在一起，我们可以成为抵御人工智能攻击的最佳保护。这就是为什么时机变得重要，而且我们都来自实力，”乔杜里说。

paras.zh: 想深入了解克莱默的世界吗？打他！

articles.title: Voyager 1, SpaceX Starship and BepiColombo mark major space milestones

paras.en: Rachel Feltman: Happy Monday, listeners! For Scientific American’s Science Quickly, I’m Rachel Feltman.
paras.zh: 雷切尔·费尔特曼：听众们，星期一快乐！我是《科学美国人》的《科学快报》的雷切尔·费尔特曼。

paras.en: As usual, we’re starting the week off with a roundup of recent news. But because there’s been so much exciting space-related stuff happening in the last few weeks, we decided to spend today focused on space stories.
paras.zh: 像往常一样，我们以最近的新闻综述开始新的一周。但由于过去几周发生了很多令人兴奋的与太空相关的事情，我们决定今天重点关注太空故事。

paras.en: Here to fill us in is Lee Billings, senior editor for physical science at Scientific American.
paras.zh: 《科学美国人》物理科学高级编辑李·比林斯 (Lee Billings) 为我们介绍了这一情况。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: Lee, thanks so much for coming on to talk to us about all the exciting space news we’ve been having.
paras.zh: 李，非常感谢您接受我们的采访，谈论我们所收到的所有令人兴奋的太空新闻。

paras.en: Lee Billings: Rachel, it’s always my pleasure to be here. There’s so much to talk about. We’re barely gonna scratch the surface, but uh, it’s gonna be a lot of fun.
paras.zh: 李·比林斯：雷切尔，我很高兴来到这里。有很多话要说。我们几乎不会触及表面，但是，呃，这会很有趣。

paras.en: Feltman: Yeah, absolutely. Well, I guess, you know, is there a story that you would like to start with that’s felt particularly big the last couple weeks?
paras.zh: 费尔特曼：是的，绝对如此。好吧，我想，你知道，有没有一个故事是你想从过去几周感觉特别重要的开始的？

paras.en: Billings: You know, it’s hard not to go with NASA’s Voyager 1 probe, which is now, uh, on its way out of the solar system into interstellar space, reaching the one light-day milestone. So people talk about light-years a lot, which, you know, “Oh, a light year, how far is that?” Well, really, really, really far. But it turns out even a light-day is very, very far because Voyager 1 was launched almost a half century ago, in September 1977, on a tour of the outer solar system. It swung by Jupiter and Saturn. Here we are, almost a half-century later. It’s been traveling at about 38,000 miles per hour, and just last week, Voyager 1 finally hit that milestone of one light-day, the point at which a signal from Earth to the spacecraft or a signal from the spacecraft to Earth takes a full 24 hours traveling through space to get to its destination. And that, to me, is just wild. It’s a relatively small thing, but it’s still so cool.
paras.zh: 比林斯：你知道，很难不选择 NASA 的航行者 1 号探测器，它现在正在离开太阳系进入星际空间，达到一光日的里程碑。所以人们经常谈论光年，你知道，“哦，一光年，那有多远？”嗯，真的，真的，真的很远。但事实证明，即使是一个光日也非常非常遥远，因为航海者一号是在近半个世纪前的 1977 年 9 月发射的，当时正在外太阳系巡游。它绕着木星和土星摆动。近半个世纪后，我们来到这里。它的飞行速度约为每小时 38,000 英里，就在上周，旅行者 1 号终于达到了一光日的里程碑，在这一点上，从地球到航天器的信号或从航天器到地球的信号需要整整 24 小时穿过太空才能到达目的地。对我来说，这太疯狂了。这是一个相对较小的事情，但它仍然很酷。

paras.en: Feltman: Yeah. No, it really puts the scale of it all into perspective. You know, I feel like Voyager is such a fun mission, and we don’t talk about it that much. I feel like it comes up when we hit a big milestone for how far out it is. So could you remind our listeners what the point of Voyager is and what it’s doing out there?
paras.zh: 费尔特曼：是的。不，它确实让我们全面了解了这一切的规模。你知道，我觉得 Voyager 是一个非常有趣的任务，但我们对此谈论得不多。我觉得当我们达到一个重要的里程碑时，它就会出现。那么您能否提醒我们的听众 Voyager 的意义是什么以及它正在做什么？

paras.en: Billings: So Voyager 1 was one of two probes. There was a sister probe called Voyager 2 that was actually, somewhat counterintuitively, launched earlier than Voyager 1. But the pair of them went out into the outer solar system on what some people called a grand tour. And Voyager 1 looked at Jupiter and at Saturn, and Voyager 2 looked at those as well and also looked at Uranus and Neptune.
paras.zh: 比林斯：航海者一号是两个探测器之一。还有一个名为航海者 2 号的姊妹探测器，实际上有点违反直觉，它比航海者 1 号更早发射。但这两个探测器进入了太阳系外层，进行了一些人所说的盛大旅行。航海家一号观察了木星和土星，航海家二号也观察了这些，还观察了天王星和海王星。

paras.en: And now they’re both on their way out of the solar system. They, in fact, have already breached the so-called heliopause, this boundary in space where the sun’s influence wanes, and instead they’re essentially in interstellar space. And today it seems kind of basic. Oh, they went and saw these outer planets. Well, back then we didn’t really know much about these planets, and even now some of the observations from Voyager 1 or Voyager 2 are the best we’ve got from some of these locations, like Neptune or Uranus, for instance.
paras.zh: 现在他们都在离开太阳系的路上。事实上，它们已经突破了所谓的日球层顶，这是太阳影响力减弱的空间边界，而它们本质上是在星际空间中。今天看来，这似乎很基本。哦，他们去看了这些外行星。好吧，当时我们对这些行星了解不多，即使现在，航海者 1 号或航海者 2 号的一些观测结果也是我们从其中一些位置（例如海王星或天王星）获得的最好观测结果。

paras.en: Feltman: Well, and speaking of, you know, exactly how far out they are, it’s kind of a semantic discussion of if and when they’ve reached the solar system, right?
paras.zh: 费尔特曼：嗯，说到，你知道，它们到底有多远，这是一种关于它们是否以及何时到达太阳系的语义讨论，对吧？

paras.en: Billings: That’s right. It depends on, kind of, what you define as the end of the solar system. For instance, beyond this heliopause I mentioned, this boundary where the sun’s influence wanes in terms of its solar wind and stuff like that, there’s also something called the Oort Cloud, which is much, much farther out, and that’s what we think is a big spherical shell of comets that are very, very, very far out around the solar system, but they’re still gravitationally bound to the sun. They’re still influenced by the sun’s gravity and held in thrall by it. And so some people would say that that is the true boundary of the solar system. So you’re right, it is a somewhat semantic consideration. But the whole point is that this is the farthest anything that we’ve ever sent out there has gotten in terms of a physical artifact, and it may stay that way for quite some time.
paras.zh: 比林斯：没错。这在某种程度上取决于你对太阳系终结的定义。例如，在我提到的日球层顶之外，太阳的影响力在太阳风等方面减弱的边界之外，还有一种叫做奥尔特云的东西，它离太阳很远很远，我们认为它是一个巨大的彗星球壳，它们在太阳系周围非常非常非常远，但它们仍然受到太阳引力的束缚。它们仍然受到太阳引力的影响并受其束缚。所以有人会说那才是太阳系的真正边界。所以你是对的，这是一种语义上的考虑。但重点是，就物理文物而言，这是我们发送到那里的最远的东西，并且它可能会保持这种状态相当长的一段时间。

paras.en: Feltman: Also, just as an aside: [I] love the Oort cloud. In my opinion, it’s one of the most Star Trek names of a thing that we have in our immediate cosmic vicinity. It’s just like, “That cloud full of Oorts,” you know?
paras.zh: 费尔特曼：另外，顺便说一句：[我]喜欢奥尔特云。在我看来，这是我们在宇宙附近拥有的最像《星际迷航》的名字之一。就像“那片充满奥尔特的云”，你知道吗？

paras.en: Billings: Yeah, and the weirdest thing is, you know, we’ve never actually seen it directly. The only way we know it’s there, basically, is that we can look at the trajectories of these long-period comets and surmise that they must be coming from this reservoir that’s very, very far away, with a boundary that’s perhaps around one light-year away. And unfortunately, it will take Voyager 1 much longer to get past that.
paras.zh: 比林斯：是的，最奇怪的是，你知道，我们从未真正直接看到过它。基本上，我们知道它在那里的唯一方法是，我们可以观察这些长周期彗星的轨迹，并推测它们一定来自这个非常非常远的水库，其边界可能在一光年左右。不幸的是，航行者一号需要更长的时间才能克服这个问题。

paras.en: Feltman: Well, great segue to my last question about Voyager, which is just: What can we expect next from this, you know, very long-lived mission? What would you say are some of the milestones or pings back that we’re most excited about?
paras.zh: 费尔特曼：嗯，很好地继续我关于航行者号的最后一个问题，这就是：我们接下来可以从这个非常长寿的任务中期待什么？您认为我们最兴奋的一些里程碑或反馈是什么？

paras.en: Billings: So I don’t wanna be a downer. I do think that what’s happened with Voyager 1 and also Voyager 2 is amazing and beautiful, and they’re phenomenal achievements of humanity that will go down in history. At the same time, nothing lasts forever, and Voyager 1, and I think also Voyager 2, are both slated to essentially go dark no later than about 2036, about 10 years from now. And that’s because their radioactive, nuclear power sources that give them heat and electricity way out there, where things like solar power won’t work ’cause they’re so far away, uh, will diminish to essentially nothing due to radioactive decay. They will no longer be able to send signals back. They’ll no longer be able to stay warm, and so they’ll freeze and go dark. Obviously that’s at most 10 years away. I think perhaps it’s optimistic to think that they will reach that point because they’re already hanging on by a thread.
paras.zh: 比林斯：所以我不想成为一个沮丧的人。我确实认为航海家一号和航海家二号所发生的事情是令人惊叹和美丽的，它们是人类的非凡成就，将载入史册。与此同时，没有什么是永恒的，航海者 1 号和我认为航海者 2 号都预计将在 2036 年左右（即从现在起大约 10 年后）基本上陷入黑暗。那是因为它们的放射性核动力源为它们提供热量和电力，而太阳能之类的东西则无法工作，因为它们距离太远，呃，由于放射性衰变，它们将基本上消失殆尽。他们将无法再发回信号。它们将不再能够保持温暖，因此它们会被冻住并变黑。显然，这最多还需要10年的时间。我认为也许乐观地认为他们会达到这一点，因为他们已经命悬一线了。

paras.en: Some people at NASA were very concerned that Voyager 1 wouldn’t even be awake, so to speak, to see this light-day milestone because they have been having a lot of trouble with keeping its instruments on. They have been shutting down instruments and components on these spacecraft to continue to use them on the small trickle of electricity, of power that still comes from these radioactive power sources. And so we do have some, some time still left in their life, so enjoy them while you can.
paras.zh: NASA 的一些人非常担心航海者 1 号甚至不会醒来，可以说，看到这个光日里程碑，因为他们在保持仪器开启方面遇到了很多麻烦。他们一直在关闭这些航天器上的仪器和组件，以继续使用仍然来自这些放射性电源的少量电力。因此，他们的生命中确实还剩下一些时间，所以趁你还可以的时候享受它们吧。

paras.en: Feltman: Always good advice. Well, let’s move on to another piece of space news that people may have seen recently, that has to do with reusable rockets and some chopsticks, some big ol’ space chopsticks.
paras.zh: 费尔特曼：总是好的建议。好吧，让我们转向人们最近可能看到的另一条太空新闻，这与可重复使用的火箭和一些筷子有关，一些大的太空筷子。

paras.en: Billings: Oh, goodness, goodness, goodness. Yes, yes, of course. Well, I hope everyone’s heard about this because it is a very big deal. SpaceX’s experimental Starship, a fully reusable megarocket that’s just giant, it’s hard to envision the scale of this thing, went up into orbit, it deployed some Starlink satellites, and then it came back to Earth, and it flew back to its launch site, and it precision flew and slid in kinda like a glove into its launch tower, which then deployed these, yes, these mechanical arms that are called chopsticks and plucked it out of midair. I guess you could say that if they’re chopsticks, then the Starship upper stage that did this is like the world’s biggest egg roll, and it plucked it right out of midair.
paras.zh: 比林斯：哦，天哪，天哪，天哪。是的，是的，当然。好吧，我希望每个人都听说过这件事，因为这是一件大事。 SpaceX 的实验星舰，一个完全可重复使用的巨型火箭，非常巨大，很难想象它的规模，进入轨道，部署了一些星链卫星，然后返回地球，飞回发射场，它精确地飞行并像手套一样滑入发射塔，然后部署这些，是的，这些被称为筷子的机械臂，并将其从半空中拔出。我想你可能会说，如果它们是筷子，那么星舰上层做这件事就像世界上最大的鸡蛋卷一样，它直接从半空中把它夹了起来。

paras.en: And the reason why this is a big deal is because that’s never, ever, ever been done before. This is something out of science fiction. The engineering behind this is staggering. Only SpaceX has managed to do it, and it matters because if they can catch these things routinely and then fly them again very quickly—that’s the whole point of catching them like this—then you are in a new era of spaceflight. You are in a place where, all of a sudden, instead of launching this thing, you know, maybe at best once every few days or once a week or once a month, you might be launching it a dozen times a day. And that is a very wild prospect, and I don’t think anyone’s really ready for what the world literally looks like if that happens. I can’t emphasize enough how much of a change and a shift that would be in what we can put into space, and also, frankly, some of the environmental effects we might have to deal with from such a rapid uptick in launches. So it is a very, very big deal, and people looking back 100 years from now will probably look at that moment, and they’ll forget about the light-day, and they’ll say, “Oh, that was when, uh, SpaceX managed to catch the upper stage of Starship with the chopsticks.”
paras.zh: 这之所以是一件大事，是因为以前从未这样做过。这是科幻小说中的东西。这背后的工程技术令人震惊。只有 SpaceX 成功做到了这一点，这很重要，因为如果他们能够定期捕捉这些东西，然后很快地再次飞行它们——这就是像这样捕捉它们的全部意义——那么你就进入了航天的新时代。你知道，你突然之间就不再启动这个东西了，最好是每隔几天、每周一次或每月一次，而可能是每天启动十几次。这是一个非常疯狂的前景，我认为没有人真正准备好迎接这种情况发生时世界的实际情况。我无法充分强调我们可以投入太空的东西将会有多大的变化和转变，而且坦率地说，我们可能必须应对发射数量如此迅速增加所带来的一些环境影响。所以这是一件非常非常大的事情，100 年后的人们回顾过去，可能会看到那一刻，他们会忘记光日，他们会说，“哦，那时候，嗯，SpaceX 成功地用筷子抓住了星舰的上层。”

paras.en: Feltman: Yeah. Before we move on, one last question on that. Could you tell us briefly what it is about catching the rocket in air that makes it so much more practically, you know, reusable than having it land back on the ground?
paras.zh: 费尔特曼：是的。在我们继续之前，还有最后一个问题。您能否简单地告诉我们，在空中捕获火箭的原因是什么，使得它比让它降落在地面上更加实用，可以重复使用？

paras.en: Billings: So I think a lot of it has to do with, in some sense, with the tower rather than the rocket. Because people think about these rockets going off into space and shooting into orbit, and they focus on the rocket, and they don’t really pay a lot of attention to the launchpad or the launch tower. But those are critical pieces of infrastructure in this equation as well. And we’ve seen in the past what happens when a rocket as mighty as Starship interacts with its big plume of exhaust, its fiery plume of gas coming out of its rocket engines. What happens when that stuff hits that, sort of, infrastructure? A direct hit can be pretty nasty. And you can reinforce that infrastructure, but it’s probably easier just to minimize the sandblasting effects and the flambéing that happens with a more direct exposure. So you catch it in midair, you ideally preserve more of the readiness of the tower itself and also, frankly, the rocket. The rocket is gonna have to go through a significant, kind of, g-force experience when it shudders to a stop on the ground. And if you can minimize that stuff you notionally can launch much faster and do a faster turnaround.
