paras.en: Diplomatic relations were normalized in 1972 and Tokyo pursued a policy of engagement over the following decades, although that came to a halt in the mid-2000s, points out David Adebahr, a professor of international relations and Asia-Pacific security policy at Kobe University.
paras.zh: 神户大学国际关系和亚太安全政策教授大卫·阿德巴尔指出，1972年两国外交关系正常化，东京在接下来的几十年里奉行接触政策，尽管这种政策在2000年代中期停止了。

paras.en: Japan's Taiwan comments open new rift with Beijing
paras.zh: 日本的台湾言论引发与北京的新裂痕

paras.en: "China's rising military spending, the breakdown of talks over the East China Sea in 2006, and a resurgence of nationalism raised concerns even among Japan's more China-friendly diplomats, while defence analysts noted an increase in Chinese submarine activity near Japanese waters," he told DW.
paras.zh: 他告诉德国之声：“中国不断增加的军费开支、2006年东海谈判的破裂以及民族主义的复苏，甚至引起了对中国更为友好的日本外交官的担忧，而防务分析人士指出，中国潜艇在日本水域附近的活动有所增加。”

paras.en: The nationalism on display during the 2008 Beijing Olympics, coupled with China's more assertive stance over the Senkaku Islands, which Japan has sovereignty over but which Beijing claims, accelerated this shift.
paras.zh: 2008 年北京奥运会期间表现出的民族主义，加上中国对日本拥有主权但北京声称拥有主权的尖阁列岛采取更加自信的立场，加速了这一转变。

paras.en: Ties took a sudden nosedive in November 2025 when Takaichi responded to a question in Japan's parliament, the Diet, by saying that any "contingency” involving Taiwan would also inevitably threaten the national security of Japan.
paras.zh: 2025 年 11 月，高市在日本国会回答提问时表示，任何涉及台湾的“意外事件”也将不可避免地威胁日本的国家安全，两国关系突然急转直下。

paras.en: According to Adebahr, the Japanese leader was merely saying out loud what "had long been the internal logic of Japanese security planning." Nevertheless, Beijing has reacted with fury.
paras.zh: 阿德巴尔表示，这位日本领导人只是大声说出“长期以来日本安全计划的内部逻辑”。然而，北京方面做出了愤怒的反应。

paras.en: China has demanded that Takaichi retract the statement and raised pressure on Japan by restricting exports of rare earth minerals critical to Japanese industry, banning imports of Japanese seafood and telling tourists to take Japan off their destination list.
paras.zh: 中国要求高市收回声明，并通过限制对日本工业至关重要的稀土矿物出口、禁止进口日本海鲜以及要求游客将日本从目的地名单中删除等方式向日本施加压力。

paras.en: And while ruffled national feelings have been smoothed in the past with shows of reciprocal goodwill, China is standing firm on its demands this time.
paras.zh: 尽管过去曾通过展示互惠善意来缓和激怒的民族感情，但这一次中国坚定了自己的要求。

paras.en: "From Tokyo's perspective, it is clear that Beijing believes it holds more cards than in the past," said Adebahr.
paras.zh: 阿德巴尔表示：“从东京的角度来看，北京显然认为自己比过去拥有更多的牌。”

paras.en: "Today, Beijing has considerable leverage: Japan's dependence on Chinese rare earths; an increasingly visible military presence around Japan, sometimes in conjunction with Russia; and a US administration that has urged Tokyo to de-escalate rather than firmly backing it."
paras.zh: “如今，北京拥有相当大的影响力：日本对中国稀土的依赖；日本周边日益明显的军事存在，有时还与俄罗斯联合；美国政府敦促东京缓和局势，而不是坚定支持。”

paras.en: Adebahr added that this left China with little incentive to offer Takaichi a face-saving compromise. However, he pointed out that Beijing's reliance on coercion could backfire by prompting Japan to increase defence spending and seek closer ties with other partners.
paras.zh: 阿德巴尔补充说，这使得中国没有动力向高市提出一个保全面子的妥协方案。不过，他指出，北京对胁迫的依赖可能会适得其反，促使日本增加国防开支并寻求与其他伙伴建立更密切的关系。

paras.en: Still, the Japanese leader finds herself in a difficult position, said analyst Yang.
paras.zh: 分析师杨表示，尽管如此，这位日本领导人仍发现自己处于困境。

paras.en: As a committed conservative who has talked tough on Beijing's rapid military buildup, its seizure of islands and atolls in the South China Sea and the inexorable pressure on Taiwan to capitulate and become one with mainland China, Takaichi cannot give in to Xi's demands for fear of losing face with her hardline base.
paras.zh: 作为一名坚定的保守派，他对北京的快速军事集结、在南海夺取岛屿和环礁以及对台湾投降并与中国大陆合而为一的不可阻挡的压力发表了强硬言论，高市不能屈服于习近平的要求，因为担心在她的强硬派选民面前丢脸。

paras.en: "This is a major test of her abilities and wisdom as the nation's leader," Yang said. "She is walking a political tightrope between reducing tensions with China but, at the same time, preparing the nation and its allies for a potential contingency over Taiwan."
paras.zh: 杨说：“这是对她作为国家领导人的能力和智慧的重大考验。” “她在政治上走钢丝，既要缓和与中国的紧张关系，又要让国家及其盟友为台湾问题上的潜在突发事件做好准备。”

paras.en: "I foresee China maintaining its current approach, continuing to step up the pressure by limiting targeted exports and amplifying the assertion with Russia and North Korea that Japan is embracing remilitarization," he said.
paras.zh: 他表示：“我预计中国将维持目前的做法，通过限制有针对性的出口继续加大压力，并强化对俄罗斯和朝鲜的说法，即日本正在拥抱重新军事化。”

paras.en: Yang added that Japan was likely to seek opportunities to signal goodwill and improve relations "in return for small-scale compromises." However, he said that a reset in the dynamics would depend on how the Trump administration shaped its foreign policy for the remainder of his presidency.
paras.zh: 杨补充说，日本可能会寻求机会表达善意并改善关系，“以换取小规模妥协”。不过，他表示，动态的重置将取决于特朗普政府如何制定其剩余总统任期内的外交政策。

paras.en: Analyst Adebahr said that while he expects diplomatic relations to remain frosty, there are too many interdependencies for a full decoupling between China and Japan.
paras.zh: 分析师阿德巴尔表示，虽然他预计外交关系将继续冷淡，但中日之间存在太多相互依存关系，无法实现全面脱钩。

paras.en: "I would not be too pessimistic about the relationship, because in the medium term, trade, technology and critical minerals are now seen as security issues," he added. "Therefore, complex interdependence will prevent a return to the old pattern of keeping politics and economics separate."
paras.zh: “我不会对这种关系过于悲观，因为从中期来看，贸易、技术和关键矿产现在被视为安全问题，”他补充道。 “因此，复杂的相互依存关系将阻止回到政治和经济分离的旧模式。”

paras.en: "While economic interdependence alone will not be enough to stabilize the relationship, full decoupling is highly unlikely, as transaction costs would be far too high for both sides," he said.
paras.zh: 他表示：“虽然经济上的相互依存不足以稳定两国关系，但完全脱钩的可能性极小，因为交易成本对双方来说都太高了。”

articles.title: What Nvidia’s Jensen Huang’s return means for Washington and Wall Street?

paras.en: Nvidia founder Jensen Huang’s dramatic return to the helm of the world’s most valuable chipmaker, less than two weeks after his resignation, has sent the company’s stock soaring.
paras.zh: 英伟达创始人黄仁勋在辞职不到两周后戏剧性地重新掌舵这家全球最有价值的芯片制造商，导致该公司股价飙升。

paras.en: At the same time, the White House’s involvement in his reinstatement has raised questions about Silicon Valley’s growing sway in Washington, with United States President Donald Trump claiming to have been a linchpin in the decision.
paras.zh: 与此同时，白宫参与他的复职引发了人们对硅谷在华盛顿影响力日益增强的质疑，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普声称自己是这一决定的关键。

paras.en: The saga began less than two weeks ago when Huang resigned amid reports of extramarital affairs, including with Alice Huang, a woman alleged to be a Chinese spy.
paras.zh: 这段传奇故事开始于不到两周前，当时黄因婚外情报道而辞职，其中包括与据称是中国间谍的女性爱丽丝·黄(Alice Huang)的婚外情。

paras.en: Beijing has denied that Alice Huang is a spy. She previously led Megaspeed, a company that had a business relationship with Nvidia, the Santa Clara, California-based tech giant.
paras.zh: 北京否认黄爱丽是间谍。她之前领导过 Megaspeed 公司，该公司与总部位于加利福尼亚州圣克拉拉的科技巨头 Nvidia 有着业务关系。

paras.en: Nvidia’s board had begun an investigation into the allegations, but Huang resigned before it reached a conclusion.
paras.zh: 英伟达董事会已开始对这些指控进行调查，但黄在得出结论之前就辞职了。

paras.en: In his absence, Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress took over as interim chief executive while the board searched for a permanent successor.
paras.zh: 在他缺席的情况下，首席财务官科莱特·克雷斯 (Colette Kress) 接任临时首席执行官，而董事会正在寻找永久继任者。

paras.en: However, Huang’s departure quickly prompted a backlash from influential figures in Silicon Valley. A petition calling for his reinstatement attracted more than 180,000 signatures, including that of SpaceX CEO Elon Musk.
paras.zh: 然而，黄的离开很快引起了硅谷有影响力人物的强烈反对。一份要求他复职的请愿书吸引了超过 18 万个签名，其中包括 SpaceX 首席执行官埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk)。

paras.en: Analysts also warned that losing Huang could significantly undermine Nvidia’s market value. Dan Ives, managing partner at Yorkville Ives, estimated that Huang’s departure could wipe as much as 30 percent off the company’s valuation.
paras.zh: 分析师还警告称，失去黄仁勋可能会严重削弱英伟达的市值。 Yorkville Ives 的管理合伙人丹·艾夫斯 (Dan Ives) 估计，黄仁勋的离职可能会使公司估值下降 30%。

paras.en: By Monday, Nvidia brought Huang back to lead the company.
paras.zh: 到周一，英伟达让黄重新领导该公司。

paras.en: “The Board believes Jensen is the right person to lead NVIDIA, and that his reinstatement is in the best interests of our stockholders, employees, partners and customers,” said Harvey C Jones, chair of the board, in a news statement. That was an about-face from just a few days ago when the board ruled out bringing back Huang.
paras.zh: 董事会主席 Harvey C Jones 在一份新闻声明中表示：“董事会认为 Jensen 是领导 NVIDIA 的合适人选，他的复职符合我们股东、员工、合作伙伴和客户的最佳利益。”这与几天前的情况发生了大转变，当时董事会排除了召回黄的可能性。

paras.en: “I am honored to return to NVIDIA and lead one of the most consequential technology companies in the world at the beginning of a new industrial revolution,” Huang added.
paras.zh: 黄补充道：“我很荣幸能够回到 NVIDIA，并在新工业革命开始之际领导世界上最有影响力的科技公司之一。”

paras.en: How has the Trump administration been involved?
paras.zh: 特朗普政府如何参与其中？

paras.en: Trump said on Monday that he played a central role in Huang’s reinstatement, saying in social media posts and in an interview with CNBC that his intervention had been instrumental in the board’s decision.
paras.zh: 特朗普周一表示，他在黄的复职过程中发挥了核心作用，并在社交媒体帖子和接受 CNBC 采访时表示，他的干预对董事会的决定发挥了重要作用。

paras.en: Trump said he had participated in the board meeting, following efforts by influential Silicon Valley figures to persuade the president to intervene in the leadership crisis, which analysts say lacked a clear succession plan.
paras.zh: 特朗普表示，在硅谷有影响力的人物努力说服总统干预领导层危机之后，他参加了董事会会议，分析人士称，这场领导危机缺乏明确的继任计划。

paras.en: Trump told CNBC that the stock market reaction to Huang’s resignation from Nvidia “probably” factored into his decision to push for the CEO’s reinstatement, although his view of the long-term benefit of having Huang at the helm of the company was the bigger weight, the Reuters news agency reported.
paras.zh: 据路透社报道，特朗普对 CNBC 表示，股市对黄仁勋从英伟达辞职的反应“可能”是他推动首席执行官复职的决定的一个因素，尽管他认为让黄仁勋执掌公司的长期利益才是更重要的因素。

paras.en: “I think this move is unprecedented in the sense that a sitting president has exerted very public pressure on a corporate board to make a particular decision,” Aleksandar Tomic, associate dean for strategy, innovation and technology at Boston College, told Al Jazeera.
paras.zh: 波士顿学院负责战略、创新和技术的副院长亚历山大·托米奇 (Aleksandar Tomic) 告诉半岛电视台：“我认为此举是史无前例的，因为现任总统向公司董事会施加了很大的公开压力，要求其做出特定决定。”

paras.en: Corporate governance experts say greater transparency is needed about the extent of Trump’s involvement in Nvidia’s leadership decisions.
paras.zh: 公司治理专家表示，特朗普参与英伟达领导决策的程度需要提高透明度。

paras.en: “A board can take input from [the] government; what it should not do is let any outside party choose the CEO without explaining to shareholders why,” Martin Mulyadi, professor of accounting at Shenandoah University’s College of Business, Engineering & Technology, told Al Jazeera.
paras.zh: 雪兰多大学商业、工程与技术学院会计学教授马丁·穆利亚迪 (Martin Mulyadi) 告诉半岛电视台：“董事会可以听取政府的意见；但它不应该让任何外部人士在不向股东解释原因的情况下选择首席执行官。”

paras.en: The intervention comes amid divisions within the Trump administration over Nvidia’s business practices and its relationship with China.
paras.zh: 此次干预发生之际，特朗普政府内部对英伟达的商业行为及其与中国的关系存在分歧。

paras.en: The Department of Justice (DOJ) and Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) continue to investigate the company, and Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has emerged as one of its most vocal critics.
paras.zh: 美国司法部 (DOJ) 和证券交易委员会 (SEC) 继续调查该公司，财政部长斯科特·贝森特 (Scott Bessent) 已成为最直言不讳的批评者之一。

paras.en: Bessent has questioned whether Nvidia facilitated chip sales to China to bolster its financial performance, alleging in an interview with Fox News that the AI chip giant had engaged in “seemingly illicit sales to goose their revenues and their earnings”.
paras.zh: 贝森特质疑英伟达是否促进了对中国的芯片销售以提振其财务业绩，并在接受福克斯新闻采访时声称，这家人工智能芯片巨头参与了“看似非法的销售，以提高其收入和收益”。

paras.en: He has also called for Nvidia to appoint a new chief executive from outside the company.
paras.zh: 他还呼吁英伟达从公司外部任命一位新首席执行官。

paras.en: Meanwhile, Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick faces allegations that he delayed restrictions on Nvidia chip sales to China, raising questions about whether his decisions were influenced by the financial interests of his former firm, Cantor Fitzgerald, which is now controlled by his two sons.
paras.zh: 与此同时，商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克 (Howard Lutnick) 面临指控，称他推迟了对英伟达 (Nvidia) 芯片向中国销售的限制，这引发了人们对他的决定是否受到其前公司 Cantor Fitzgerald 经济利益的影响的质疑，该公司现在由他的两个儿子控制。

paras.en: Democratic lawmakers are seeking to determine whether the firm’s holdings or business relationships benefitted from the Commerce Department’s failure to impose those restrictions.
paras.zh: 民主党议员正在寻求确定该公司的持股或业务关系是否因商务部未能实施这些限制而受益。

paras.en: “The key issue is how much of Nvidia’s revenue may be coming from sales that would not pass increased scrutiny vis-a-vis export control violations. Given accusations within the government of lax monitoring and enforcement, it is also not clear that Nvidia had robust controls, and their inability to stick to the CEO decision makes it doubtful that they will be able to implement it in the future,” Tomic said.
paras.zh: “关键问题是，英伟达的收入有多少可能来自于无法通过针对出口管制违规行为的严格审查的销售。鉴于政府内部对监管和执法不严的指控，也不清楚英伟达是否拥有强有力的控制措施，而且他们无法坚持首席执行官的决定，这让人怀疑他们未来是否能够执行该决定，”托米奇说。

paras.en: Trump’s involvement has also raised broader questions about the relationship between the federal government and corporate America, particularly the extent to which a president should influence decisions traditionally reserved for a company’s board of directors.
paras.zh: 特朗普的参与还引发了有关联邦政府与美国企业界之间关系的更广泛问题，特别是总统应在多大程度上影响传统上由公司董事会决定的决策。

paras.en: Tomic says that the level of direct pressure Trump placed on Nvidia’s board, including his participation in discussions about Huang’s reinstatement, is highly unusual for a sitting president.
paras.zh: 托米奇表示，特朗普对英伟达董事会施加的直接压力，包括他参与有关黄仁勋复职的讨论，对于现任总统来说是极不寻常的。

paras.en: The precedent could ultimately backfire on Republicans, Tomic warned, particularly as Democrats prepare to take control of both the House and Senate in January. Democrats have historically pushed for greater oversight of large corporations, and the incoming Congress could seek to exercise similar influence over corporate decision-making.
paras.zh: 托米奇警告说，这一先例最终可能会给共和党带来适得其反的影响，特别是在民主党准备在一月份控制众议院和参议院的情况下。民主党历史上一直推动对大公司进行更大的监督，即将上任的国会可能会寻求对公司决策施加类似的影响。

paras.en: “I think that Nvidia will invite much stronger government scrutiny, especially with Congress and the new administration in 2028, as they have shown a complete lack of capacity for self-governance,” Tomic said.
paras.zh: 托米奇表示：“我认为 Nvidia 将受到更严格的政府审查，尤其是国会和 2028 年新政府的审查，因为他们已经表现出完全缺乏自治能力。”

paras.en: Nvidia’s board’s decision to reinstate Huang could have lasting implications for corporate accountability, particularly in Silicon Valley, where investors frequently place enormous value on the leadership of company founders, Tomic added.
paras.zh: 托米奇补充说，英伟达董事会恢复黄仁勋的决定可能会对企业问责制产生持久影响，特别是在硅谷，投资者经常非常看重公司创始人的领导力。

paras.en: Huang’s reinstatement could reinforce the perception that prominent technology executives are indispensable to their companies, potentially making it more difficult to hold them accountable for personal or professional misconduct, he said.
paras.zh: 他表示，黄仁勋的复职可能会强化人们的看法，即杰出的技术高管对于他们的公司来说是不可或缺的，这可能会让追究他们个人或职业不当行为的责任变得更加困难。

paras.en: “It is hard to imagine any other industry where this would happen. The attitude of immunity and idolatry of tech founders is grating on voters and is one of the reasons for the electoral outcome. This is an unforced error, as Huang could have stayed substantially involved at Nvidia in a much less public way,” Tomic added.
paras.zh: “很难想象任何其他行业会发生这种情况。科技创始人的豁免和偶像崇拜态度激怒了选民，也是选举结果的原因之一。这是一个非受迫性错误，因为黄仁勋本可以以一种不那么公开的方式继续深入参与英伟达，”托米奇补充道。

paras.en: Wall Street welcomed the news of Huang’s return, sending Nvidia shares soaring approximately 31 percent in early trading on Monday. The stock maintained much of those gains throughout the session.
paras.zh: 华尔街对黄仁勋回归的消息表示欢迎，导致英伟达股价在周一早盘交易中飙升约 31%。该股在整个交易日中保持了大部分涨幅。

paras.en: The rally extended beyond Nvidia, helping lift broader US stock markets, with all three major indices finishing the trading day in positive territory.
paras.zh: 涨势不仅限于英伟达，帮助提振了更广泛的美国股市，所有三大股指均在交易日收盘。

paras.en: The tech-heavy Nasdaq 100 rose nearly 7 percent, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average gained 3 percent and the S&P 500 climbed 4.7 percent.
paras.zh: 以科技股为主的纳斯达克 100 指数上涨近 7%，道琼斯工业平均指数上涨 3%，标准普尔 500 指数上涨 4.7%。

paras.en: Other major technology companies also benefitted from the rally. Shares of rival chipmaker Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) jumped 6.85 percent, while Microsoft gained 1.65 percent and Alphabet rose 5.8 percent.
paras.zh: 其他主要科技公司也从涨势中受益。竞争对手芯片制造商AMD (AMD) 股价上涨 6.85%，微软上涨 1.65%，Alphabet 上涨 5.8%。

paras.en: Why does this decision matter for the broader markets?
paras.zh: 为什么这个决定对更广泛的市场很重要？

paras.en: Nvidia has taken an outsized role in the broader markets. As of October, the tech giant accounted for 8.1 percent of the Nasdaq 100 index.
paras.zh: 英伟达在更广阔的市场中发挥了巨大的作用。截至 10 月，这家科技巨头占纳斯达克 100 指数的 8.1%。

paras.en: According to an analysis by The Wall Street Journal, Nvidia has amassed investments worth more than $100bn, including more than $48bn in shares of eight publicly traded companies, citing SEC filings.
paras.zh: 根据《华尔街日报》援引美国证券交易委员会备案文件的分析，英伟达已积累了价值超过 1000 亿美元的投资，其中包括价值超过 480 亿美元的八家上市公司的股票。

paras.en: Among those holdings is a 10 percent stake in CoreWeave, a cloud-computing company that operates data centres. CoreWeave shares surged 22 percent following news of Huang’s reinstatement.
paras.zh: 这些股份中包括 CoreWeave 10% 的股份，CoreWeave 是一家运营数据中心的云计算公司。在黄仁勋复职的消息传出后，CoreWeave 股价飙升 22%。

paras.en: Nvidia has broader connections to other companies.
paras.zh: 英伟达与其他公司有着更广泛的联系。

paras.en: In late August, Amazon announced plans to deploy an additional two million Nvidia graphics processing units (GPUs) through its cloud-computing division, Amazon Web Services, in 2027 and 2028. That commitment followed a previously announced deployment of more than one million GPUs in March.
paras.zh: 8 月下旬，亚马逊宣布计划在 2027 年和 2028 年通过其云计算部门 Amazon Web Services 额外部署 200 万个 Nvidia 图形处理单元 (GPU)。在此之前，亚马逊曾于 3 月份宣布部署超过 100 万个 GPU。

paras.en: Nvidia has also deepened its financial ties to Anthropic, committing $10bn to buy shares in the AI company’s blockbuster initial public offering on US markets late last week.
paras.zh: 英伟达还加深了与 Anthropic 的财务联系，承诺斥资 100 亿美元购买这家人工智能公司上周晚些时候在美国市场进行的大规模首次公开募股的股票。

articles.title: EU plans sports ban in sweeping new Russia sanctions proposal

paras.en: The European Commission has proposed new sanctions against Russia targeting its banks, crypto platforms, and participation in sporting events.
paras.zh: 欧盟委员会提议对俄罗斯实施新的制裁，目标是其银行、加密货币平台和参与体育赛事。

paras.en: Commission chief Ursula von der Leyen introduced the 22nd package of sanctions on Monday, which includes a ban on Russian teams and individual athletes competing under the country’s flag at events in the European Union.
paras.zh: 欧盟委员会主席乌苏拉·冯德莱恩周一提出了第 22 项制裁措施，其中包括禁止俄罗斯代表队和个人运动员代表该国参加欧盟赛事。

paras.en: “We are striking harder at Russia’s ways to finance its war, by targeting its banks and crypto platforms,” von der Leyen wrote in a post on X, adding that the EU will be “shutting the door to its participation in European sports and cultural events”.
paras.zh: 冯德莱恩在 X 上的一篇帖子中写道：“我们通过针对其银行和加密平台，对俄罗斯为其战争提供资金的方式进行更严厉的打击。”他补充说，欧盟将“关闭其参与欧洲体育和文化活动的大门”。

paras.en: Von der Leyen said 60 banks will be removed from the Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication (SWIFT) messaging system used for international payments under the new proposals, which are intended to maintain economic pressure on Russia, almost five years into its full-scale invasion of Ukraine.
paras.zh: 冯德莱恩表示，根据新提案，60家银行将被从用于国际支付的环球银行金融电信协会（SWIFT）消息系统中删除，其目的是在俄罗斯全面入侵乌克兰近五年后继续对俄罗斯施加经济压力。

paras.en: She announced the creation of a crypto sanctions task force seeking to curb countries helping Russia to evade sanctions.
paras.zh: 她宣布成立一个加密货币制裁特别工作组，旨在遏制帮助俄罗斯逃避制裁的国家。

paras.en: The commission also proposed a ban on visas for Russians who had fought in the war in Ukraine.
paras.zh: 该委员会还提议禁止向参加过乌克兰战争的俄罗斯人发放签证。

paras.en: “Russian ex-combatants pose a security risk to Europe. They cannot be allowed to wander freely across our countries,” von der Leyen said.
paras.zh: “俄罗斯前战斗人员对欧洲构成安全风险。不能允许他们在我们国家自由游荡，”冯德莱恩说。

paras.en: The plan also put forward restrictions on financial flows from Russian sponsors to sports and cultural associations based in the EU. Russian nationals would also no longer be allowed to hold leadership positions on the governing bodies of sports federations.
paras.zh: 该计划还对俄罗斯赞助商向欧盟体育和文化协会的资金流动提出了限制。俄罗斯国民也将不再被允许在体育联合会的管理机构中担任领导职务。

paras.en: “Sports events cannot be a forum for propaganda activities,” said von der Leyen.
paras.zh: “体育赛事不能成为宣传活动的论坛，”冯德莱恩说。

paras.en: The proposed package must be endorsed by all 27 EU member countries before going into force and comes just over a month after the bloc posted the largest listing of sanctions against Russia, targeting about 1,600 Russian officials and companies linked to its arms industry.
paras.zh: 拟议的一揽子计划必须得到所有 27 个欧盟成员国的批准才能生效，就在一个多月前，欧盟公布了针对俄罗斯的最大规模制裁清单，目标是约 1,600 名俄罗斯官员和与其军火工业相关的公司。

paras.en: The EU has already slapped sanctions on more than 4,200 people and entities, including Russian President Vladimir Putin and several energy companies.
paras.zh: 欧盟已对 4,200 多名个人和实体实施制裁，其中包括俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京和多家能源公司。

articles.title: Drone attack on Colombia police base injures civilians, including infant

paras.en: A drone attack on a police base in the Colombian city of Cucuta has injured at least three civilians, including an infant, and damaged 60 homes.
paras.zh: 无人机袭击了哥伦比亚库库塔市的一个警察基地，造成至少 3 名平民受伤，其中包括一名婴儿，并损坏了 60 所房屋。

paras.en: Officials did not immediately say who was responsible for the attack on Monday that struck the base belonging to the Norte de Santander police.
paras.zh: 官员们没有立即透露谁对周一袭击北桑坦德警察基地的袭击负责。

paras.en: Orlando Roa, who lives near the base, told local media that his 18-month-old grandson was among those injured and was being treated at a nearby hospital.
paras.zh: 住在基地附近的奥兰多·罗阿告诉当地媒体，受伤者中有他 18 个月大的孙子，正在附近的一家医院接受治疗。

paras.en: The attack came as far-right President Abelardo de la Espriella steps up an offensive against rebel groups and drug gangs that has resulted in the military capturing several mid-level commanders.
paras.zh: 这次袭击发生之际，极右翼总统阿韦拉多·德拉埃斯普里埃拉加大了对叛乱组织和贩毒团伙的攻势，导致军方抓获了几名中层指挥官。

paras.en: Armed groups have responded by attacking military bases and police stations with small drones, rockets made with gas canisters and roadside bombs. De la Espriella, who took office in August, has cancelled peace negotiations with rebel groups that were under way under his predecessor, leftist Gustavo Petro.
paras.zh: 武装团体的反应是用小型无人机、瓦斯罐火箭和路边炸弹袭击军事基地和警察局。八月上任的德拉埃斯普里埃拉取消了与反叛组织的和平谈判，该谈判在他的前任、左翼分子古斯塔沃·佩特罗的领导下正在进行。

paras.en: Cucuta, a city near Colombia’s border with Venezuela, is a major trade hub and a centre for criminal groups profiting from the drug trade and other kinds of smuggling. Rebel groups, including the National Liberation Army and the FARC-EMC, also operate in the nearby Catatumbo region.
paras.zh: 库库塔是哥伦比亚与委内瑞拉边境附近的一座城市，是一个主要的贸易中心，也是从毒品贸易和其他走私中获利的犯罪集团的中心。包括民族解放军和哥伦比亚革命武装力量-EMC在内的反叛组织也在附近的卡塔通博地区活动。

paras.en: In 2016, a peace deal between the Colombian government and the FARC led to the demobilisation of more than 14,000 fighters.
paras.zh: 2016年，哥伦比亚政府与哥伦比亚革命武装力量达成和平协议，导致14,000多名武装分子复员。

paras.en: However, some border areas in Colombia have seen a surge of violence as smaller armed groups try to seize territory abandoned by the FARC, where the government has been slow to provide security and basic services.
paras.zh: 然而，哥伦比亚的一些边境地区暴力事件激增，因为较小的武装团体试图夺取哥伦比亚革命武装力量放弃的领土，而政府在这些地区提供安全和基本服务的速度缓慢。

paras.en: Another police station in the Cesar region was also attacked with drones on Monday, injuring a police officer. On Saturday, one soldier was killed, and 12 others were injured during an attack with drones and rockets on a military base also in Cesar.
paras.zh: 塞萨尔地区的另一个警察局周一也遭到无人机袭击，造成一名警察受伤。周六，同样位于塞萨尔的一个军事基地遭到无人机和火箭袭击，造成 1 名士兵死亡，另有 12 人受伤。

paras.en: Both incidents remain under investigation, according to local officials.
paras.zh: 据当地官员称，这两起事件仍在调查中。

articles.title: Zelenskyy hails Ukraine's attack on a Russian warship docked at a naval base in Libya
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: Zelenskyy hails Ukraine's attack on a Russian warship docked at a naval base in Libya
paras.zh: 泽连斯基赞扬乌克兰袭击一艘停靠在利比亚海军基地的俄罗斯军舰

paras.en: KYIV, Ukraine — Ukraine carried out an attack on a Russian warship moored at a port in Libya, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Monday, claiming that maritime drones sank the navy vessel in a surprise assault the previous day.
paras.zh: 乌克兰基辅——总统泽连斯基周一表示，乌克兰对停泊在利比亚港口的一艘俄罗斯军舰进行了袭击，并声称海上无人机在前一天的突然袭击中击沉了这艘海军舰艇。

paras.en: Ukrainian forces deployed seven drones in the operation that struck the Russian navy corvette in the Mediterranean, according to Zelenskyy. The ship, the Merkury, was one of Russia's newest vessels, commissioned a year after Moscow launched the 2022 full-scale invasion of its neighbor, he said in a post on X.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基表示，乌克兰军队在地中海袭击俄罗斯海军护卫舰的行动中部署了七架无人机。他在 X 上的一篇帖子中表示，这艘名为“水星号”的船只是俄罗斯最新的船只之一，在莫斯科于 2022 年对其邻国发动全面入侵一年后投入使用。

paras.en: Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov declined to comment on the attack, saying that Russia's Defense Ministry would provide more information "if deemed to be appropriate."
paras.zh: 克里姆林宫发言人德米特里·佩斯科夫拒绝就此次袭击发表评论，称俄罗斯国防部“如果认为合适”将提供更多信息。

paras.en: The operation, conducted some 2,400 kilometers (1,500 miles) from the front line in Ukraine, was the latest daring long-range assault by Kyiv's forces.
paras.zh: 这次行动是在距乌克兰前线约 2,400 公里（1,500 英里）处进行的，是基辅部队最新一次大胆的远程攻击。

paras.en: Ukraine has at times embarrassed Moscow during the war with attacks such as Operation Spiderweb in June 2025, when drones launched from trucks hit over 40 aircraft parked at air bases across Russia. Along the roughly 1,250-kilometer (almost 800-mile) front line snaking through eastern and southern Ukraine, Kyiv's drones and ground robots are helping hold back Russia's bigger army.
paras.zh: 战争期间，乌克兰有时会发动袭击，例如 2025 年 6 月的蜘蛛网行动，当时从卡车发射的无人机击中了停在俄罗斯各地空军基地的 40 多架飞机。沿着蜿蜒穿过乌克兰东部和南部的约 1,250 公里（近 800 英里）前线，基辅的无人机和地面机器人正在帮助阻挡俄罗斯规模更大的军队。

paras.en: At the same time, Russia's missiles and drones have devastated Ukraine's power grid ahead of winter and damaged civilian buildings.
paras.zh: 与此同时，俄罗斯的导弹和无人机在冬季来临前摧毁了乌克兰的电网，并损坏了民用建筑。

paras.en: A Russian strike on a five-story apartment block in a village near Kyiv killed 11 people, regional police said Monday. A 7-year-old child and a 79-year-old woman were pulled alive from the rubble after the Sunday morning attack, rescue services said.
paras.zh: 地区警方周一表示，俄罗斯对基辅附近一个村庄的一座五层公寓楼发动袭击，造成 11 人死亡。救援部门称，周日上午的袭击事件后，一名 7 岁儿童和一名 79 岁妇女被从废墟中救出。

paras.en: Three people were killed Monday in a Russian strike on a hospital in the city of Zaporizhzhia in southern Ukraine, the regional military administration said. Two other people were killed when Russian forces struck a vehicle that bore markings indicating it was evacuating residents from the eastern city of Kramatorsk, authorities said.
paras.zh: 地区军事管理局称，俄罗斯周一对乌克兰南部扎波罗热市一家医院发动袭击，造成三人死亡。当局称，俄罗斯军队撞上了一辆带有标记的车辆，表明该车正在从东部城市克拉马托尔斯克疏散居民，造成另外两人死亡。

paras.en: Also on Monday, the European Commission proposed a new round of sanctions to keep economic pressure on Moscow, targeting dozens of Russian banks, cracking down on crypto platforms and slapping bans on sports teams and athletes competing under the country's flag.
paras.zh: 同样在周一，欧盟委员会提出了新一轮制裁措施，以保持对莫斯科的经济压力，制裁对象是数十家俄罗斯银行，打击加密货币平台，并禁止代表俄罗斯参加比赛的运动队和运动员。

paras.en: The proposals, put forward by Commission President Ursula von der Leyen, must be endorsed by all 27 European Union member countries before they can enter into force. The process can take weeks, and the planned measures are likely to be modified.
paras.zh: 这些提案由欧盟委员会主席乌苏拉·冯德莱恩提出，必须得到所有 27 个欧盟成员国的认可才能生效。该过程可能需要数周时间，并且计划的措施可能会被修改。

paras.en: The bloc has already hit more than 4,700 people and entities, including President Vladimir Putin, and several energy companies.
paras.zh: 该集团已对超过 4,700 名个人和实体造成影响，其中包括总统弗拉基米尔·普京 (Vladimir Putin) 和多家能源公司。

paras.en: Zelenskyy lauds Ukrainian attacks from Siberia to Libya
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基赞扬乌克兰从西伯利亚到利比亚的袭击

paras.en: Zelenskyy described Sunday's attack as "exemplary" and said "the targets we set were achieved."
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基将周日的袭击描述为“典范”，并表示“我们设定的目标已经实现”。

paras.en: "We continue our operations in designated waters. We are responding to Russia's aggression. We are developing Ukrainian weapons," he said.
paras.zh: “我们继续在指定水域开展行动。我们正在回应俄罗斯的侵略。我们正在开发乌克兰武器，”他说。

paras.en: Ukraine has hit Russian oil refineries as far away as western Siberia and Russian warships in the Mediterranean, Zelenskyy noted in a video address to a meeting of the NATO Parliamentary Assembly in Berlin.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基在柏林举行的北约议会会议上的视频讲话中指出，乌克兰袭击了远至西西伯利亚西部的俄罗斯炼油厂和地中海的俄罗斯军舰。

paras.en: An oil refinery in Russia's western Rostov region halted work Monday after what Gov. Yuri Slyusar said was a "massive" Ukrainian drone and missile attack that lasted more than six hours. Ukraine's General Staff said the refinery, located just a few dozen kilometers (miles) from the Ukrainian border, can process up to 55 million barrels of oil a year and was on fire after the attack.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯西部罗斯托夫地区的一家炼油厂周一停止了生产，此前州长尤里·斯柳萨尔表示，乌克兰发动了一场持续了六个多小时的“大规模”无人机和导弹袭击。乌克兰总参谋部表示，该炼油厂距离乌克兰边境仅几十公里，每年可加工多达 5500 万桶石油，在袭击后已起火。

paras.en: Russian officials also reported Monday a Ukrainian attack on industrial sites in Russia's Perm region, more than 1,000 kilometers (620 miles) from Ukraine. One person was killed in the attack, and 56 Ukrainian drones were downed, Perm Gov. Dmitri Makhonin said.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯官员周一还报告称，乌克兰对俄罗斯彼尔姆地区的工业场地发动袭击，该地区距乌克兰 1,000 多公里（620 英里）。彼尔姆州州长德米特里·马霍宁 (Dmitri Makhonin) 表示，袭击造成 1 人死亡，56 架乌克兰无人机被击落。

paras.en: "We keep finding ways to get back on our feet after every Russian attack," Zelenskyy said.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基说：“每次俄罗斯袭击后，我们都在寻找重新站起来的方法。”

paras.en: Ukrainian forces also struck the Russian dry cargo ship MV Angara, which Zelenskyy said Moscow used to transport weapons. He added that the forces also destroyed a Ka-27 military helicopter that was on the Merkury.
paras.zh: 乌克兰军队还袭击了俄罗斯干货船安加拉号，泽连斯基称莫斯科用该船运输武器。他补充说，部队还摧毁了水星号上的一架 Ka-27 军用直升机。

paras.en: Ukrainian forces are operating in western Libya under a covert deal endorsed by the West, using the North African country's territory to strike a Russian tanker in the Mediterranean in March, according to Libyan officials.
paras.zh: 据利比亚官员称，根据西方国家认可的一项秘密协议，乌克兰军队正在利比亚西部开展行动，三月份利用这个北非国家的领土在地中海袭击了一艘俄罗斯油轮。

paras.en: The Ukrainian forces, most of them drone experts, were operating mainly at an air base in the coastal city of Misrata, but also in other military facilities in the capital of Tripoli and the coastal town of Zawiya, the officials told The Associated Press earlier this year. They spoke on condition of anonymity to discuss confidential matters.
paras.zh: 官员们今年早些时候告诉美联社，乌克兰军队大多是无人机专家，主要在沿海城市米苏拉塔的一个空军基地开展行动，但也在首都的黎波里和沿海城镇扎维耶的其他军事设施进行行动。他们以匿名方式讨论机密问题。

paras.en: Sunday's attack severely damaged the Russian corvette at the Benghazi Naval Base in eastern Libya, according to two Libyan officials, although Zelenskyy claimed it was sunk.
paras.zh: 据两名利比亚官员称，周日的袭击严重损坏了利比亚东部班加西海军基地的俄罗斯护卫舰，尽管泽伦斯基声称该护卫舰已被击沉。

paras.en: Benghazi residents heard loud explosions and saw flames at the base early Sunday. Civil defense units rushed to the site and extinguished the fire, authorities in eastern Libya said.
paras.zh: 周日早些时候，班加西居民听到了巨大的爆炸声，并看到基地出现火焰。利比亚东部当局表示，民防部队赶到现场并扑灭了大火。

paras.en: The vessel had docked to refuel and take on supplies as part of an agreement between Russia and the eastern-based government in Libya, a statement said without providing details about the vessel or its cargo.
paras.zh: 一份声明称，作为俄罗斯与利比亚东部政府之间协议的一部分，该船停靠码头是为了加油和接收物资，但没有提供有关该船或其货物的详细信息。

paras.en: The government in eastern Libya sent a letter to U.N. Secretary-General António Guterres and the U.N. Security Council, calling for an international investigation into the potential use of western Libya to prepare and launch the attack.
paras.zh: 利比亚东部政府致函联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯和联合国安理会，呼吁对可能利用利比亚西部准备和发动袭击的情况进行国际调查。

paras.en: Libyan officials say 2 sea drones hit Russian warship
paras.zh: 利比亚官员称两架海上无人机击中俄罗斯军舰

paras.en: Libyan officials who were briefed on the attack told AP that at least four drones were intercepted while two hit the corvette, which is designed to patrol coastal waters and escort other ships.
paras.zh: 了解袭击情况的利比亚官员告诉美联社，至少四架无人机被拦截，其中两架击中了这艘护卫舰，这艘护卫舰旨在巡逻沿海水域并护送其他船只。

paras.en: At least 10 people, including Libyan and Russian nationals, were wounded in the attack, one of the officials said.
paras.zh: 一名官员称，至少 10 人在袭击中受伤，其中包括利比亚和俄罗斯国民。

paras.en: The officials, affiliated with the self-styled Libyan National Army, which controls eastern and southern Libya, spoke on condition of anonymity because they weren't allowed to talk with reporters.
paras.zh: 这些官员隶属于控制利比亚东部和南部的自称为利比亚国民军的官员，他们要求匿名，因为他们不被允许与记者交谈。

paras.en: Ambrey, a U.K.-based maritime security and risk intelligence firm, said that some of the explosions at the Benghazi Naval Base were likely caused by the detonation of ammunition aboard the Merkury.
paras.zh: 英国海上安全和风险情报公司安布雷表示，班加西海军基地的部分爆炸可能是由水星号上的弹药爆炸引起的。

paras.en: Hours after the warship attack, another sea drone strike hit a Maltese-flagged commercial vessel sailing off Benghazi, the Libyan coast guard said.
paras.zh: 利比亚海岸警卫队表示，军舰袭击事件发生数小时后，另一次海上无人机袭击了一艘在班加西附近航行的悬挂马耳他国旗的商船。

paras.en: The Russian cargo ship was sanctioned, Ukraine says
paras.zh: 乌克兰称俄罗斯货船受到制裁

paras.en: Ukraine's Security Service, or SBU, said the cargo ship MV Angara was sanctioned and used to transport Russian military equipment, while the Merkury regularly escorted Russian naval convoys, including guarding the MV Angara.
paras.zh: 乌克兰安全局（SBU）表示，MV Angara 号货船受到制裁，用于运输俄罗斯军事装备，而水星号定期护航俄罗斯海军护航队，包括护卫 MV Angara 号。

paras.en: The drones were delivered to a designated location and launched from a "mother ship" near the target, the SBU said.
paras.zh: SBU表示，这些无人机被运送到指定地点，并从目标附近的一艘“母船”发射。

paras.en: Russian defenses tried to intercept the attacking drones, it said.
paras.zh: 据称，俄罗斯防御系统试图拦截攻击无人机。

paras.en: "Ukraine's defense forces have once again shown that the Russian navy and its logistics have no safe routes," the SBU said.
paras.zh: SBU表示：“乌克兰国防军再次表明，俄罗斯海军及其后勤保障没有安全路线。”

articles.title: Democrats win House by largest margin in 50 years. And, COP31 ends with no deal
articles.author: Brittney Melton

paras.en: Democrats win House by largest margin in 50 years. And, COP31 ends with no deal
paras.zh: 民主党以 50 年来最大优势赢得众议院。而且，COP31 没有达成协议

paras.en: Vote counts are concluding for the 2026 midterm elections, revealing a better picture of just how much Democrats dominated. Fifty-six percent of voters chose the Democrats in House races compared to 42% for Republicans. The 14-point gap is the largest margin won by Democrats in 50 years. The party has officially won the largest majority in Congress since the early 1990s. Take a look at NPR's breakdown of the U.S. House races, by the numbers.
paras.zh: 2026 年中期选举的计票工作即将结束，这将更好地显示民主党的主导地位。 56% 的选民在众议院竞选中选择了民主党，而只有 42% 的选民选择了共和党。 14个百分点的差距是民主党50年来的最大优势。自 20 世纪 90 年代初以来，该党正式赢得了国会的最大多数席位。看看 NPR 对美国众议院竞选数据的详细分析。

paras.en: Artificial intelligence is causing significant swings in the stock market as investors speculate about the future of the technology boom. While AI stocks have driven markets to record highs and bolstered the economy, concerns are growing about a potential bubble. Investors anticipated that AI giant Anthropic's stock market debut last week would lift markets, but instead Wall Street experienced one of its worst weeks in recent times.
paras.zh: 随着投资者对科技繁荣的未来进行猜测，人工智能正在导致股市大幅波动。尽管人工智能股票推动市场创下历史新高并提振了经济，但人们对潜在泡沫的担忧与日俱增。投资者预计人工智能巨头 Anthropic 上周的上市将提振市场，但华尔街却经历了近年来最糟糕的一周之一。

paras.en: - 🎧 The National Association for Business Economics released a survey asking firms about their AI experiences. NPR's Scott Horsley tells Up First that one in five reported measurable, widespread productivity gains, while about half said they saw some gains, but they weren't widespread. About 30% were either not using AI or felt it was too soon to assess its impact. Austan Goolsbee, head of the Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago, pointed out that the significant investment in AI is already affecting the economy, contributing to inflation by increasing demand for construction materials and electronic components. Although proponents believe AI could eventually help lower costs and limit inflation, Goolsbee tells Horsley that the Federal Reserve must address inflation challenges right now.
paras.zh: - 🎧 美国商业经济协会发布了一项调查，询问企业的人工智能体验。 NPR 的斯科特·霍斯利 (Scott Horsley) 告诉 Up First，五分之一的人表示生产力得到了可衡量的、广泛的提高，而大约一半的人表示他们看到了一些进步，但并不普遍。大约 30% 的人要么没有使用人工智能，要么认为现在评估其影响还为时过早。芝加哥联邦储备银行行长奥斯坦·古尔斯比指出，对人工智能的大量投资已经影响了经济，通过增加对建筑材料和电子元件的需求而导致通货膨胀。尽管支持者认为人工智能最终可以帮助降低成本并限制通胀，但古尔斯比告诉霍斯利，美联储现在必须应对通胀挑战。

paras.en: Poland has called an emergency NATO session for today after Russia fired three cruise missiles into its territory. The incident highlights the stakes for European countries in Russia's war on Ukraine, prompting nations along NATO's eastern border to seek enhanced air defense support. Poland plans to present proposals to increase surveillance capabilities and deploy more F-35s to intercept incoming missiles and drones.
paras.zh: 在俄罗斯向其领土发射三枚巡航导弹后，波兰呼吁北约今天召开紧急会议。这一事件凸显了欧洲国家在俄罗斯对乌克兰战争中的利害关系，促使北约东部边境沿线国家寻求加强防空支持。波兰计划提出增强监视能力并部署更多 F-35 来拦截来袭导弹和无人机的提案。

paras.en: - 🎧 Anti-missile systems and NATO flights were activated successfully, but Polish authorities say that poor weather prevented them from intercepting the incoming Russian missiles, according to reporter Teri Schultz. No injuries or damage were reported. More than a year ago, NATO established the Eastern Sentry to enhance air defense after a significant drone swarm from Russia entered Poland. Experts are now scrutinizing potential gaps in this defense. If this attack was deliberate by Moscow, Russia is risking severe consequences by endangering the lives of people on the ground in a NATO country, Schultz says.
paras.zh: - 据记者泰里·舒尔茨报道，反导弹系统和北约航班已成功启动，但波兰当局表示，恶劣的天气使他们无法拦截来袭的俄罗斯导弹。没有人员受伤或损坏的报告。一年多前，在俄罗斯大批无人机进入波兰后，北约建立了东部哨兵部队以加强防空。专家们现在正在仔细研究这种防御中的潜在漏洞。舒尔茨说，如果这次袭击是莫斯科故意的，那么俄罗斯将面临严重后果的风险，危及北约国家当地人民的生命。

paras.en: Delegates at COP31 in Antalya, Turkey, couldn't agree on a plan over the weekend to address fossil fuels, the main cause of climate change. The event ran two days longer than expected, making it the longest in the history of these summits. Nearly 200 nations failed to finalize targets for electrification and financial aid for developing countries, or to address the impacts of climate change. The European Union rejected any conclusion that didn't advocate for a transition away from fossil fuels, while oil-producing countries like Saudi Arabia opposed this position. Fossil fuels contribute about 73% of global emissions.
paras.zh: 周末，在土耳其安塔利亚举行的第 31 次缔约方大会 (COP31) 上，代表们未能就解决气候变化主要原因的化石燃料问题的计划达成一致。此次活动比预期时间长了两天，成为这些峰会历史上最长的一次。近 200 个国家未能最终确定发展中国家的电气化和财政援助目标，或解决气候变化影响的目标。欧盟拒绝接受任何不提倡摆脱化石燃料的结论，而沙特阿拉伯等石油生产国则反对这一立场。化石燃料约占全球排放量的 73%。

paras.en: - 🎧 Ultimately, the EU decided that no COP deal was better than a deal that didn't address fossil fuels, NPR's Rachel Waldholz says. She adds that money was another major issue. Developing nations sought increased support to tackle climate change, noting that they've contributed very little to climate change but often deal with the worst impacts. Wealthy nations agreed to provide funding under the Paris Climate Agreement. The U.S. was absent from the discussions due to the Trump administration's withdrawal from international climate negotiations. Many smaller and developing nations are strong defenders of these talks, viewing them as a vital platform to ensure their voices are heard alongside larger countries, Waldholz says.
paras.zh: - 🎧 NPR 的 Rachel Waldholz 表示，最终，欧盟认为没有 COP 协议比没有解决化石燃料问题的协议更好。她补充说，钱是另一个主要问题。发展中国家寻求更多支持来应对气候变化，并指出它们对气候变化的贡献很小，但往往要应对最严重的影响。富裕国家同意根据《巴黎气候协定》提供资金。由于特朗普政府退出国际气候谈判，美国缺席了讨论。瓦尔德霍尔茨说，许多较小的发展中国家是这些谈判的坚定捍卫者，将其视为确保其声音与大国一起被听到的重要平台。

paras.en: NPR's annual reading guide, Books We Love, is back with more than 380 new recommendations from staff and trusted critics. This year's picks span a range of genres, including fiction, cookbooks, children's reads, poetry and science fiction. Don't worry if it looks overwhelming; the interactive filters will help you narrow down your list and find your next great read. And why stop at this year's reads? The Books We Love archive has 14 years of recommendations, so you can discover more than 4,700 amazing books, all in one place. This year's edition of Books We Love is dedicated to Rose Friedman, who edited a dozen editions and worked at NPR for 15 years before her death this year at age 38. Friedman was one of the original founders of Books We Love, formerly known as The Book Concierge. In her honor, start exploring and find something wonderful to read today.
paras.zh: NPR 年度阅读指南《我们喜爱的书籍》强势回归，带来了来自工作人员和值得信赖的评论家的 380 多条新推荐。今年的精选内容涵盖多种类型，包括小说、烹饪书、儿童读物、诗歌和科幻小说。如果它看起来令人难以承受，请不要担心；交互式过滤器将帮助您缩小列表范围并找到下一本精彩的读物。为什么只停留在今年的阅读上呢？我们喜爱的书籍档案库拥有 14 年的推荐，因此您可以在一个地方发现 4,700 多本精彩的书籍。今年的《我们爱的书》一期是献给罗丝·弗里德曼的，她编辑了十几个版本，并在 NPR 工作了 15 年，直到今年 38 岁去世。弗里德曼是《我们爱的书》的最初创始人之一，以前称为“图书礼宾”。为了纪念她，今天就开始探索并找到一些精彩的内容来阅读吧。

paras.en: by Maria Godoy, senior science and health editor and correspondent
paras.zh: 作者：Maria Godoy，科学与健康高级编辑兼通讯员

paras.en: People had warned me it might be tough to get Amish people to talk to me as a journalist — and probably impossible to get their permission to record their voice. Not a great omen for compelling radio storytelling.
paras.zh: 人们警告我，让阿米什人以记者的身份与我交谈可能很困难，而且可能不可能获得他们的许可来录制他们的声音。对于引人注目的广播故事来说，这不是一个好兆头。

paras.en: Yet as I headed off to Lancaster County, Pa., last month to report on the biggest and deadliest measles outbreak in the U.S. in decades, I knew I wanted to hear directly from the community hit hardest.
paras.zh: 然而，当我上个月前往宾夕法尼亚州兰开斯特县报道美国数十年来最大规模、最致命的麻疹疫情时，我知道我想直接听到受灾最严重的社区的声音。

paras.en: So I turned to some good old shoe-leather reporting. My producer and I mapped out Amish-owned businesses in and around Lancaster County and spent a day driving around from shop to shop. At every stop, we introduced ourselves and explained the focus of our story. We asked Amish people (easily identifiable by their traditional dress) about their views on the measles outbreak and vaccination. While some declined to talk, others opened up about how measles had affected their families and communities, and why they had or hadn't decided to get vaccinated. To my surprise, one woman even let me record her voice.
paras.zh: 所以我转向一些好的旧鞋皮报告。我和我的制片人绘制了兰开斯特县及其周边地区阿米什人拥有的企业的地图，并花了一天的时间开车从一家商店逛到另一家商店。在每一站，我们都会进行自我介绍并解释故事的重点。我们询问阿米什人（通过他们的传统服饰很容易辨认）对麻疹疫情和疫苗接种的看法。虽然有些人拒绝谈论，但其他人则敞开心扉讲述麻疹如何影响他们的家庭和社区，以及为什么他们决定或没有决定接种疫苗。令我惊讶的是，一位女士甚至让我录下她的声音。

paras.en: Outside a farm supply store in a rural town, I met an Amish woman who was visibly pregnant. Measles can have devastating consequences during pregnancy. She told me her husband and two children had gotten vaccinated to protect her and her unborn child. She declined to give me her name at first, then got in a car driven by her hired non-Amish driver. As they exited the parking lot, the driver stopped to ask us what media outlet we were with. "Oh, NPR!" the driver said when we replied. Then she turned to her Amish passenger and told her, "Don't worry, you can trust them."
paras.zh: 在一个乡村小镇的一家农用品商店外，我遇到了一位明显怀孕的阿米什妇女。麻疹可能会在怀孕期间产生毁灭性的后果。她告诉我，她的丈夫和两个孩子已经接种了疫苗，以保护她和她未出生的孩子。她一开始拒绝透露自己的名字，然后上了一辆由她雇用的非阿米什人司机驾驶的汽车。当他们离开停车场时，司机停下来问我们是哪家媒体。 “哦，美国国家公共广播电台！”当我们回复时，司机说道。然后她转向她的阿米什乘客并告诉她：“别担心，你可以相信他们。”

paras.en: - Bayer could pay up to $7.25 billion to settle lawsuits alleging that its weed-killer Roundup caused cancer. A Missouri judge gave final approval to the nationwide settlement.
paras.zh: - 拜耳可能支付高达 72.5 亿美元的费用来和解指控其除草剂农达致癌的诉讼。密苏里州法官最终批准了全国范围内的和解方案。

paras.en: - South Africa's grassroots program Read Alex is tackling a children's literacy crisis and inspiring kids to write. The initiative culminated in a book launch for an anthology titled From Gomora to the World, showcasing stories written by children.
paras.zh: - 南非的草根项目“Read Alex”正在解决儿童识字危机并激励孩子们写作。该倡议最终以题为《从哥莫拉到世界》的选集新书发布会告终，展示了儿童写的故事。

paras.en: - Orchestra Noir transforms 2000s hip-hop and R&B classics into high-energy, choreographed symphonic shows. Beyond delivering performances, the all-Black ensemble creates a cultural bridge through their post-show ritual, when musicians meet with their multigenerational audiences.
paras.zh: - Orchestra Noir 将 2000 年代的嘻哈和 R&B 经典转变为充满活力、精心编排的交响乐表演。除了表演之外，全黑人乐团还通过演出后的仪式（音乐家与多代观众见面）建立了一座文化桥梁。

articles.title: Russian incursions into NATO territory are increasing
articles.author: Esme Nicholson

paras.en: Russian incursions into NATO territory are increasing NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte is seeking to reassure the alliance's eastern European members after three Russian cruise missiles landed in Poland on Friday.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯对北约领土的入侵正在增加，周五三枚俄罗斯巡航导弹落在波兰后，北约秘书长马克·吕特正在寻求安抚北约东欧成员国。
